activities.description: Allow to fully colour for premium market. Pick before softening.
activities.why: Coloured capsicum fetches 2–3× higher price than green.
activities.description_si: උසස් වෙළඳපොළ සඳහා සම්පූර්ණයෙන් වර්ණය ගැනීමට ඉඩ හරින්න. මෘදු වීමට පෙර නෙළන්න.
activities.description_ta: உயர்தரச் சந்தைக்கு முழுமையாக நிறம் மாற விடுங்கள். மென்மையாவதற்கு முன் பறியுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: වර්ණවත් මාළු මිරිස්වලට අමු ඒවාට වඩා 2–3 ගුණයක් ඉහළ මිලක් ලැබේ.
activities.why_ta: நிறமுள்ள குடைமிளகாய்க்குப் பச்சையை விட 2–3 மடங்கு அதிக விலை கிடைக்கும்.

stages.description_si: අමු හෝ සම්පූර්ණයෙන් වර්ණවත් වූ අවධියේ අස්වනු නෙළන්න.
stages.description_ta: பச்சை நிலையிலோ முழுமையாக நிறம் மாறிய நிலையிலோ அறுவடை செய்யுங்கள்.

fertilization.why_si: ඉහළ වටිනාකමක් ඇති බෝගයක් සඳහා පෝෂක බහුල පදනම.

irrigation.notes: Very sensitive to water stress. Consistent moisture is essential for uniform fruit sizing.
irrigation.notes_si: ජල ආතතියට ඉතා සංවේදීය. ඒකාකාර ප්‍රමාණයේ ගෙඩි ලැබීමට නොකඩවා තෙතමනය අත්‍යවශ්‍යයි.
irrigation.notes_ta: நீர் அழுத்தத்துக்கு மிகவும் உணர்திறன் உடையது. சீரான அளவுக் காய்களுக்குத் தொடர்ச்சியான ஈரப்பதம் அவசியம்.

diseases.name: Bacterial Wilt
diseases.symptoms: Sudden wilting and plant death; vascular browning visible in stem cross-section.
diseases.favorable_conditions: Wet, warm soil conditions, poor drainage, previously infected plots.
diseases.prevention: Crop rotation. Raised beds. Avoid Solanaceae family for 3+ years.
diseases.treatment: No cure. Remove and destroy infected plants. Lime affected soil.
diseases.symptoms_si: හදිසියේ මැලවී පැළය මිය යාම; කඳේ හරස්කඩේ සන්නායක පටක දුඹුරු පැහැයෙන් පෙනේ.
diseases.symptoms_ta: திடீர் வாடலும் செடி இறப்பும்; தண்டின் குறுக்குவெட்டில் கடத்துத் திசு பழுப்பாகத் தெரியும்.
diseases.favorable_conditions_si: තෙත්, උණුසුම් පස, දුර්වල ජලාපවහනය, කලින් ආසාදනය වූ බිම්.
diseases.favorable_conditions_ta: ஈரமான, வெப்பமான மண், மோசமான வடிகால், முன்பு பாதிக்கப்பட்ட நிலங்கள்.
diseases.prevention_si: බෝග මාරුව. උස් කළ පාත්ති. අවුරුදු 3කට වැඩි කාලයක් Solanaceae කුලයේ බෝග නොවගා කරන්න.
diseases.prevention_ta: பயிர்ச் சுழற்சி. உயர்த்திய பாத்திகள். 3 ஆண்டுகளுக்கு மேல் Solanaceae குடும்பப் பயிர்களைத் தவிருங்கள்.
diseases.treatment_si: ප්‍රතිකාරයක් නැත. ආසාදිත පැළ ඉවත් කර විනාශ කරන්න. බලපෑමට ලක් වූ පසට හුණු යොදන්න.
diseases.treatment_ta: சிகிச்சை இல்லை. பாதிக்கப்பட்ட செடிகளை அகற்றி அழியுங்கள். பாதிக்கப்பட்ட மண்ணுக்குச் சுண்ணாம்பு இடுங்கள்.

diseases.name: Viral Mosaic
diseases.symptoms: Mosaic patterns, leaf distortion, stunted growth, poor fruit set.
diseases.favorable_conditions: High aphid/thrips populations; hot dry weather.
diseases.prevention: Control vectors. Use virus-free transplants. Remove infected plants.
diseases.treatment: No cure. Manage vectors: Imidacloprid (0.3 ml/L) for aphids; Spinosad for thrips.
diseases.symptoms_si: මොසෙයික් රටා, කොළ විකෘති වීම, වර්ධනය බාල වීම, ගෙඩි හටගැනීම දුර්වල වීම.
diseases.symptoms_ta: தேமல் வடிவங்கள், இலை உருக்குலைவு, வளர்ச்சிக் குன்றல், காய் பிடிப்பு குறைதல்.
diseases.favorable_conditions_si: කුඩිත්තා/ත්‍රිප්ස් ගහනය වැඩි වීම; උණුසුම් වියළි කාලගුණය.
diseases.favorable_conditions_ta: அதிக அசுவினி/இலைப்பேன்; வெப்பமான வறண்ட வானிலை.
diseases.prevention_si: වාහක කෘමීන් පාලනය කරන්න. වෛරසවලින් තොර පැළ භාවිත කරන්න. ආසාදිත පැළ ඉවත් කරන්න.
diseases.prevention_ta: நோய் பரப்பும் பூச்சிகளைக் கட்டுப்படுத்துங்கள். வைரஸற்ற நாற்றுகளைப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள். பாதிக்கப்பட்ட செடிகளை அகற்றுங்கள்.
diseases.treatment_si: ප්‍රතිකාරයක් නැත. වාහක පාලනය: කුඩිත්තන්ට Imidacloprid (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 0.3); ත්‍රිප්ස්වලට Spinosad.
diseases.treatment_ta: சிகிச்சை இல்லை. நோய் பரப்பிகளைக் கட்டுப்படுத்துங்கள்: அசுவினிக்கு Imidacloprid (லிட்டருக்கு 0.3 மி.லி); இலைப்பேனுக்கு Spinosad.

pests.name: Thrips
pests.damage: Damages flowers and young fruits; causes silvering, distortion, and reduced fruit set.
pests.identification: Tiny yellowish insects in flowers and leaf folds; silvery scarring.
pests.prevention: Blue sticky traps. Reflective mulch. Remove infested flowers.
pests.treatment: Spinosad 45SC (0.3 ml/L) or Fipronil. Apply early morning.
pests.prevention_si: නිල් ඇලෙන උගුල්. ආලෝකය පරාවර්තනය කරන වසුන්. ආසාදිත මල් ඉවත් කරන්න.
pests.prevention_ta: நீல ஒட்டும் பொறிகள். ஒளியைப் பிரதிபலிக்கும் மூடாக்கு. பாதிக்கப்பட்ட பூக்களை அகற்றுங்கள்.
pests.treatment_si: Spinosad 45SC (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 0.3) හෝ Fipronil. අලුයම යොදන්න.
pests.treatment_ta: Spinosad 45SC (லிட்டருக்கு 0.3 மி.லி) அல்லது Fipronil. அதிகாலையில் தெளியுங்கள்.
pests.damage_si: මල් සහ ළපටි ගෙඩිවලට හානි කරයි; රිදී පැහැය, විකෘති වීම සහ ගෙඩි හටගැනීම අඩු වීම ඇති කරයි.
pests.damage_ta: பூக்களையும் இளம் காய்களையும் சேதப்படுத்தும்; வெள்ளி நிறம், உருக்குலைவு, காய் பிடிப்புக் குறைவு ஏற்படும்.
pests.identification_si: මල් සහ කොළ නැමුම් තුළ කුඩා කහ පැහැති කෘමීන්; රිදී පැහැති කැළැල්.
pests.identification_ta: பூக்களிலும் இலை மடிப்புகளிலும் சிறிய மஞ்சள் பூச்சிகள்; வெள்ளி நிறத் தழும்புகள்.

pests.name: Aphid
pests.damage: Sucks sap; major vector of viral mosaic diseases.
pests.identification: Dense colonies on new shoots and leaf undersides.
pests.prevention: Yellow sticky traps. Neem oil spray. Reflective mulch.
pests.treatment: Imidacloprid 200SL (0.3 ml/L).
pests.prevention_si: කහ ඇලෙන උගුල්. කොහොඹ තෙල් ඉසීම. ආලෝකය පරාවර්තනය කරන වසුන්.
pests.prevention_ta: மஞ்சள் ஒட்டும் பொறிகள். வேப்ப எண்ணெய் தெளிப்பு. ஒளியைப் பிரதிபலிக்கும் மூடாக்கு.
pests.treatment_si: Imidacloprid 200SL (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 0.3).
pests.treatment_ta: Imidacloprid 200SL (லிட்டருக்கு 0.3 மி.லி).
pests.damage_si: යුෂ උරා බොයි; මොසෙයික් වෛරස රෝගවල ප්‍රධාන වාහකයාය.
pests.damage_ta: சாற்றை உறிஞ்சும்; தேமல் வைரஸ் நோய்களைப் பரப்பும் முக்கியப் பூச்சி.
pests.identification_si: නව දළු සහ කොළවල යටි පැත්තේ ඝන ජනපද.
pests.identification_ta: புதிய தளிர்களிலும் இலைகளின் அடிப்பக்கத்திலும் அடர்த்தியான கூட்டங்கள்.

pests.name: Fruit Borer
pests.damage: Larvae bore into fruits reducing market quality.
pests.identification: Entry holes with frass on fruit surface.
pests.prevention: Pheromone traps. Remove infested fruits immediately.
pests.treatment: Spinosad 45SC (0.3 ml/L) at first fruit set.
pests.prevention_si: ෆෙරමෝන උගුල්. ආසාදිත ගෙඩි වහාම ඉවත් කරන්න.
pests.prevention_ta: இனக்கவர்ச்சிப் பொறிகள். பாதிக்கப்பட்ட காய்களை உடனே அகற்றுங்கள்.
pests.treatment_si: පළමු ගෙඩි හටගන්නා විට Spinosad 45SC (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 0.3).
pests.treatment_ta: முதல் காய் பிடிக்கும் போது Spinosad 45SC (லிட்டருக்கு 0.3 மி.லி).
pests.damage_si: කීටයෝ ගෙඩි තුළට විද වෙළඳපොළ ගුණාත්මකභාවය අඩු කරයි.
pests.damage_ta: புழுக்கள் காய்களைத் துளைத்து சந்தைத் தரத்தைக் குறைக்கும்.
pests.identification_si: ගෙඩියේ මතුපිට අසූචි සහිත ඇතුළු වූ සිදුරු.
pests.identification_ta: காயின் மேற்பரப்பில் கழிவுடன் நுழைவுத் துளைகள்.

pests.name: Whitefly
pests.damage: Sucks sap; causes yellowing and may transmit viruses.
pests.identification: White clouds when plants disturbed; sticky honeydew on leaves.
pests.prevention: Yellow sticky traps. Neem oil spray.
pests.treatment: Imidacloprid 200SL (0.3 ml/L).
pests.prevention_si: කහ ඇලෙන උගුල්. කොහොඹ තෙල් ඉසීම.
pests.prevention_ta: மஞ்சள் ஒட்டும் பொறிகள். வேப்ப எண்ணெய் தெளிப்பு.
pests.treatment_si: Imidacloprid 200SL (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 0.3).
pests.treatment_ta: Imidacloprid 200SL (லிட்டருக்கு 0.3 மி.லி).
pests.damage_si: යුෂ උරා බොයි; කහ වීම ඇති කරන අතර වෛරස පැතිරවිය හැක.
pests.damage_ta: சாற்றை உறிஞ்சும்; மஞ்சளாதலை ஏற்படுத்தும், வைரஸ்களையும் பரப்பலாம்.
pests.identification_si: පැළ සෙලවූ විට සුදු කෘමි රංචු ඉගිලේ; කොළ මත ඇලෙන සුළු මී පැණි වැනි ස්‍රාවයක්.
pests.identification_ta: செடியை அசைத்தால் வெள்ளைப் பூச்சிக் கூட்டங்கள் பறக்கும்; இலைகளில் ஒட்டும் தேன் போன்ற திரவம்.

risks.name: Low Temperature (<15°C)
risks.description: Poor fruit set and colour development.
risks.mitigation: Use polytunnel or frost cover in up-country during cold nights.
risks.description_si: ගෙඩි හටගැනීම සහ වර්ණ වර්ධනය දුර්වල වේ.
risks.description_ta: காய் பிடிப்பும் நிற வளர்ச்சியும் குறையும்.
risks.signs_si: කුඩා, හැඩය වෙනස් ගෙඩි, වර්ධනය මන්දගාමී වීම.
risks.mitigation_si: උඩරට සීතල රාත්‍රීවලදී පොලිතීන් උමං ගෘහ හෝ ආවරණ භාවිත කරන්න.
risks.mitigation_ta: மலைநாட்டில் குளிரான இரவுகளில் பொலித்தீன் சுரங்கக் கூடாரம் அல்லது பனி மூடியைப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள்.

risks.name: Drought
risks.description: Blossom drop and fruit cracking.
risks.mitigation: Drip irrigation. Mulch heavily.
risks.description_si: මල් හැලීම සහ ගෙඩි ඉරිතැලීම.
risks.description_ta: பூ உதிர்வும் காய் வெடிப்பும்.
risks.signs_si: මල් හැලීම, ඉරිතැලුණු ගෙඩි.
risks.mitigation_si: බිංදු ජලසම්පාදනය. ඝනව වසුන් යොදන්න.
risks.mitigation_ta: சொட்டு நீர்ப்பாசனம். தடிமனாக மூடாக்கு இடுங்கள்.

indicators: Green → yellow/red colour change for coloured stage
harvest.method: Cut with sharp knife leaving 2 cm stalk.
harvest.post_harvest: Grade by size and colour. Pack carefully in ventilated boxes. Refrigerate at 8–12°C if possible.
harvest.method_si: සෙ.මී. 2ක නටුවක් ඉතිරි කරමින් තියුණු පිහියකින් කපන්න.
harvest.method_ta: 2 செ.மீ காம்பை விட்டு கூர்மையான கத்தியால் வெட்டுங்கள்.
harvest.post_harvest_si: ප්‍රමාණය සහ වර්ණය අනුව වර්ග කරන්න. වාතාශ්‍රය ඇති පෙට්ටිවල ප්‍රවේශමෙන් අසුරන්න. හැකි නම් 8–12°C ශීතකරණයක තබන්න.
harvest.post_harvest_ta: அளவு, நிறம் அடிப்படையில் தரம் பிரியுங்கள். காற்றோட்டமுள்ள பெட்டிகளில் கவனமாகப் பொதியிடுங்கள். முடிந்தால் 8–12°C குளிரூட்டியில் வையுங்கள்.
indicators_si: වර්ණවත් අවධිය සඳහා කොළ → කහ/රතු වර්ණ වෙනස
indicators_ta: நிறமுள்ள நிலைக்குப் பச்சை → மஞ்சள்/சிவப்பு நிற மாற்றம்

Capsicum.growth_stages_text: Capsicum cultivation follows several important growth stages including germination, nursery development, vegetative growth, flowering, fruit setting, and harvesting. Seeds usually germinate within 7–14 days, after which seedlings are raised in a nursery for about 3–5 weeks before transplanting. Vegetative growth continues for 25–40 days after transplanting, followed by flowering around 45–60 days. Fruit set occurs shortly after flowering, and harvesting typically begins within 70–90 days after transplanting when fruits reach proper size and color development. Farmers commonly use transplanting methods and maintain spacing of approximately 45–60 cm between plants and 60–75 cm between rows to ensure adequate sunlight penetration, airflow, and healthy fruit development.
Capsicum.management_text: Successful capsicum cultivation requires a structured week-by-week crop management plan including nursery preparation, land preparation, transplanting, fertilizer application, irrigation, weed control, staking, pest monitoring, and harvesting activities. Fertilizer application is important during vegetative growth and flowering stages, commonly using nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium fertilizers, and organic compost to support strong plant growth and improve fruit size, color, and quality. Irrigation frequency is highest during flowering and fruit setting stages due to high water demand, while moderate irrigation is maintained during vegetative growth to prevent excessive leaf growth. Harvesting indicators include firm fruits with bright color (green, red, or yellow depending on variety) and proper size before over-ripening occurs.
Capsicum.disease_management_text: Disease and pest management are essential in capsicum cultivation. Aphids, thrips, and whiteflies suck plant sap, causing leaf curling, yellowing, and reduced plant vigor. Fruit borers damage developing fruits internally, leading to reduced market value. Bacterial wilt causes sudden wilting and plant death due to vascular infection, while viral diseases may cause mosaic patterns, leaf distortion, and stunted growth. These problems can be managed through crop rotation, field sanitation, removal of infected plants, use of resistant varieties, insect traps, biological control methods, and recommended pesticide or fungicide applications when necessary. Risk mitigation practices such as regular field monitoring, proper irrigation management, balanced fertilizer use, staking support systems, and integrated pest management techniques help reduce crop losses and improve overall productivity.
Capsicum.overview_si: ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ “මාළු මිරිස්” ලෙස හැඳින්වෙන මාළු මිරිස් (Capsicum annuum) Solanaceae කුලයට අයත්, ඉහළ වටිනාකමක් ඇති එළවළු බෝගයකි. ගෙඩි හටගැනීමට සහ වර්ණ වර්ධනයට සුදුසු උෂ්ණත්වයක් ඇති නුවරඑළිය, බදුල්ල, මහනුවර වැනි සිසිල් සහ අතරමැදි ප්‍රදේශවල එය ප්‍රධාන වශයෙන් වගා කෙරේ. මාළු මිරිස් 18°C–28°C අතර උෂ්ණත්වයේ හොඳින් වැඩෙන අතර, pH 6.0–6.8 අතර, කාබනික ද්‍රව්‍ය බහුල, හොඳින් ජලය බැස යන සාරවත් ලෝම පසක් අවශ්‍ය වේ. නිරෝගී වර්ධනයට සහ උසස් ගුණාත්මක ගෙඩි ලැබීමට මධ්‍යස්ථ වර්ෂාව, නිතිපතා ජලසම්පාදනය සහ හොඳ හිරු එළිය අවශ්‍යය. ශ්‍රී ලාංකික ආහාරවල ව්‍යංජන, සලාද සහ බැදුම් සඳහා මාළු මිරිස් බහුලව භාවිත වන අතර, විටමින් C බහුල බැවින් පෝෂණීය වටිනාකමක් ඇත. ප්‍රභේදය සහ වගා තත්ත්ව අනුව පැළ සිටුවීමෙන් දින 70–90ක් පමණ ගත වූ පසු අස්වනු නෙළීම ආරම්භ වේ. උෂ්ණත්වය, පාංශු තෙතමනය, වර්ෂාව, හිරු එළිය, ආර්ද්‍රතාව සහ පසේ සාරවත්බව වගාවට බලපාන ප්‍රධාන සාධක වේ. කුඩිත්තා, ත්‍රිප්ස්, සුදු මැස්සා, ගෙඩි විදින දළඹුවා, බැක්ටීරියා මැලවීම සහ වෛරස ආසාදන පොදු පළිබෝධ හා රෝග වන අතර, නිසි ලෙස පාලනය නොකළහොත් ඒවා අස්වැන්න සහ ගෙඩිවල ගුණාත්මකභාවය අඩු කරයි.
Capsicum.overview_ta: இலங்கையில் “மாலு மிரிஸ்” என அழைக்கப்படும் குடைமிளகாய் (Capsicum annuum), Solanaceae குடும்பத்தைச் சேர்ந்த அதிக மதிப்புள்ள ஒரு காய்கறிப் பயிர். காய் பிடிப்புக்கும் நிற வளர்ச்சிக்கும் ஏற்ற வெப்பநிலை உள்ள நுவரெலியா, பதுளை, கண்டி போன்ற குளிர்ந்த மற்றும் இடைப் பகுதிகளில் இது முக்கியமாகப் பயிரிடப்படுகிறது. குடைமிளகாய் 18°C–28°C வெப்பநிலையில் நன்றாக வளரும்; pH 6.0–6.8 உள்ள, கரிமப் பொருள் நிறைந்த, நன்கு நீர் வடியும் வளமான இருமண் தேவை. ஆரோக்கியமான வளர்ச்சி மற்றும் தரமான காய் உற்பத்திக்கு மிதமான மழை, தொடர்ச்சியான நீர்ப்பாசனம், நல்ல சூரிய ஒளி அவசியம். இலங்கை உணவில் கறி, சாலட், வதக்கல் ஆகியவற்றுக்குக் குடைமிளகாய் பரவலாகப் பயன்படுகிறது; விட்டமின் C நிறைந்திருப்பதால் ஊட்டச்சத்து மதிப்புடையது. இனம் மற்றும் வளர்ப்பு நிலைமைகளைப் பொறுத்து நாற்று நட்டு சுமார் 70–90 நாட்களில் அறுவடை தொடங்கும். வெப்பநிலை, மண் ஈரப்பதம், மழை, சூரிய ஒளி, காற்று ஈரப்பதம், மண் வளம் ஆகியவை சாகுபடியைப் பாதிக்கும் முக்கியக் காரணிகள். அசுவினி, இலைப்பேன், வெள்ளை ஈ, காய்த் துளைப்பான், பாக்டீரியா வாடல், வைரஸ் தொற்றுகள் ஆகியவை பொதுவான பூச்சிகளும் நோய்களும்; சரியாகக் கட்டுப்படுத்தாவிட்டால் இவை மகசூலையும் காயின் தரத்தையும் குறைக்கும்.

Potato.overview: Potato, commonly known as “Ala” in Sri Lanka, is a cool-climate tuber crop belonging to the Solanaceae family and scientifically known as Solanum tuberosum. It is mainly cultivated in the up-country regions of Sri Lanka such as Nuwara Eliya, Badulla, and Kandy where lower temperatures are favorable for tuber formation and growth. Potato grows best in temperatures between 15°C and 20°C and requires deep, fertile, well-drained sandy loam soil with a soil pH ranging from 5.0 to 6.5. The crop needs moderate rainfall, regular irrigation, and full sunlight exposure for healthy plant growth and high tuber yield. Potatoes are one of the most important food crops in Sri Lanka and are widely used in curries, fried dishes, and various food preparations due to their high carbohydrate content and nutritional value. The crop is generally harvested within 90 to 120 days after planting depending on the variety and climatic conditions. Important factors affecting potato cultivation include temperature, soil moisture, rainfall, sunlight, humidity, and soil fertility. Common pests and diseases include potato tuber moth, aphids, late blight, early blight, bacterial wilt, and fungal tuber rot, which can significantly reduce yield and tuber quality if not properly managed.

stages.name: Land Preparation

activities.title: Deep plough to 40 cm
activities.description: Break all clods. Potato tubers need loose soil to develop freely.
activities.why: Compacted soil causes deformed small tubers.
activities.description_si: සියලු පස් කැට කඩන්න. අල නිදහසේ වැඩීමට ලිහිල් පසක් අවශ්‍යය.
activities.description_ta: எல்லா மண் கட்டிகளையும் உடையுங்கள். கிழங்குகள் தடையின்றி வளர இளகிய மண் தேவை.
activities.why_si: තද වූ පස නිසා හැඩය වෙනස් කුඩා අල හටගනී.
activities.why_ta: இறுகிய மண்ணால் உருக்குலைந்த சிறிய கிழங்குகள் உருவாகும்.

activities.title: Apply compost and lime
activities.description: Compost 15 t/ha + agricultural lime to bring pH to 5.5–6.0.
activities.why: Potato scab is worse in alkaline soils above pH 6.5.
activities.description_si: හෙක්ටයාරයකට ටොන් 15ක් කොම්පෝස්ට් + pH 5.5–6.0 දක්වා ගෙන ඒමට කෘෂිකාර්මික හුණු.
activities.description_ta: எக்டேருக்கு 15 டன் மக்கிய உரம் + pH-ஐ 5.5–6.0க்குக் கொண்டுவர விவசாயச் சுண்ணாம்பு.
activities.why_si: pH 6.5ට වැඩි ක්ෂාරීය පසේ අල ගොරෝසු (ස්කැබ්) රෝගය වැඩිය.
activities.why_ta: pH 6.5க்கு மேற்பட்ட காரத்தன்மை மண்ணில் உருளைச் சொறி (ஸ்கேப்) நோய் அதிகம்.

stages.description_si: අල වර්ධනය සඳහා ගැඹුරු බිම් සැකසීම.

stages.name: Planting & Emergence
stages.description: Plant seed tubers and encourage emergence.

activities.title: Plant seed tubers
activities.description: Place 60–80 g seed tubers in furrows 10 cm deep. Cover with soil. Spray with Mancozeb before planting to prevent seed tuber rot.
activities.why: Healthy seed tubers are the foundation of a good crop.
activities.description_si: ග්‍රෑ. 60–80 බීජ අල සෙ.මී. 10ක් ගැඹුරු ඇළවල තබන්න. පසින් වසන්න. බීජ අල කුණුවීම වැළැක්වීමට සිටුවීමට පෙර Mancozeb ඉසින්න.
activities.description_ta: 60–80 கி விதைக் கிழங்குகளை 10 செ.மீ ஆழச் சால்களில் வையுங்கள். மண்ணால் மூடுங்கள். விதைக் கிழங்கு அழுகலைத் தடுக்க நடுவதற்கு முன் Mancozeb தெளியுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: නිරෝගී බීජ අල හොඳ අස්වැන්නක පදනමයි.
activities.why_ta: ஆரோக்கியமான விதைக் கிழங்குகளே நல்ல பயிரின் அடித்தளம்.

activities.title: Irrigate if no rain
activities.description: Maintain soil moisture but avoid waterlogging.
activities.why: Consistent moisture ensures uniform sprouting.
activities.description_si: පසේ තෙතමනය පවත්වා ගන්න, නමුත් ජලය රැඳීමෙන් වළකින්න.
activities.description_ta: மண் ஈரப்பதத்தைப் பேணுங்கள்; ஆனால் நீர் தேங்குவதைத் தவிருங்கள்.
activities.why_si: නොකඩවා තෙතමනය ඒකාකාර පැළ මතුවීම සහතික කරයි.
activities.why_ta: தொடர்ச்சியான ஈரப்பதம் சீரான முளைப்பை உறுதிசெய்யும்.

activities.title: Check emergence
activities.description: 80% emergence should occur by day 14–18.
activities.why: Poor emergence may indicate seed tuber rot — check a few plants.
activities.description_si: 14–18 දින වන විට පැළ 80%ක් මතු විය යුතුය.
activities.description_ta: 14–18 நாட்களில் 80% முளைப்பு இருக்க வேண்டும்.
activities.why_si: පැළ මතුවීම අඩු නම් බීජ අල කුණුවීමක් විය හැක — පැළ කිහිපයක් පරීක්ෂා කරන්න.
activities.why_ta: முளைப்பு குறைவாக இருந்தால் விதைக் கிழங்கு அழுகலாக இருக்கலாம் — சில செடிகளைச் சோதியுங்கள்.

stages.description_si: බීජ අල සිටුවා පැළ මතුවීම දිරිමත් කරන්න.

stages.name: Vegetative Growth
stages.description: Build foliage for photosynthesis and tuber fill.

activities.title: Top dressing 1
activities.description: Urea 100 kg/ha between rows.
activities.why: High nitrogen demand during rapid foliage growth.
activities.description_si: පේළි අතරට යූරියා හෙක්ටයාරයකට කි.ග්‍රෑ. 100.
activities.description_ta: வரிசைகளுக்கு இடையே எக்டேருக்கு 100 கி.கி யூரியா.
activities.why_si: පත්‍ර වේගයෙන් වැඩෙන කාලයේ නයිට්‍රජන් ඉල්ලුම ඉහළය.
activities.why_ta: இலைகள் வேகமாக வளரும் காலத்தில் நைட்ரஜன் தேவை அதிகம்.

activities.title: Earthing up (hilling)
activities.description: Heap soil 15–20 cm high around plant base.
activities.why: Earthing up prevents green tubers (toxic solanine) and supports plant.
activities.description_si: පැළයේ පාමුල වටා සෙ.මී. 15–20ක් උසට පස් ගොඩ කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: செடியின் அடிப்பகுதியைச் சுற்றி 15–20 செ.மீ உயரத்துக்கு மண்ணைக் குவியுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: පස් කෙටීමෙන් අල කොළ පැහැ වීම (විෂ සහිත සොලනීන්) වළකින අතර පැළයට ආධාරක වේ.
activities.why_ta: மண் அணைப்பது கிழங்குகள் பச்சையாவதைத் (நச்சுத்தன்மையுள்ள சொலனின்) தடுத்து செடிக்கு ஆதாரம் தரும்.

activities.title: Begin late blight monitoring
activities.description: Check for water-soaked lesions on leaves — especially after rain. Spray preventively.
activities.why: Late blight can destroy a crop within 5–7 days in cool wet weather.
activities.description_si: කොළ මත ජලයෙන් තෙත් වූ වැනි තුවාල — විශේෂයෙන් වැස්සෙන් පසු — පරීක්ෂා කරන්න. වැළැක්වීම සඳහා ඉසින්න.
activities.description_ta: இலைகளில் நீரில் ஊறியது போன்ற புண்கள் — குறிப்பாக மழைக்குப் பின் — உள்ளனவா எனப் பாருங்கள். தடுப்பாகத் தெளியுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: සිසිල්, තෙත් කාලගුණයේදී පසු අංගමාරය දින 5–7ක් ඇතුළත බෝගයක් විනාශ කළ හැක.
activities.why_ta: குளிர்ந்த ஈரமான வானிலையில் பின் கருகல் 5–7 நாட்களில் பயிரை அழிக்கலாம்.

stages.description_si: ප්‍රභාසංශ්ලේෂණයට සහ අල පිරීමට පත්‍ර වර්ධනය ගොඩනඟන්න.
stages.description_ta: ஒளிச்சேர்க்கைக்கும் கிழங்கு நிரம்புவதற்கும் இலை வளர்ச்சியை உருவாக்குங்கள்.

stages.name: Tuber Development
stages.description: Critical phase — nutrition and disease control determine yield.

activities.title: Top dressing 2
activities.description: MOP 100 kg/ha + Urea 50 kg/ha.
activities.why: Potassium is critical for tuber starch content and yield.
activities.description_si: MOP හෙක්ටයාරයකට කි.ග්‍රෑ. 100 + යූරියා කි.ග්‍රෑ. 50.
activities.description_ta: எக்டேருக்கு 100 கி.கி MOP + 50 கி.கி யூரியா.
activities.why_si: අලවල පිෂ්ඨය සහ අස්වැන්න සඳහා පොටෑසියම් අත්‍යවශ්‍යයි.
activities.why_ta: கிழங்கின் மாவுச்சத்துக்கும் மகசூலுக்கும் பொட்டாசியம் மிக அவசியம்.

activities.title: Blight spray schedule
activities.description: Spray Metalaxyl + Mancozeb (2.5 g/L) every 7 days. Do not miss a spray in wet weather.
activities.why: Late blight spreads exponentially. One missed spray can cost the crop.
activities.description_si: Metalaxyl + Mancozeb (ලීටරයකට ග්‍රෑ. 2.5) දින 7කට වරක් ඉසින්න. තෙත් කාලගුණයේදී එක ඉසීමක්වත් මඟ නොහරින්න.
activities.description_ta: Metalaxyl + Mancozeb (லிட்டருக்கு 2.5 கி) 7 நாட்களுக்கு ஒருமுறை தெளியுங்கள். ஈரமான வானிலையில் ஒரு தெளிப்பையும் தவறவிடாதீர்கள்.
activities.why_si: පසු අංගමාරය ඉතා වේගයෙන් පැතිරේ. එක ඉසීමක් මඟ හැරීමෙන් බෝගය අහිමි විය හැක.
activities.why_ta: பின் கருகல் மிக வேகமாகப் பரவும். ஒரு தெளிப்பைத் தவறவிட்டாலும் பயிர் இழக்க நேரிடும்.

stages.description_si: තීරණාත්මක අවධිය — පෝෂණය සහ රෝග පාලනය අස්වැන්න තීරණය කරයි.
stages.description_ta: முக்கியமான நிலை — ஊட்டமும் நோய்க் கட்டுப்பாடும் மகசூலைத் தீர்மானிக்கும்.

stages.name: Harvest

activities.title: Remove haulm (tops)
activities.description: Cut or pull off foliage 2 weeks before harvest.
activities.why: Haulm removal hardens tuber skin and reduces tuber disease at harvest.
activities.description_si: අස්වනු නෙළීමට සති 2කට පෙර පත්‍ර කපා හෝ ගලවා ඉවත් කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: அறுவடைக்கு 2 வாரங்களுக்கு முன் தழைகளை வெட்டி அல்லது பிடுங்கி அகற்றுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: අතු-කොළ ඉවත් කිරීමෙන් අලවල පොත්ත තද වන අතර අස්වනු කාලයේ අල රෝග අඩු වේ.
activities.why_ta: தழையை அகற்றுவது கிழங்குத் தோலை உறுதியாக்கி, அறுவடையின் போது கிழங்கு நோய்களைக் குறைக்கும்.

activities.title: Dig and harvest
activities.description: Use fork or digger. Avoid tuber damage. Sort and grade immediately.
activities.why: Wounded tubers rot quickly in storage.
activities.description_si: ගෑරුප්පුවක් හෝ හාරන උපකරණයක් භාවිත කරන්න. අලවලට හානි නොකරන්න. වහාම වර්ග කර ශ්‍රේණිගත කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: முட்கரண்டி அல்லது தோண்டும் கருவியைப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள். கிழங்குகளைச் சேதப்படுத்தாதீர்கள். உடனே பிரித்துத் தரம் பிரியுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: තුවාල වූ අල ගබඩාවේදී ඉක්මනින් කුණු වේ.
activities.why_ta: காயம்பட்ட கிழங்குகள் சேமிப்பில் விரைவில் அழுகும்.

stages.description_si: කායික මේරීම සිදු වූ විට අස්වනු නෙළන්න.

fertilization.why: High P for tuber initiation; K for yield.
fertilization.why_si: අල හටගැනීම ආරම්භයට වැඩි පොස්පරස්; අස්වැන්නට පොටෑසියම්.
fertilization.why_ta: கிழங்கு உருவாக்கம் தொடங்க அதிக பாஸ்பரஸ்; மகசூலுக்குப் பொட்டாசியம்.

irrigation.notes: Reduce watering 2 weeks before harvest to harden tuber skin.
irrigation.notes_si: අලවල පොත්ත තද කිරීමට අස්වනු නෙළීමට සති 2කට පෙර ජලය දීම අඩු කරන්න.
irrigation.notes_ta: கிழங்குத் தோலை உறுதியாக்க அறுவடைக்கு 2 வாரங்களுக்கு முன் நீர்ப்பாசனத்தைக் குறையுங்கள்.
irrigation.critical_stages_text_si: අල හටගැනීම (දින 40–60) · අල ප්‍රමාණය වැඩි වීම (දින 60–85)

diseases.name: Late Blight
diseases.symptoms: Dark water-soaked lesions on leaves spreading rapidly; white fluffy growth on leaf underside in humid conditions; plants collapse.
diseases.favorable_conditions: Cool temperatures (10–20°C), high humidity (>90%), wet weather, poor air circulation.
diseases.prevention: Good plant spacing. Avoid overhead irrigation. Use blight-resistant varieties. Destroy infected debris.
diseases.treatment: Metalaxyl-M + Mancozeb (2.5 g/L) preventively every 7 days during high-risk periods. Chlorothalonil (2 g/L) as alternative.
diseases.symptoms_si: කොළ මත වේගයෙන් පැතිරෙන, ජලයෙන් තෙත් වූ වැනි තද පැහැ තුවාල; ආර්ද්‍ර තත්ත්වවලදී කොළ යට සුදු පුළුන් වැනි වර්ධනයක්; පැළ ඇද වැටේ.
diseases.symptoms_ta: இலைகளில் வேகமாகப் பரவும், நீரில் ஊறியது போன்ற கரும் புண்கள்; ஈரப்பதமான நிலையில் இலையின் அடிப்பக்கத்தில் வெண்மையான பஞ்சு போன்ற வளர்ச்சி; செடிகள் சரிந்துவிடும்.
diseases.favorable_conditions_si: සිසිල් උෂ්ණත්වය (10–20°C), ඉහළ ආර්ද්‍රතාව (>90%), තෙත් කාලගුණය, දුර්වල වාතාශ්‍රය.
diseases.favorable_conditions_ta: குளிர்ந்த வெப்பநிலை (10–20°C), அதிக ஈரப்பதம் (>90%), ஈரமான வானிலை, மோசமான காற்றோட்டம்.
diseases.prevention_si: පැළ අතර හොඳ පරතරයක් තබන්න. ඉහළින් ජලය ඉසීමෙන් වළකින්න. අංගමාරයට ඔරොත්තු දෙන ප්‍රභේද භාවිත කරන්න. ආසාදිත කොටස් විනාශ කරන්න.
diseases.prevention_ta: செடிகளுக்கிடையே நல்ல இடைவெளி விடுங்கள். மேலிருந்து நீர் தெளிப்பதைத் தவிருங்கள். கருகல் எதிர்ப்புள்ள இனங்களைப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள். பாதிக்கப்பட்ட கழிவுகளை அழியுங்கள்.
diseases.treatment_si: අවදානම් කාලවලදී වැළැක්වීම සඳහා Metalaxyl-M + Mancozeb (ලීටරයකට ග්‍රෑ. 2.5) දින 7කට වරක්. විකල්පයක් ලෙස Chlorothalonil (ලීටරයකට ග්‍රෑ. 2).
diseases.treatment_ta: அபாயமான காலங்களில் தடுப்பாக Metalaxyl-M + Mancozeb (லிட்டருக்கு 2.5 கி) 7 நாட்களுக்கு ஒருமுறை. மாற்றாக Chlorothalonil (லிட்டருக்கு 2 கி).

diseases.name: Early Blight
diseases.symptoms: Brown concentric ring spots on lower leaves; premature defoliation; reduced tuber size.
diseases.favorable_conditions: Moderate temperatures (24–29°C), humidity fluctuations, nutrient stress.
diseases.prevention: Balanced fertilisation. Good spacing. Remove infected leaves.
diseases.treatment: Mancozeb 80WP (2.5 g/L) or Iprodione (1.5 ml/L) every 10 days.
diseases.symptoms_si: පහළ කොළවල දුඹුරු, ඒකකේන්ද්‍රික වළලු සහිත පැල්ලම්; කලින් කොළ හැලීම; අලවල ප්‍රමාණය අඩු වීම.
diseases.symptoms_ta: கீழ் இலைகளில் வளையம் வளையமான பழுப்புப் புள்ளிகள்; முன்கூட்டிய இலை உதிர்வு; கிழங்கின் அளவு குறைதல்.
diseases.favorable_conditions_si: මධ්‍යස්ථ උෂ්ණත්වය (24–29°C), ආර්ද්‍රතාවයේ උච්චාවචන, පෝෂක ආතතිය.
diseases.favorable_conditions_ta: மிதமான வெப்பநிலை (24–29°C), ஈரப்பத மாற்றங்கள், ஊட்டச்சத்துப் பற்றாக்குறை.
diseases.prevention_si: සමබර පොහොර යෙදීම. හොඳ පරතරය. ආසාදිත කොළ ඉවත් කරන්න.
diseases.prevention_ta: சமச்சீர் உரமிடல். நல்ல இடைவெளி. பாதிக்கப்பட்ட இலைகளை அகற்றுங்கள்.
diseases.treatment_si: Mancozeb 80WP (ලීටරයකට ග්‍රෑ. 2.5) හෝ Iprodione (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 1.5) දින 10කට වරක්.
diseases.treatment_ta: Mancozeb 80WP (லிட்டருக்கு 2.5 கி) அல்லது Iprodione (லிட்டருக்கு 1.5 மி.லி) 10 நாட்களுக்கு ஒருமுறை.

diseases.name: Bacterial Wilt
diseases.symptoms: Sudden wilting; vascular browning; tubers show vascular ring discolouration.
diseases.favorable_conditions: Warm moist soil, infected seed tubers, poor drainage.
diseases.prevention: Use certified disease-free seed tubers. Crop rotation. Raised ridges.
diseases.treatment: No cure. Remove infected plants. Do not plant in affected areas for 3+ years.
diseases.symptoms_si: හදිසියේ මැලවීම; සන්නායක පටක දුඹුරු වීම; අලවල සන්නායක වළල්ල වර්ණය වෙනස් වීම.
diseases.symptoms_ta: திடீர் வாடல்; கடத்துத் திசு பழுப்பாதல்; கிழங்குகளில் கடத்து வளையம் நிறம் மாறுதல்.
diseases.favorable_conditions_si: උණුසුම් තෙත් පස, ආසාදිත බීජ අල, දුර්වල ජලාපවහනය.
diseases.favorable_conditions_ta: வெப்பமான ஈர மண், பாதிக்கப்பட்ட விதைக் கிழங்குகள், மோசமான வடிகால்.
diseases.prevention_si: රෝගවලින් තොර සහතික කළ බීජ අල භාවිත කරන්න. බෝග මාරුව. උස් කළ වැටි.
diseases.prevention_ta: நோயற்ற சான்றளிக்கப்பட்ட விதைக் கிழங்குகளைப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள். பயிர்ச் சுழற்சி. உயர்த்திய முகடுகள்.
diseases.treatment_si: ප්‍රතිකාරයක් නැත. ආසාදිත පැළ ඉවත් කරන්න. බලපෑමට ලක් වූ ප්‍රදේශවල අවුරුදු 3කට වැඩි කාලයක් නොවගා කරන්න.
diseases.treatment_ta: சிகிச்சை இல்லை. பாதிக்கப்பட்ட செடிகளை அகற்றுங்கள். பாதிக்கப்பட்ட பகுதிகளில் 3 ஆண்டுகளுக்கு மேல் பயிரிட வேண்டாம்.

diseases.name: Fungal Tuber Rot
diseases.symptoms: Internal decay and discolouration of tubers; soft rot starting from surface wounds.
diseases.favorable_conditions: Waterlogged soil, wounds during earthing-up or harvest, high moisture.
diseases.prevention: Careful handling. Avoid waterlogging. Well-drained ridges.
diseases.treatment: Thiram or Copper fungicide drench at early detection.
diseases.symptoms_si: අල ඇතුළත දිරාපත් වීම සහ වර්ණය වෙනස් වීම; මතුපිට තුවාලවලින් ආරම්භ වන මෘදු කුණුවීම.
diseases.symptoms_ta: கிழங்கின் உட்புறம் அழுகுதலும் நிறம் மாறுதலும்; மேற்பரப்புக் காயங்களிலிருந்து தொடங்கும் மென் அழுகல்.
diseases.favorable_conditions_si: ජලය රැඳුණු පස, පස් කෙටීමේදී හෝ අස්වනු නෙළීමේදී වන තුවාල, ඉහළ තෙතමනය.
diseases.favorable_conditions_ta: நீர் தேங்கிய மண், மண் அணைக்கும்போதோ அறுவடையின்போதோ ஏற்படும் காயங்கள், அதிக ஈரப்பதம்.
diseases.prevention_si: ප්‍රවේශමෙන් හැසිරවීම. ජලය රැඳීමෙන් වළකින්න. හොඳින් ජලය බැස යන වැටි.
diseases.prevention_ta: கவனமான கையாளுதல். நீர் தேங்குவதைத் தவிருங்கள். நன்கு நீர் வடியும் முகடுகள்.
diseases.treatment_si: කලින්ම හඳුනාගත් විට Thiram හෝ තඹ දිලීර නාශකයකින් පස තෙමීම.
diseases.treatment_ta: முன்கூட்டியே கண்டறிந்தால் Thiram அல்லது செம்புப் பூஞ்சைக்கொல்லியால் மண்ணை நனைத்தல்.

pests.name: Potato Tuber Moth
pests.damage: Larvae mine leaves and bore into tubers; stored tubers heavily damaged.
pests.identification: Serpentine mines in leaves; larvae and tunnels visible inside cut tubers.
pests.prevention: Hill up soil over tubers. Harvest on time. Store in dark cool conditions.
pests.treatment: Bt (Bacillus thuringiensis) spray (2 g/L) in field. Pheromone traps for monitoring.
pests.prevention_si: අල මත පස් ගොඩ කරන්න. නියමිත වේලාවට අස්වනු නෙළන්න. අඳුරු, සිසිල් තත්ත්වවල ගබඩා කරන්න.
pests.prevention_ta: கிழங்குகளின் மேல் மண் அணையுங்கள். உரிய நேரத்தில் அறுவடை செய்யுங்கள். இருண்ட, குளிர்ந்த இடத்தில் சேமியுங்கள்.
pests.treatment_si: කෙතේ Bt (Bacillus thuringiensis) ඉසීම (ලීටරයකට ග්‍රෑ. 2). නිරීක්ෂණයට ෆෙරමෝන උගුල්.
pests.treatment_ta: வயலில் Bt (Bacillus thuringiensis) தெளிப்பு (லிட்டருக்கு 2 கி). கண்காணிப்புக்கு இனக்கவர்ச்சிப் பொறிகள்.
pests.damage_si: කීටයෝ කොළ තුළ සුරං හාරා අල තුළට විද යති; ගබඩා කළ අලවලට දැඩි හානි වේ.
pests.damage_ta: புழுக்கள் இலைகளில் சுரங்கம் அமைத்து கிழங்குகளைத் துளைக்கும்; சேமித்த கிழங்குகள் கடுமையாகச் சேதமடையும்.
pests.identification_si: කොළවල සර්පිලාකාර සුරං; කැපූ අල තුළ කීටයන් සහ උමං පෙනේ.
pests.identification_ta: இலைகளில் வளைந்து நெளிந்த சுரங்கங்கள்; வெட்டிய கிழங்குகளுக்குள் புழுக்களும் சுரங்கங்களும் தெரியும்.

pests.name: Aphid
pests.damage: Sucks sap; major vector of potato virus Y (PVY) and potato leaf roll virus.
pests.identification: Colonies on young shoots; virus symptoms appear after aphid feeding.
pests.prevention: Yellow sticky traps. Reflective silver mulch. Remove virus-infected plants.
pests.treatment: Imidacloprid 200SL (0.3 ml/L) or Thiamethoxam. Spray fortnightly.
pests.prevention_si: කහ ඇලෙන උගුල්. රිදී පැහැති පරාවර්තක වසුන්. වෛරස ආසාදිත පැළ ඉවත් කරන්න.
pests.prevention_ta: மஞ்சள் ஒட்டும் பொறிகள். வெள்ளி நிற ஒளிபிரதிபலிக்கும் மூடாக்கு. வைரஸ் பாதித்த செடிகளை அகற்றுங்கள்.
pests.treatment_si: Imidacloprid 200SL (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 0.3) හෝ Thiamethoxam. සති දෙකකට වරක් ඉසින්න.
pests.treatment_ta: Imidacloprid 200SL (லிட்டருக்கு 0.3 மி.லி) அல்லது Thiamethoxam. இரண்டு வாரங்களுக்கு ஒருமுறை தெளியுங்கள்.
pests.damage_si: යුෂ උරා බොයි; අර්තාපල් Y වෛරසය (PVY) සහ අර්තාපල් කොළ රෝල් වෛරසයේ ප්‍රධාන වාහකයාය.
pests.damage_ta: சாற்றை உறிஞ்சும்; உருளைக்கிழங்கு Y வைரஸ் (PVY), இலைச் சுருட்டு வைரஸ் ஆகியவற்றைப் பரப்பும் முக்கியப் பூச்சி.
pests.identification_si: ළපටි දළු මත ජනපද; කුඩිත්තන් කෑමෙන් පසු වෛරස ලක්ෂණ මතු වේ.
pests.identification_ta: இளம் தளிர்களில் கூட்டங்கள்; அசுவினி உண்ட பின் வைரஸ் அறிகுறிகள் தோன்றும்.

risks.name: Late Blight Epidemic
risks.description: Can destroy 100% of crop in 1–2 weeks during cool wet weather.
risks.signs: Rapid brown leaf collapse, dark water-soaked lesions.
risks.mitigation: Never miss fungicide schedule. Remove first infected plants to slow spread.
risks.description_si: සිසිල් තෙත් කාලගුණයේදී සති 1–2ක් ඇතුළත බෝගයෙන් 100%ක්ම විනාශ කළ හැක.
risks.description_ta: குளிர்ந்த ஈரமான வானிலையில் 1–2 வாரங்களில் பயிரை 100% அழிக்கலாம்.
risks.signs_si: කොළ වේගයෙන් දුඹුරු වී ඇද වැටීම, ජලයෙන් තෙත් වූ වැනි තද පැහැ තුවාල.
risks.signs_ta: இலைகள் வேகமாகப் பழுப்பாகிச் சரிதல், நீரில் ஊறியது போன்ற கரும் புண்கள்.
risks.mitigation_si: දිලීර නාශක කාලසටහන කිසිවිටෙක මඟ නොහරින්න. පැතිරීම මන්දගාමී කිරීමට මුලින්ම ආසාදනය වූ පැළ ඉවත් කරන්න.
risks.mitigation_ta: பூஞ்சைக்கொல்லி அட்டவணையை ஒருபோதும் தவறவிடாதீர்கள். பரவலைக் குறைக்க முதலில் பாதிக்கப்பட்ட செடிகளை அகற்றுங்கள்.

risks.name: Frost (below 2°C)
risks.description: Kills foliage rapidly. Common in Nuwara Eliya November–January.
risks.signs: Black wilted foliage overnight. Ice crystals visible on leaves.
risks.mitigation: Cover with gunny sacks or polytunnel at night during risk period.
risks.description_si: පත්‍ර වේගයෙන් විනාශ කරයි. නුවරඑළියේ නොවැම්බර්–ජනවාරි කාලයේ බහුලය.
risks.description_ta: இலைகளை விரைவில் அழிக்கும். நுவரெலியாவில் நவம்பர்–ஜனவரியில் பொதுவானது.
risks.signs_si: එක රැයකින් පත්‍ර කළු වී මැලවීම. කොළ මත අයිස් ස්ඵටික පෙනේ.
risks.signs_ta: ஒரே இரவில் இலைகள் கறுத்து வாடுதல். இலைகளில் பனிக்கட்டிப் படிகங்கள் தெரியும்.
risks.mitigation_si: අවදානම් කාලයේ රාත්‍රියේදී ගෝනි හෝ පොලිතීන් උමං ගෘහ මගින් ආවරණය කරන්න.
risks.mitigation_ta: அபாயக் காலத்தில் இரவில் கோணிப் பைகள் அல்லது பொலித்தீன் சுரங்கக் கூடாரத்தால் மூடுங்கள்.

indicators: Foliage turns yellow and dies back naturally
Tuber skin does not peel when rubbed
harvest.method: Dig with fork carefully. Avoid cutting tubers. Grade into A, B, C sizes.
harvest.post_harvest: Cure in shade for 7–10 days. Store in cool dark ventilated store. Do not expose to sunlight — causes greening and toxicity.
harvest.method_si: ගෑරුප්පුවකින් ප්‍රවේශමෙන් හාරන්න. අල කැපීමෙන් වළකින්න. A, B, C ප්‍රමාණ අනුව ශ්‍රේණිගත කරන්න.
harvest.method_ta: முட்கரண்டியால் கவனமாகத் தோண்டுங்கள். கிழங்குகளை வெட்டுவதைத் தவிருங்கள். A, B, C அளவுகளாகத் தரம் பிரியுங்கள்.
harvest.post_harvest_si: දින 7–10ක් සෙවණේ තබා සුව කරන්න. සිසිල්, අඳුරු, වාතාශ්‍රය ඇති ගබඩාවක තබන්න. හිරු එළියට නිරාවරණය නොකරන්න — එයින් අල කොළ පැහැ වී විෂ සහිත වේ.
harvest.post_harvest_ta: 7–10 நாட்கள் நிழலில் வைத்துப் பதப்படுத்துங்கள். குளிர்ந்த, இருண்ட, காற்றோட்டமுள்ள அறையில் சேமியுங்கள். சூரிய ஒளியில் வைக்காதீர்கள் — கிழங்கு பச்சையாகி நச்சுத்தன்மை அடையும்.
indicators_si: පත්‍ර කහ වී ස්වාභාවිකව මැරී යයි
අතුල්ලන විට අලයේ පොත්ත ගැලවී නොයයි

Potato.growth_stages_text: Potato cultivation follows several important growth stages including sprouting, vegetative growth, tuber initiation, tuber bulking, and harvesting. The crop is usually propagated using seed tubers rather than true botanical seeds, and sprouting occurs within 2–3 weeks after planting. Vegetative growth continues for about 30–50 days, during which strong foliage develops to support photosynthesis. Tuber initiation begins around 35–50 days after planting, followed by tuber bulking, where underground tubers expand rapidly and accumulate starch. Harvesting is typically carried out between 90–120 days when plants start yellowing and drying, indicating that tubers have reached maturity. Farmers commonly plant seed tubers at a depth of about 5–10 cm and maintain spacing of approximately 20–30 cm between plants and 60–75 cm between rows to ensure proper tuber development, soil aeration, and ease of harvesting.
Potato.management_text: Successful potato cultivation requires a structured week-by-week crop management plan including land preparation, seed tuber planting, fertilizer application, irrigation, earthing-up, weed control, pest monitoring, and harvesting activities. Fertilizer application is critical for high yield, with balanced use of nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium to support both foliage growth and tuber formation. Potassium is particularly important for improving tuber size, quality, and storage life. Irrigation is most important during sprouting, flowering, and tuber bulking stages, while excessive water should be avoided to prevent tuber rot. Earthing-up is an essential practice where soil is mounded around the plant base to protect developing tubers from sunlight exposure and greening.
Potato.disease_management_text: Disease and pest management are vital in potato cultivation. Potato tuber moth damages both foliage and stored tubers, while aphids weaken plants by feeding on sap and also transmit viral diseases. Late blight is one of the most destructive diseases, causing dark lesions on leaves and rapid plant collapse under cool, wet conditions. Early blight creates concentric ring-like spots on leaves, reducing photosynthesis and yield. Bacterial wilt causes sudden wilting and plant death, while fungal tuber rot leads to decay during growth or storage. These problems can be managed through crop rotation, use of certified disease-free seed tubers, proper field sanitation, balanced fertilizer use, timely irrigation management, and integrated pest management practices. Regular monitoring and early intervention are essential to minimize losses and ensure high-quality potato production.
Potato.overview_si: ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ “අල” ලෙස හැඳින්වෙන අර්තාපල් (Solanum tuberosum) Solanaceae කුලයට අයත්, සිසිල් දේශගුණයක වැඩෙන අල බෝගයකි. අඩු උෂ්ණත්වය අල හටගැනීමට සහ වර්ධනයට හිතකර වන නුවරඑළිය, බදුල්ල, මහනුවර වැනි උඩරට ප්‍රදේශවල එය ප්‍රධාන වශයෙන් වගා කෙරේ. අර්තාපල් 15°C–20°C අතර උෂ්ණත්වයේ හොඳින් වැඩෙන අතර, pH 5.0–6.5 අතර, ගැඹුරු, සාරවත්, හොඳින් ජලය බැස යන වැලි ලෝම පසක් අවශ්‍ය වේ. නිරෝගී වර්ධනයට සහ ඉහළ අල අස්වැන්නකට මධ්‍යස්ථ වර්ෂාව, නිතිපතා ජලසම්පාදනය සහ පූර්ණ හිරු එළිය අවශ්‍යය. ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ වැදගත්ම ආහාර බෝගවලින් එකක් වන අර්තාපල්, කාබෝහයිඩ්‍රේට් සහ පෝෂණ අගය ඉහළ බැවින් ව්‍යංජන, බැදුම් සහ විවිධ ආහාර සඳහා බහුලව භාවිත වේ. ප්‍රභේදය සහ දේශගුණය අනුව සිටුවීමෙන් දින 90–120 අතර අස්වනු නෙළනු ලැබේ. උෂ්ණත්වය, පාංශු තෙතමනය, වර්ෂාව, හිරු එළිය, ආර්ද්‍රතාව සහ පසේ සාරවත්බව අර්තාපල් වගාවට බලපාන ප්‍රධාන සාධක වේ. අල සලබයා, කුඩිත්තා, පසු අංගමාරය, මුල් අංගමාරය, බැක්ටීරියා මැලවීම සහ දිලීර මගින් අල කුණුවීම පොදු පළිබෝධ හා රෝග වන අතර, නිසි ලෙස පාලනය නොකළහොත් ඒවා අස්වැන්න සහ අලවල ගුණාත්මකභාවය බෙහෙවින් අඩු කරයි.
Potato.overview_ta: இலங்கையில் “அல” என அழைக்கப்படும் உருளைக்கிழங்கு (Solanum tuberosum), Solanaceae குடும்பத்தைச் சேர்ந்த குளிர் காலநிலைக் கிழங்குப் பயிர். குறைந்த வெப்பநிலை கிழங்கு உருவாக்கத்துக்கும் வளர்ச்சிக்கும் சாதகமான நுவரெலியா, பதுளை, கண்டி போன்ற மலைநாட்டுப் பகுதிகளில் இது முக்கியமாகப் பயிரிடப்படுகிறது. உருளைக்கிழங்கு 15°C–20°C வெப்பநிலையில் நன்றாக வளரும்; pH 5.0–6.5 உள்ள, ஆழமான, வளமான, நன்கு நீர் வடியும் மணல் கலந்த இருமண் தேவை. ஆரோக்கியமான வளர்ச்சி மற்றும் அதிக கிழங்கு மகசூலுக்கு மிதமான மழை, தொடர்ச்சியான நீர்ப்பாசனம், முழுச் சூரிய ஒளி அவசியம். இலங்கையின் மிக முக்கியமான உணவுப் பயிர்களில் ஒன்றான உருளைக்கிழங்கு, அதிக மாவுச்சத்தும் ஊட்டச்சத்தும் கொண்டிருப்பதால் கறி, பொரியல் மற்றும் பல்வேறு உணவுகளுக்குப் பரவலாகப் பயன்படுகிறது. இனம் மற்றும் காலநிலையைப் பொறுத்து நடவு செய்து 90–120 நாட்களில் அறுவடை செய்யப்படும். வெப்பநிலை, மண் ஈரப்பதம், மழை, சூரிய ஒளி, காற்று ஈரப்பதம், மண் வளம் ஆகியவை உருளைக்கிழங்கு சாகுபடியைப் பாதிக்கும் முக்கியக் காரணிகள். கிழங்கு அந்துப்பூச்சி, அசுவினி, பின் கருகல், முன் கருகல், பாக்டீரியா வாடல், பூஞ்சைக் கிழங்கு அழுகல் ஆகியவை பொதுவான பூச்சிகளும் நோய்களும்; சரியாகக் கட்டுப்படுத்தாவிட்டால் இவை மகசூலையும் கிழங்கின் தரத்தையும் பெருமளவு குறைக்கும்.

Elabatu (Thai Eggplant).overview: Thai Eggplant, commonly known as “Elabatu” in Sri Lanka, is a tropical vegetable crop belonging to the Solanaceae family and scientifically identified as Solanum melongena. It is widely cultivated in many parts of Sri Lanka due to its adaptability to warm climatic conditions and its importance in local cuisine. Elabatu grows best in temperatures between 22°C and 30°C and prefers well-drained fertile loamy or sandy soils with a soil pH ranging from 5.5 to 6.8. The crop requires moderate rainfall, regular irrigation, and sufficient sunlight for healthy growth and fruit development. Thai eggplant plants produce small round green or light-colored fruits that are commonly used in curries and traditional dishes. The crop can be cultivated throughout the year under suitable environmental conditions and generally starts harvesting within 70 to 90 days after planting. Important factors affecting cultivation include temperature, soil moisture, humidity, rainfall, sunlight, and soil fertility. Farmers must also manage common pests and diseases such as aphids, whiteflies, fruit and shoot borers, bacterial wilt, and fungal leaf spot diseases, which can significantly reduce crop yield and quality if not properly controlled.

stages.name: Land Preparation

activities.title: Plough and prepare beds
activities.description: Plough 30 cm deep. Form raised beds.
activities.why: Good drainage essential for this long-duration crop.
activities.description_si: සෙ.මී. 30ක් ගැඹුරට සීසාන්න. උස් කළ පාත්ති සාදන්න.
activities.description_ta: 30 செ.மீ ஆழத்துக்கு உழுங்கள். உயர்த்திய பாத்திகள் அமையுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: මෙම දිගුකාලීන බෝගයට හොඳ ජලාපවහනය අත්‍යවශ්‍යයි.
activities.why_ta: இந்த நீண்ட காலப் பயிருக்கு நல்ல வடிகால் அவசியம்.

activities.title: Apply compost
activities.description: Incorporate 10–15 t/ha compost.
activities.why: Organic base supports long cropping duration.
activities.description_si: හෙක්ටයාරයකට ටොන් 10–15ක් කොම්පෝස්ට් පසට මිශ්‍ර කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: எக்டேருக்கு 10–15 டன் மக்கிய உரத்தை மண்ணுடன் கலந்துவிடுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: කාබනික පදනම දිගු වගා කාලයට උපකාරී වේ.
activities.why_ta: கரிம அடித்தளம் நீண்ட சாகுபடிக் காலத்துக்கு உதவும்.

stages.description_si: හොඳින් ජලය බැස යන සාරවත් පසක් සකස් කරන්න.
stages.description_ta: நன்கு நீர் வடியும் வளமான மண்ணைத் தயார்செய்யுங்கள்.

stages.name: Transplanting

activities.title: Transplant in evening
activities.description: Plant 25-day-old seedlings. Water immediately.
activities.why: Reduces transplant shock.
activities.description_si: දින 25ක පැළ සිටුවන්න. වහාම ජලය දෙන්න.
activities.description_ta: 25 நாள் வயதுடைய நாற்றுகளை நடுங்கள். உடனே நீர் பாய்ச்சுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: පැළ සිටුවීමේ කම්පනය අඩු කරයි.
activities.why_ta: நடவு அதிர்ச்சியைக் குறைக்கும்.

activities.title: Water daily first 2 weeks
activities.description: Gentle watering at base.
activities.why: Critical establishment period.
activities.description_si: පැළයේ මුලට මෘදුව ජලය දීම.
activities.description_ta: செடியின் அடியில் மெதுவாக நீர் ஊற்றுதல்.
activities.why_si: ස්ථාපිත වීමේ තීරණාත්මක කාලය.
activities.why_ta: நிலைபெறுவதற்கான முக்கியமான காலம்.

stages.description_si: කෙතේ පැළ ස්ථාපිත කරන්න.

stages.name: Vegetative Growth

activities.title: Top dressing 1
activities.description: Urea 75 kg/ha ring application.
activities.why: Nitrogen for branching.
activities.description_si: යූරියා හෙක්ටයාරයකට කි.ග්‍රෑ. 75 වළල්ලක් ලෙස යෙදීම.
activities.description_ta: எக்டேருக்கு 75 கி.கி யூரியா வளையமாக இடுதல்.
activities.why_si: අතු බෙදීමට නයිට්‍රජන්.
activities.why_ta: கிளைப்பதற்கு நைட்ரஜன்.

activities.title: Scout for Fruit & Shoot Borer
activities.description: Check for wilted shoot tips daily.
activities.why: FSB is the main pest of all eggplant types.
activities.title_si: කඳ හා ගෙඩි විදින දළඹුවා සඳහා පරීක්ෂා කරන්න
activities.title_ta: தண்டு மற்றும் காய்த் துளைப்பானுக்காக ஆய்வு செய்தல்
activities.description_si: මැලවුණු දළු අග සඳහා දිනපතා පරීක්ෂා කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: வாடிய தளிர் நுனிகளுக்காகத் தினமும் சோதியுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: කඳ හා ගෙඩි විදින දළඹුවා සියලු වම්බටු වර්ගවල ප්‍රධාන පළිබෝධයයි.
activities.why_ta: தண்டு மற்றும் காய்த் துளைப்பான் எல்லாக் கத்தரி வகைகளின் முக்கியப் பூச்சி.

stages.description_si: ශක්තිමත් අතු ව්‍යුහයක් ගොඩනඟන්න.

stages.name: Flowering & Fruiting

activities.title: Top dressing 2
activities.description: Urea 75 kg/ha + MOP 75 kg/ha.
activities.why: Sustained nutrition for continuous fruiting.
activities.description_si: යූරියා හෙක්ටයාරයකට කි.ග්‍රෑ. 75 + MOP කි.ග්‍රෑ. 75.
activities.description_ta: எக்டேருக்கு 75 கி.கி யூரியா + 75 கி.கி MOP.
activities.why_si: නොකඩවා ගෙඩි හටගැනීමට අඛණ්ඩ පෝෂණය.
activities.why_ta: தொடர்ச்சியான காய்ப்புக்கு நிலையான ஊட்டம்.

activities.title: Regular pest and disease check
activities.description: Inspect fruits and shoots.
activities.why: Continuous monitoring maintains crop health.
activities.description_si: ගෙඩි සහ දළු පරීක්ෂා කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: காய்களையும் தளிர்களையும் சோதியுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: නොකඩවා නිරීක්ෂණයෙන් බෝගයේ සෞඛ්‍යය පවත්වා ගැනේ.
activities.why_ta: தொடர் கண்காணிப்பு பயிரின் ஆரோக்கியத்தைப் பேணும்.

stages.description_si: නොකඩවා ගෙඩි හටගන්නා අවධිය.

stages.name: Harvest

activities.title: Begin first harvest
activities.description: Pick small green fruits when full sized and firm.
activities.why: Harvesting at correct size gives best culinary quality.
activities.description_si: කුඩා කොළ පැහැ ගෙඩි පූර්ණ ප්‍රමාණයට පැමිණ තද වූ විට නෙළන්න.
activities.description_ta: சிறிய பச்சைக் காய்கள் முழு அளவை அடைந்து உறுதியானதும் பறியுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: නිවැරදි ප්‍රමාණයේදී නෙළීමෙන් ආහාරයට හොඳම ගුණාත්මකභාවය ලැබේ.
activities.why_ta: சரியான அளவில் அறுவடை செய்வது சமையலுக்குச் சிறந்த தரத்தைத் தரும்.

activities.title: Harvest every 3–5 days
activities.description: Remove all mature fruits regularly.
activities.why: Regular picking maintains plant productivity.
activities.description_si: මේරූ සියලු ගෙඩි නිතිපතා ඉවත් කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: முற்றிய எல்லாக் காய்களையும் தொடர்ந்து பறியுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: නිතිපතා නෙළීමෙන් පැළයේ ඵලදායිතාව පවතී.
activities.why_ta: தொடர்ந்து பறிப்பது செடியின் விளைச்சல் திறனைப் பேணும்.

stages.description_si: හොඳම අස්වැන්න සඳහා නිතිපතා අස්වනු නෙළන්න.

irrigation.notes: Elabatu tolerates moderate drought but needs consistent moisture for continuous fruiting.
irrigation.notes_si: එළබටු මධ්‍යස්ථ නියඟයට ඔරොත්තු දුන්නද, නොකඩවා ගෙඩි හටගැනීමට නොකඩවා තෙතමනය අවශ්‍යය.
irrigation.notes_ta: எலபட்டு மிதமான வறட்சியைத் தாங்கும்; ஆனால் தொடர்ச்சியான காய்ப்புக்குத் தொடர்ச்சியான ஈரப்பதம் தேவை.

diseases.name: Bacterial Wilt
diseases.symptoms: Sudden wilting of entire plant; milky ooze from cut stem in water.
diseases.favorable_conditions: Wet soil, warm temperatures (25–35°C), poor drainage.
diseases.prevention: Crop rotation. Raised beds. Use disease-free planting material.
diseases.treatment: No cure. Remove infected plants. Drench soil with lime.
diseases.symptoms_si: මුළු පැළයම හදිසියේ මැලවීම; කපන ලද කඳ ජලයේ තැබූ විට කිරි වැනි ස්‍රාවයක් ගලයි.
diseases.symptoms_ta: முழுச் செடியும் திடீரென வாடுதல்; வெட்டிய தண்டை நீரில் வைத்தால் பால் போன்ற கசிவு.
diseases.favorable_conditions_si: තෙත් පස, උණුසුම් උෂ්ණත්වය (25–35°C), දුර්වල ජලාපවහනය.
diseases.favorable_conditions_ta: ஈரமான மண், வெப்பமான வெப்பநிலை (25–35°C), மோசமான வடிகால்.
diseases.prevention_si: බෝග මාරුව. උස් කළ පාත්ති. රෝගවලින් තොර රෝපණ ද්‍රව්‍ය භාවිත කරන්න.
diseases.prevention_ta: பயிர்ச் சுழற்சி. உயர்த்திய பாத்திகள். நோயற்ற நடவுப் பொருளைப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள்.
diseases.treatment_si: ප්‍රතිකාරයක් නැත. ආසාදිත පැළ ඉවත් කරන්න. පසට හුණු දියර යොදන්න.
diseases.treatment_ta: சிகிச்சை இல்லை. பாதிக்கப்பட்ட செடிகளை அகற்றுங்கள். மண்ணைச் சுண்ணாம்புக் கரைசலால் நனையுங்கள்.

diseases.name: Fungal Leaf Spot
diseases.symptoms: Dark or yellowish spots on leaves reducing photosynthesis and plant vigour.
diseases.favorable_conditions: High humidity, overhead irrigation, poor air circulation.
diseases.prevention: Good spacing. Avoid wetting foliage.
diseases.treatment: Mancozeb 80WP (2.5 g/L) or Chlorothalonil (2 g/L) spray.
diseases.symptoms_si: ප්‍රභාසංශ්ලේෂණය සහ පැළයේ ශක්තිය අඩු කරන, කොළ මත තද හෝ කහ පැහැති පැල්ලම්.
diseases.symptoms_ta: ஒளிச்சேர்க்கையையும் செடியின் வீரியத்தையும் குறைக்கும், இலைகளில் கருமையான அல்லது மஞ்சள் புள்ளிகள்.
diseases.favorable_conditions_si: ඉහළ ආර්ද්‍රතාව, ඉහළින් ජලය ඉසීම, දුර්වල වාතාශ්‍රය.
diseases.favorable_conditions_ta: அதிக ஈரப்பதம், மேலிருந்து நீர் தெளிப்பு, மோசமான காற்றோட்டம்.
diseases.prevention_si: හොඳ පරතරය. කොළ තෙමීමෙන් වළකින්න.
diseases.prevention_ta: நல்ல இடைவெளி. இலைகளை நனைப்பதைத் தவிருங்கள்.
diseases.treatment_si: Mancozeb 80WP (ලීටරයකට ග්‍රෑ. 2.5) හෝ Chlorothalonil (ලීටරයකට ග්‍රෑ. 2) ඉසීම.
diseases.treatment_ta: Mancozeb 80WP (லிட்டருக்கு 2.5 கி) அல்லது Chlorothalonil (லிட்டருக்கு 2 கி) தெளிப்பு.

pests.name: Fruit and Shoot Borer
pests.damage: Bores into shoots and fruits causing wilting of growing tips and internal fruit damage.
pests.identification: Withered shoot tips ('dead heart'); entry holes on fruits with frass.
pests.prevention: Pheromone traps. Remove and destroy infested shoot tips and fruits.
pests.treatment: Spinosad 45SC (0.3 ml/L) or Chlorpyrifos (2 ml/L). Apply fortnightly.
pests.prevention_si: ෆෙරමෝන උගුල්. ආසාදිත දළු අග සහ ගෙඩි ඉවත් කර විනාශ කරන්න.
pests.prevention_ta: இனக்கவர்ச்சிப் பொறிகள். பாதிக்கப்பட்ட தளிர் நுனிகளையும் காய்களையும் அகற்றி அழியுங்கள்.
pests.treatment_si: Spinosad 45SC (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 0.3) හෝ Chlorpyrifos (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 2). සති දෙකකට වරක් යොදන්න.
pests.treatment_ta: Spinosad 45SC (லிட்டருக்கு 0.3 மி.லி) அல்லது Chlorpyrifos (லிட்டருக்கு 2 மி.லி). இரண்டு வாரங்களுக்கு ஒருமுறை தெளியுங்கள்.
pests.damage_si: දළු සහ ගෙඩි තුළට විද වැඩෙන අග මැලවීම සහ ගෙඩිවල ඇතුළත හානිය ඇති කරයි.
pests.damage_ta: தளிர்களையும் காய்களையும் துளைத்து வளரும் நுனிகள் வாடுதலையும் காயின் உட்புறச் சேதத்தையும் ஏற்படுத்தும்.
pests.identification_si: මැලවුණු දළු අග ('මැරුණු දළු'); ගෙඩිවල අසූචි සහිත ඇතුළු වූ සිදුරු.
pests.identification_ta: வாடிய தளிர் நுனிகள் ('காய்ந்த குருத்து'); காய்களில் கழிவுடன் நுழைவுத் துளைகள்.

pests.name: Whitefly
pests.damage: Sucks sap causing leaf curling and yellowing; may transmit viral diseases.
pests.identification: Clouds of tiny white insects rising from leaves when disturbed.
pests.prevention: Yellow sticky traps. Reflective mulch to deter whiteflies.
pests.treatment: Imidacloprid 200SL (0.3 ml/L) on leaf undersides.
pests.prevention_si: කහ ඇලෙන උගුල්. සුදු මැස්සන් පලවා හැරීමට ආලෝකය පරාවර්තනය කරන වසුන්.
pests.prevention_ta: மஞ்சள் ஒட்டும் பொறிகள். வெள்ளை ஈக்களை விரட்ட ஒளியைப் பிரதிபலிக்கும் மூடாக்கு.
pests.treatment_si: Imidacloprid 200SL (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 0.3) කොළවල යටි පැත්තට.
pests.treatment_ta: Imidacloprid 200SL (லிட்டருக்கு 0.3 மி.லி) இலைகளின் அடிப்பக்கத்தில்.
pests.damage_si: යුෂ උරා බීමෙන් කොළ කොඩවීම සහ කහ වීම ඇති කරයි; වෛරස රෝග පැතිරවිය හැක.
pests.damage_ta: சாற்றை உறிஞ்சி இலைச் சுருளையும் மஞ்சளாதலையும் ஏற்படுத்தும்; வைரஸ் நோய்களைப் பரப்பலாம்.
pests.identification_si: පැළ සෙලවූ විට කොළවලින් කුඩා සුදු කෘමි රංචු ඉහළ නගී.
pests.identification_ta: செடியை அசைத்தால் இலைகளிலிருந்து சிறிய வெள்ளைப் பூச்சிக் கூட்டங்கள் எழும்.

pests.name: Aphid
pests.damage: Sucks plant sap; causes curling, yellowing, and stunted shoot growth.
pests.identification: Dense clusters on new growth and leaf undersides.
pests.prevention: Neem oil (5 ml/L). Encourage beneficial insects (ladybirds).
pests.treatment: Dimethoate 40EC (1.5 ml/L) if severe.
pests.prevention_si: කොහොඹ තෙල් (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 5). හිතකර කෘමීන් (ලේඩිබර්ඩ් කුරුමිණියන්) දිරිමත් කරන්න.
pests.prevention_ta: வேப்ப எண்ணெய் (லிட்டருக்கு 5 மி.லி). நன்மை செய்யும் பூச்சிகளை (பொறி வண்டுகள்) ஊக்குவியுங்கள்.
pests.treatment_si: දැඩි නම් Dimethoate 40EC (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 1.5).
pests.treatment_ta: கடுமையாக இருந்தால் Dimethoate 40EC (லிட்டருக்கு 1.5 மி.லி).
pests.damage_si: ශාක යුෂ උරා බොයි; කොඩවීම, කහ වීම සහ දළු වර්ධනය බාල වීම ඇති කරයි.
pests.damage_ta: தாவரச் சாற்றை உறிஞ்சும்; சுருள், மஞ்சளாதல், தளிர் வளர்ச்சிக் குன்றல் ஏற்படுத்தும்.
pests.identification_si: නව වර්ධනය සහ කොළවල යටි පැත්තේ ඝන පොකුරු.
pests.identification_ta: புதிய வளர்ச்சியிலும் இலைகளின் அடிப்பக்கத்திலும் அடர்த்தியான கூட்டங்கள்.

risks.name: Fruit & Shoot Borer
risks.description: Primary threat. Can cause >50% loss.
risks.signs: Multiple wilted tips, many bored fruits.
risks.mitigation: Daily scouting, pheromone traps, weekly spray.
risks.description_si: ප්‍රධාන තර්ජනය. 50%කට වඩා හානියක් ඇති කළ හැක.
risks.description_ta: முக்கிய அச்சுறுத்தல். 50%க்கு மேல் இழப்பை ஏற்படுத்தலாம்.
risks.signs_si: මැලවුණු දළු අග රැසක්, විදින ලද ගෙඩි රැසක්.
risks.signs_ta: பல வாடிய நுனிகள், பல துளைக்கப்பட்ட காய்கள்.
risks.mitigation_si: දිනපතා පරීක්ෂාව, ෆෙරමෝන උගුල්, සතිපතා ඉසීම.
risks.mitigation_ta: தினசரி ஆய்வு, இனக்கவர்ச்சிப் பொறிகள், வாராந்திரத் தெளிப்பு.

risks.name: Waterlogging
risks.description: Root rot and wilt promotion.
risks.mitigation: Raised beds, drainage channels.
risks.description_si: මුල් කුණුවීම සහ මැලවීම වැඩි කරයි.
risks.description_ta: வேர் அழுகலையும் வாடலையும் அதிகரிக்கும்.
risks.signs_si: තෙත් පසේ වුවද මැලවීම.
risks.mitigation_si: උස් කළ පාත්ති, ජලාපවහන කානු.
risks.mitigation_ta: உயர்த்திய பாத்திகள், வடிகால் வாய்க்கால்கள்.

harvest.method: Cut with short stalk. Handle carefully.
harvest.post_harvest: Store in cool shaded area. Market within 3–4 days.
harvest.method_si: කෙටි නටුවක් සමඟ කපන්න. ප්‍රවේශමෙන් හසුරුවන්න.
harvest.method_ta: சிறிய காம்புடன் வெட்டுங்கள். கவனமாகக் கையாளுங்கள்.
harvest.post_harvest_si: සිසිල් සෙවණ ඇති තැනක ගබඩා කරන්න. දින 3–4ක් ඇතුළත වෙළඳපොළට යවන්න.
harvest.post_harvest_ta: குளிர்ந்த நிழலான இடத்தில் சேமியுங்கள். 3–4 நாட்களுக்குள் சந்தைக்கு அனுப்புங்கள்.
indicators_si: ගෙඩි පූර්ණ ප්‍රමාණයට පැමිණ තද වී ඇත
indicators_ta: காய்கள் முழு அளவை அடைந்து உறுதியாக இருக்கும்

Elabatu (Thai Eggplant).growth_stages_text: Thai eggplant cultivation follows several important growth stages including germination, vegetative growth, flowering, fruit development, and harvesting. Germination usually occurs within 7–14 days after sowing, while the vegetative growth stage continues for about 30–40 days depending on environmental conditions and soil fertility. Flowering begins approximately 45–60 days after planting, followed by fruit formation and harvesting. Harvesting generally starts within 70–90 days after planting when the fruits become fully developed, firm, and reach the desired market size. Farmers commonly use seed propagation methods and maintain plant spacing of approximately 60–75 cm between plants and rows to ensure proper sunlight exposure, healthy branching, and good air circulation.
Elabatu (Thai Eggplant).management_text: Successful Thai eggplant cultivation requires a week-by-week crop management schedule including nursery preparation, land preparation, transplanting, fertilizer application, irrigation, weed control, pest monitoring, and harvesting activities. Fertilizer application is important during vegetative growth, flowering, and fruiting stages, commonly using nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium fertilizers, and organic compost to improve plant health and fruit production. Irrigation frequency varies according to crop growth stages, with frequent watering required during germination, flowering, and fruit development stages, while moderate irrigation is sufficient during vegetative growth. Farmers identify harvesting readiness when the fruits become shiny, firm, and reach suitable size and color for consumption and market use.
Elabatu (Thai Eggplant).disease_management_text: Disease and pest management are essential in Thai eggplant cultivation. Aphids and whiteflies suck plant sap, causing curling, yellowing, and weakening of leaves, while fruit and shoot borers damage shoots and fruits by feeding internally, reducing fruit quality and yield. Bacterial wilt causes sudden wilting and collapse of plants due to bacterial infection in the root and stem system, and fungal leaf spot diseases appear as dark or yellowish spots on leaves that reduce photosynthesis and plant vigor. These problems can be controlled through proper field sanitation, crop rotation, balanced fertilizer use, removal of infected plant parts, biological pest control methods, and recommended pesticide or fungicide applications when necessary. Risk mitigation practices such as regular field monitoring, proper irrigation management, maintaining soil fertility, use of healthy seedlings, and timely pest and disease control measures  help reduce crop losses and improve overall productivity.
Elabatu (Thai Eggplant).overview_si: ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ “එළබටු” ලෙස හැඳින්වෙන එළබටු (Solanum melongena ගණයේ) Solanaceae කුලයට අයත් නිවර්තන එළවළු බෝගයකි. උණුසුම් දේශගුණයට හැඩගැසීමේ හැකියාව සහ දේශීය ආහාරවල වැදගත්කම නිසා එය ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ බොහෝ ප්‍රදේශවල වගා කෙරේ. එළබටු 22°C–30°C අතර උෂ්ණත්වයේ හොඳින් වැඩෙන අතර, pH 5.5–6.8 අතර, හොඳින් ජලය බැස යන සාරවත් ලෝම හෝ වැලි පසකට කැමතිය. නිරෝගී වර්ධනයට සහ ගෙඩි වර්ධනයට මධ්‍යස්ථ වර්ෂාව, නිතිපතා ජලසම්පාදනය සහ ප්‍රමාණවත් හිරු එළිය අවශ්‍යය. එළබටු පැළවල කුඩා, රවුම්, කොළ හෝ ලා පැහැති ගෙඩි හටගන්නා අතර, ඒවා ව්‍යංජන සහ සාම්ප්‍රදායික ආහාර සඳහා බහුලව භාවිත වේ. සුදුසු පාරිසරික තත්ත්ව යටතේ වසර පුරා වගා කළ හැකි අතර, සාමාන්‍යයෙන් සිටුවීමෙන් දින 70–90 අතර අස්වනු නෙළීම ආරම්භ වේ. උෂ්ණත්වය, පාංශු තෙතමනය, ආර්ද්‍රතාව, වර්ෂාව, හිරු එළිය සහ පසේ සාරවත්බව වගාවට බලපාන ප්‍රධාන සාධක වේ. ගොවීන් කුඩිත්තා, සුදු මැස්සා, කඳ හා ගෙඩි විදින දළඹුවා, බැක්ටීරියා මැලවීම සහ දිලීර පත්‍ර පුල්ලි රෝග වැනි පොදු පළිබෝධ හා රෝග ද පාලනය කළ යුතු අතර, නිසි ලෙස පාලනය නොකළහොත් ඒවා අස්වැන්න සහ ගුණාත්මකභාවය බෙහෙවින් අඩු කරයි.
Elabatu (Thai Eggplant).overview_ta: இலங்கையில் “எலபட்டு” என அழைக்கப்படும் தாய் கத்தரி (Solanum melongena இனத்தைச் சேர்ந்தது), Solanaceae குடும்பத்தைச் சேர்ந்த அயனமண்டலக் காய்கறிப் பயிர். வெப்பமான காலநிலைக்கு ஏற்ப வளரும் தன்மையும் உள்ளூர் உணவில் அதன் முக்கியத்துவமும் காரணமாக இலங்கையின் பல பகுதிகளில் இது பயிரிடப்படுகிறது. எலபட்டு 22°C–30°C வெப்பநிலையில் நன்றாக வளரும்; pH 5.5–6.8 உள்ள, நன்கு நீர் வடியும் வளமான இருமண் அல்லது மணல் மண் சிறந்தது. ஆரோக்கியமான வளர்ச்சி மற்றும் காய் வளர்ச்சிக்கு மிதமான மழை, தொடர்ச்சியான நீர்ப்பாசனம், போதுமான சூரிய ஒளி அவசியம். இச்செடிகள் சிறிய, உருண்டையான பச்சை அல்லது வெளிர் நிறக் காய்களைத் தரும்; அவை கறிகளுக்கும் பாரம்பரிய உணவுகளுக்கும் பரவலாகப் பயன்படுகின்றன. ஏற்ற சூழலில் ஆண்டு முழுவதும் பயிரிடலாம்; பொதுவாக நடவு செய்து 70–90 நாட்களில் அறுவடை தொடங்கும். வெப்பநிலை, மண் ஈரப்பதம், காற்று ஈரப்பதம், மழை, சூரிய ஒளி, மண் வளம் ஆகியவை சாகுபடியைப் பாதிக்கும் முக்கியக் காரணிகள். அசுவினி, வெள்ளை ஈ, தண்டு மற்றும் காய்த் துளைப்பான், பாக்டீரியா வாடல், பூஞ்சை இலைப்புள்ளி நோய்கள் போன்ற பொதுவான பூச்சிகளையும் நோய்களையும் விவசாயிகள் கட்டுப்படுத்த வேண்டும்; இல்லையெனில் இவை மகசூலையும் தரத்தையும் பெருமளவு குறைக்கும்.

Tibbatu (Turkey Berry).overview: Tibbatu, scientifically known as Solanum torvum, is a small perennial vegetable and medicinal plant commonly grown in Sri Lanka. It belongs to the Solanaceae family and is widely cultivated in home gardens and rural agricultural areas throughout the country. Tibbatu grows well in tropical climatic conditions with temperatures ranging between 20°C and 30°C and can tolerate moderate drought conditions. The crop prefers well-drained sandy or loamy soils with a soil pH between 5.5 and 7.0. It requires moderate rainfall, adequate sunlight, and regular watering for healthy flowering and fruit production. The plant produces small green berry-like fruits that are commonly used in Sri Lankan cuisine and traditional medicine due to their nutritional and medicinal value. Tibbatu can be cultivated throughout the year under suitable environmental conditions and usually begins fruiting within a few months after planting. Important factors affecting cultivation include temperature, soil moisture, sunlight, rainfall, and soil fertility. Common pests and diseases affecting the crop include aphids, fruit borers, bacterial wilt, and fungal leaf diseases, which can reduce plant health and yield if not properly managed.

duration.note: days after planting to first harvest

stages.name: Land Preparation
stages.description: Minimal land prep needed — hardy plant.

activities.title: Clear land and dig planting holes
activities.description: Dig holes 30×30×30 cm. Fill with compost mix.
activities.why: Good start promotes fast establishment.
activities.title_si: බිම එළි පෙහෙළි කර සිටුවීමේ වළවල් හාරන්න
activities.description_si: සෙ.මී. 30×30×30 වළවල් හාරන්න. කොම්පෝස්ට් මිශ්‍රණයකින් පුරවන්න.
activities.description_ta: 30×30×30 செ.மீ குழிகள் தோண்டுங்கள். மக்கிய உரக் கலவையால் நிரப்புங்கள்.
activities.why_si: හොඳ ආරම්භයක් ඉක්මනින් ස්ථාපිත වීමට උපකාරී වේ.
activities.why_ta: நல்ல தொடக்கம் விரைவாக நிலைபெற உதவும்.

stages.description_si: අවම බිම් සැකසීමක් ප්‍රමාණවත් — ඔරොත්තු දෙන ශාකයකි.
stages.description_ta: குறைந்த நிலத் தயாரிப்பே போதும் — உறுதியான செடி.

stages.name: Planting & Establishment

activities.title: Plant seedlings or cuttings
activities.description: Water immediately. Shade for first week if hot.
activities.why: Good establishment reduces care needed later.
activities.description_si: වහාම ජලය දෙන්න. උණුසුම් නම් පළමු සතියේ සෙවණ දෙන්න.
activities.description_ta: உடனே நீர் பாய்ச்சுங்கள். வெப்பமாக இருந்தால் முதல் வாரம் நிழல் கொடுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: හොඳින් ස්ථාපිත වූ විට පසුව අවශ්‍ය රැකවරණය අඩු වේ.
activities.why_ta: நன்றாக நிலைபெற்றால் பின்னர் தேவைப்படும் பராமரிப்பு குறையும்.

activities.title: Water every 3 days for first month
activities.description: Maintain moisture at base.
activities.why: Young plants need consistent moisture.
activities.title_si: පළමු මාසය දින 3කට වරක් ජලය දෙන්න
activities.title_ta: முதல் மாதம் 3 நாட்களுக்கு ஒருமுறை நீர் பாய்ச்சுதல்
activities.description_si: පැළයේ මුල අසල තෙතමනය පවත්වා ගන්න.
activities.description_ta: செடியின் அடியில் ஈரப்பதத்தைப் பேணுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: ළපටි පැළවලට නොකඩවා තෙතමනය අවශ්‍යය.
activities.why_ta: இளம் செடிகளுக்குத் தொடர்ச்சியான ஈரப்பதம் தேவை.

stages.description_si: ළපටි පැළ ස්ථාපිත කරන්න.

stages.name: Vegetative Growth

activities.title: Apply compost mulch
activities.description: Apply 2 kg compost per plant as ring mulch.
activities.why: Slow-release nutrition for perennial plant.
activities.description_si: පැළයකට කොම්පෝස්ට් කි.ග්‍රෑ. 2ක් වළල්ලක් ලෙස වසුනක් වශයෙන් යොදන්න.
activities.description_ta: செடிக்கு 2 கி.கி மக்கிய உரத்தை வளைய மூடாக்காக இடுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: බහුවාර්ෂික පැළයට සෙමින් මුදාහරින පෝෂණය.
activities.why_ta: பல்லாண்டுச் செடிக்கு மெதுவாக விடுவிக்கப்படும் ஊட்டம்.

activities.title: Check for aphids and leaf spot
activities.description: Inspect leaves for pest and disease signs.
activities.why: Early management prevents spread.
activities.title_si: කුඩිත්තා සහ පත්‍ර පුල්ලි සඳහා පරීක්ෂා කරන්න
activities.description_si: පළිබෝධ සහ රෝග ලක්ෂණ සඳහා කොළ පරීක්ෂා කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: பூச்சி, நோய் அறிகுறிகளுக்காக இலைகளைச் சோதியுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: කලින්ම පාලනය කිරීමෙන් පැතිරීම වළකී.
activities.why_ta: முன்கூட்டியே கட்டுப்படுத்துவது பரவலைத் தடுக்கும்.

stages.description_si: පැළය ඵලදායී පඳුරක් බවට වැඩේ.

stages.name: Flowering & Fruiting

activities.title: Encourage branching
activities.description: Lightly prune main stem tip to encourage lateral branching.
activities.why: More branches = more fruiting points.
activities.description_si: පැති අතු බෙදීම දිරිමත් කිරීමට ප්‍රධාන කඳේ අග සැහැල්ලුවෙන් කප්පාදු කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: பக்கக் கிளைப்பை ஊக்குவிக்க முதன்மைத் தண்டின் நுனியை லேசாகக் கத்தரியுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: අතු වැඩි වන තරමට ගෙඩි හටගන්නා ස්ථාන වැඩිය.
activities.why_ta: கிளைகள் அதிகமானால் காய்க்கும் இடங்களும் அதிகம்.

activities.title: Maintain moisture during fruiting
activities.description: Water every 5–7 days.
activities.why: Consistent moisture improves fruit size.
activities.title_si: ගෙඩි හටගන්නා කාලයේ තෙතමනය පවත්වා ගන්න
activities.description_si: දින 5–7කට වරක් ජලය දෙන්න.
activities.description_ta: 5–7 நாட்களுக்கு ஒருமுறை நீர் பாய்ச்சுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: නොකඩවා තෙතමනය ගෙඩිවල ප්‍රමාණය වැඩි කරයි.
activities.why_ta: தொடர்ச்சியான ஈரப்பதம் காயின் அளவை அதிகரிக்கும்.

stages.description_si: පළමු ගෙඩි හටගැනීම ආරම්භ වේ.

stages.name: Harvest

activities.title: Begin first harvest
activities.description: Pick berry clusters when fully green and firm.
activities.why: Over-ripe berries become soft and less flavourful.
activities.description_si: ගෙඩි පොකුරු සම්පූර්ණයෙන් කොළ පැහැ සහ තද වූ විට නෙළන්න.
activities.description_ta: காய்க் கொத்துகள் முழுமையாகப் பச்சையாகவும் உறுதியாகவும் இருக்கும்போது பறியுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: ඉදුණු ගෙඩි මෘදු වී රසය අඩු වේ.
activities.why_ta: அதிகம் முற்றிய காய்கள் மென்மையாகிச் சுவை குறையும்.

activities.title: Harvest every 7–10 days
activities.description: Pick full clusters regularly.
activities.why: Regular picking stimulates new berry production.
activities.description_si: පූර්ණ පොකුරු නිතිපතා නෙළන්න.
activities.description_ta: முழுக் கொத்துகளையும் தொடர்ந்து பறியுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: නිතිපතා නෙළීම නව ගෙඩි හටගැනීම උත්තේජනය කරයි.
activities.why_ta: தொடர்ந்து பறிப்பது புதிய காய்ப்பைத் தூண்டும்.

stages.description_si: වසර ගණනාවක් පුරා නිතිපතා ගෙඩි නෙළන්න.

fertilization.why_si: කන්න ගණනාවක් පුරා ඵලදායිතාව පවත්වා ගන්න.

irrigation.notes: Tibbatu is drought tolerant once established. Reduce watering in rainy season.
irrigation.notes_si: තිබ්බටු ස්ථාපිත වූ පසු නියඟයට ඔරොත්තු දෙයි. වැසි කාලයේ ජලය දීම අඩු කරන්න.
irrigation.notes_ta: சுண்டைக்காய் நிலைபெற்ற பின் வறட்சியைத் தாங்கும். மழைக் காலத்தில் நீர்ப்பாசனத்தைக் குறையுங்கள்.

diseases.name: Bacterial Wilt
diseases.symptoms: Sudden wilting and collapse of plant; vascular browning in cut stem.
diseases.favorable_conditions: High soil moisture, warm temperatures, poor drainage.
diseases.prevention: Crop rotation. Raised beds. Avoid Solanaceae family in same plot.
diseases.treatment: No cure. Remove infected plants. Lime soil. Improve drainage.
diseases.symptoms_si: පැළය හදිසියේ මැලවී ඇද වැටීම; කපන ලද කඳේ සන්නායක පටක දුඹුරු වීම.
diseases.symptoms_ta: செடி திடீரென வாடிச் சரிதல்; வெட்டிய தண்டில் கடத்துத் திசு பழுப்பாதல்.
diseases.favorable_conditions_si: පසේ ඉහළ තෙතමනය, උණුසුම් උෂ්ණත්වය, දුර්වල ජලාපවහනය.
diseases.favorable_conditions_ta: மண்ணில் அதிக ஈரப்பதம், வெப்பமான வெப்பநிலை, மோசமான வடிகால்.
diseases.prevention_si: බෝග මාරුව. උස් කළ පාත්ති. එම බිමේම Solanaceae කුලයේ බෝග නොවගා කරන්න.
diseases.prevention_ta: பயிர்ச் சுழற்சி. உயர்த்திய பாத்திகள். அதே நிலத்தில் Solanaceae குடும்பப் பயிர்களைத் தவிருங்கள்.
diseases.treatment_si: ප්‍රතිකාරයක් නැත. ආසාදිත පැළ ඉවත් කරන්න. පසට හුණු යොදන්න. ජලාපවහනය වැඩි දියුණු කරන්න.
diseases.treatment_ta: சிகிச்சை இல்லை. பாதிக்கப்பட்ட செடிகளை அகற்றுங்கள். மண்ணுக்குச் சுண்ணாம்பு இடுங்கள். வடிகாலை மேம்படுத்துங்கள்.

diseases.name: Fungal Leaf Disease
diseases.symptoms: Yellow, brown, or black spots on leaves; reduces photosynthesis.
diseases.favorable_conditions: High humidity, poor air circulation, wet foliage.
diseases.prevention: Good plant spacing. Avoid overhead irrigation.
diseases.treatment: Mancozeb 80WP (2.5 g/L) or Copper Oxychloride (3 g/L).
diseases.symptoms_si: කොළ මත කහ, දුඹුරු හෝ කළු පැල්ලම්; ප්‍රභාසංශ්ලේෂණය අඩු කරයි.
diseases.symptoms_ta: இலைகளில் மஞ்சள், பழுப்பு அல்லது கருப்புப் புள்ளிகள்; ஒளிச்சேர்க்கையைக் குறைக்கும்.
diseases.favorable_conditions_si: ඉහළ ආර්ද්‍රතාව, දුර්වල වාතාශ්‍රය, තෙත් කොළ.
diseases.favorable_conditions_ta: அதிக ஈரப்பதம், மோசமான காற்றோட்டம், ஈரமான இலைகள்.
diseases.prevention_si: පැළ අතර හොඳ පරතරයක් තබන්න. ඉහළින් ජලය ඉසීමෙන් වළකින්න.
diseases.prevention_ta: செடிகளுக்கிடையே நல்ல இடைவெளி விடுங்கள். மேலிருந்து நீர் தெளிப்பதைத் தவிருங்கள்.
diseases.treatment_si: Mancozeb 80WP (ලීටරයකට ග්‍රෑ. 2.5) හෝ Copper Oxychloride (ලීටරයකට ග්‍රෑ. 3).
diseases.treatment_ta: Mancozeb 80WP (லிட்டருக்கு 2.5 கி) அல்லது Copper Oxychloride (லிட்டருக்கு 3 கி).

pests.name: Aphid
pests.damage: Sucks sap from young shoots causing leaf curling and weak growth.
pests.identification: Small soft-bodied insects on shoot tips and leaf undersides.
pests.prevention: Neem oil spray. Yellow sticky traps.
pests.treatment: Imidacloprid 200SL (0.3 ml/L) if heavy infestation.
pests.prevention_si: කොහොඹ තෙල් ඉසීම. කහ ඇලෙන උගුල්.
pests.prevention_ta: வேப்ப எண்ணெய் தெளிப்பு. மஞ்சள் ஒட்டும் பொறிகள்.
pests.treatment_si: ආසාදනය අධික නම් Imidacloprid 200SL (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 0.3).
pests.treatment_ta: தாக்குதல் அதிகமாக இருந்தால் Imidacloprid 200SL (லிட்டருக்கு 0.3 மி.லி).
pests.damage_si: ළපටි දළුවලින් යුෂ උරා බීමෙන් කොළ කොඩවීම සහ දුර්වල වර්ධනය ඇති කරයි.
pests.damage_ta: இளம் தளிர்களில் சாற்றை உறிஞ்சி இலைச் சுருளையும் வலுவற்ற வளர்ச்சியையும் ஏற்படுத்தும்.
pests.identification_si: දළු අග සහ කොළවල යටි පැත්තේ කුඩා මෘදු සිරුරු සහිත කෘමීන්.
pests.identification_ta: தளிர் நுனிகளிலும் இலைகளின் அடிப்பக்கத்திலும் சிறிய மென்னுடல் பூச்சிகள்.

pests.name: Fruit Borer
pests.damage: Damages developing fruits by feeding inside; reduces marketable yield.
pests.identification: Entry holes on fruit surface with frass; internal damage visible when cut.
pests.prevention: Pheromone traps. Remove and destroy infested fruits.
pests.treatment: Spinosad 45SC (0.3 ml/L). Spray when first entry holes noticed.
pests.prevention_si: ෆෙරමෝන උගුල්. ආසාදිත ගෙඩි ඉවත් කර විනාශ කරන්න.
pests.prevention_ta: இனக்கவர்ச்சிப் பொறிகள். பாதிக்கப்பட்ட காய்களை அகற்றி அழியுங்கள்.
pests.treatment_si: Spinosad 45SC (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 0.3). පළමු ඇතුළු වූ සිදුරු දුටු විට ඉසින්න.
pests.treatment_ta: Spinosad 45SC (லிட்டருக்கு 0.3 மி.லி). முதல் நுழைவுத் துளைகளைக் கண்டதும் தெளியுங்கள்.
pests.damage_si: වැඩෙන ගෙඩි ඇතුළත කමින් හානි කරයි; විකිණිය හැකි අස්වැන්න අඩු කරයි.
pests.damage_ta: வளரும் காய்களுக்குள் உண்டு சேதப்படுத்தும்; விற்கக்கூடிய மகசூலைக் குறைக்கும்.
pests.identification_si: ගෙඩියේ මතුපිට අසූචි සහිත ඇතුළු වූ සිදුරු; කැපූ විට ඇතුළත හානිය පෙනේ.
pests.identification_ta: காயின் மேற்பரப்பில் கழிவுடன் நுழைவுத் துளைகள்; வெட்டினால் உட்புறச் சேதம் தெரியும்.

risks.name: Drought
risks.description: Tibbatu is naturally drought tolerant. Severe drought reduces fruit size.
risks.mitigation: Water during prolonged dry spells.
risks.description_si: තිබ්බටු ස්වභාවයෙන්ම නියඟයට ඔරොත්තු දෙයි. දැඩි නියඟය ගෙඩිවල ප්‍රමාණය අඩු කරයි.
risks.description_ta: சுண்டைக்காய் இயற்கையாகவே வறட்சியைத் தாங்கும். கடும் வறட்சி காயின் அளவைக் குறைக்கும்.
risks.signs_si: ගෙඩි හැලීම, මැලවීම.
risks.mitigation_si: දිගු වියළි කාලවලදී ජලය දෙන්න.
risks.mitigation_ta: நீண்ட வறண்ட காலங்களில் நீர் பாய்ச்சுங்கள்.

risks.name: Waterlogging
risks.description: Root rot in poorly drained soils.
risks.mitigation: Plant on raised ground or ridges.
risks.description_si: ජලය හොඳින් බැස නොයන පසේ මුල් කුණුවීම.
risks.description_ta: நீர் சரியாக வடியாத மண்ணில் வேர் அழுகல்.
risks.signs_si: තෙත් පසේ පැළය මැලවීම.
risks.mitigation_si: උස් බිමක හෝ වැටි මත සිටුවන්න.
risks.mitigation_ta: மேடான இடத்திலோ முகடுகளிலோ நடுங்கள்.

harvest.method: Cut entire berry clusters with scissors. Handle carefully.
harvest.post_harvest: Store in cool shaded area. Use fresh for cooking. Market within 2–3 days.
harvest.method_si: කතුරකින් සම්පූර්ණ ගෙඩි පොකුරු කපන්න. ප්‍රවේශමෙන් හසුරුවන්න.
harvest.method_ta: கத்தரிக்கோலால் முழுக் காய்க் கொத்துகளை வெட்டுங்கள். கவனமாகக் கையாளுங்கள்.
harvest.post_harvest_si: සිසිල් සෙවණ ඇති තැනක ගබඩා කරන්න. නැවුම්ව ආහාරයට ගන්න. දින 2–3ක් ඇතුළත වෙළඳපොළට යවන්න.
harvest.post_harvest_ta: குளிர்ந்த நிழலான இடத்தில் சேமியுங்கள். புதிதாகச் சமையலுக்குப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள். 2–3 நாட்களுக்குள் சந்தைக்கு அனுப்புங்கள்.

Tibbatu (Turkey Berry).growth_stages_text: Tibbatu cultivation follows several important growth stages including germination, vegetative growth, flowering, fruit development, and harvesting. Germination generally occurs within 7–14 days after sowing, while the vegetative growth stage continues for about 30–45 days depending on environmental conditions and soil fertility. Flowering begins around 45–60 days after planting, followed by fruit formation and harvesting. Harvesting can usually begin within 70–90 days after planting when the fruits become fully developed, green, and firm. Farmers mainly use seed propagation methods and maintain proper spacing of approximately 60–90 cm between plants to ensure healthy plant growth, proper sunlight exposure, and air circulation.
Tibbatu (Turkey Berry).management_text: Successful cultivation requires a week-by-week management schedule including nursery preparation, land preparation, planting, fertilizer application, irrigation, weed management, pest monitoring, and harvesting activities. Fertilizer application is important during vegetative growth and flowering stages, commonly using organic compost together with nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium fertilizers to improve plant growth and fruit production. Irrigation frequency varies according to the crop stage, with regular watering required during germination, flowering, and fruiting stages, while moderate watering is sufficient during mature vegetative growth. Harvesting indicators include firm green fruits, healthy fruit size, and mature clusters suitable for consumption and market use.
Tibbatu (Turkey Berry).disease_management_text: Disease and pest management are essential in tibbatu cultivation. Aphids attack young leaves and shoots by sucking plant sap, causing leaf curling and weak plant growth. Fruit borers damage developing fruits by feeding inside them, reducing fruit quality and market value. Bacterial wilt causes sudden wilting and collapse of plants due to bacterial infection in the stem and root system, while fungal leaf diseases appear as yellow, brown, or black spots on leaves that reduce photosynthesis and overall plant health. These problems can be controlled through proper field sanitation, crop rotation, balanced fertilizer use, removal of infected plant parts, proper drainage, and recommended pesticide or fungicide applications when necessary. Risk mitigation practices such as regular field monitoring, maintaining healthy soil moisture levels, use of healthy seedlings, timely disease identification, and proper irrigation management help reduce crop losses and improve overall productivity.
Tibbatu (Turkey Berry).overview_si: Solanum torvum ලෙස විද්‍යාත්මකව හැඳින්වෙන තිබ්බටු ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ බහුලව වැවෙන කුඩා බහුවාර්ෂික එළවළු සහ ඖෂධීය ශාකයකි. Solanaceae කුලයට අයත් එය රට පුරා ගෙවතුවල සහ ග්‍රාමීය කෘෂිකාර්මික ප්‍රදේශවල බහුලව වගා කෙරේ. තිබ්බටු 20°C–30°C අතර උෂ්ණත්වයක් සහිත නිවර්තන දේශගුණයේ හොඳින් වැඩෙන අතර, මධ්‍යස්ථ නියඟයට ඔරොත්තු දිය හැක. pH 5.5–7.0 අතර, හොඳින් ජලය බැස යන වැලි හෝ ලෝම පසකට එය කැමතිය. නිරෝගී මල් පිපීමට සහ ගෙඩි ලැබීමට මධ්‍යස්ථ වර්ෂාව, ප්‍රමාණවත් හිරු එළිය සහ නිතිපතා ජලය දීම අවශ්‍යය. පැළය කුඩා, කොළ පැහැති, බෙරි වැනි ගෙඩි හටගන්වන අතර, ඒවායේ පෝෂණීය හා ඖෂධීය වටිනාකම නිසා ශ්‍රී ලාංකික ආහාරවල සහ සාම්ප්‍රදායික වෛද්‍ය ක්‍රමයේ බහුලව භාවිත වේ. සුදුසු පාරිසරික තත්ත්ව යටතේ වසර පුරා වගා කළ හැකි අතර, සාමාන්‍යයෙන් සිටුවීමෙන් මාස කිහිපයකින් ගෙඩි හටගැනීම ආරම්භ වේ. උෂ්ණත්වය, පාංශු තෙතමනය, හිරු එළිය, වර්ෂාව සහ පසේ සාරවත්බව වගාවට බලපාන ප්‍රධාන සාධක වේ. කුඩිත්තා, ගෙඩි විදින දළඹුවා, බැක්ටීරියා මැලවීම සහ දිලීර පත්‍ර රෝග මෙම බෝගයට බලපාන පොදු පළිබෝධ හා රෝග වන අතර, නිසි ලෙස පාලනය නොකළහොත් ඒවා පැළයේ සෞඛ්‍යය සහ අස්වැන්න අඩු කරයි.
Tibbatu (Turkey Berry).overview_ta: Solanum torvum என அறிவியல் பெயர் கொண்ட சுண்டைக்காய், இலங்கையில் பொதுவாக வளர்க்கப்படும் சிறிய பல்லாண்டுக் காய்கறி மற்றும் மருத்துவச் செடி. Solanaceae குடும்பத்தைச் சேர்ந்த இது நாடு முழுவதும் வீட்டுத் தோட்டங்களிலும் கிராமப்புற விவசாயப் பகுதிகளிலும் பரவலாகப் பயிரிடப்படுகிறது. சுண்டைக்காய் 20°C–30°C வெப்பநிலையுள்ள அயனமண்டலக் காலநிலையில் நன்றாக வளரும்; மிதமான வறட்சியையும் தாங்கும். pH 5.5–7.0 உள்ள, நன்கு நீர் வடியும் மணல் அல்லது இருமண் சிறந்தது. ஆரோக்கியமான பூப்பு மற்றும் காய் உற்பத்திக்கு மிதமான மழை, போதுமான சூரிய ஒளி, தொடர்ந்து நீர் பாய்ச்சுதல் தேவை. இச்செடி சிறிய, பச்சை நிற, பெர்ரி போன்ற காய்களைத் தரும்; அவற்றின் ஊட்டச்சத்து மற்றும் மருத்துவ மதிப்பு காரணமாக இலங்கை உணவிலும் பாரம்பரிய மருத்துவத்திலும் பரவலாகப் பயன்படுகின்றன. ஏற்ற சூழலில் ஆண்டு முழுவதும் பயிரிடலாம்; பொதுவாக நடவு செய்து சில மாதங்களில் காய்க்கத் தொடங்கும். வெப்பநிலை, மண் ஈரப்பதம், சூரிய ஒளி, மழை, மண் வளம் ஆகியவை சாகுபடியைப் பாதிக்கும் முக்கியக் காரணிகள். அசுவினி, காய்த் துளைப்பான், பாக்டீரியா வாடல், பூஞ்சை இலை நோய்கள் ஆகியவை இப்பயிரைத் தாக்கும் பொதுவான பூச்சிகளும் நோய்களும்; சரியாகக் கட்டுப்படுத்தாவிட்டால் இவை செடியின் ஆரோக்கியத்தையும் மகசூலையும் குறைக்கும்.

Bitter Gourd.overview: Bitter gourd, commonly known as “Karawila” in Sri Lanka, is a tropical vegetable crop belonging to the Cucurbitaceae family and scientifically known as Momordica charantia. It is widely cultivated throughout Sri Lanka due to its adaptability to warm climatic conditions and its nutritional and medicinal value. Bitter gourd grows best in temperatures between 24°C and 30°C and prefers well-drained fertile sandy or loamy soil with a soil pH ranging from 5.5 to 6.7. The crop requires moderate to high rainfall, regular irrigation, and adequate sunlight for healthy vine growth and fruit development. Bitter gourd is commonly used in Sri Lankan cuisine and traditional medicine because of its health benefits, including its ability to help regulate blood sugar levels. The crop generally begins harvesting within 55 to 70 days after planting and can continue producing fruits for several weeks under proper management. Important factors affecting cultivation include temperature, soil moisture, rainfall, humidity, sunlight, and soil fertility. Common pests and diseases affecting bitter gourd include fruit flies, aphids, red pumpkin beetles, powdery mildew, downy mildew, and viral diseases, which can significantly reduce crop quality and yield if not properly controlled.

stages.name: Land Preparation

activities.title: Dig planting pits
activities.description: Dig 45×45×45 cm pits. Fill with compost + topsoil mix (1:1).
activities.why: Deep pits with rich organic matter support vigorous vine growth.
activities.description_si: සෙ.මී. 45×45×45 වළවල් හාරන්න. කොම්පෝස්ට් + මතුපිට පස් (1:1) මිශ්‍රණයකින් පුරවන්න.
activities.description_ta: 45×45×45 செ.மீ குழிகள் தோண்டுங்கள். மக்கிய உரம் + மேல்மண் (1:1) கலவையால் நிரப்புங்கள்.
activities.why_si: කාබනික ද්‍රව්‍ය බහුල ගැඹුරු වළවල් ශක්තිමත් වැල් වර්ධනයට උපකාරී වේ.
activities.why_ta: கரிமப் பொருள் நிறைந்த ஆழமான குழிகள் வீரியமான கொடி வளர்ச்சிக்கு உதவும்.

activities.title: Install trellis
activities.description: Erect bamboo or wooden poles 2 m high with wire or string netting.
activities.why: Bitter gourd is a climbing vine and needs firm support from the start.
activities.description_si: කම්බි හෝ ලණු දැලක් සහිතව මීටර් 2ක් උස උණ හෝ ලී කණු සිටුවන්න.
activities.description_ta: கம்பி அல்லது கயிற்று வலையுடன் 2 மீ உயர மூங்கில் அல்லது மரக் கம்புகளை நடுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: කරවිල වැලක් වන බැවින් මුල සිටම ශක්තිමත් ආධාරකයක් අවශ්‍යය.
activities.why_ta: பாகற்காய் படரும் கொடி என்பதால் ஆரம்பத்திலிருந்தே உறுதியான ஆதாரம் தேவை.

stages.description_si: වළවල් සකස් කර මැස්ස සවි කරන්න.

stages.name: Sowing & Germination

activities.title: Sow seeds in pit
activities.description: Sow 2–3 seeds per pit at 2 cm depth. Water gently.
activities.why: Multiple seeds ensure at least one germinates.
activities.description_si: වළකට බීජ 2–3ක් සෙ.මී. 2ක් ගැඹුරට සිටුවන්න. මෘදුව ජලය දෙන්න.
activities.description_ta: குழிக்கு 2–3 விதைகளை 2 செ.மீ ஆழத்தில் விதையுங்கள். மெதுவாக நீர் ஊற்றுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: බීජ කිහිපයක් සිටුවීමෙන් අවම වශයෙන් එකක් හෝ පැළවීම සහතික වේ.
activities.why_ta: பல விதைகள் விதைப்பது குறைந்தது ஒன்றாவது முளைப்பதை உறுதிசெய்யும்.

activities.title: Thin to one plant
activities.description: Remove weaker seedlings, keeping the strongest.
activities.why: Competition between seedlings reduces overall vigour.
activities.description_si: දුර්වල පැළ ඉවත් කර ශක්තිමත්ම පැළය තබා ගන්න.
activities.description_ta: வலுவற்ற நாற்றுகளை அகற்றி, வலிமையானதை வைத்திருங்கள்.
activities.why_si: පැළ අතර තරඟය සමස්ත ශක්තිය අඩු කරයි.
activities.why_ta: நாற்றுகளுக்கிடையேயான போட்டி மொத்த வீரியத்தைக் குறைக்கும்.

activities.title: Water every 2 days
activities.description: Keep soil moist. Avoid waterlogging.
activities.why: Consistent moisture needed for germination.
activities.description_si: පස තෙත්ව තබා ගන්න. ජලය රැඳීමෙන් වළකින්න.
activities.description_ta: மண்ணை ஈரமாக வையுங்கள். நீர் தேங்குவதைத் தவிருங்கள்.
activities.why_si: පැළවීමට නොකඩවා තෙතමනය අවශ්‍යය.
activities.why_ta: முளைப்புக்குத் தொடர்ச்சியான ஈரப்பதம் தேவை.

stages.description_si: වළවල තුළ පැළ ස්ථාපිත කරන්න.

stages.name: Vine Growth
stages.description: Train vines and build vegetative frame.

activities.title: Train vines onto trellis
activities.description: Guide young tendrils onto the trellis as they emerge.
activities.why: Proper training maximises light interception and air flow.
activities.description_si: ළපටි අතු-දඟර මතු වන විට ඒවා මැස්ස මතට යොමු කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: இளம் பற்றுக்கம்பிகள் தோன்றும்போது அவற்றைப் பந்தலில் வழிநடத்துங்கள்.
activities.why_si: නිසි ලෙස හැසිරවීමෙන් ආලෝකය ලබාගැනීම සහ වාතය ගලායාම උපරිම වේ.
activities.why_ta: சரியான முறையில் படரவிடுவது ஒளி கிடைப்பையும் காற்றோட்டத்தையும் அதிகரிக்கும்.

activities.title: Top dressing 1
