activities.description: Urea 50 kg/ha in ring around plant.
activities.why: Nitrogen drives rapid vine extension.
activities.description_si: පැළය වටා වළල්ලක් ලෙස යූරියා හෙක්ටයාරයකට කි.ග්‍රෑ. 50.
activities.description_ta: செடியைச் சுற்றி வளையமாக எக்டேருக்கு 50 கி.கி யூரியா.
activities.why_si: නයිට්‍රජන් වැල් වේගයෙන් දිගු වීමට දායක වේ.
activities.why_ta: நைட்ரஜன் கொடி வேகமாக நீள்வதைத் தூண்டும்.

activities.title: Weed around base
activities.description: Remove weeds within 30 cm of plant base.
activities.why: Weeds reduce nutrients and harbour pests.
activities.description_si: පැළයේ මුලේ සිට සෙ.මී. 30ක් ඇතුළත වල් පැළෑටි ඉවත් කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: செடியின் அடியிலிருந்து 30 செ.மீ சுற்றளவுக்குள் களைகளை அகற்றுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: වල් පැළෑටි පෝෂක අඩු කරන අතර පළිබෝධකයන්ට වාසස්ථාන සපයයි.
activities.why_ta: களைகள் ஊட்டச்சத்தைக் குறைத்து பூச்சிகளுக்குப் புகலிடமாகும்.

stages.description_si: වැල් හසුරුවා ශාක රාමුව ගොඩනඟන්න.

stages.name: Flowering & Fruiting

activities.title: Check male/female flower ratio
activities.description: First flowers are male. Female flowers (with small fruit at base) appear later.
activities.why: Understanding flower types helps identify poor pollination issues.
activities.description_si: මුල්ම මල් පුරුෂ මල් වේ. ස්ත්‍රී මල් (පාමුලේ කුඩා ගෙඩියක් සහිත) පසුව මතු වේ.
activities.description_ta: முதலில் வரும் பூக்கள் ஆண் பூக்கள். பெண் பூக்கள் (அடியில் சிறிய பிஞ்சுடன்) பின்னர் தோன்றும்.
activities.why_si: මල් වර්ග තේරුම් ගැනීමෙන් දුර්වල පරාගණ ගැටලු හඳුනාගත හැක.
activities.why_ta: பூ வகைகளைப் புரிந்துகொள்வது மகரந்தச் சேர்க்கைக் குறைபாடுகளைக் கண்டறிய உதவும்.

activities.title: Top dressing 2
activities.description: Urea 50 kg/ha + MOP 50 kg/ha.
activities.why: Potassium during fruiting improves fruit weight and bitterness.
activities.description_si: යූරියා හෙක්ටයාරයකට කි.ග්‍රෑ. 50 + MOP කි.ග්‍රෑ. 50.
activities.description_ta: எக்டேருக்கு 50 கி.கி யூரியா + 50 கி.கி MOP.
activities.why_si: ගෙඩි හටගන්නා කාලයේ පොටෑසියම් ගෙඩිවල බර සහ තිත්තබව වැඩි කරයි.
activities.why_ta: காய்க்கும் காலத்தில் பொட்டாசியம் காயின் எடையையும் கசப்பையும் அதிகரிக்கும்.

activities.title: Scout for fruit fly
activities.description: Check fruits for puncture marks and ooze. Set protein bait traps.
activities.why: Fruit fly is the most damaging pest of bitter gourd.
activities.description_si: ගෙඩිවල කටු ඇනුම් සලකුණු සහ ස්‍රාව සඳහා පරීක්ෂා කරන්න. ප්‍රෝටීන් ඇම උගුල් තබන්න.
activities.description_ta: காய்களில் துளைக் குறிகளும் கசிவும் உள்ளனவா எனப் பாருங்கள். புரத இரைப் பொறிகளை வையுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: ගෙඩි මැස්සා කරවිලවලට වඩාත්ම හානිකර පළිබෝධයයි.
activities.why_ta: பழ ஈ பாகற்காயின் மிகச் சேதம் விளைவிக்கும் பூச்சி.

stages.description_si: පරාගණය සහ ගෙඩි වර්ධනය.

stages.name: Harvest

activities.title: First harvest
activities.description: Harvest fruits when full sized but still firm and green (before turning yellow/orange).
activities.why: Over-ripe fruits lose market value and reduce further yield.
activities.description_si: ගෙඩි පූර්ණ ප්‍රමාණයට පැමිණ, තවමත් තද හා කොළ පැහැයෙන් ඇති විට (කහ/තැඹිලි වීමට පෙර) නෙළන්න.
activities.description_ta: காய்கள் முழு அளவை அடைந்து, இன்னும் உறுதியாகவும் பச்சையாகவும் இருக்கும்போது (மஞ்சள்/ஆரஞ்சு ஆவதற்கு முன்) பறியுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: ඉදුණු ගෙඩිවල වෙළඳපොළ වටිනාකම අඩු වන අතර ඉදිරි අස්වැන්න ද අඩු වේ.
activities.why_ta: அதிகம் முற்றிய காய்கள் சந்தை மதிப்பை இழக்கும்; அடுத்த மகசூலும் குறையும்.

activities.title: Harvest every 2–3 days
activities.description: Pick all mature fruits. Never leave yellowing fruits.
activities.why: Leaving mature fruits stops new fruit development.
activities.description_si: මේරූ සියලු ගෙඩි නෙළන්න. කහ වන ගෙඩි කිසි විටෙක වැලේ නොතබන්න.
activities.description_ta: முற்றிய எல்லாக் காய்களையும் பறியுங்கள். மஞ்சளாகும் காய்களைக் கொடியில் ஒருபோதும் விடாதீர்கள்.
activities.why_si: මේරූ ගෙඩි වැලේ තැබීමෙන් නව ගෙඩි හටගැනීම නතර වේ.
activities.why_ta: முற்றிய காய்களைக் கொடியில் விட்டால் புதிய காய்ப்பு நின்றுவிடும்.

stages.description_si: ළපටි, මෘදු ගෙඩි නිතිපතා නෙළන්න.

fertilization.why: Rich pit preparation feeds vine throughout season.
fertilization.why_si: පෝෂක බහුල වළ සැකසීම මුළු කන්නය පුරාම වැලට පෝෂණය සපයයි.
fertilization.why_ta: வளமான குழித் தயாரிப்பு பருவம் முழுவதும் கொடிக்கு ஊட்டம் தரும்.
fertilization.timing_si: මූලික පොහොර — වළ සකස් කරන විට

irrigation.notes: Do not let soil dry out during flowering — causes flower and fruit drop.
irrigation.method_si: වළ ළඟ පාත්ති ක්‍රමයට ජලය දීම
irrigation.notes_si: මල් පිපෙන කාලයේ පස වියළීමට ඉඩ නොදෙන්න — එයින් මල් සහ ගෙඩි හැලේ.
irrigation.notes_ta: பூக்கும் காலத்தில் மண் காய விடாதீர்கள் — பூ, காய் உதிர்வை ஏற்படுத்தும்.

diseases.name: Powdery Mildew
diseases.symptoms: White powder-like fungal coating on upper leaf surfaces and stems.
diseases.favorable_conditions: High temperatures (25–30°C), low humidity, dry conditions.
diseases.prevention: Good air circulation. Avoid overcrowding. Remove infected leaves.
diseases.treatment: Wettable Sulphur (3 g/L) or Tebuconazole (1 ml/L) every 10 days.
diseases.symptoms_si: කොළවල උඩු පැත්තේ සහ කඳන් මත සුදු පිටි වැනි දිලීර තට්ටුවක්.
diseases.symptoms_ta: இலைகளின் மேற்பரப்பிலும் தண்டுகளிலும் வெண்மையான தூள் போன்ற பூஞ்சைப் படலம்.
diseases.favorable_conditions_si: ඉහළ උෂ්ණත්වය (25–30°C), අඩු ආර්ද්‍රතාව, වියළි තත්ත්ව.
diseases.favorable_conditions_ta: அதிக வெப்பநிலை (25–30°C), குறைந்த ஈரப்பதம், வறண்ட நிலை.
diseases.prevention_si: හොඳ වාතාශ්‍රය. පැළ ඝන වීමෙන් වළකින්න. ආසාදිත කොළ ඉවත් කරන්න.
diseases.prevention_ta: நல்ல காற்றோட்டம். செடிகள் நெருக்கமாவதைத் தவிருங்கள். பாதிக்கப்பட்ட இலைகளை அகற்றுங்கள்.
diseases.treatment_si: Wettable Sulphur (ලීටරයකට ග්‍රෑ. 3) හෝ Tebuconazole (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 1) දින 10කට වරක්.
diseases.treatment_ta: Wettable Sulphur (லிட்டருக்கு 3 கி) அல்லது Tebuconazole (லிட்டருக்கு 1 மி.லி) 10 நாட்களுக்கு ஒருமுறை.

diseases.name: Downy Mildew
diseases.symptoms: Yellow angular patches on upper leaf surface; greyish-purple downy growth below.
diseases.favorable_conditions: High humidity, cool nights, heavy dew, poor air circulation.
diseases.prevention: Widen plant spacing. Avoid overhead irrigation. Trellis to improve airflow.
diseases.treatment: Metalaxyl-M + Mancozeb (2.5 g/L) every 7 days.
diseases.symptoms_si: කොළවල උඩු පැත්තේ කහ කෝණික ලප; යට පැත්තේ අළු-දම් පැහැ පුළුන් වැනි වර්ධනය.
diseases.symptoms_ta: இலையின் மேற்பரப்பில் மஞ்சள் கோணத் திட்டுகள்; அடிப்பக்கத்தில் சாம்பல்-ஊதா பஞ்சு போன்ற வளர்ச்சி.
diseases.favorable_conditions_si: ඉහළ ආර්ද්‍රතාව, සිසිල් රාත්‍රී, අධික පිනි, දුර්වල වාතාශ්‍රය.
diseases.favorable_conditions_ta: அதிக ஈரப்பதம், குளிர்ந்த இரவுகள், அதிக பனித்துளி, மோசமான காற்றோட்டம்.
diseases.prevention_si: පැළ අතර පරතරය වැඩි කරන්න. ඉහළින් ජලය ඉසීමෙන් වළකින්න. වාතය ගලායාමට මැස්සක් භාවිත කරන්න.
diseases.prevention_ta: செடி இடைவெளியை அதிகரியுங்கள். மேலிருந்து நீர் தெளிப்பதைத் தவிருங்கள். காற்றோட்டத்துக்குப் பந்தல் அமையுங்கள்.
diseases.treatment_si: Metalaxyl-M + Mancozeb (ලීටරයකට ග්‍රෑ. 2.5) දින 7කට වරක්.
diseases.treatment_ta: Metalaxyl-M + Mancozeb (லிட்டருக்கு 2.5 கி) 7 நாட்களுக்கு ஒருமுறை.

diseases.name: Viral Diseases (Mosaic)
diseases.symptoms: Mosaic yellow-green patterns on leaves; leaf distortion; stunted growth; reduced yield.
diseases.favorable_conditions: High aphid/whitefly populations; hot dry weather.
diseases.prevention: Control vectors with sticky traps. Use virus-free seeds. Remove infected plants immediately.
diseases.treatment: No cure. Focus on vector control: Imidacloprid (0.3 ml/L) or Thiamethoxam.
diseases.cause_si: වෛරස (CMV, WMV — කුඩිත්තා/සුදු මැස්සා මගින් පැතිරේ)
diseases.cause_ta: வைரஸ் (CMV, WMV — அசுவினி/வெள்ளை ஈ மூலம் பரவும்)
diseases.symptoms_si: කොළ මත කහ-කොළ මොසෙයික් රටා; කොළ විකෘති වීම; වර්ධනය බාල වීම; අස්වැන්න අඩු වීම.
diseases.symptoms_ta: இலைகளில் மஞ்சள்-பச்சைத் தேமல் வடிவங்கள்; இலை உருக்குலைவு; வளர்ச்சிக் குன்றல்; மகசூல் குறைவு.
diseases.favorable_conditions_si: කුඩිත්තා/සුදු මැස්සන් ගහනය වැඩි වීම; උණුසුම් වියළි කාලගුණය.
diseases.favorable_conditions_ta: அதிக அசுவினி/வெள்ளை ஈக்கள்; வெப்பமான வறண்ட வானிலை.
diseases.prevention_si: ඇලෙන උගුල් මගින් වාහකයන් පාලනය කරන්න. වෛරසවලින් තොර බීජ භාවිත කරන්න. ආසාදිත පැළ වහාම ඉවත් කරන්න.
diseases.prevention_ta: ஒட்டும் பொறிகள் மூலம் நோய் பரப்பிகளைக் கட்டுப்படுத்துங்கள். வைரஸற்ற விதைகளைப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள். பாதிக்கப்பட்ட செடிகளை உடனே அகற்றுங்கள்.
diseases.treatment_si: ප්‍රතිකාරයක් නැත. වාහක පාලනය කෙරෙහි අවධානය යොමු කරන්න: Imidacloprid (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 0.3) හෝ Thiamethoxam.
diseases.treatment_ta: சிகிச்சை இல்லை. நோய் பரப்பிகளைக் கட்டுப்படுத்துவதில் கவனம் செலுத்துங்கள்: Imidacloprid (லிட்டருக்கு 0.3 மி.லி) அல்லது Thiamethoxam.

pests.name: Fruit Fly
pests.damage: Lays eggs inside developing fruits causing internal rotting and market rejection.
pests.identification: Soft watery spots on fruits; maggots inside when cut open.
pests.prevention: Protein bait traps. Cover young fruits with bags. Collect and destroy fallen fruits.
pests.treatment: Malathion bait spray (Malathion + molasses + water). Fipronil bait stations.
pests.prevention_si: ප්‍රෝටීන් ඇම උගුල්. ළපටි ගෙඩි උරවලින් ආවරණය කරන්න. බිම වැටුණු ගෙඩි එකතු කර විනාශ කරන්න.
pests.prevention_ta: புரத இரைப் பொறிகள். இளம் காய்களைப் பைகளால் மூடுங்கள். கீழே விழுந்த காய்களைச் சேகரித்து அழியுங்கள்.
pests.treatment_si: Malathion ඇම ඉසීම (Malathion + පැණි + ජලය). Fipronil ඇම මධ්‍යස්ථාන.
pests.treatment_ta: Malathion இரைத் தெளிப்பு (Malathion + வெல்லப்பாகு + நீர்). Fipronil இரை நிலையங்கள்.
pests.damage_si: වැඩෙන ගෙඩි තුළ බිත්තර දමන බැවින් ගෙඩි ඇතුළතින් කුණු වී වෙළඳපොළේ ප්‍රතික්ෂේප වේ.
pests.damage_ta: வளரும் காய்களுக்குள் முட்டையிடுவதால் காய்கள் உள்ளே அழுகி சந்தையில் நிராகரிக்கப்படும்.
pests.identification_si: ගෙඩි මත මෘදු ජලමය ලප; කපා බැලූ විට ඇතුළත පණුවන්.
pests.identification_ta: காய்களில் மென்மையான நீர்க்கோர்த்த புள்ளிகள்; வெட்டினால் உள்ளே புழுக்கள்.

pests.name: Aphid
pests.damage: Sucks sap; major vector of viral mosaic diseases.
pests.identification: Clusters on new shoots; sticky honeydew on leaves attracting ants.
pests.prevention: Yellow sticky traps. Reflective silver mulch. Neem oil spray.
pests.treatment: Imidacloprid 200SL (0.3 ml/L) or Acetamiprid. Spray at first sighting.
pests.prevention_si: කහ ඇලෙන උගුල්. රිදී පැහැති පරාවර්තක වසුන්. කොහොඹ තෙල් ඉසීම.
pests.prevention_ta: மஞ்சள் ஒட்டும் பொறிகள். வெள்ளி நிற ஒளிபிரதிபலிக்கும் மூடாக்கு. வேப்ப எண்ணெய் தெளிப்பு.
pests.treatment_si: Imidacloprid 200SL (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 0.3) හෝ Acetamiprid. මුලින්ම දුටු විට ඉසින්න.
pests.treatment_ta: Imidacloprid 200SL (லிட்டருக்கு 0.3 மி.லி) அல்லது Acetamiprid. முதலில் கண்டதும் தெளியுங்கள்.
pests.damage_si: යුෂ උරා බොයි; මොසෙයික් වෛරස රෝගවල ප්‍රධාන වාහකයාය.
pests.damage_ta: சாற்றை உறிஞ்சும்; தேமல் வைரஸ் நோய்களைப் பரப்பும் முக்கியப் பூச்சி.
pests.identification_si: නව දළු මත පොකුරු; කොළ මත කූඹින් ආකර්ෂණය කරන ඇලෙන සුළු මී පැණි වැනි ස්‍රාවයක්.
pests.identification_ta: புதிய தளிர்களில் கூட்டங்கள்; இலைகளில் எறும்புகளைக் கவரும் ஒட்டும் தேன் போன்ற திரவம்.

pests.name: Red Pumpkin Beetle
pests.damage: Adults feed on leaves and cotyledons of young plants; severe damage in early stages.
pests.identification: Shiny red-orange beetles (5–8 mm) visible on leaves; large irregular leaf holes.
pests.prevention: Row covers at seedling stage. Hand-pick adults in morning.
pests.treatment: Chlorpyrifos 20EC (2 ml/L) or Carbaryl (2 g/L). Apply in early morning.
pests.prevention_si: පැළ අවධියේදී පේළි ආවරණ. උදෑසන වැඩිහිටි කුරුමිණියන් අතින් අල්ලා ඉවත් කරන්න.
pests.prevention_ta: நாற்று நிலையில் வரிசை மூடிகள். காலையில் முதிர்ந்த வண்டுகளைக் கையால் பொறுக்கி அகற்றுங்கள்.
pests.treatment_si: Chlorpyrifos 20EC (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 2) හෝ Carbaryl (ලීටරයකට ග්‍රෑ. 2). අලුයම යොදන්න.
pests.treatment_ta: Chlorpyrifos 20EC (லிட்டருக்கு 2 மி.லி) அல்லது Carbaryl (லிட்டருக்கு 2 கி). அதிகாலையில் தெளியுங்கள்.
pests.damage_si: වැඩිහිටි කුරුමිණියෝ ළපටි පැළවල කොළ සහ බීජ පත්‍ර කති; මුල් අවධිවලදී දැඩි හානියක් කරයි.
pests.damage_ta: முதிர்ந்த வண்டுகள் இளம் செடிகளின் இலைகளையும் வித்திலைகளையும் உண்ணும்; ஆரம்ப நிலைகளில் கடும் சேதம் ஏற்படுத்தும்.
pests.identification_si: කොළ මත දිලිසෙන රතු-තැඹිලි කුරුමිණියන් (මි.මී. 5–8); කොළවල විශාල අක්‍රමවත් සිදුරු.
pests.identification_ta: இலைகளில் பளபளப்பான சிவப்பு-ஆரஞ்சு வண்டுகள் (5–8 மி.மீ); இலைகளில் பெரிய ஒழுங்கற்ற துளைகள்.

risks.name: Fruit Fly
risks.description: Most serious threat. Can destroy 40–60% of harvest.
risks.signs: Punctured fruits with ooze, larvae in cut fruits.
risks.mitigation: Protein bait traps from day 40. Harvest frequently. Remove fallen fruits daily.
risks.description_si: වඩාත්ම බරපතල තර්ජනය. අස්වැන්නෙන් 40–60%ක් විනාශ කළ හැක.
risks.description_ta: மிகக் கடுமையான அச்சுறுத்தல். அறுவடையில் 40–60% அழிக்கலாம்.
risks.signs_si: ස්‍රාව සහිත විදින ලද ගෙඩි, කැපූ ගෙඩි තුළ කීටයන්.
risks.signs_ta: கசிவுடன் துளைக்கப்பட்ட காய்கள், வெட்டிய காய்களுக்குள் புழுக்கள்.
risks.mitigation_si: 40 වන දින සිට ප්‍රෝටීන් ඇම උගුල්. නිතර අස්වනු නෙළන්න. බිම වැටුණු ගෙඩි දිනපතා ඉවත් කරන්න.
risks.mitigation_ta: 40வது நாளிலிருந்து புரத இரைப் பொறிகள். அடிக்கடி அறுவடை செய்யுங்கள். கீழே விழுந்த காய்களைத் தினமும் அகற்றுங்கள்.

risks.name: Excessive Rain
risks.description: Promotes powdery and downy mildew. Poor pollination in heavy rain.
risks.signs: White powdery patches, angular yellow spots.
risks.mitigation: Preventive fungicide spray before rainy season.
risks.description_si: පිටි පුස් සහ ඩවුනි මිල්ඩිව් රෝග වැඩි කරයි. අධික වැස්සේදී පරාගණය දුර්වල වේ.
risks.description_ta: சாம்பல் நோயையும் அடிச்சாம்பல் நோயையும் அதிகரிக்கும். கனமழையில் மகரந்தச் சேர்க்கை குறையும்.
risks.signs_si: සුදු පිටි වැනි ලප, කෝණික කහ පැල්ලම්.
risks.signs_ta: வெண்மையான தூள் போன்ற திட்டுகள், கோண மஞ்சள் புள்ளிகள்.
risks.mitigation_si: වැසි කාලයට පෙර වැළැක්වීම සඳහා දිලීර නාශක ඉසීම.
risks.mitigation_ta: மழைக் காலத்துக்கு முன் தடுப்புப் பூஞ்சைக்கொல்லி தெளிப்பு.

indicators: Fruit full sized with prominent ridges/warts
Skin is dark green and firm
harvest.method: Cut with sharp knife or scissors. Leave 2 cm stalk.
harvest.post_harvest: Store in cool shaded area. Market within 3–4 days. Avoid bruising.
harvest.method_si: තියුණු පිහියකින් හෝ කතුරකින් කපන්න. සෙ.මී. 2ක නටුවක් ඉතිරි කරන්න.
harvest.method_ta: கூர்மையான கத்தி அல்லது கத்தரிக்கோலால் வெட்டுங்கள். 2 செ.மீ காம்பை விடுங்கள்.
harvest.post_harvest_si: සිසිල් සෙවණ ඇති තැනක ගබඩා කරන්න. දින 3–4ක් ඇතුළත වෙළඳපොළට යවන්න. තැලීම් වළකින්න.
harvest.post_harvest_ta: குளிர்ந்த நிழலான இடத்தில் சேமியுங்கள். 3–4 நாட்களுக்குள் சந்தைக்கு அனுப்புங்கள். நசுங்குவதைத் தவிருங்கள்.

පොත්ත තද කොළ පැහැ සහ තදය
කහ පැහැය ගැනීම ආරම්භ වීම යනු ඉදී ඇති බවයි
indicators_ta: மஞ்சள் நிறம் தோன்றத் தொடங்கினால் அதிகம் முற்றிவிட்டது

Bitter Gourd.growth_stages_text: Bitter gourd cultivation follows several important growth stages including germination, vegetative vine growth, flowering, fruit development, and harvesting. Germination usually occurs within 5–10 days after sowing, while vegetative growth continues for about 20–30 days depending on environmental conditions and nutrient availability. Flowering generally begins around 30–40 days after planting, followed by fruit formation and harvesting. The crop usually starts producing harvestable fruits within 55–70 days after planting. Farmers commonly use direct seeding methods and maintain proper spacing of approximately 1.5–2 meters between plants and rows to provide enough space for vine spreading, sunlight exposure, and air circulation. Trellis systems or vertical supports are also commonly used to improve fruit quality and reduce disease incidence.
Bitter Gourd.management_text: Successful bitter gourd cultivation requires a week-by-week management schedule including land preparation, seed sowing, fertilizer application, irrigation, weed management, vine training, pest monitoring, and harvesting activities. Fertilizer application is important during vegetative growth, flowering, and fruiting stages, commonly using nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium fertilizers, and organic compost to improve vine growth and fruit production. Irrigation frequency varies according to crop growth stages, with frequent watering required during germination, flowering, and fruit development stages, while moderate irrigation is maintained during mature vegetative growth. Farmers identify harvesting readiness when fruits become fully elongated, green, tender, and reach suitable size before over-ripening occurs.
Bitter Gourd.disease_management_text: Disease and pest management are essential in successful bitter gourd cultivation. Fruit flies lay eggs inside developing fruits, causing rotting and internal damage that reduce market quality. Aphids suck plant sap, resulting in curling, yellowing, and weakening of leaves, while red pumpkin beetles feed on leaves and young seedlings causing severe plant damage. Powdery mildew appears as white powder-like growth on leaves and stems, reducing photosynthesis and plant vigor, while downy mildew causes yellow patches and fungal growth under humid conditions. Viral diseases may cause leaf curling, mosaic patterns, and stunted growth, significantly affecting yield. These problems can be controlled through proper field sanitation, crop rotation, balanced fertilizer use, removal of infected fruits and leaves, use of trellis systems, biological pest control methods, and recommended pesticide or fungicide applications when necessary. Risk mitigation practices such as regular field monitoring, proper drainage management, timely irrigation, use of healthy seeds, and climate-aware cultivation methods help reduce crop losses and improve overall productivity.
Bitter Gourd.overview_si: ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ “කරවිල” ලෙස හැඳින්වෙන කරවිල (Momordica charantia) Cucurbitaceae කුලයට අයත් නිවර්තන එළවළු බෝගයකි. උණුසුම් දේශගුණයට හැඩගැසීමේ හැකියාව සහ පෝෂණීය හා ඖෂධීය වටිනාකම නිසා එය ශ්‍රී ලංකාව පුරා බහුලව වගා කෙරේ. කරවිල 24°C–30°C අතර උෂ්ණත්වයේ හොඳින් වැඩෙන අතර, pH 5.5–6.7 අතර, හොඳින් ජලය බැස යන සාරවත් වැලි හෝ ලෝම පසකට කැමතිය. නිරෝගී වැල් වර්ධනයට සහ ගෙඩි වර්ධනයට මධ්‍යස්ථ සිට ඉහළ වර්ෂාව, නිතිපතා ජලසම්පාදනය සහ ප්‍රමාණවත් හිරු එළිය අවශ්‍යය. රුධිරයේ සීනි මට්ටම පාලනයට උපකාරී වීම ඇතුළු සෞඛ්‍ය ප්‍රතිලාභ නිසා කරවිල ශ්‍රී ලාංකික ආහාරවල සහ සාම්ප්‍රදායික වෛද්‍ය ක්‍රමයේ බහුලව භාවිත වේ. සාමාන්‍යයෙන් සිටුවීමෙන් දින 55–70 අතර අස්වනු නෙළීම ආරම්භ වන අතර, නිසි කළමනාකරණය යටතේ සති කිහිපයක් පුරා ගෙඩි ලැබේ. උෂ්ණත්වය, පාංශු තෙතමනය, වර්ෂාව, ආර්ද්‍රතාව, හිරු එළිය සහ පසේ සාරවත්බව වගාවට බලපාන ප්‍රධාන සාධක වේ. ගෙඩි මැස්සා, කුඩිත්තා, රතු වට්ටක්කා කුරුමිණියා, පිටි පුස් රෝගය, ඩවුනි මිල්ඩිව් රෝගය සහ වෛරස රෝග කරවිලවලට බලපාන පොදු පළිබෝධ හා රෝග වන අතර, නිසි ලෙස පාලනය නොකළහොත් ඒවා ගුණාත්මකභාවය සහ අස්වැන්න බෙහෙවින් අඩු කරයි.
Bitter Gourd.overview_ta: இலங்கையில் “கரவில” என அழைக்கப்படும் பாகற்காய் (Momordica charantia), Cucurbitaceae குடும்பத்தைச் சேர்ந்த அயனமண்டலக் காய்கறிப் பயிர். வெப்பமான காலநிலைக்கு ஏற்ப வளரும் தன்மையும் ஊட்டச்சத்து மற்றும் மருத்துவ மதிப்பும் காரணமாக இலங்கை முழுவதும் பரவலாகப் பயிரிடப்படுகிறது. பாகற்காய் 24°C–30°C வெப்பநிலையில் நன்றாக வளரும்; pH 5.5–6.7 உள்ள, நன்கு நீர் வடியும் வளமான மணல் அல்லது இருமண் சிறந்தது. ஆரோக்கியமான கொடி வளர்ச்சி மற்றும் காய் வளர்ச்சிக்கு மிதமானது முதல் அதிகமான மழை, தொடர்ச்சியான நீர்ப்பாசனம், போதுமான சூரிய ஒளி தேவை. இரத்தச் சர்க்கரை அளவைக் கட்டுப்படுத்த உதவுவது உட்பட உடல்நல நன்மைகள் இருப்பதால் பாகற்காய் இலங்கை உணவிலும் பாரம்பரிய மருத்துவத்திலும் பரவலாகப் பயன்படுகிறது. பொதுவாக நடவு செய்து 55–70 நாட்களில் அறுவடை தொடங்கும்; சரியான பராமரிப்பில் பல வாரங்கள் காய் கிடைக்கும். வெப்பநிலை, மண் ஈரப்பதம், மழை, காற்று ஈரப்பதம், சூரிய ஒளி, மண் வளம் ஆகியவை சாகுபடியைப் பாதிக்கும் முக்கியக் காரணிகள். பழ ஈ, அசுவினி, சிவப்புப் பூசணி வண்டு, சாம்பல் நோய், அடிச்சாம்பல் நோய், வைரஸ் நோய்கள் ஆகியவை பாகற்காயைத் தாக்கும் பொதுவான பூச்சிகளும் நோய்களும்; சரியாகக் கட்டுப்படுத்தாவிட்டால் இவை தரத்தையும் மகசூலையும் பெருமளவு குறைக்கும்.

Luffa.overview: Luffa, commonly known as “Niyan Wetakolu” or sponge gourd in Sri Lanka, is a tropical vegetable crop belonging to the Cucurbitaceae family and scientifically known as Luffa aegyptiaca (or Luffa cylindrica). It is widely cultivated in many parts of Sri Lanka, especially in home gardens and dry to intermediate zone agricultural areas, due to its adaptability to warm climatic conditions. Luffa grows best in temperatures between 24°C and 32°C and requires well-drained fertile sandy or loamy soil with a soil pH ranging from 5.5 to 7.0. The crop needs moderate rainfall, regular irrigation, and full sunlight exposure for vigorous vine growth and proper fruit development. Young luffa fruits are used as a vegetable in Sri Lankan cuisine, while mature fruits are used as natural sponges after drying. The crop can be harvested for vegetables within 50 to 70 days after planting, while mature sponge production takes longer depending on growing conditions. Important factors affecting luffa cultivation include temperature, soil moisture, sunlight, rainfall, humidity, and soil fertility. Common pests and diseases include fruit flies, aphids, red pumpkin beetles, powdery mildew, and downy mildew, which can reduce yield and fruit quality if not properly managed.

duration.note: days after planting for vegetable harvest

stages.name: Land Preparation

activities.title: Dig pits and prepare trellis
activities.description: 45×45×45 cm pits with compost mix. Install 2 m trellis.
activities.why: Luffa is a vigorous climber needing strong support.
activities.description_si: කොම්පෝස්ට් මිශ්‍රණය සහිත සෙ.මී. 45×45×45 වළවල්. මීටර් 2 මැස්සක් සවි කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: மக்கிய உரக் கலவையுடன் 45×45×45 செ.மீ குழிகள். 2 மீ பந்தல் அமையுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: වැටකොළු ශක්තිමත් ආධාරකයක් අවශ්‍ය වේගයෙන් වැඩෙන වැලකි.
activities.why_ta: பீர்க்கங்காய் வலுவான ஆதாரம் தேவைப்படும் வீரியமான கொடி.

stages.description_si: වළවල් සහ මැස්ස සකස් කරන්න.

stages.name: Sowing & Germination

activities.title: Sow 2 seeds per pit at 2 cm depth
activities.description: Water gently. Keep moist.
activities.why: Ensures at least one strong plant per pit.
activities.description_si: මෘදුව ජලය දෙන්න. තෙත්ව තබා ගන්න.
activities.description_ta: மெதுவாக நீர் ஊற்றுங்கள். ஈரமாக வையுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: වළකට අවම වශයෙන් එක් ශක්තිමත් පැළයක් සහතික කරයි.
activities.why_ta: குழிக்குக் குறைந்தது ஒரு வலுவான செடியை உறுதிசெய்யும்.

activities.title: Thin to one plant per pit
activities.description: Remove weaker seedling.
activities.why: Avoids competition between plants.
activities.title_si: වළකට එක් පැළයක් දක්වා විරල කරන්න
activities.description_si: දුර්වල පැළය ඉවත් කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: வலுவற்ற நாற்றை அகற்றுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: පැළ අතර තරඟය වළක්වයි.
activities.why_ta: செடிகளுக்கிடையேயான போட்டியைத் தவிர்க்கும்.

stages.description_si: බීජ සිටුවා ස්ථාපිත කරන්න.

stages.name: Vine Growth
stages.description: Rapid vine extension and leaf development.

activities.title: Guide vines onto trellis
activities.description: Direct main stem upward.
activities.why: Early training prevents tangled vines.
activities.description_si: ප්‍රධාන කඳ ඉහළට යොමු කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: முதன்மைத் தண்டை மேல்நோக்கி வழிநடத்துங்கள்.
activities.why_si: කලින්ම හැසිරවීමෙන් වැල් පැටලීම වළකී.
activities.why_ta: ஆரம்பத்திலேயே படரவிடுவது கொடிகள் சிக்குவதைத் தடுக்கும்.

activities.title: Top dressing 1
activities.description: Urea 50 kg/ha ring around base.
activities.why: Supports rapid vine extension.
activities.description_si: පාමුල වටා වළල්ලක් ලෙස යූරියා හෙක්ටයාරයකට කි.ග්‍රෑ. 50.
activities.description_ta: அடிப்பகுதியைச் சுற்றி வளையமாக எக்டேருக்கு 50 கி.கி யூரியா.
activities.why_si: වැල් වේගයෙන් දිගු වීමට සහාය වේ.
activities.why_ta: கொடி வேகமாக நீள்வதற்கு உதவும்.

stages.description_si: වැල් වේගයෙන් දිගු වීම සහ කොළ වර්ධනය.

stages.name: Flowering & Fruiting

activities.title: Check for fruit fly
activities.description: Set protein bait traps. Check fruits for puncture marks.
activities.why: Fruit fly is main pest — act early.
activities.description_si: ප්‍රෝටීන් ඇම උගුල් තබන්න. කටු ඇනුම් සලකුණු සඳහා ගෙඩි පරීක්ෂා කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: புரத இரைப் பொறிகளை வையுங்கள். துளைக் குறிகளுக்காகக் காய்களைச் சோதியுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: ගෙඩි මැස්සා ප්‍රධාන පළිබෝධයයි — කලින්ම ක්‍රියා කරන්න.
activities.why_ta: பழ ஈ முக்கியப் பூச்சி — முன்கூட்டியே நடவடிக்கை எடுங்கள்.

activities.title: Top dressing 2
activities.description: Urea 50 kg/ha + MOP 50 kg/ha.
activities.why: Supports fruit development.
activities.description_si: යූරියා හෙක්ටයාරයකට කි.ග්‍රෑ. 50 + MOP කි.ග්‍රෑ. 50.
activities.description_ta: எக்டேருக்கு 50 கி.கி யூரியா + 50 கி.கி MOP.
activities.why_si: ගෙඩි වර්ධනයට සහාය වේ.
activities.why_ta: காய் வளர்ச்சிக்கு உதவும்.

stages.description_si: පරාගණය සහ ගෙඩි වර්ධනය.

stages.name: Harvest

activities.title: First vegetable harvest
activities.description: Pick young tender fruits (20–30 cm, still soft). Cut with knife.
activities.why: Young fruits have best eating quality.
activities.description_si: ළපටි, මෘදු ගෙඩි (සෙ.මී. 20–30, තවමත් මෘදු) නෙළන්න. පිහියකින් කපන්න.
activities.description_ta: இளம், மென்மையான காய்களை (20–30 செ.மீ, இன்னும் மென்மையானவை) பறியுங்கள். கத்தியால் வெட்டுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: ළපටි ගෙඩිවල ආහාර ගුණය හොඳම වේ.
activities.why_ta: இளம் காய்களே சாப்பிடச் சிறந்தவை.

activities.title: Harvest every 2–3 days
activities.description: Do not allow fruits to mature if selling as vegetable.
activities.why: Over-mature fruits become fibrous and unsaleable.
activities.description_si: එළවළුවක් ලෙස විකුණන්නේ නම් ගෙඩි මේරීමට ඉඩ නොදෙන්න.
activities.description_ta: காய்கறியாக விற்பதானால் காய்களை முற்ற விடாதீர்கள்.
activities.why_si: අධික ලෙස මේරූ ගෙඩි කෙඳි සහිත වී විකිණිය නොහැකි වේ.
activities.why_ta: அதிகம் முற்றிய காய்கள் நார்த்தன்மை அடைந்து விற்பனைக்கு உதவாது.

stages.description_si: ආහාරයට ළපටි ගෙඩි නෙළන්න.

irrigation.notes: Luffa is moderately drought tolerant but regular watering improves yield.
irrigation.notes_si: වැටකොළු මධ්‍යස්ථ නියඟයට ඔරොත්තු දුන්නද, නිතිපතා ජලය දීමෙන් අස්වැන්න වැඩි වේ.
irrigation.notes_ta: பீர்க்கங்காய் ஓரளவு வறட்சியைத் தாங்கும்; ஆனால் தொடர்ந்து நீர் பாய்ச்சினால் மகசூல் அதிகரிக்கும்.

diseases.name: Powdery Mildew
diseases.symptoms: White powdery fungal coating on upper leaf surfaces and stems.
diseases.favorable_conditions: Dry weather, high temperatures, poor air circulation.
diseases.prevention: Good spacing. Trellis to improve airflow. Remove infected leaves.
diseases.treatment: Wettable Sulphur (3 g/L) or Trifloxystrobin (0.5 ml/L).
diseases.symptoms_si: කොළවල උඩු පැත්තේ සහ කඳන් මත සුදු පිටි වැනි දිලීර තට්ටුවක්.
diseases.symptoms_ta: இலைகளின் மேற்பரப்பிலும் தண்டுகளிலும் வெண்மையான தூள் போன்ற பூஞ்சைப் படலம்.
diseases.favorable_conditions_si: වියළි කාලගුණය, ඉහළ උෂ්ණත්වය, දුර්වල වාතාශ්‍රය.
diseases.favorable_conditions_ta: வறண்ட வானிலை, அதிக வெப்பநிலை, மோசமான காற்றோட்டம்.
diseases.prevention_si: හොඳ පරතරය. වාතය ගලායාමට මැස්සක් භාවිත කරන්න. ආසාදිත කොළ ඉවත් කරන්න.
diseases.prevention_ta: நல்ல இடைவெளி. காற்றோட்டத்துக்குப் பந்தல் அமையுங்கள். பாதிக்கப்பட்ட இலைகளை அகற்றுங்கள்.
diseases.treatment_si: Wettable Sulphur (ලීටරයකට ග්‍රෑ. 3) හෝ Trifloxystrobin (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 0.5).
diseases.treatment_ta: Wettable Sulphur (லிட்டருக்கு 3 கி) அல்லது Trifloxystrobin (லிட்டருக்கு 0.5 மி.லி).

diseases.name: Downy Mildew
diseases.symptoms: Yellow patches on upper leaf surface; purplish-grey growth on underside.
diseases.favorable_conditions: High humidity, cool nights, overhead irrigation.
diseases.prevention: Avoid overhead irrigation. Improve air circulation.
diseases.treatment: Metalaxyl + Mancozeb (2.5 g/L) spray every 7–10 days.
diseases.symptoms_si: කොළවල උඩු පැත්තේ කහ ලප; යට පැත්තේ දම්-අළු පැහැ වර්ධනය.
diseases.symptoms_ta: இலையின் மேற்பரப்பில் மஞ்சள் திட்டுகள்; அடிப்பக்கத்தில் ஊதா-சாம்பல் வளர்ச்சி.
diseases.favorable_conditions_si: ඉහළ ආර්ද්‍රතාව, සිසිල් රාත්‍රී, ඉහළින් ජලය ඉසීම.
diseases.favorable_conditions_ta: அதிக ஈரப்பதம், குளிர்ந்த இரவுகள், மேலிருந்து நீர் தெளிப்பு.
diseases.prevention_si: ඉහළින් ජලය ඉසීමෙන් වළකින්න. වාතාශ්‍රය වැඩි දියුණු කරන්න.
diseases.prevention_ta: மேலிருந்து நீர் தெளிப்பதைத் தவிருங்கள். காற்றோட்டத்தை மேம்படுத்துங்கள்.
diseases.treatment_si: Metalaxyl + Mancozeb (ලීටරයකට ග්‍රෑ. 2.5) දින 7–10කට වරක් ඉසීම.
diseases.treatment_ta: Metalaxyl + Mancozeb (லிட்டருக்கு 2.5 கி) 7–10 நாட்களுக்கு ஒருமுறை தெளிப்பு.

pests.name: Fruit Fly
pests.damage: Maggots inside fruits causing rotting and complete loss of marketable fruit.
pests.identification: Soft sunken spots on fruits; maggots visible inside.
pests.prevention: Protein bait traps. Bag developing fruits. Remove fallen fruits.
pests.treatment: Malathion bait spray. Fipronil bait stations near trellises.
pests.prevention_si: ප්‍රෝටීන් ඇම උගුල්. වැඩෙන ගෙඩි උරවලින් ආවරණය කරන්න. බිම වැටුණු ගෙඩි ඉවත් කරන්න.
pests.prevention_ta: புரத இரைப் பொறிகள். வளரும் காய்களைப் பைகளால் மூடுங்கள். கீழே விழுந்த காய்களை அகற்றுங்கள்.
pests.treatment_si: Malathion ඇම ඉසීම. මැස්ස අසල Fipronil ඇම මධ්‍යස්ථාන.
pests.treatment_ta: Malathion இரைத் தெளிப்பு. பந்தலுக்கு அருகில் Fipronil இரை நிலையங்கள்.
pests.damage_si: ගෙඩි තුළ සිටින පණුවන් නිසා ගෙඩි කුණු වී විකිණිය හැකි ගෙඩි සම්පූර්ණයෙන්ම අහිමි වේ.
pests.damage_ta: காய்களுக்குள் இருக்கும் புழுக்கள் அழுகலை ஏற்படுத்தி விற்கக்கூடிய காய்களை முழுமையாக இழக்கச் செய்யும்.
pests.identification_si: ගෙඩි මත මෘදු ගිලුණු ලප; ඇතුළත පණුවන් පෙනේ.
pests.identification_ta: காய்களில் மென்மையான குழிந்த புள்ளிகள்; உள்ளே புழுக்கள் தெரியும்.

pests.name: Red Pumpkin Beetle
pests.damage: Defoliates young seedlings; severe early-stage damage.
pests.identification: Shiny reddish-orange beetles on plants in morning.
pests.prevention: Row covers during early growth. Hand-pick early morning.
pests.treatment: Chlorpyrifos 20EC (2 ml/L) or Carbaryl dust at seedling stage.
pests.prevention_si: මුල් වර්ධන අවධියේ පේළි ආවරණ. අලුයම අතින් අල්ලා ඉවත් කරන්න.
pests.prevention_ta: ஆரம்ப வளர்ச்சியில் வரிசை மூடிகள். அதிகாலையில் கையால் பொறுக்கி அகற்றுங்கள்.
pests.treatment_si: පැළ අවධියේදී Chlorpyrifos 20EC (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 2) හෝ Carbaryl කුඩු.
pests.treatment_ta: நாற்று நிலையில் Chlorpyrifos 20EC (லிட்டருக்கு 2 மி.லி) அல்லது Carbaryl தூள்.
pests.damage_si: ළපටි පැළවල කොළ කා දමයි; මුල් අවධියේ දැඩි හානියක් කරයි.
pests.damage_ta: இளம் நாற்றுகளின் இலைகளைத் தின்று தீர்க்கும்; ஆரம்ப நிலையில் கடும் சேதம்.
pests.identification_si: උදෑසන පැළ මත දිලිසෙන රතු-තැඹිලි කුරුමිණියන්.
pests.identification_ta: காலையில் செடிகளில் பளபளப்பான சிவப்பு-ஆரஞ்சு வண்டுகள்.

pests.name: Aphid
pests.damage: Sucks sap; weakens vines and causes leaf yellowing.
pests.identification: Colonies on growing tips and undersides of young leaves.
pests.prevention: Neem oil spray (5 ml/L). Yellow sticky traps.
pests.treatment: Imidacloprid (0.3 ml/L) if infestation escalates.
pests.prevention_si: කොහොඹ තෙල් ඉසීම (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 5). කහ ඇලෙන උගුල්.
pests.prevention_ta: வேப்ப எண்ணெய் தெளிப்பு (லிட்டருக்கு 5 மி.லி). மஞ்சள் ஒட்டும் பொறிகள்.
pests.treatment_si: ආසාදනය වැඩි වුවහොත් Imidacloprid (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 0.3).
pests.treatment_ta: தாக்குதல் அதிகரித்தால் Imidacloprid (லிட்டருக்கு 0.3 மி.லி).
pests.damage_si: යුෂ උරා බොයි; වැල් දුර්වල කර කොළ කහ වීම ඇති කරයි.
pests.damage_ta: சாற்றை உறிஞ்சும்; கொடிகளை வலுவிழக்கச் செய்து இலைகளை மஞ்சளாக்கும்.
pests.identification_si: වැඩෙන අග සහ ළපටි කොළවල යටි පැත්තේ ජනපද.
pests.identification_ta: வளரும் நுனிகளிலும் இளம் இலைகளின் அடிப்பக்கத்திலும் கூட்டங்கள்.

risks.name: Fruit Fly
risks.description: Major yield threat.
risks.mitigation: Bait traps from flowering. Remove fallen fruits.
risks.description_si: අස්වැන්නට ප්‍රධාන තර්ජනයකි.
risks.description_ta: மகசூலுக்கு முக்கிய அச்சுறுத்தல்.
risks.signs_si: විදින ලද, කුණු වන ගෙඩි.
risks.mitigation_si: මල් පිපීමේ සිට ඇම උගුල්. බිම වැටුණු ගෙඩි ඉවත් කරන්න.
risks.mitigation_ta: பூக்கும் போதிருந்து இரைப் பொறிகள். கீழே விழுந்த காய்களை அகற்றுங்கள்.

risks.name: Drought
risks.description: Reduces vine growth and fruit size.
risks.mitigation: Regular irrigation every 2–3 days.
risks.description_si: වැල් වර්ධනය සහ ගෙඩිවල ප්‍රමාණය අඩු කරයි.
risks.description_ta: கொடி வளர்ச்சியையும் காயின் அளவையும் குறைக்கும்.
risks.signs_si: වර්ධනය බාල වූ වැල්, කුඩා ගෙඩි.
risks.mitigation_si: දින 2–3කට වරක් නිතිපතා ජලය දීම.
risks.mitigation_ta: 2–3 நாட்களுக்கு ஒருமுறை தொடர் நீர்ப்பாசனம்.

harvest.method: Cut with knife leaving 2 cm stalk.
harvest.post_harvest: Use fresh. Store in cool area. Market within 2–3 days.
harvest.method_si: සෙ.මී. 2ක නටුවක් ඉතිරි කරමින් පිහියකින් කපන්න.
harvest.method_ta: 2 செ.மீ காம்பை விட்டுக் கத்தியால் வெட்டுங்கள்.
harvest.post_harvest_si: නැවුම්ව භාවිත කරන්න. සිසිල් තැනක ගබඩා කරන්න. දින 2–3ක් ඇතුළත වෙළඳපොළට යවන්න.
harvest.post_harvest_ta: புதிதாகப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள். குளிர்ந்த இடத்தில் சேமியுங்கள். 2–3 நாட்களுக்குள் சந்தைக்கு அனுப்புங்கள்.
indicators_si: පොත්ත තවමත් මෘදු සහ කොළ පැහැයි

Luffa.growth_stages_text: Luffa cultivation follows several important growth stages including germination, vegetative vine growth, flowering, fruit development, and harvesting. Germination usually occurs within 5–10 days after sowing, while vigorous vine growth continues for about 20–30 days depending on environmental conditions and nutrient availability. Flowering generally begins around 35–45 days after planting, followed by fruit formation and harvesting. Vegetable harvesting usually starts within 50–70 days after planting when fruits are young, tender, and green, while sponge harvesting is done later when fruits become mature, dry, and fibrous. Farmers commonly use direct seeding methods and maintain spacing of approximately 1.5–2 meters between plants and rows to support healthy vine spreading, sunlight exposure, and good air circulation. Trellis systems or vertical supports are widely used to improve fruit quality, reduce disease incidence, and make harvesting easier.
Luffa.management_text: Successful luffa cultivation requires a week-by-week crop management schedule including land preparation, seed sowing, fertilizer application, irrigation, weed management, vine training, pest monitoring, and harvesting activities. Fertilizer application is important during vegetative growth, flowering, and fruiting stages, commonly using nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium fertilizers, and organic compost to improve vine growth and fruit production. Irrigation frequency changes according to crop growth stages, with frequent watering required during germination, flowering, and fruit development stages, while moderate irrigation is maintained during mature vegetative growth. Harvesting indicators for vegetable use include tender green fruits with soft skin and suitable length, while mature sponge production requires fruits to become brown, dry, lightweight, and fibrous before collection.
Luffa.disease_management_text: Disease and pest management are essential in successful luffa cultivation. Fruit flies lay eggs inside developing fruits, causing internal rotting and fruit damage that reduce market quality. Aphids suck plant sap and cause leaf curling, yellowing, and weakening of plants, while red pumpkin beetles feed on leaves and seedlings, resulting in severe plant damage during early growth stages. Powdery mildew appears as white powder-like fungal growth on leaves and stems, reducing photosynthesis and plant vigor, while downy mildew causes yellow patches and fungal growth under humid conditions. These problems can be controlled through proper field sanitation, crop rotation, balanced fertilizer use, removal of infected fruits and leaves, use of trellis systems, biological pest control methods, and recommended pesticide or fungicide applications when necessary. Risk mitigation practices such as regular field monitoring, maintaining proper drainage, timely irrigation management, use of healthy seeds, and climate-aware cultivation methods help reduce crop losses and improve overall productivity.
Luffa.overview_si: ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ “නියන් වැටකොළු” ලෙස හැඳින්වෙන වැටකොළු (Luffa aegyptiaca හෝ Luffa cylindrica) Cucurbitaceae කුලයට අයත් නිවර්තන එළවළු බෝගයකි. උණුසුම් දේශගුණයට හැඩගැසීමේ හැකියාව නිසා එය ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ බොහෝ ප්‍රදේශවල, විශේෂයෙන් ගෙවතුවල සහ වියළි සිට අතරමැදි කලාපවල කෘෂිකාර්මික ප්‍රදේශවල වගා කෙරේ. වැටකොළු 24°C–32°C අතර උෂ්ණත්වයේ හොඳින් වැඩෙන අතර, pH 5.5–7.0 අතර, හොඳින් ජලය බැස යන සාරවත් වැලි හෝ ලෝම පසක් අවශ්‍ය වේ. ශක්තිමත් වැල් වර්ධනයට සහ නිසි ගෙඩි වර්ධනයට මධ්‍යස්ථ වර්ෂාව, නිතිපතා ජලසම්පාදනය සහ පූර්ණ හිරු එළිය අවශ්‍යය. ළපටි වැටකොළු ගෙඩි ශ්‍රී ලාංකික ආහාරවල එළවළුවක් ලෙස භාවිත වන අතර, මේරූ ගෙඩි වියළා ස්වාභාවික ස්පොන්ජ ලෙස භාවිත කෙරේ. සිටුවීමෙන් දින 50–70 අතර එළවළු සඳහා අස්වනු නෙළිය හැකි අතර, ස්පොන්ජ නිෂ්පාදනයට වගා තත්ත්ව අනුව වැඩි කාලයක් ගත වේ. උෂ්ණත්වය, පාංශු තෙතමනය, හිරු එළිය, වර්ෂාව, ආර්ද්‍රතාව සහ පසේ සාරවත්බව වැටකොළු වගාවට බලපාන ප්‍රධාන සාධක වේ. ගෙඩි මැස්සා, කුඩිත්තා, රතු වට්ටක්කා කුරුමිණියා, පිටි පුස් රෝගය සහ ඩවුනි මිල්ඩිව් රෝගය පොදු පළිබෝධ හා රෝග වන අතර, නිසි ලෙස පාලනය නොකළහොත් ඒවා අස්වැන්න සහ ගෙඩිවල ගුණාත්මකභාවය අඩු කරයි.
Luffa.overview_ta: இலங்கையில் “நியன் வெட்டகொலு” என அழைக்கப்படும் பீர்க்கங்காய் (Luffa aegyptiaca அல்லது Luffa cylindrica), Cucurbitaceae குடும்பத்தைச் சேர்ந்த அயனமண்டலக் காய்கறிப் பயிர். வெப்பமான காலநிலைக்கு ஏற்ப வளரும் தன்மையால் இலங்கையின் பல பகுதிகளில், குறிப்பாக வீட்டுத் தோட்டங்களிலும் உலர் முதல் இடை வலய விவசாயப் பகுதிகளிலும் இது பயிரிடப்படுகிறது. பீர்க்கங்காய் 24°C–32°C வெப்பநிலையில் நன்றாக வளரும்; pH 5.5–7.0 உள்ள, நன்கு நீர் வடியும் வளமான மணல் அல்லது இருமண் தேவை. வீரியமான கொடி வளர்ச்சி மற்றும் சரியான காய் வளர்ச்சிக்கு மிதமான மழை, தொடர்ச்சியான நீர்ப்பாசனம், முழுச் சூரிய ஒளி அவசியம். இளம் பீர்க்கங்காய்கள் இலங்கை உணவில் காய்கறியாகப் பயன்படுகின்றன; முற்றிய காய்கள் உலர்த்தப்பட்டு இயற்கைக் கடற்பஞ்சாகப் பயன்படுகின்றன. நடவு செய்து 50–70 நாட்களில் காய்கறிக்காக அறுவடை செய்யலாம்; கடற்பஞ்சு உற்பத்திக்கு வளர்ப்பு நிலைமைகளைப் பொறுத்து அதிக காலம் தேவை. வெப்பநிலை, மண் ஈரப்பதம், சூரிய ஒளி, மழை, காற்று ஈரப்பதம், மண் வளம் ஆகியவை பீர்க்கங்காய் சாகுபடியைப் பாதிக்கும் முக்கியக் காரணிகள். பழ ஈ, அசுவினி, சிவப்புப் பூசணி வண்டு, சாம்பல் நோய், அடிச்சாம்பல் நோய் ஆகியவை பொதுவான பூச்சிகளும் நோய்களும்; சரியாகக் கட்டுப்படுத்தாவிட்டால் இவை மகசூலையும் காயின் தரத்தையும் குறைக்கும்.

Pathola (Snake Gourd).overview: Pathola, commonly known in Sri Lanka as snake gourd or “Pathola”, is a tropical vegetable crop belonging to the Cucurbitaceae family and scientifically known as Trichosanthes cucumerina. It is widely cultivated across Sri Lanka, especially in home gardens and warm lowland and intermediate zones, due to its high adaptability to tropical conditions. Pathola grows best in temperatures between 24°C and 32°C and requires well-drained fertile sandy or loamy soil with a soil pH ranging from 5.5 to 6.8. The crop needs moderate rainfall, regular irrigation, and full sunlight exposure for healthy vine growth and proper fruit formation. The young fruits are commonly used as a vegetable in Sri Lankan cooking and are valued for its soft texture and nutritional benefits. Pathola can be harvested within 50 to 65 days after planting, depending on growing conditions and management practices. Important factors affecting cultivation include temperature, soil moisture, rainfall, sunlight, humidity, and soil fertility. Common pests and diseases include fruit flies, aphids, red pumpkin beetles, powdery mildew, and viral infections, which can reduce yield and fruit quality if not properly controlled.

activities.title_si: වළවල් සකස් කර මැස්ස සවි කරන්න
activities.description_si: කොම්පෝස්ට් මිශ්‍රණය සහිත සෙ.මී. 45×45×45 වළවල්. මීටර් 2 මැස්සක් සවි කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: மக்கிய உரக் கலவையுடன் 45×45×45 செ.மீ குழிகள். 2 மீ பந்தல் அமையுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: වේගයෙන් වැඩෙන වැල් බෝගයකට හොඳ ආරම්භයක්.
activities.why_ta: வீரியமான கொடிப் பயிருக்கு நல்ல தொடக்கம்.

stages.description_si: වළවල් සහ මැස්ස සකස් කරන්න.

stages.name: Sowing

activities.title: Sow 2 seeds per pit
activities.description: 2 cm depth. Water gently.
activities.why: Ensures successful germination.
activities.description_si: සෙ.මී. 2ක් ගැඹුරට. මෘදුව ජලය දෙන්න.
activities.description_ta: 2 செ.மீ ஆழத்தில். மெதுவாக நீர் ஊற்றுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: සාර්ථක පැළවීම සහතික කරයි.
activities.why_ta: வெற்றிகரமான முளைப்பை உறுதிசெய்யும்.

activities.title: Thin to 1 plant
activities.description: Remove weaker seedling.
activities.why: Avoids crowding.
activities.description_si: දුර්වල පැළය ඉවත් කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: வலுவற்ற நாற்றை அகற்றுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: පැළ ඝන වීම වළක්වයි.
activities.why_ta: செடிகள் நெருக்கமாவதைத் தவிர்க்கும்.

stages.description_si: බීජ සිටුවා ස්ථාපිත කරන්න.

stages.name: Vine Growth

activities.title: Guide vines up trellis
activities.description: Direct main stem upward onto trellis.
activities.why: Proper training improves fruiting.
activities.title_si: වැල් මැස්ස දිගේ ඉහළට යොමු කරන්න
activities.description_si: ප්‍රධාන කඳ මැස්ස මතට ඉහළට යොමු කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: முதன்மைத் தண்டைப் பந்தலில் மேல்நோக்கி வழிநடத்துங்கள்.
activities.why_si: නිසි ලෙස හැසිරවීමෙන් ගෙඩි හටගැනීම වැඩි වේ.
activities.why_ta: சரியாகப் படரவிடுவது காய்ப்பை மேம்படுத்தும்.

activities.title: Top dressing 1
activities.description: Urea 50 kg/ha ring.
activities.why: Vine growth nitrogen.
activities.description_si: යූරියා හෙක්ටයාරයකට කි.ග්‍රෑ. 50 වළල්ලක් ලෙස.
activities.description_ta: எக்டேருக்கு 50 கி.கி யூரியா வளையமாக.
activities.why_si: වැල් වර්ධනයට නයිට්‍රජන්.
activities.why_ta: கொடி வளர்ச்சிக்கு நைட்ரஜன்.

stages.description_si: වැල් වේගයෙන් දිගු වීම.

stages.name: Flowering & Fruiting

activities.title: Scout for fruit fly
activities.description: Set protein bait traps.
activities.why: Fruit fly is main pest.
activities.description_si: ප්‍රෝටීන් ඇම උගුල් තබන්න.
activities.description_ta: புரத இரைப் பொறிகளை வையுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: ගෙඩි මැස්සා ප්‍රධාන පළිබෝධයයි.
activities.why_ta: பழ ஈ முக்கியப் பூச்சி.

activities.title: Top dressing 2
activities.description: Urea 50 kg/ha + MOP 50 kg/ha.
activities.why: Fruiting support.
activities.description_si: යූරියා හෙක්ටයාරයකට කි.ග්‍රෑ. 50 + MOP කි.ග්‍රෑ. 50.
activities.description_ta: எக்டேருக்கு 50 கி.கி யூரியா + 50 கி.கி MOP.
activities.why_si: ගෙඩි හටගැනීමට සහාය.
activities.why_ta: காய்ப்புக்கு ஆதரவு.

stages.description_si: ගෙඩි වර්ධනය.

stages.name: Harvest

activities.title: First harvest
activities.description: Pick young tender fruits with ridges still soft.
activities.why: Young fruits best for cooking.
activities.description_si: රැලි තවමත් මෘදු ළපටි, මෘදු ගෙඩි නෙළන්න.
activities.description_ta: முகடுகள் இன்னும் மென்மையாக உள்ள இளம், மென்மையான காய்களைப் பறியுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: ආහාර පිසීමට ළපටි ගෙඩි හොඳම වේ.
activities.why_ta: சமையலுக்கு இளம் காய்களே சிறந்தவை.

activities.title: Harvest every 2–3 days
activities.description: Regular picking prevents over-maturity.
activities.why: Frequent harvest maximises yield.
activities.description_si: නිතිපතා නෙළීමෙන් ගෙඩි අධික ලෙස මේරීම වළකී.
activities.description_ta: தொடர்ந்து பறிப்பது காய்கள் அதிகம் முற்றுவதைத் தடுக்கும்.
activities.why_si: නිතර අස්වනු නෙළීමෙන් අස්වැන්න උපරිම වේ.
activities.why_ta: அடிக்கடி அறுவடை செய்வது மகசூலை அதிகரிக்கும்.

stages.description_si: ළපටි ගෙඩි නිතිපතා නෙළීම.

irrigation.notes: Pathola is relatively drought tolerant once established.
irrigation.notes_si: පතෝල ස්ථාපිත වූ පසු සාපේක්ෂව නියඟයට ඔරොත්තු දෙයි.
irrigation.notes_ta: புடலங்காய் நிலைபெற்ற பின் ஒப்பீட்டளவில் வறட்சியைத் தாங்கும்.

diseases.name: Powdery Mildew
diseases.symptoms: White powdery coating on leaves; reduces photosynthesis.
diseases.favorable_conditions: Warm dry days, cool nights, poor air circulation.
diseases.prevention: Trellis management. Good spacing. Remove infected leaves.
diseases.treatment: Wettable Sulphur (3 g/L) every 10 days.
diseases.symptoms_si: කොළ මත සුදු පිටි වැනි තට්ටුවක්; ප්‍රභාසංශ්ලේෂණය අඩු කරයි.
diseases.symptoms_ta: இலைகளில் வெண்மையான தூள் போன்ற படலம்; ஒளிச்சேர்க்கையைக் குறைக்கும்.
diseases.favorable_conditions_si: උණුසුම් වියළි දවල්, සිසිල් රාත්‍රී, දුර්වල වාතාශ්‍රය.
diseases.favorable_conditions_ta: வெப்பமான வறண்ட பகல்கள், குளிர்ந்த இரவுகள், மோசமான காற்றோட்டம்.
diseases.prevention_si: මැස්ස කළමනාකරණය. හොඳ පරතරය. ආසාදිත කොළ ඉවත් කරන්න.
diseases.prevention_ta: பந்தல் பராமரிப்பு. நல்ல இடைவெளி. பாதிக்கப்பட்ட இலைகளை அகற்றுங்கள்.
diseases.treatment_si: Wettable Sulphur (ලීටරයකට ග්‍රෑ. 3) දින 10කට වරක්.
diseases.treatment_ta: Wettable Sulphur (லிட்டருக்கு 3 கி) 10 நாட்களுக்கு ஒருமுறை.

diseases.name: Viral Mosaic
diseases.symptoms: Mosaic yellow-green patterns; leaf distortion; stunted growth; poor fruiting.
diseases.favorable_conditions: High aphid populations; hot dry weather.
diseases.prevention: Control aphid vectors. Use virus-free seeds. Remove infected plants.
diseases.treatment: No cure. Manage aphid vectors with Imidacloprid (0.3 ml/L).
diseases.symptoms_si: කහ-කොළ මොසෙයික් රටා; කොළ විකෘති වීම; වර්ධනය බාල වීම; ගෙඩි හටගැනීම දුර්වල වීම.
diseases.symptoms_ta: மஞ்சள்-பச்சைத் தேமல் வடிவங்கள்; இலை உருக்குலைவு; வளர்ச்சிக் குன்றல்; காய்ப்புக் குறைவு.
diseases.favorable_conditions_si: කුඩිත්තන් ගහනය වැඩි වීම; උණුසුම් වියළි කාලගුණය.
diseases.favorable_conditions_ta: அதிக அசுவினி; வெப்பமான வறண்ட வானிலை.
diseases.prevention_si: වාහක කුඩිත්තන් පාලනය කරන්න. වෛරසවලින් තොර බීජ භාවිත කරන්න. ආසාදිත පැළ ඉවත් කරන්න.
diseases.prevention_ta: நோய் பரப்பும் அசுவினியைக் கட்டுப்படுத்துங்கள். வைரஸற்ற விதைகளைப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள். பாதிக்கப்பட்ட செடிகளை அகற்றுங்கள்.
diseases.treatment_si: ප්‍රතිකාරයක් නැත. Imidacloprid (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 0.3) මගින් වාහක කුඩිත්තන් පාලනය කරන්න.
diseases.treatment_ta: சிகிச்சை இல்லை. Imidacloprid (லிட்டருக்கு 0.3 மி.லி) மூலம் நோய் பரப்பும் அசுவினியைக் கட்டுப்படுத்துங்கள்.

pests.name: Fruit Fly
pests.damage: Internal fruit damage leading to rotting and unmarketable harvest.
pests.identification: Soft watery areas on fruit surface; maggots inside.
pests.prevention: Protein bait traps. Bag fruits. Collect and destroy fallen fruits.
pests.treatment: Malathion bait spray or Fipronil bait.
pests.prevention_si: ප්‍රෝටීන් ඇම උගුල්. ගෙඩි උරවලින් ආවරණය කරන්න. බිම වැටුණු ගෙඩි එකතු කර විනාශ කරන්න.
pests.prevention_ta: புரத இரைப் பொறிகள். காய்களைப் பைகளால் மூடுங்கள். கீழே விழுந்த காய்களைச் சேகரித்து அழியுங்கள்.
pests.treatment_si: Malathion ඇම ඉසීම හෝ Fipronil ඇම.
pests.treatment_ta: Malathion இரைத் தெளிப்பு அல்லது Fipronil இரை.
pests.damage_si: ගෙඩිවල ඇතුළත හානිය නිසා කුණු වී අස්වැන්න විකිණිය නොහැකි වේ.
pests.damage_ta: காயின் உட்புறச் சேதத்தால் அழுகல் ஏற்பட்டு அறுவடை விற்பனைக்கு உதவாது.
pests.identification_si: ගෙඩියේ මතුපිට මෘදු ජලමය ප්‍රදේශ; ඇතුළත පණුවන්.
pests.identification_ta: காயின் மேற்பரப்பில் மென்மையான நீர்க்கோர்த்த பகுதிகள்; உள்ளே புழுக்கள்.

pests.name: Red Pumpkin Beetle
pests.damage: Heavy defoliation of young seedlings in early growth stage.
pests.identification: Reddish-orange beetles on plants; large leaf holes.
pests.prevention: Row covers. Hand-pick in early morning.
pests.treatment: Chlorpyrifos 20EC (2 ml/L) or Carbaryl (2 g/L).
pests.prevention_si: පේළි ආවරණ. අලුයම අතින් අල්ලා ඉවත් කරන්න.
pests.prevention_ta: வரிசை மூடிகள். அதிகாலையில் கையால் பொறுக்கி அகற்றுங்கள்.
pests.treatment_si: Chlorpyrifos 20EC (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 2) හෝ Carbaryl (ලීටරයකට ග්‍රෑ. 2).
pests.treatment_ta: Chlorpyrifos 20EC (லிட்டருக்கு 2 மி.லி) அல்லது Carbaryl (லிட்டருக்கு 2 கி).
pests.damage_si: මුල් වර්ධන අවධියේදී ළපටි පැළවල කොළ දැඩි ලෙස කා දමයි.
pests.damage_ta: ஆரம்ப வளர்ச்சி நிலையில் இளம் நாற்றுகளின் இலைகளைக் கடுமையாகத் தின்று தீர்க்கும்.
pests.identification_si: පැළ මත රතු-තැඹිලි කුරුමිණියන්; කොළවල විශාල සිදුරු.
pests.identification_ta: செடிகளில் சிவப்பு-ஆரஞ்சு வண்டுகள்; இலைகளில் பெரிய துளைகள்.

pests.name: Aphid
pests.damage: Sucks sap; weakens vines; transmits viral diseases.
pests.identification: Small colonies on growing tips and leaf undersides.
pests.prevention: Yellow sticky traps. Neem oil spray.
pests.treatment: Imidacloprid (0.3 ml/L) if population builds up.
pests.prevention_si: කහ ඇලෙන උගුල්. කොහොඹ තෙල් ඉසීම.
pests.prevention_ta: மஞ்சள் ஒட்டும் பொறிகள். வேப்ப எண்ணெய் தெளிப்பு.
pests.treatment_si: ගහනය වැඩි වුවහොත් Imidacloprid (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 0.3).
pests.treatment_ta: எண்ணிக்கை அதிகரித்தால் Imidacloprid (லிட்டருக்கு 0.3 மி.லி).
pests.damage_si: යුෂ උරා බොයි; වැල් දුර්වල කරයි; වෛරස රෝග පතුරුවයි.
pests.damage_ta: சாற்றை உறிஞ்சும்; கொடிகளை வலுவிழக்கச் செய்யும்; வைரஸ் நோய்களைப் பரப்பும்.
pests.identification_si: වැඩෙන අග සහ කොළවල යටි පැත්තේ කුඩා ජනපද.
pests.identification_ta: வளரும் நுனிகளிலும் இலைகளின் அடிப்பக்கத்திலும் சிறிய கூட்டங்கள்.

risks.name: Fruit Fly
risks.description: Major pest — up to 40% loss without management.
risks.mitigation: Weekly bait traps, remove fallen fruits.
risks.description_si: ප්‍රධාන පළිබෝධයකි — පාලනය නොකළහොත් 40%ක් දක්වා හානි.
risks.description_ta: முக்கியப் பூச்சி — கட்டுப்படுத்தாவிட்டால் 40% வரை இழப்பு.
risks.signs_si: කීටයන් සහිත කුණු වන ගෙඩි.
risks.mitigation_si: සතිපතා ඇම උගුල්, බිම වැටුණු ගෙඩි ඉවත් කරන්න.
risks.mitigation_ta: வாராந்திர இரைப் பொறிகள், கீழே விழுந்த காய்களை அகற்றுங்கள்.

risks.name: Waterlogging
risks.description: Root rot in poorly drained areas.
risks.signs: Yellow wilting plants in wet soil.
risks.mitigation: Raised pits and drainage channels.
risks.description_si: ජලය හොඳින් බැස නොයන ප්‍රදේශවල මුල් කුණුවීම.
risks.description_ta: நீர் சரியாக வடியாத இடங்களில் வேர் அழுகல்.
risks.signs_si: තෙත් පසේ කහ වී මැලවෙන පැළ.
risks.mitigation_si: උස් කළ වළවල් සහ ජලාපවහන කානු.
risks.mitigation_ta: உயர்த்திய குழிகளும் வடிகால் வாய்க்கால்களும்.

harvest.method: Cut with knife, 2 cm stalk.
harvest.post_harvest: Sell fresh. Store cool. Market within 2–3 days.
harvest.method_si: සෙ.මී. 2ක නටුවක් සමඟ පිහියකින් කපන්න.
harvest.method_ta: 2 செ.மீ காம்புடன் கத்தியால் வெட்டுங்கள்.
harvest.post_harvest_si: නැවුම්ව විකුණන්න. සිසිල්ව ගබඩා කරන්න. දින 2–3ක් ඇතුළත වෙළඳපොළට යවන්න.
harvest.post_harvest_ta: புதிதாக விற்பனை செய்யுங்கள். குளிர்ச்சியாகச் சேமியுங்கள். 2–3 நாட்களுக்குள் சந்தைக்கு அனுப்புங்கள்.

Pathola (Snake Gourd).growth_stages_text: Pathola cultivation follows several important growth stages including germination, vegetative vine growth, flowering, fruit development, and harvesting. Germination usually occurs within 5–10 days after sowing, while vegetative vine growth continues for about 20–30 days depending on environmental conditions and nutrient availability. Flowering generally begins around 30–40 days after planting, followed by fruit formation and harvesting. Harvesting of young fruits typically starts within 50–65 days after planting when fruits are tender, green, and have reached suitable size for consumption. Farmers commonly use direct seeding methods and maintain spacing of approximately 1.5–2 meters between plants and rows to allow proper vine spreading, sunlight exposure, and air circulation. Trellis systems are often used to support vines, improve fruit quality, and reduce disease incidence.
Pathola (Snake Gourd).management_text: Successful pathola cultivation requires a structured week-by-week crop management plan including land preparation, seed sowing, fertilizer application, irrigation, weed management, vine training, pest monitoring, and harvesting activities. Fertilizer application is important during vegetative growth, flowering, and fruiting stages, commonly using nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium fertilizers, and organic compost to enhance vine growth and fruit yield. Irrigation frequency varies according to growth stages, with frequent watering required during germination, flowering, and fruit development stages, while moderate irrigation is maintained during mature vegetative growth. Farmers identify harvesting readiness when fruits become long, tender, green, and free from bitterness or fibrous texture.
Pathola (Snake Gourd).disease_management_text: Disease and pest management are essential for successful pathola cultivation. Fruit flies cause internal damage by laying eggs inside developing fruits, leading to rotting and reduced market value. Aphids feed on plant sap, resulting in curling, yellowing, and weakened vines, while red pumpkin beetles damage leaves and young seedlings during early growth stages. Powdery mildew appears as white fungal patches on leaves and reduces photosynthesis and plant vigor, while viral infections may cause leaf curling, mosaic patterns, and stunted growth. These problems can be managed through proper field sanitation, crop rotation, balanced fertilizer use, removal of infected plant parts, trellis support systems, biological pest control, and recommended chemical treatments when necessary. Risk mitigation practices such as regular field monitoring, proper irrigation management, maintaining soil fertility, use of healthy seeds, and climate-aware cultivation techniques help reduce crop losses and improve overall productivity.
Pathola (Snake Gourd).overview_si: ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ “පතෝල” ලෙස හැඳින්වෙන පතෝල (Trichosanthes cucumerina) Cucurbitaceae කුලයට අයත් නිවර්තන එළවළු බෝගයකි. නිවර්තන තත්ත්වවලට හොඳින් හැඩගැසෙන බැවින් එය ශ්‍රී ලංකාව පුරා, විශේෂයෙන් ගෙවතුවල සහ උණුසුම් පහතරට හා අතරමැදි කලාපවල බහුලව වගා කෙරේ. පතෝල 24°C–32°C අතර උෂ්ණත්වයේ හොඳින් වැඩෙන අතර, pH 5.5–6.8 අතර, හොඳින් ජලය බැස යන සාරවත් වැලි හෝ ලෝම පසක් අවශ්‍ය වේ. නිරෝගී වැල් වර්ධනයට සහ නිසි ගෙඩි හටගැනීමට මධ්‍යස්ථ වර්ෂාව, නිතිපතා ජලසම්පාදනය සහ පූර්ණ හිරු එළිය අවශ්‍යය. ළපටි ගෙඩි ශ්‍රී ලාංකික ආහාර පිසීමේදී එළවළුවක් ලෙස බහුලව භාවිත වන අතර, ඒවායේ මෘදු ස්වභාවය සහ පෝෂණීය ප්‍රතිලාභ නිසා අගය කෙරේ. වගා තත්ත්ව සහ කළමනාකරණ ක්‍රම අනුව සිටුවීමෙන් දින 50–65 අතර අස්වනු නෙළිය හැක. උෂ්ණත්වය, පාංශු තෙතමනය, වර්ෂාව, හිරු එළිය, ආර්ද්‍රතාව සහ පසේ සාරවත්බව වගාවට බලපාන ප්‍රධාන සාධක වේ. ගෙඩි මැස්සා, කුඩිත්තා, රතු වට්ටක්කා කුරුමිණියා, පිටි පුස් රෝගය සහ වෛරස ආසාදන පොදු පළිබෝධ හා රෝග වන අතර, නිසි ලෙස පාලනය නොකළහොත් ඒවා අස්වැන්න සහ ගෙඩිවල ගුණාත්මකභාවය අඩු කරයි.
Pathola (Snake Gourd).overview_ta: இலங்கையில் “பத்தோல” என அழைக்கப்படும் புடலங்காய் (Trichosanthes cucumerina), Cucurbitaceae குடும்பத்தைச் சேர்ந்த அயனமண்டலக் காய்கறிப் பயிர். அயனமண்டல நிலைமைகளுக்கு நன்றாகப் பொருந்துவதால் இலங்கை முழுவதும், குறிப்பாக வீட்டுத் தோட்டங்களிலும் வெப்பமான தாழ்நில மற்றும் இடை வலயங்களிலும் பரவலாகப் பயிரிடப்படுகிறது. புடலங்காய் 24°C–32°C வெப்பநிலையில் நன்றாக வளரும்; pH 5.5–6.8 உள்ள, நன்கு நீர் வடியும் வளமான மணல் அல்லது இருமண் தேவை. ஆரோக்கியமான கொடி வளர்ச்சி மற்றும் சரியான காய் உருவாக்கத்துக்கு மிதமான மழை, தொடர்ச்சியான நீர்ப்பாசனம், முழுச் சூரிய ஒளி அவசியம். இளம் காய்கள் இலங்கைச் சமையலில் காய்கறியாகப் பரவலாகப் பயன்படுகின்றன; அவற்றின் மென்மையும் ஊட்டச்சத்தும் மதிக்கப்படுகின்றன. வளர்ப்பு நிலைமைகள் மற்றும் பராமரிப்பு முறைகளைப் பொறுத்து நடவு செய்து 50–65 நாட்களில் அறுவடை செய்யலாம். வெப்பநிலை, மண் ஈரப்பதம், மழை, சூரிய ஒளி, காற்று ஈரப்பதம், மண் வளம் ஆகியவை சாகுபடியைப் பாதிக்கும் முக்கியக் காரணிகள். பழ ஈ, அசுவினி, சிவப்புப் பூசணி வண்டு, சாம்பல் நோய், வைரஸ் தொற்றுகள் ஆகியவை பொதுவான பூச்சிகளும் நோய்களும்; சரியாகக் கட்டுப்படுத்தாவிட்டால் இவை மகசூலையும் காயின் தரத்தையும் குறைக்கும்.

Pumpkin.overview: Pumpkin, commonly known as “Wattakka” in Sri Lanka, is a widely cultivated tropical vegetable crop belonging to the Cucurbitaceae family and scientifically known as Cucurbita moschata (and sometimes Cucurbita maxima depending on the variety). It is grown throughout Sri Lanka, especially in dry and intermediate zones as well as home gardens, due to its adaptability to warm climatic conditions and relatively low maintenance requirements. Pumpkin grows best in temperatures between 24°C and 32°C and requires well-drained fertile loamy or sandy loam soil with a soil pH ranging from 5.5 to 7.0. The crop needs moderate rainfall, regular irrigation, and full sunlight exposure for vigorous vine growth and proper fruit development. Pumpkin is a highly nutritious vegetable rich in vitamins, fiber, and antioxidants, and it is widely used in Sri Lankan curries and traditional dishes. The crop generally takes about 90 to 120 days after planting to reach harvest depending on the variety and environmental conditions. Important factors affecting pumpkin cultivation include temperature, soil moisture, rainfall, sunlight, humidity, and soil fertility. Common pests and diseases include fruit flies, aphids, pumpkin beetles, powdery mildew, downy mildew, and viral infections, which can reduce yield and fruit quality if not properly managed.

stages.name: Land Preparation
stages.description: Prepare large pits for long-duration vines.

activities.title: Dig large pits
activities.description: 60×60×60 cm pits. Fill with rich compost + topsoil mix.
activities.why: Large pits support the extensive root system of pumpkin.
activities.description_si: සෙ.මී. 60×60×60 වළවල්. පෝෂක බහුල කොම්පෝස්ට් + මතුපිට පස් මිශ්‍රණයකින් පුරවන්න.
activities.description_ta: 60×60×60 செ.மீ குழிகள். வளமான மக்கிய உரம் + மேல்மண் கலவையால் நிரப்புங்கள்.
activities.why_si: විශාල වළවල් වට්ටක්කාවල පුළුල් මුල් පද්ධතියට උපකාරී වේ.
activities.why_ta: பெரிய குழிகள் பூசணியின் பரந்த வேர்த் தொகுதிக்கு உதவும்.

activities.title: Mark rows 3 m apart
activities.description: Allow 2×3 m spacing for vine spreading.
activities.why: Pumpkin vines can spread 3–4 m — adequate space prevents crowding.
activities.description_si: වැල් පැතිරීමට මීටර් 2×3 පරතරයක් තබන්න.
activities.description_ta: கொடிகள் பரவ 2×3 மீ இடைவெளி விடுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: වට්ටක්කා වැල් මීටර් 3–4ක් දක්වා පැතිරිය හැක — ප්‍රමාණවත් ඉඩ පැළ ඝන වීම වළක්වයි.
activities.why_ta: பூசணிக் கொடிகள் 3–4 மீ வரை பரவலாம் — போதுமான இடம் நெருக்கத்தைத் தவிர்க்கும்.

stages.description_si: දිගුකාලීන වැල් සඳහා විශාල වළවල් සකස් කරන්න.
stages.description_ta: நீண்ட காலக் கொடிகளுக்குப் பெரிய குழிகளைத் தயார்செய்யுங்கள்.

stages.name: Sowing & Emergence

activities.title: Sow 3 seeds per pit
activities.description: Sow at 3 cm depth. Water and cover.
activities.why: Pumpkin germinates reliably in warm soil.
activities.description_si: සෙ.මී. 3ක් ගැඹුරට සිටුවන්න. ජලය දී වසන්න.
activities.description_ta: 3 செ.மீ ஆழத்தில் விதையுங்கள். நீர் ஊற்றி மூடுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: උණුසුම් පසේ වට්ටක්කා විශ්වාසදායක ලෙස පැළ වේ.
activities.why_ta: வெப்பமான மண்ணில் பூசணி நம்பகமாக முளைக்கும்.

activities.title: Thin to 2 plants per pit
activities.description: Remove weakest seedling once established.
activities.why: Two plants per pit improve pollination.
activities.description_si: ස්ථාපිත වූ පසු දුර්වලම පැළය ඉවත් කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: நிலைபெற்ற பின் மிக வலுவற்ற நாற்றை அகற்றுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: වළකට පැළ දෙකක් පරාගණය වැඩි දියුණු කරයි.
activities.why_ta: குழிக்கு இரண்டு செடிகள் மகரந்தச் சேர்க்கையை மேம்படுத்தும்.

activities.title: Water every 3 days
activities.description: Keep pit moist. Do not waterlog.
activities.why: Even germination needs consistent moisture.
activities.description_si: වළ තෙත්ව තබා ගන්න. ජලය රැඳීමට ඉඩ නොදෙන්න.
activities.description_ta: குழியை ஈரமாக வையுங்கள். நீர் தேங்க விடாதீர்கள்.
activities.why_si: ඒකාකාර පැළවීමට නොකඩවා තෙතමනය අවශ්‍යය.
activities.why_ta: சீரான முளைப்புக்குத் தொடர்ச்சியான ஈரப்பதம் தேவை.

stages.description_si: බීජ සිටුවා පැළ ස්ථාපිත කරන්න.

stages.name: Vine Extension
stages.description: Long vegetative phase — vigorous vine growth.

activities.title: Top dressing 1
activities.description: Urea 75 kg/ha ring around plant.
activities.why: Supports vigorous vine growth phase.
activities.description_si: පැළය වටා වළල්ලක් ලෙස යූරියා හෙක්ටයාරයකට කි.ග්‍රෑ. 75.
activities.description_ta: செடியைச் சுற்றி வளையமாக எக்டேருக்கு 75 கி.கி யூரியா.
activities.why_si: වැල් ශක්තිමත්ව වැඩෙන අවධියට සහාය වේ.
activities.why_ta: கொடிகள் வீரியமாக வளரும் நிலைக்கு உதவும்.

activities.title: Weed and mulch
activities.description: Remove weeds. Lay straw mulch around base.
activities.why: Mulch suppresses weeds and retains moisture during dry spells.
activities.description_si: වල් පැළෑටි ඉවත් කරන්න. පාමුල වටා පිදුරු වසුනක් අතුරන්න.
activities.description_ta: களைகளை அகற்றுங்கள். அடிப்பகுதியைச் சுற்றி வைக்கோல் மூடாக்கு பரப்புங்கள்.
activities.why_si: වසුන් වල් පැළෑටි මර්දනය කරන අතර වියළි කාලවලදී තෙතමනය රඳවා ගනී.
activities.why_ta: மூடாக்கு களைகளை அடக்கி, வறண்ட காலங்களில் ஈரப்பதத்தைத் தக்கவைக்கும்.

stages.description_si: දිගු ශාක වර්ධන අවධිය — වැල් ශක්තිමත්ව වැඩේ.
stages.description_ta: நீண்ட தாவர வளர்ச்சி நிலை — கொடிகள் வீரியமாக வளரும்.

stages.name: Flowering & Fruit Set

activities.title: Check for male/female flowers
activities.description: Male flowers appear first. Female flowers have small fruit base.
activities.why: Hand-pollinate early morning if natural pollination is poor.
activities.description_si: පුරුෂ මල් මුලින් මතු වේ. ස්ත්‍රී මල්වල පාමුලේ කුඩා ගෙඩියක් ඇත.
activities.description_ta: ஆண் பூக்கள் முதலில் தோன்றும். பெண் பூக்களின் அடியில் சிறிய பிஞ்சு இருக்கும்.
activities.why_si: ස්වාභාවික පරාගණය දුර්වල නම් අලුයම අතින් පරාගණය කරන්න.
activities.why_ta: இயற்கை மகரந்தச் சேர்க்கை குறைவாக இருந்தால் அதிகாலையில் கையால் மகரந்தச் சேர்க்கை செய்யுங்கள்.

activities.title: Top dressing 2
activities.description: MOP 100 kg/ha between vines.
activities.why: High potassium for fruit development and storage quality.
activities.description_si: වැල් අතරට MOP හෙක්ටයාරයකට කි.ග්‍රෑ. 100.
activities.description_ta: கொடிகளுக்கு இடையே எக்டேருக்கு 100 கி.கி MOP.
activities.why_si: ගෙඩි වර්ධනයට සහ ගබඩා කිරීමේ ගුණාත්මකභාවයට වැඩි පොටෑසියම්.
activities.why_ta: காய் வளர்ச்சிக்கும் சேமிப்புத் தரத்துக்கும் அதிக பொட்டாசியம்.

activities.title: Place fruits on dry surface
activities.description: Slide a tile or wood piece under developing fruits.
activities.why: Prevents soil contact which causes rotting of the fruit base.
activities.description_si: වැඩෙන ගෙඩි යටට උළු කැටයක් හෝ ලී කැබැල්ලක් තබන්න.
activities.description_ta: வளரும் காய்களுக்கு அடியில் ஓடு அல்லது மரத்துண்டை வையுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: ගෙඩියේ පාමුල කුණු වීමට හේතු වන පස සමඟ ස්පර්ශය වළක්වයි.
activities.why_ta: காயின் அடிப்பகுதி அழுகக் காரணமான மண் தொடர்பைத் தடுக்கும்.

stages.description_si: පරාගණය සහ ගෙඩි වර්ධනය.

stages.name: Harvest
stages.description: Harvest mature fruits at correct stage.

activities.title: Check maturity signs
activities.description: Tap fruit — hollow sound indicates maturity. Skin should resist thumbnail pressure.
activities.why: Harvesting too early reduces storage life significantly.
activities.description_si: ගෙඩියට තට්ටු කරන්න — හිස් හඬක් මේරීම පෙන්වයි. නියපොත්තෙන් තද කළ විට පොත්ත ඔරොත්තු දිය යුතුය.
activities.description_ta: காயைத் தட்டுங்கள் — உள்ளீடற்ற ஒலி முதிர்ச்சியைக் காட்டும். நகத்தால் அழுத்தினால் தோல் தாங்க வேண்டும்.
activities.why_si: ඉතා කලින් නෙළීමෙන් ගබඩා කාලය සැලකිය යුතු ලෙස අඩු වේ.
activities.why_ta: மிக முன்கூட்டியே அறுவடை செய்வது சேமிப்புக் காலத்தைக் கணிசமாகக் குறைக்கும்.

activities.title: Harvest mature fruits
activities.description: Cut stalk leaving 5–10 cm attached to fruit.
activities.why: Long stalk prevents entry of pathogens into the fruit.
activities.description_si: ගෙඩියට සෙ.මී. 5–10ක නටුවක් ඉතිරි වන සේ කපන්න.
activities.description_ta: காயுடன் 5–10 செ.மீ காம்பு இருக்குமாறு வெட்டுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: දිගු නටුව රෝගකාරක ගෙඩිය තුළට ඇතුළු වීම වළක්වයි.
activities.why_ta: நீண்ட காம்பு நோய்க்கிருமிகள் காய்க்குள் நுழைவதைத் தடுக்கும்.

stages.description_si: මේරූ ගෙඩි නිවැරදි අවධියේ නෙළන්න.
stages.description_ta: முற்றிய காய்களைச் சரியான நிலையில் அறுவடை செய்யுங்கள்.

fertilization.why: Concentrated nutrition at root zone for long-duration crop.
fertilization.why_si: දිගුකාලීන බෝගයක් සඳහා මුල් කලාපයට සාන්ද්‍ර පෝෂණය.
fertilization.why_ta: நீண்ட காலப் பயிருக்கு வேர்ப் பகுதியில் செறிவான ஊட்டம்.

fertilization.why: Potassium for fruit fill and storage quality.
fertilization.why_si: ගෙඩි පිරීමට සහ ගබඩා ගුණාත්මකභාවයට පොටෑසියම්.

irrigation.frequency: Every 4–5 days during establishment; every 7 days when established
irrigation.notes: Pumpkin is drought tolerant once established. Reduce watering 2 weeks before harvest to improve storage life.
irrigation.frequency_si: ස්ථාපිත වන කාලයේ දින 4–5කට වරක්; ස්ථාපිත වූ පසු දින 7කට වරක්
irrigation.frequency_ta: நிலைபெறும் காலத்தில் 4–5 நாட்களுக்கு ஒருமுறை; நிலைபெற்ற பின் 7 நாட்களுக்கு ஒருமுறை
irrigation.method_si: වළ ළඟ පාත්ති ක්‍රමයට ජලය දීම
irrigation.notes_si: වට්ටක්කා ස්ථාපිත වූ පසු නියඟයට ඔරොත්තු දෙයි. ගබඩා කාලය වැඩි කිරීමට අස්වනු නෙළීමට සති 2කට පෙර ජලය දීම අඩු කරන්න.
irrigation.notes_ta: பூசணி நிலைபெற்ற பின் வறட்சியைத் தாங்கும். சேமிப்புக் காலத்தை நீட்டிக்க அறுவடைக்கு 2 வாரங்களுக்கு முன் நீர்ப்பாசனத்தைக் குறையுங்கள்.
irrigation.critical_stages_text_si: ගෙඩි හටගැනීම (දින 60–75) · ගෙඩි ප්‍රමාණය වැඩි වීම (දින 75–100)

diseases.name: Powdery Mildew
diseases.symptoms: White powdery growth on leaves and stems; reduces photosynthesis.
diseases.favorable_conditions: Warm dry weather, poor air circulation.
diseases.prevention: Good vine management. Remove infected leaves.
diseases.treatment: Wettable Sulphur (3 g/L) or Tebuconazole (1 ml/L).
diseases.symptoms_si: කොළ සහ කඳන් මත සුදු පිටි වැනි වර්ධනය; ප්‍රභාසංශ්ලේෂණය අඩු කරයි.
diseases.symptoms_ta: இலைகளிலும் தண்டுகளிலும் வெண்மையான தூள் போன்ற வளர்ச்சி; ஒளிச்சேர்க்கையைக் குறைக்கும்.
diseases.favorable_conditions_si: උණුසුම් වියළි කාලගුණය, දුර්වල වාතාශ්‍රය.
diseases.favorable_conditions_ta: வெப்பமான வறண்ட வானிலை, மோசமான காற்றோட்டம்.
diseases.prevention_si: වැල් හොඳින් කළමනාකරණය කරන්න. ආසාදිත කොළ ඉවත් කරන්න.
diseases.prevention_ta: கொடிகளை நன்றாகப் பராமரியுங்கள். பாதிக்கப்பட்ட இலைகளை அகற்றுங்கள்.
diseases.treatment_si: Wettable Sulphur (ලීටරයකට ග්‍රෑ. 3) හෝ Tebuconazole (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 1).
diseases.treatment_ta: Wettable Sulphur (லிட்டருக்கு 3 கி) அல்லது Tebuconazole (லிட்டருக்கு 1 மி.லி).

diseases.name: Downy Mildew
diseases.symptoms: Yellow patches on upper leaf surface; grey downy growth beneath.
diseases.favorable_conditions: High humidity, cool nights, wet conditions.
diseases.prevention: Avoid overhead irrigation. Improve air circulation.
diseases.treatment: Metalaxyl + Mancozeb (2.5 g/L) every 7–10 days.
diseases.symptoms_si: කොළවල උඩු පැත්තේ කහ ලප; යට පැත්තේ අළු පැහැ පුළුන් වැනි වර්ධනය.
diseases.symptoms_ta: இலையின் மேற்பரப்பில் மஞ்சள் திட்டுகள்; அடிப்பக்கத்தில் சாம்பல் நிறப் பஞ்சு போன்ற வளர்ச்சி.
diseases.favorable_conditions_si: ඉහළ ආර්ද්‍රතාව, සිසිල් රාත්‍රී, තෙත් තත්ත්ව.
diseases.favorable_conditions_ta: அதிக ஈரப்பதம், குளிர்ந்த இரவுகள், ஈரமான நிலை.
diseases.prevention_si: ඉහළින් ජලය ඉසීමෙන් වළකින්න. වාතාශ්‍රය වැඩි දියුණු කරන්න.
diseases.prevention_ta: மேலிருந்து நீர் தெளிப்பதைத் தவிருங்கள். காற்றோட்டத்தை மேம்படுத்துங்கள்.
diseases.treatment_si: Metalaxyl + Mancozeb (ලීටරයකට ග්‍රෑ. 2.5) දින 7–10කට වරක්.
diseases.treatment_ta: Metalaxyl + Mancozeb (லிட்டருக்கு 2.5 கி) 7–10 நாட்களுக்கு ஒருமுறை.

pests.name: Fruit Fly
pests.damage: Causes internal fruit rotting; major post-set damage.
pests.identification: Puncture marks on fruit surface; maggots inside.
pests.prevention: Protein bait traps. Collect and destroy fallen fruits daily.
pests.treatment: Malathion bait spray. Fipronil bait.
pests.prevention_si: ප්‍රෝටීන් ඇම උගුල්. බිම වැටුණු ගෙඩි දිනපතා එකතු කර විනාශ කරන්න.
pests.prevention_ta: புரத இரைப் பொறிகள். கீழே விழுந்த காய்களைத் தினமும் சேகரித்து அழியுங்கள்.
pests.treatment_si: Malathion ඇම ඉසීම. Fipronil ඇම.
pests.treatment_ta: Malathion இரைத் தெளிப்பு. Fipronil இரை.
pests.damage_si: ගෙඩි ඇතුළතින් කුණු කරයි; ගෙඩි හටගත් පසු ප්‍රධාන හානිය.
pests.damage_ta: காய்களை உள்ளிருந்து அழுகச் செய்யும்; காய் பிடித்த பின் ஏற்படும் முக்கியச் சேதம்.
pests.identification_si: ගෙඩියේ මතුපිට කටු ඇනුම් සලකුණු; ඇතුළත පණුවන්.
pests.identification_ta: காயின் மேற்பரப்பில் துளைக் குறிகள்; உள்ளே புழுக்கள்.

pests.name: Pumpkin Beetle
pests.damage: Defoliates young seedlings; adults eat leaves and stems.
pests.identification: Yellow-orange beetles on plants in early morning.
pests.prevention: Row covers at germination. Hand-pick adults early morning.
pests.treatment: Chlorpyrifos (2 ml/L) or Carbaryl dust.
pests.prevention_si: පැළවෙන විට පේළි ආවරණ. අලුයම වැඩිහිටි කුරුමිණියන් අතින් අල්ලා ඉවත් කරන්න.
pests.prevention_ta: முளைக்கும் போது வரிசை மூடிகள். அதிகாலையில் முதிர்ந்த வண்டுகளைக் கையால் பொறுக்கி அகற்றுங்கள்.
pests.treatment_si: Chlorpyrifos (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 2) හෝ Carbaryl කුඩු.
pests.treatment_ta: Chlorpyrifos (லிட்டருக்கு 2 மி.லி) அல்லது Carbaryl தூள்.
pests.damage_si: ළපටි පැළවල කොළ කා දමයි; වැඩිහිටි කුරුමිණියෝ කොළ සහ කඳන් කති.
pests.damage_ta: இளம் நாற்றுகளின் இலைகளைத் தின்று தீர்க்கும்; முதிர்ந்த வண்டுகள் இலைகளையும் தண்டுகளையும் உண்ணும்.
pests.identification_si: අලුයම පැළ මත කහ-තැඹිලි කුරුමිණියන්.
pests.identification_ta: அதிகாலையில் செடிகளில் மஞ்சள்-ஆரஞ்சு வண்டுகள்.

pests.name: Aphid
pests.damage: Sucks sap; weakens vines; transmits viruses.
pests.identification: Clusters on growing tips and leaf undersides.
pests.prevention: Yellow sticky traps. Neem oil spray.
pests.treatment: Imidacloprid (0.3 ml/L) at threshold.
pests.prevention_si: කහ ඇලෙන උගුල්. කොහොඹ තෙල් ඉසීම.
pests.prevention_ta: மஞ்சள் ஒட்டும் பொறிகள். வேப்ப எண்ணெய் தெளிப்பு.
pests.treatment_si: සීමාව ඉක්මවූ විට Imidacloprid (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 0.3).
pests.treatment_ta: வரம்பை மீறினால் Imidacloprid (லிட்டருக்கு 0.3 மி.லி).
pests.damage_si: යුෂ උරා බොයි; වැල් දුර්වල කරයි; වෛරස පතුරුවයි.
pests.damage_ta: சாற்றை உறிஞ்சும்; கொடிகளை வலுவிழக்கச் செய்யும்; வைரஸ்களைப் பரப்பும்.
pests.identification_si: වැඩෙන අග සහ කොළවල යටි පැත්තේ පොකුරු.
pests.identification_ta: வளரும் நுனிகளிலும் இலைகளின் அடிப்பக்கத்திலும் கூட்டங்கள்.

risks.name: Drought During Fruit Set
risks.description: Fruit abortion and reduced fruit size.
risks.signs: Wilting vines, small or no fruits setting.
risks.mitigation: Maintain irrigation every 4–5 days during fruit set. Mulch heavily.
risks.description_si: ගෙඩි හැලීම සහ ගෙඩිවල ප්‍රමාණය අඩු වීම.
risks.description_ta: பிஞ்சு உதிர்வும் காயின் அளவு குறைவும்.
risks.signs_si: මැලවෙන වැල්, කුඩා ගෙඩි හෝ ගෙඩි නොහටගැනීම.
risks.signs_ta: வாடும் கொடிகள், சிறிய காய்கள் அல்லது காய் பிடிக்காமை.
risks.mitigation_si: ගෙඩි හටගන්නා කාලයේ දින 4–5කට වරක් ජලය දීම පවත්වා ගන්න. ඝනව වසුන් යොදන්න.
risks.mitigation_ta: காய் பிடிக்கும் காலத்தில் 4–5 நாட்களுக்கு ஒருமுறை நீர்ப்பாசனத்தைத் தொடருங்கள். தடிமனாக மூடாக்கு இடுங்கள்.

risks.name: Waterlogging
risks.description: Root rot and vine collapse.
risks.signs: Yellowing wilting vines in wet conditions.
risks.mitigation: Ensure proper drainage from pit. Raise planting area if needed.
risks.description_si: මුල් කුණුවීම සහ වැල් ඇද වැටීම.
risks.description_ta: வேர் அழுகலும் கொடி சரிவும்.
risks.signs_si: තෙත් තත්ත්වවලදී කහ වී මැලවෙන වැල්.
risks.mitigation_si: වළෙන් නිසි ලෙස ජලය බැස යාම සහතික කරන්න. අවශ්‍ය නම් සිටුවන ප්‍රදේශය උස් කරන්න.
risks.mitigation_ta: குழியிலிருந்து சரியாக நீர் வடிவதை உறுதிசெய்யுங்கள். தேவைப்பட்டால் நடவுப் பகுதியை உயர்த்துங்கள்.

indicators: Skin hardens and resists thumbnail scratch
harvest.method: Cut with sharp knife, leave 5–10 cm stalk. Handle carefully to avoid bruising.
harvest.frequency: Single or multiple harvests over 2–3 weeks
harvest.post_harvest: Cure in shade for 7 days to harden skin. Store in cool dry ventilated area up to 3 months. Do not stack more than 2 layers.
harvest.method_si: තියුණු පිහියකින් කපා සෙ.මී. 5–10ක නටුවක් ඉතිරි කරන්න. තැලීම් නොවීමට ප්‍රවේශමෙන් හසුරුවන්න.
harvest.method_ta: கூர்மையான கத்தியால் வெட்டி 5–10 செ.மீ காம்பை விடுங்கள். நசுங்காமல் கவனமாகக் கையாளுங்கள்.
harvest.frequency_si: සති 2–3ක් පුරා එක් වරක් හෝ කිහිප වරක් අස්වනු නෙළීම
harvest.post_harvest_si: පොත්ත තද කිරීමට දින 7ක් සෙවණේ තබා සුව කරන්න. සිසිල්, වියළි, වාතාශ්‍රය ඇති තැනක මාස 3ක් දක්වා ගබඩා කරන්න. ස්ථර 2කට වඩා ගොඩ නොගසන්න.
harvest.post_harvest_ta: தோலை உறுதியாக்க 7 நாட்கள் நிழலில் வைத்துப் பதப்படுத்துங்கள். குளிர்ந்த, உலர்ந்த, காற்றோட்டமுள்ள இடத்தில் 3 மாதங்கள் வரை சேமியுங்கள். 2 அடுக்குகளுக்கு மேல் அடுக்காதீர்கள்.
indicators_si: පොත්ත තද වී නියපොත්තෙන් සීරීමට ඔරොත්තු දෙයි
ගෙඩිය එහි ආවේණික තැඹිලි/තැඹිලි-දුඹුරු පැහැය ගනී

Pumpkin.growth_stages_text: Pumpkin cultivation follows several important growth stages including germination, vegetative vine growth, flowering, fruit development, and harvesting. Germination usually occurs within 5–10 days after sowing, while vigorous vine growth continues for about 30–45 days depending on environmental conditions and nutrient availability. Flowering begins around 45–60 days after planting, followed by fruit development and maturation. Harvesting generally takes place between 90–120 days after planting when fruits reach full size, develop a hard outer skin, and the stem near the fruit begins to dry. Farmers commonly use direct seeding methods and maintain spacing of approximately 2–3 meters between plants and rows to allow extensive vine spreading, sunlight penetration, and proper air circulation. In many farming systems, vines are allowed to trail on the ground, though in smaller plots limited trellising may be used.
Pumpkin.management_text: Successful pumpkin cultivation requires a structured week-by-week crop management plan including land preparation, seed sowing, fertilizer application, irrigation, weed control, vine training, pest monitoring, and harvesting activities. Fertilizer application is important during early vegetative growth, flowering, and fruit development stages, commonly using nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium fertilizers, and organic compost to support strong vine growth and improve fruit size and quality. Irrigation frequency is higher during germination and flowering stages due to high water demand, while moderate irrigation is maintained during fruit maturation to prevent fruit cracking and disease development. Harvesting indicators include fully grown fruits with hard rinds, dull skin color, and drying stems indicating maturity.
Pumpkin.disease_management_text: Disease and pest management are essential in successful pumpkin cultivation. Fruit flies damage developing fruits by laying eggs inside, causing internal decay and reducing market value. Aphids feed on plant sap, resulting in curling, yellowing, and weakened vines, while pumpkin beetles attack leaves and seedlings causing severe damage during early growth stages. Powdery mildew appears as white fungal growth on leaves, reducing photosynthesis and plant vigor, while downy mildew causes yellow patches and leaf collapse under humid conditions. Viral infections may cause mosaic patterns, stunted growth, and reduced yield. These problems can be controlled through proper field sanitation, crop rotation, balanced fertilizer use, removal of infected plant parts, use of resistant varieties, and biological or chemical pest control methods when necessary. Risk mitigation practices such as regular field monitoring, proper irrigation management, maintaining soil fertility, use of healthy seeds, and climate-aware cultivation techniques help reduce crop losses and improve overall productivity.
Pumpkin.overview_si: ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ “වට්ටක්කා” ලෙස හැඳින්වෙන වට්ටක්කා (Cucurbita moschata — ප්‍රභේදය අනුව සමහර විට Cucurbita maxima) Cucurbitaceae කුලයට අයත්, බහුලව වගා කෙරෙන නිවර්තන එළවළු බෝගයකි. උණුසුම් දේශගුණයට හැඩගැසීමේ හැකියාව සහ සාපේක්ෂව අඩු නඩත්තු අවශ්‍යතා නිසා එය ශ්‍රී ලංකාව පුරා, විශේෂයෙන් වියළි සහ අතරමැදි කලාපවල මෙන්ම ගෙවතුවලද වගා කෙරේ. වට්ටක්කා 24°C–32°C අතර උෂ්ණත්වයේ හොඳින් වැඩෙන අතර, pH 5.5–7.0 අතර, හොඳින් ජලය බැස යන සාරවත් ලෝම හෝ වැලි ලෝම පසක් අවශ්‍ය වේ. ශක්තිමත් වැල් වර්ධනයට සහ නිසි ගෙඩි වර්ධනයට මධ්‍යස්ථ වර්ෂාව, නිතිපතා ජලසම්පාදනය සහ පූර්ණ හිරු එළිය අවශ්‍යය. විටමින්, තන්තු සහ ප්‍රතිඔක්සිකාරක බහුල ඉතා පෝෂ්‍යදායී එළවළුවක් වන වට්ටක්කා ශ්‍රී ලාංකික ව්‍යංජන සහ සාම්ප්‍රදායික ආහාර සඳහා බහුලව භාවිත වේ. ප්‍රභේදය සහ පාරිසරික තත්ත්ව අනුව සිටුවීමෙන් දින 90–120ක් පමණ ගත වූ පසු අස්වනු නෙළිය හැක. උෂ්ණත්වය, පාංශු තෙතමනය, වර්ෂාව, හිරු එළිය, ආර්ද්‍රතාව සහ පසේ සාරවත්බව වට්ටක්කා වගාවට බලපාන ප්‍රධාන සාධක වේ. ගෙඩි මැස්සා, කුඩිත්තා, වට්ටක්කා කුරුමිණියා, පිටි පුස් රෝගය, ඩවුනි මිල්ඩිව් රෝගය සහ වෛරස ආසාදන පොදු පළිබෝධ හා රෝග වන අතර, නිසි ලෙස පාලනය නොකළහොත් ඒවා අස්වැන්න සහ ගෙඩිවල ගුණාත්මකභාවය අඩු කරයි.
Pumpkin.overview_ta: இலங்கையில் “வட்டக்கா” என அழைக்கப்படும் பூசணிக்காய் (Cucurbita moschata — இனத்தைப் பொறுத்து சில சமயம் Cucurbita maxima), Cucurbitaceae குடும்பத்தைச் சேர்ந்த, பரவலாகப் பயிரிடப்படும் அயனமண்டலக் காய்கறிப் பயிர். வெப்பமான காலநிலைக்கு ஏற்ப வளரும் தன்மையும் ஒப்பீட்டளவில் குறைந்த பராமரிப்புத் தேவையும் காரணமாக இலங்கை முழுவதும், குறிப்பாக உலர் மற்றும் இடை வலயங்களிலும் வீட்டுத் தோட்டங்களிலும் பயிரிடப்படுகிறது. பூசணி 24°C–32°C வெப்பநிலையில் நன்றாக வளரும்; pH 5.5–7.0 உள்ள, நன்கு நீர் வடியும் வளமான இருமண் அல்லது மணல் கலந்த இருமண் தேவை. வீரியமான கொடி வளர்ச்சி மற்றும் சரியான காய் வளர்ச்சிக்கு மிதமான மழை, தொடர்ச்சியான நீர்ப்பாசனம், முழுச் சூரிய ஒளி அவசியம். விட்டமின்கள், நார்ச்சத்து, ஆக்ஸிஜனேற்றிகள் நிறைந்த மிகவும் சத்தான காய்கறியான பூசணி இலங்கைக் கறிகளிலும் பாரம்பரிய உணவுகளிலும் பரவலாகப் பயன்படுகிறது. இனம் மற்றும் சூழல் நிலைமைகளைப் பொறுத்து நடவு செய்து சுமார் 90–120 நாட்களில் அறுவடைக்குத் தயாராகும். வெப்பநிலை, மண் ஈரப்பதம், மழை, சூரிய ஒளி, காற்று ஈரப்பதம், மண் வளம் ஆகியவை பூசணி சாகுபடியைப் பாதிக்கும் முக்கியக் காரணிகள். பழ ஈ, அசுவினி, பூசணி வண்டு, சாம்பல் நோய், அடிச்சாம்பல் நோய், வைரஸ் தொற்றுகள் ஆகியவை பொதுவான பூச்சிகளும் நோய்களும்; சரியாகக் கட்டுப்படுத்தாவிட்டால் இவை மகசூலையும் காயின் தரத்தையும் குறைக்கும்.

Cabbage.overview: Cabbage, commonly known as “Gowa Kol” in Sri Lanka, is a cool-climate leafy vegetable crop belonging to the Brassicaceae family and scientifically known as Brassica oleracea var. capitata. It is mainly cultivated in the up-country regions of Sri Lanka such as Nuwara Eliya, Badulla, and Kandy where low temperatures support proper head formation and compact growth. Cabbage grows best in temperatures between 15°C and 22°C and requires fertile, well-drained loamy soil rich in organic matter with a soil pH ranging from 6.0 to 7.0. The crop needs moderate rainfall, regular irrigation, and full sunlight exposure for healthy vegetative growth and tight head development. Cabbage is widely used in Sri Lankan cuisine in curries, stir-fries, and salads and is valued for its nutritional content including vitamins C and K, fiber, and antioxidants. The crop is generally ready for harvest within 70 to 90 days after transplanting depending on the variety and growing conditions. Important factors affecting cabbage cultivation include temperature, soil moisture, rainfall, sunlight, humidity, and soil fertility. Common pests and diseases include aphids, cabbage worms, diamondback moth, cutworms, club root, and fungal leaf spot diseases, which can reduce yield and head quality if not properly managed.

stages.name: Land Preparation

activities.title: Plough and lime soil if needed
activities.description: Deep plough 30 cm. Apply lime if pH below 6.0. Form raised beds.
activities.why: Club root disease is promoted by acidic soils. Liming prevents it.
activities.title_si: සීසා අවශ්‍ය නම් පසට හුණු යොදන්න
activities.description_si: සෙ.මී. 30ක් ගැඹුරට සීසාන්න. pH 6.0ට අඩු නම් හුණු යොදන්න. උස් කළ පාත්ති සාදන්න.
activities.description_ta: 30 செ.மீ ஆழத்துக்கு உழுங்கள். pH 6.0க்குக் குறைவாக இருந்தால் சுண்ணாம்பு இடுங்கள். உயர்த்திய பாத்திகள் அமையுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: මුල් ඉදිමීමේ රෝගය ආම්ලික පසේ වැඩිය. හුණු යෙදීමෙන් එය වළකී.
activities.why_ta: வேர் முடிச்சு நோய் அமில மண்ணில் அதிகம். சுண்ணாம்பு இடுவது அதைத் தடுக்கும்.

activities.title: Apply compost
activities.description: Incorporate 15 t/ha well-decomposed compost.
activities.why: High organic matter supports uniform head development.
activities.description_si: හොඳින් දිරාපත් වූ කොම්පෝස්ට් හෙක්ටයාරයකට ටොන් 15ක් පසට මිශ්‍ර කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: நன்கு மக்கிய உரத்தை எக்டேருக்கு 15 டன் மண்ணுடன் கலந்துவிடுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: වැඩි කාබනික ද්‍රව්‍ය ඒකාකාර ගෙඩි වර්ධනයට උපකාරී වේ.
activities.why_ta: அதிக கரிமப் பொருள் சீரான முடிச்சு வளர்ச்சிக்கு உதவும்.

stages.description_si: ගෙඩි සෑදීම සඳහා ගැඹුරු බිම් සැකසීම.

stages.name: Transplanting

activities.title: Transplant 25-day seedlings
activities.description: Plant in late afternoon. Water immediately. Space 45×60 cm.
activities.why: Evening planting reduces heat stress on young seedlings.
activities.description_si: සවස් වරුවේ සිටුවන්න. වහාම ජලය දෙන්න. සෙ.මී. 45×60 පරතරය.
activities.description_ta: பிற்பகலில் நடுங்கள். உடனே நீர் பாய்ச்சுங்கள். 45×60 செ.மீ இடைவெளி.
activities.why_si: සවස සිටුවීමෙන් ළපටි පැළවලට ඇතිවන තාප ආතතිය අඩු වේ.
activities.why_ta: மாலையில் நடுவது இளம் நாற்றுகளின் வெப்ப அழுத்தத்தைக் குறைக்கும்.

activities.title: Water daily for 2 weeks
activities.description: Water at base morning and evening.
activities.why: Consistent moisture in first 2 weeks determines establishment success.
activities.description_si: උදේ සහ සවස පැළයේ මුලට ජලය දෙන්න.
activities.description_ta: காலையும் மாலையும் செடியின் அடியில் நீர் ஊற்றுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: පළමු සති 2 තුළ නොකඩවා තෙතමනය ස්ථාපිත වීමේ සාර්ථකත්වය තීරණය කරයි.
activities.why_ta: முதல் 2 வாரங்களில் தொடர்ச்சியான ஈரப்பதமே நிலைபெறுதலின் வெற்றியைத் தீர்மானிக்கும்.

stages.description_si: පැළ ස්ථාපිත කරන්න.

stages.name: Vegetative & Head Initiation

activities.title: First weeding and fertilize
activities.description: Weed thoroughly, then apply top dressing.
activities.why: Clean weeds improve air circulation — reduces disease risk.
