activities.title_si: පළමු වල් නෙළීම සහ පොහොර යෙදීම
activities.description_si: හොඳින් වල් නෙළා, ඉන්පසු මතුපිට පොහොර යොදන්න.
activities.description_ta: நன்றாகக் களையெடுத்து, பின்னர் மேலுரம் இடுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: වල් පැළෑටි නැති කිරීමෙන් වාතාශ්‍රය වැඩි වී රෝග අවදානම අඩු වේ.
activities.why_ta: களைகளை நீக்குவது காற்றோட்டத்தை மேம்படுத்தி நோய் அபாயத்தைக் குறைக்கும்.

activities.title: Top dressing 1
activities.description: Urea 100 kg/ha + MOP 50 kg/ha ring around plant.
activities.why: Nitrogen drives leaf development; potassium improves head density.
activities.description_si: පැළය වටා වළල්ලක් ලෙස යූරියා හෙක්ටයාරයකට කි.ග්‍රෑ. 100 + MOP කි.ග්‍රෑ. 50.
activities.description_ta: செடியைச் சுற்றி வளையமாக எக்டேருக்கு 100 கி.கி யூரியா + 50 கி.கி MOP.
activities.why_si: නයිට්‍රජන් කොළ වර්ධනයට දායක වේ; පොටෑසියම් ගෙඩියේ ඝනත්වය වැඩි කරයි.
activities.why_ta: நைட்ரஜன் இலை வளர்ச்சியைத் தூண்டும்; பொட்டாசியம் முடிச்சின் அடர்த்தியை மேம்படுத்தும்.

activities.title: Daily DBM scouting
activities.description: Inspect undersides of leaves for DBM eggs and larvae (tiny green caterpillars).
activities.why: Diamondback Moth is the #1 threat to cabbage. Early detection is critical.
activities.title_si: දියමන්ති පිටැති සලබයා සඳහා දිනපතා පරීක්ෂාව
activities.description_si: දියමන්ති පිටැති සලබයාගේ බිත්තර සහ කීටයන් (කුඩා කොළ පැහැ දළඹුවන්) සඳහා කොළවල යටි පැත්ත පරීක්ෂා කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: வைரமுதுகு அந்துப்பூச்சியின் முட்டைகள், புழுக்களுக்காக (சிறிய பச்சைப் புழுக்கள்) இலைகளின் அடிப்பக்கத்தைச் சோதியுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: දියමන්ති පිටැති සලබයා ගෝවාවලට ඇති අංක 1 තර්ජනයයි. කලින්ම හඳුනාගැනීම අත්‍යවශ්‍යයි.
activities.why_ta: வைரமுதுகு அந்துப்பூச்சி முட்டைக்கோஸின் முதன்மை அச்சுறுத்தல். முன்கூட்டியே கண்டறிவது மிக அவசியம்.

stages.description_si: කොළ වර්ධනය සහ ගෙඩි සෑදීම ආරම්භය.

stages.name: Head Development
stages.description: Critical stage — head fills and hardens.

activities.title: Top dressing 2
activities.description: Urea 50 kg/ha.
activities.why: Final nitrogen push for head fill.
activities.description_si: යූරියා හෙක්ටයාරයකට කි.ග්‍රෑ. 50.
activities.description_ta: எக்டேருக்கு 50 கி.கி யூரியா.
activities.why_si: ගෙඩිය පිරීමට අවසාන නයිට්‍රජන් යෙදීම.
activities.why_ta: முடிச்சு நிரம்ப இறுதி நைட்ரஜன் இடுதல்.

activities.title: Check for head rot
activities.description: Look for slimy soft areas at head base. Improve drainage if seen.
activities.why: Black rot and head rot can destroy heads quickly in wet conditions.
activities.description_si: ගෙඩියේ පාමුල ලිස්සන සුළු මෘදු ප්‍රදේශ සොයන්න. දුටුවහොත් ජලාපවහනය වැඩි දියුණු කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: முடிச்சின் அடியில் வழுவழுப்பான மென்மையான பகுதிகளைத் தேடுங்கள். கண்டால் வடிகாலை மேம்படுத்துங்கள்.
activities.why_si: තෙත් තත්ත්වවලදී කළු කුණුවීම සහ ගෙඩි කුණුවීම ගෙඩි ඉක්මනින් විනාශ කළ හැක.
activities.why_ta: ஈரமான நிலையில் கரும் அழுகலும் முடிச்சு அழுகலும் முடிச்சுகளை விரைவில் அழிக்கும்.

activities.title: Maintain consistent moisture
activities.description: Irregular watering at this stage causes head splitting.
activities.why: Head splitting reduces market value to zero.
activities.description_si: මෙම අවධියේ අක්‍රමවත් ජලය දීම ගෙඩි පැලීමට හේතු වේ.
activities.description_ta: இந்த நிலையில் ஒழுங்கற்ற நீர்ப்பாசனம் முடிச்சு வெடிப்பை ஏற்படுத்தும்.
activities.why_si: ගෙඩි පැලීමෙන් වෙළඳපොළ වටිනාකම සම්පූර්ණයෙන්ම අහිමි වේ.
activities.why_ta: முடிச்சு வெடிப்பு சந்தை மதிப்பை முழுமையாக இழக்கச் செய்யும்.

stages.description_si: තීරණාත්මක අවධිය — ගෙඩිය පිරී තද වේ.

stages.name: Harvest

activities.title: Test for maturity
activities.description: Press head with palm — firm solid head indicates maturity.
activities.why: Soft heads are immature; over-mature heads split and rot.
activities.description_si: අත්ලෙන් ගෙඩිය තද කරන්න — තද, ඝන ගෙඩියක් මේරීම පෙන්වයි.
activities.description_ta: உள்ளங்கையால் முடிச்சை அழுத்துங்கள் — உறுதியான, திடமான முடிச்சு முதிர்ச்சியைக் காட்டும்.
activities.why_si: මෘදු ගෙඩි නොමේරූ ඒවාය; අධික ලෙස මේරූ ගෙඩි පැලී කුණු වේ.
activities.why_ta: மென்மையான முடிச்சுகள் முற்றாதவை; அதிகம் முற்றியவை வெடித்து அழுகும்.

activities.title: Cut heads
activities.description: Cut with sharp knife at base leaving 3–4 outer leaves for protection.
activities.why: Outer leaves protect the head during transport.
activities.description_si: ආරක්ෂාව සඳහා පිටත කොළ 3–4ක් ඉතිරි කරමින් තියුණු පිහියකින් පාමුලින් කපන්න.
activities.description_ta: பாதுகாப்புக்கு வெளி இலைகள் 3–4 ஐ விட்டு, கூர்மையான கத்தியால் அடியில் வெட்டுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: ප්‍රවාහනයේදී පිටත කොළ ගෙඩිය ආරක්ෂා කරයි.
activities.why_ta: போக்குவரத்தின்போது வெளி இலைகள் முடிச்சைப் பாதுகாக்கும்.

stages.description_si: ගෙඩි අධික ලෙස මේරීමට පෙර අස්වනු නෙළන්න.
stages.description_ta: முடிச்சுகள் அதிகம் முற்றுவதற்கு முன் அறுவடை செய்யுங்கள்.

fertilization.why_si: පෝෂක බහුලව අවශ්‍ය බෝගයක් සඳහා අඩිතාලම.

irrigation.notes: Maintain consistent moisture during head fill. Irregular watering = head splitting.
irrigation.notes_si: ගෙඩිය පිරෙන කාලයේ නොකඩවා තෙතමනය පවත්වා ගන්න. අක්‍රමවත් ජලය දීම = ගෙඩි පැලීම.
irrigation.notes_ta: முடிச்சு நிரம்பும் காலத்தில் தொடர்ச்சியான ஈரப்பதத்தைப் பேணுங்கள். ஒழுங்கற்ற நீர்ப்பாசனம் = முடிச்சு வெடிப்பு.

diseases.name: Club Root
diseases.symptoms: Swollen, distorted club-shaped roots; wilting and severely stunted growth.
diseases.favorable_conditions: Acidic soil (pH < 6.0), high soil moisture, warm temperatures.
diseases.prevention: Apply lime to raise soil pH above 6.5. Crop rotation for 4+ years. Good drainage.
diseases.treatment: No effective chemical. Lime soil. Remove and destroy infected plants.
diseases.symptoms_si: ඉදිමුණු, විකෘති, මුගුරක හැඩැති මුල්; මැලවීම සහ වර්ධනය දැඩි ලෙස බාල වීම.
diseases.symptoms_ta: வீங்கிய, உருக்குலைந்த, தண்டாயுத வடிவ வேர்கள்; வாடலும் கடுமையான வளர்ச்சிக் குன்றலும்.
diseases.favorable_conditions_si: ආම්ලික පස (pH < 6.0), පසේ ඉහළ තෙතමනය, උණුසුම් උෂ්ණත්වය.
diseases.favorable_conditions_ta: அமில மண் (pH < 6.0), மண்ணில் அதிக ஈரப்பதம், வெப்பமான வெப்பநிலை.
diseases.prevention_si: පසේ pH 6.5ට වඩා වැඩි කිරීමට හුණු යොදන්න. අවුරුදු 4කට වැඩි බෝග මාරුව. හොඳ ජලාපවහනය.
diseases.prevention_ta: மண் pH-ஐ 6.5க்கு மேல் உயர்த்தச் சுண்ணாம்பு இடுங்கள். 4 ஆண்டுகளுக்கு மேல் பயிர்ச் சுழற்சி. நல்ல வடிகால்.
diseases.treatment_si: ඵලදායී රසායනිකයක් නැත. පසට හුණු යොදන්න. ආසාදිත පැළ ඉවත් කර විනාශ කරන්න.
diseases.treatment_ta: பயனுள்ள இரசாயனம் இல்லை. மண்ணுக்குச் சுண்ணாம்பு இடுங்கள். பாதிக்கப்பட்ட செடிகளை அகற்றி அழியுங்கள்.

diseases.name: Fungal Leaf Spot
diseases.symptoms: Brown circular spots with concentric rings on leaves; reduces photosynthesis.
diseases.favorable_conditions: Humid conditions, cool weather, poor air circulation.
diseases.prevention: Good spacing. Remove infected leaves. Avoid overhead irrigation.
diseases.treatment: Mancozeb 80WP (2.5 g/L) or Iprodione (1.5 ml/L).
diseases.symptoms_si: කොළ මත ඒකකේන්ද්‍රික වළලු සහිත දුඹුරු රවුම් පැල්ලම්; ප්‍රභාසංශ්ලේෂණය අඩු කරයි.
diseases.symptoms_ta: இலைகளில் வளையம் வளையமான பழுப்பு வட்டப் புள்ளிகள்; ஒளிச்சேர்க்கையைக் குறைக்கும்.
diseases.favorable_conditions_si: ආර්ද්‍ර තත්ත්ව, සිසිල් කාලගුණය, දුර්වල වාතාශ්‍රය.
diseases.favorable_conditions_ta: ஈரப்பதமான நிலை, குளிர்ந்த வானிலை, மோசமான காற்றோட்டம்.
diseases.prevention_si: හොඳ පරතරය. ආසාදිත කොළ ඉවත් කරන්න. ඉහළින් ජලය ඉසීමෙන් වළකින්න.
diseases.prevention_ta: நல்ல இடைவெளி. பாதிக்கப்பட்ட இலைகளை அகற்றுங்கள். மேலிருந்து நீர் தெளிப்பதைத் தவிருங்கள்.
diseases.treatment_si: Mancozeb 80WP (ලීටරයකට ග්‍රෑ. 2.5) හෝ Iprodione (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 1.5).
diseases.treatment_ta: Mancozeb 80WP (லிட்டருக்கு 2.5 கி) அல்லது Iprodione (லிட்டருக்கு 1.5 மி.லி).

pests.name: Diamondback Moth
pests.damage: Larvae scrape and eat leaf tissue; creates 'window pane' pattern; develops resistance to insecticides quickly.
pests.identification: Small pale green caterpillars on leaf undersides; window-like transparent patches on leaves.
pests.prevention: Use Bt sprays. Rotate insecticide classes to prevent resistance. Remove heavily damaged leaves.
pests.treatment: Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) 2 g/L or Spinosad 45SC (0.3 ml/L). Never use same chemical repeatedly.
pests.prevention_si: Bt ඉසීම් භාවිත කරන්න. ප්‍රතිරෝධය වැළැක්වීමට කෘමි නාශක වර්ග මාරුවෙන් මාරුවට භාවිත කරන්න. දැඩි ලෙස හානි වූ කොළ ඉවත් කරන්න.
pests.prevention_ta: Bt தெளிப்புகளைப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள். எதிர்ப்புத்திறன் உருவாகாமல் இருக்கப் பூச்சிக்கொல்லி வகைகளை மாற்றி மாற்றிப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள். கடுமையாகச் சேதமடைந்த இலைகளை அகற்றுங்கள்.
pests.treatment_si: Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) ලීටරයකට ග්‍රෑ. 2 හෝ Spinosad 45SC (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 0.3). එකම රසායනිකය නැවත නැවත කිසි විටෙක භාවිත නොකරන්න.
pests.treatment_ta: Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) லிட்டருக்கு 2 கி அல்லது Spinosad 45SC (லிட்டருக்கு 0.3 மி.லி). ஒரே இரசாயனத்தைத் திரும்பத் திரும்ப ஒருபோதும் பயன்படுத்தாதீர்கள்.
pests.damage_si: කීටයෝ කොළ පටක සූරා කති; 'ජනෙල් වීදුරු' වැනි රටාවක් ඇති කරයි; කෘමි නාශකවලට ඉක්මනින් ප්‍රතිරෝධය වර්ධනය කරයි.
pests.damage_ta: புழுக்கள் இலைத் திசுவைச் சுரண்டி உண்ணும்; 'சன்னல் கண்ணாடி' போன்ற வடிவத்தை ஏற்படுத்தும்; பூச்சிக்கொல்லிகளுக்கு விரைவில் எதிர்ப்புத்திறன் பெறும்.
pests.identification_si: කොළවල යටි පැත්තේ කුඩා ලා කොළ පැහැ දළඹුවන්; කොළ මත ජනෙල් වැනි විනිවිද පෙනෙන ලප.
pests.identification_ta: இலைகளின் அடிப்பக்கத்தில் சிறிய வெளிர் பச்சைப் புழுக்கள்; இலைகளில் சன்னல் போன்ற ஒளிபுகும் திட்டுகள்.

pests.name: Cabbage Worm
pests.damage: Large caterpillars eat entire leaves leaving only main veins; causes severe defoliation.
pests.identification: Green velvety caterpillars on plants; white butterfly visible in field.
pests.prevention: Hand-pick caterpillars and egg masses. Use fine netting.
pests.treatment: Chlorpyrifos (2 ml/L) or Bt spray (2 g/L).
pests.prevention_si: දළඹුවන් සහ බිත්තර පොකුරු අතින් අල්ලා ඉවත් කරන්න. සියුම් දැල් භාවිත කරන්න.
pests.prevention_ta: புழுக்களையும் முட்டைக் கூட்டங்களையும் கையால் பொறுக்கி அகற்றுங்கள். நுண்ணிய வலையைப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள்.
pests.treatment_si: Chlorpyrifos (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 2) හෝ Bt ඉසීම (ලීටරයකට ග්‍රෑ. 2).
pests.treatment_ta: Chlorpyrifos (லிட்டருக்கு 2 மி.லி) அல்லது Bt தெளிப்பு (லிட்டருக்கு 2 கி).
pests.damage_si: විශාල දළඹුවෝ ප්‍රධාන නාරටි පමණක් ඉතිරි කරමින් සම්පූර්ණ කොළ කති; දැඩි ලෙස කොළ අහිමි වේ.
pests.damage_ta: பெரிய புழுக்கள் முதன்மை நரம்புகளை மட்டும் விட்டு முழு இலைகளையும் உண்ணும்; கடுமையான இலை இழப்பு.
pests.identification_si: පැළ මත කොළ පැහැ වෙල්වට් වැනි දළඹුවන්; කෙතේ සුදු සමනලුන් පෙනේ.
pests.identification_ta: செடிகளில் பச்சை நிற வெல்வெட் போன்ற புழுக்கள்; வயலில் வெள்ளை வண்ணத்துப்பூச்சிகள் தெரியும்.

pests.name: Cutworm
pests.damage: Cuts seedling stems at soil level; young transplants collapse overnight.
pests.identification: Cut-off stems at ground level; fat grey-brown caterpillar found in soil near base.
pests.prevention: Soil cultivation before planting. Remove surface debris.
pests.treatment: Chlorpyrifos granules in soil at planting or Carbofuran (2 g/m²).
pests.prevention_si: සිටුවීමට පෙර පස සකස් කිරීම. මතුපිට කුණු ඉවත් කරන්න.
pests.prevention_ta: நடவுக்கு முன் மண்ணைப் பண்படுத்துதல். மேற்பரப்புக் கழிவுகளை அகற்றுங்கள்.
pests.treatment_si: සිටුවන විට පසට Chlorpyrifos කැට හෝ Carbofuran (වර්ග මීටරයකට ග්‍රෑ. 2).
pests.treatment_ta: நடவின் போது மண்ணில் Chlorpyrifos குருணைகள் அல்லது Carbofuran (சதுர மீட்டருக்கு 2 கி).
pests.damage_si: පස මට්ටමින් පැළවල කඳන් කපයි; අලුතින් සිටුවූ පැළ එක රැයකින් ඇද වැටේ.
pests.damage_ta: மண் மட்டத்தில் நாற்றுத் தண்டுகளை வெட்டும்; புதிதாக நட்ட நாற்றுகள் ஒரே இரவில் சரிந்துவிடும்.
pests.identification_si: බිම් මට්ටමින් කැපුණු කඳන්; පාමුල අසල පසේ තර, අළු-දුඹුරු පැහැ දළඹුවෙක් හමු වේ.
pests.identification_ta: தரை மட்டத்தில் வெட்டப்பட்ட தண்டுகள்; அடிப்பகுதிக்கு அருகில் மண்ணில் கொழுத்த சாம்பல்-பழுப்புப் புழு காணப்படும்.

pests.name: Aphid
pests.damage: Dense colonies on inner leaves; causes distortion and reduced head quality.
pests.identification: Grey-green colonies inside developing heads.
pests.prevention: Inspect inner leaves regularly. Neem oil spray.
pests.treatment: Dimethoate 40EC (1.5 ml/L) before heads close.
pests.prevention_si: ඇතුළත කොළ නිතිපතා පරීක්ෂා කරන්න. කොහොඹ තෙල් ඉසීම.
pests.prevention_ta: உள் இலைகளைத் தொடர்ந்து சோதியுங்கள். வேப்ப எண்ணெய் தெளிப்பு.
pests.treatment_si: ගෙඩි වැසීමට පෙර Dimethoate 40EC (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 1.5).
pests.treatment_ta: முடிச்சுகள் மூடுவதற்கு முன் Dimethoate 40EC (லிட்டருக்கு 1.5 மி.லி).
pests.damage_si: ඇතුළත කොළ මත ඝන ජනපද; විකෘති වීම සහ ගෙඩිවල ගුණාත්මකභාවය අඩු වීම ඇති කරයි.
pests.damage_ta: உள் இலைகளில் அடர்த்தியான கூட்டங்கள்; உருக்குலைவையும் முடிச்சுத் தரக் குறைவையும் ஏற்படுத்தும்.
pests.identification_si: වැඩෙන ගෙඩි ඇතුළත අළු-කොළ පැහැ ජනපද.
pests.identification_ta: வளரும் முடிச்சுகளுக்குள் சாம்பல்-பச்சைக் கூட்டங்கள்.

risks.name: Diamondback Moth Resistance
risks.description: DBM has developed resistance to most insecticides. Poor control = total crop loss.
risks.signs: Spraying with no effect on caterpillar populations.
risks.mitigation: Use Bt and Spinosad. Rotate with different modes of action. Never spray synthetic pyrethroids only.
risks.description_si: දියමන්ති පිටැති සලබයා බොහෝ කෘමි නාශකවලට ප්‍රතිරෝධය වර්ධනය කර ඇත. දුර්වල පාලනය = මුළු බෝගයම අහිමි වීම.
risks.description_ta: வைரமுதுகு அந்துப்பூச்சி பெரும்பாலான பூச்சிக்கொல்லிகளுக்கு எதிர்ப்புத்திறன் பெற்றுவிட்டது. மோசமான கட்டுப்பாடு = முழுப் பயிர் இழப்பு.
risks.signs_si: ඉසීමෙන් පසුවත් දළඹුවන් ගහනය අඩු නොවීම.
risks.mitigation_si: Bt සහ Spinosad භාවිත කරන්න. වෙනස් ක්‍රියාකාරී ක්‍රම ඇති රසායනික මාරුවෙන් මාරුවට භාවිත කරන්න. කෘත්‍රිම පයිරෙත්‍රොයිඩ් පමණක් කිසි විටෙක ඉසීම නොකරන්න.
risks.mitigation_ta: Bt, Spinosad ஆகியவற்றைப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள். வெவ்வேறு செயல்முறையுள்ள இரசாயனங்களை மாற்றி மாற்றிப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள். செயற்கை பைரெத்ராய்டுகளை மட்டும் ஒருபோதும் தெளிக்காதீர்கள்.

risks.name: Head Splitting
risks.description: Sudden rain after dry period causes rapid water uptake and splits heads.
risks.mitigation: Maintain consistent irrigation. Harvest promptly when mature.
risks.description_si: වියළි කාලයකට පසු හදිසි වැස්ස නිසා ජලය වේගයෙන් උරා ගෙන ගෙඩි පැලේ.
risks.description_ta: வறண்ட காலத்துக்குப் பின் திடீர் மழையால் நீர் வேகமாக உறிஞ்சப்பட்டு முடிச்சுகள் வெடிக்கும்.
risks.signs_si: වැස්සෙන් පසු ඉරිතැලුණු ගෙඩි පෙනේ.
risks.mitigation_si: නොකඩවා ජලය දීම පවත්වා ගන්න. මේරූ විට වහාම අස්වනු නෙළන්න.
risks.mitigation_ta: தொடர்ச்சியான நீர்ப்பாசனத்தைப் பேணுங்கள். முற்றியதும் உடனே அறுவடை செய்யுங்கள்.

indicators: Head is firm and compact when pressed
harvest.method: Cut at base with sharp knife. Keep 3–4 outer leaves.
harvest.post_harvest: Store in cool ventilated shade. Remove damaged outer leaves. Market within 7–10 days.
harvest.method_si: තියුණු පිහියකින් පාමුලින් කපන්න. පිටත කොළ 3–4ක් තබා ගන්න.
harvest.method_ta: கூர்மையான கத்தியால் அடியில் வெட்டுங்கள். வெளி இலைகள் 3–4 ஐ வைத்திருங்கள்.
harvest.post_harvest_si: සිසිල්, වාතාශ්‍රය ඇති සෙවණක ගබඩා කරන්න. හානි වූ පිටත කොළ ඉවත් කරන්න. දින 7–10ක් ඇතුළත වෙළඳපොළට යවන්න.
harvest.post_harvest_ta: குளிர்ந்த, காற்றோட்டமுள்ள நிழலில் சேமியுங்கள். சேதமடைந்த வெளி இலைகளை அகற்றுங்கள். 7–10 நாட்களுக்குள் சந்தைக்கு அனுப்புங்கள்.
indicators_si: තද කළ විට ගෙඩිය තද හා ඝනය
පිටත කොළ මඳක් කෝප්පයක් මෙන් නැමී ඇත
indicators_ta: வெளி இலைகள் சற்றுக் கிண்ணம் போல் வளைந்திருக்கும்

Cabbage.growth_stages_text: Cabbage cultivation follows several important growth stages including nursery development, transplanting, vegetative growth, head formation, and harvesting. Seeds are usually sown in nurseries and germinate within 5–8 days, with seedlings ready for transplanting after 3–4 weeks. After transplanting, vegetative growth continues for about 30–45 days, followed by head initiation and compact head formation. Harvesting is generally done within 70–90 days after transplanting when heads become firm, compact, and reach the desired size. Farmers commonly use transplanting methods and maintain spacing of approximately 45–60 cm between plants and 60–75 cm between rows to ensure adequate space for head development, air circulation, and disease prevention.
Cabbage.management_text: Successful cabbage cultivation requires a structured week-by-week crop management plan including nursery preparation, land preparation, transplanting, fertilizer application, irrigation, weed control, pest monitoring, and harvesting activities. Fertilizer application is essential during vegetative growth and head formation stages, commonly using nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium fertilizers, and organic compost to support strong leaf development and tight head formation. Adequate nitrogen is important early in growth, but balanced nutrition is required later to avoid loose or split heads. Irrigation is most critical during head formation, as water stress can reduce head size and quality, while excessive water may lead to root diseases.
Cabbage.disease_management_text: Disease and pest management are crucial in cabbage cultivation. Aphids suck plant sap, causing curling and weakening of leaves, while cabbage worms and diamondback moth larvae feed on leaves, causing severe defoliation. Cutworms damage young seedlings by cutting stems at soil level. Club root is a serious soil-borne disease that causes swollen, distorted roots and poor plant growth, while fungal leaf spot diseases reduce photosynthesis and overall plant vigor. These issues can be managed through crop rotation, field sanitation, removal of infected plants, use of resistant varieties, biological control methods, and recommended pesticide or fungicide applications when necessary. Risk mitigation practices such as regular field monitoring, proper irrigation management, balanced fertilizer use, and integrated pest management techniques help improve yield and maintain high-quality cabbage heads.
Cabbage.overview_si: ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ “ගෝවා” ලෙස හැඳින්වෙන ගෝවා (Brassica oleracea var. capitata) Brassicaceae කුලයට අයත්, සිසිල් දේශගුණයක වැඩෙන පත්‍ර එළවළු බෝගයකි. අඩු උෂ්ණත්වය නිසි ගෝවා ගෙඩි සෑදීමට සහ ඝන වර්ධනයට උපකාරී වන නුවරඑළිය, බදුල්ල, මහනුවර වැනි උඩරට ප්‍රදේශවල එය ප්‍රධාන වශයෙන් වගා කෙරේ. ගෝවා 15°C–22°C අතර උෂ්ණත්වයේ හොඳින් වැඩෙන අතර, pH 6.0–7.0 අතර, කාබනික ද්‍රව්‍ය බහුල, හොඳින් ජලය බැස යන සාරවත් ලෝම පසක් අවශ්‍ය වේ. නිරෝගී ශාක වර්ධනයට සහ තද ගෙඩි සෑදීමට මධ්‍යස්ථ වර්ෂාව, නිතිපතා ජලසම්පාදනය සහ පූර්ණ හිරු එළිය අවශ්‍යය. ශ්‍රී ලාංකික ආහාරවල ව්‍යංජන, බැදුම් සහ සලාද සඳහා ගෝවා බහුලව භාවිත වන අතර, විටමින් C සහ K, තන්තු සහ ප්‍රතිඔක්සිකාරක අඩංගු බැවින් පෝෂණීය වටිනාකමක් ඇත. ප්‍රභේදය සහ වගා තත්ත්ව අනුව පැළ සිටුවීමෙන් දින 70–90 අතර අස්වනු නෙළිය හැක. උෂ්ණත්වය, පාංශු තෙතමනය, වර්ෂාව, හිරු එළිය, ආර්ද්‍රතාව සහ පසේ සාරවත්බව ගෝවා වගාවට බලපාන ප්‍රධාන සාධක වේ. කුඩිත්තා, ගෝවා දළඹුවා, දියමන්ති පිටැති සලබයා, කපන දළඹුවා, මුල් ඉදිමීමේ රෝගය සහ දිලීර පත්‍ර පුල්ලි රෝග පොදු පළිබෝධ හා රෝග වන අතර, නිසි ලෙස පාලනය නොකළහොත් ඒවා අස්වැන්න සහ ගෙඩිවල ගුණාත්මකභාවය අඩු කරයි.
Cabbage.overview_ta: இலங்கையில் “கோவா” என அழைக்கப்படும் முட்டைக்கோஸ் (Brassica oleracea var. capitata), Brassicaceae குடும்பத்தைச் சேர்ந்த குளிர் காலநிலை இலைக் காய்கறிப் பயிர். குறைந்த வெப்பநிலை சரியான முடிச்சு உருவாக்கத்துக்கும் அடர்த்தியான வளர்ச்சிக்கும் உதவும் நுவரெலியா, பதுளை, கண்டி போன்ற மலைநாட்டுப் பகுதிகளில் இது முக்கியமாகப் பயிரிடப்படுகிறது. முட்டைக்கோஸ் 15°C–22°C வெப்பநிலையில் நன்றாக வளரும்; pH 6.0–7.0 உள்ள, கரிமப் பொருள் நிறைந்த, நன்கு நீர் வடியும் வளமான இருமண் தேவை. ஆரோக்கியமான தாவர வளர்ச்சி மற்றும் இறுக்கமான முடிச்சு உருவாக்கத்துக்கு மிதமான மழை, தொடர்ச்சியான நீர்ப்பாசனம், முழுச் சூரிய ஒளி அவசியம். இலங்கை உணவில் கறி, வதக்கல், சாலட் ஆகியவற்றுக்கு முட்டைக்கோஸ் பரவலாகப் பயன்படுகிறது; விட்டமின் C, K, நார்ச்சத்து, ஆக்ஸிஜனேற்றிகள் அடங்கியிருப்பதால் ஊட்டச்சத்து மதிப்புடையது. இனம் மற்றும் வளர்ப்பு நிலைமைகளைப் பொறுத்து நாற்று நட்டு 70–90 நாட்களில் அறுவடைக்குத் தயாராகும். வெப்பநிலை, மண் ஈரப்பதம், மழை, சூரிய ஒளி, காற்று ஈரப்பதம், மண் வளம் ஆகியவை முட்டைக்கோஸ் சாகுபடியைப் பாதிக்கும் முக்கியக் காரணிகள். அசுவினி, முட்டைக்கோஸ் புழு, வைரமுதுகு அந்துப்பூச்சி, வெட்டுப்புழு, வேர் முடிச்சு (கிளப் ரூட்) நோய், பூஞ்சை இலைப்புள்ளி நோய்கள் ஆகியவை பொதுவான பூச்சிகளும் நோய்களும்; சரியாகக் கட்டுப்படுத்தாவிட்டால் இவை மகசூலையும் முடிச்சின் தரத்தையும் குறைக்கும்.

Cauliflower (Gowa).overview: Cauliflower, commonly known as “Gowa” in Sri Lanka, is a cool-climate vegetable crop belonging to the Brassicaceae family and scientifically known as Brassica oleracea var. botrytis. It is mainly cultivated in cooler regions of Sri Lanka such as Nuwara Eliya, Badulla, and Kandy because these areas provide favorable environmental conditions for growth. Cauliflower grows best in temperatures between 15°C and 25°C and requires well-drained loamy soil with a soil pH ranging from 6.0 to 6.8. The crop requires moderate rainfall, adequate sunlight, and regular irrigation for proper curd development and healthy growth. It is usually harvested within 60 to 75 days after transplanting and can produce an average yield of 6–9 tons per hectare under suitable cultivation conditions. Common factors affecting cauliflower cultivation include temperature, soil moisture, rainfall, humidity, and sunlight. Farmers must also manage diseases such as club root, damping off, and yellowing curds, which are commonly caused by acidic soil conditions, fungal infections, poor drainage, excessive sunlight, or high temperatures.

stages.name: Land Preparation

activities.title: Plough, lime, and raise beds
activities.description: pH should be 6.0–6.8. Lime if needed. Form raised beds.
activities.why: Acidic soils cause club root and poor curd development.
activities.title_si: සීසා, හුණු යොදා, උස් පාත්ති සාදන්න
activities.title_ta: உழுது, சுண்ணாம்பு இட்டு, உயர்த்திய பாத்திகள் அமைத்தல்
activities.description_si: pH 6.0–6.8 විය යුතුය. අවශ්‍ය නම් හුණු යොදන්න. උස් කළ පාත්ති සාදන්න.
activities.description_ta: pH 6.0–6.8 ஆக இருக்க வேண்டும். தேவைப்பட்டால் சுண்ணாம்பு இடுங்கள். உயர்த்திய பாத்திகள் அமையுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: ආම්ලික පස මුල් ඉදිමීමේ රෝගය සහ දුර්වල මල් ශීර්ෂ වර්ධනය ඇති කරයි.
activities.why_ta: அமில மண் வேர் முடிச்சு நோயையும் மோசமான பூந்தலை வளர்ச்சியையும் ஏற்படுத்தும்.

activities.title: Apply compost
activities.description: Incorporate 15 t/ha compost.
activities.why: Cauliflower is a heavy feeder needing rich soil.
activities.description_si: හෙක්ටයාරයකට ටොන් 15ක් කොම්පෝස්ට් පසට මිශ්‍ර කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: எக்டேருக்கு 15 டன் மக்கிய உரத்தை மண்ணுடன் கலந்துவிடுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: මල් ගෝවා සාරවත් පසක් අවශ්‍ය, පෝෂක බහුලව අවශ්‍ය බෝගයකි.
activities.why_ta: காலிஃபிளவர் வளமான மண் தேவைப்படும், அதிக ஊட்டம் வேண்டும் பயிர்.

stages.description_si: සාරවත්, හොඳින් ජලය බැස යන පාත්ති සකස් කරන්න.
stages.description_ta: வளமான, நன்கு நீர் வடியும் பாத்திகளைத் தயார்செய்யுங்கள்.

stages.name: Transplanting

activities.title: Transplant 25-day seedlings
activities.description: Plant in late afternoon. Water immediately.
activities.why: Protects seedlings from heat stress.
activities.description_si: සවස් වරුවේ සිටුවන්න. වහාම ජලය දෙන්න.
activities.description_ta: பிற்பகலில் நடுங்கள். உடனே நீர் பாய்ச்சுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: පැළ තාප ආතතියෙන් ආරක්ෂා කරයි.
activities.why_ta: நாற்றுகளை வெப்ப அழுத்தத்திலிருந்து காக்கும்.

activities.title: Water daily 2 weeks
activities.description: Water at base daily.
activities.why: Critical establishment period.
activities.description_si: දිනපතා පැළයේ මුලට ජලය දෙන්න.
activities.description_ta: தினமும் செடியின் அடியில் நீர் ஊற்றுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: ස්ථාපිත වීමේ තීරණාත්මක කාලය.
activities.why_ta: நிலைபெறுவதற்கான முக்கியமான காலம்.

stages.description_si: පැළ ස්ථාපිත කරන්න.

stages.name: Vegetative Growth

activities.title: Top dressing 1
activities.description: Urea 100 kg/ha + MOP 50 kg/ha ring.
activities.why: Nitrogen for leaf development; potassium for curd quality.
activities.description_si: යූරියා හෙක්ටයාරයකට කි.ග්‍රෑ. 100 + MOP කි.ග්‍රෑ. 50 වළල්ලක් ලෙස.
activities.description_ta: எக்டேருக்கு 100 கி.கி யூரியா + 50 கி.கி MOP வளையமாக.
activities.why_si: කොළ වර්ධනයට නයිට්‍රජන්; මල් ශීර්ෂයේ ගුණාත්මකභාවයට පොටෑසියම්.
activities.why_ta: இலை வளர்ச்சிக்கு நைட்ரஜன்; பூந்தலைத் தரத்துக்குப் பொட்டாசியம்.

activities.title: Scout for DBM
activities.description: Check leaf undersides for larvae and diamond-shaped holes.
activities.why: DBM damages leaves that are needed for curd development.
activities.title_si: දියමන්ති පිටැති සලබයා සඳහා පරීක්ෂා කරන්න
activities.description_si: කීටයන් සහ දියමන්ති හැඩැති සිදුරු සඳහා කොළවල යටි පැත්ත පරීක්ෂා කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: புழுக்களுக்கும் வைர வடிவத் துளைகளுக்கும் இலைகளின் அடிப்பக்கத்தைச் சோதியுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: දියමන්ති පිටැති සලබයා මල් ශීර්ෂ වර්ධනයට අවශ්‍ය කොළවලට හානි කරයි.
activities.why_ta: வைரமுதுகு அந்துப்பூச்சி பூந்தலை வளர்ச்சிக்குத் தேவையான இலைகளைச் சேதப்படுத்தும்.

stages.description_si: මල් ශීර්ෂ සෑදීම ආරම්භ වීමට පෙර කොළ වර්ධනය.
stages.description_ta: பூந்தலை உருவாகத் தொடங்குவதற்கு முன் இலை வளர்ச்சி.

stages.name: Curd Development

activities.title: Tie outer leaves over curd
activities.description: When small curd appears (5–8 cm), tie outer leaves over it to blanch.
activities.why: Exposure to sunlight turns curd yellow/brown and reduces quality.
activities.title_si: පිටත කොළ මල් ශීර්ෂයට උඩින් බඳින්න
activities.description_si: කුඩා මල් ශීර්ෂය (සෙ.මී. 5–8) මතු වූ විට, එය සුදුව තබා ගැනීමට පිටත කොළ ඒ මතින් බඳින්න.
activities.description_ta: சிறிய பூந்தலை (5–8 செ.மீ) தோன்றியதும், அதை வெண்மையாக வைக்க வெளி இலைகளை அதன் மேல் கட்டுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: හිරු එළියට නිරාවරණය වීමෙන් මල් ශීර්ෂය කහ/දුඹුරු වී ගුණාත්මකභාවය අඩු වේ.
activities.why_ta: சூரிய ஒளி படுவதால் பூந்தலை மஞ்சள்/பழுப்பாகி தரம் குறையும்.

activities.title: Top dressing 2
activities.description: Urea 50 kg/ha.
activities.why: Final nitrogen for curd fill.
activities.description_si: යූරියා හෙක්ටයාරයකට කි.ග්‍රෑ. 50.
activities.description_ta: எக்டேருக்கு 50 கி.கி யூரியா.
activities.why_si: මල් ශීර්ෂය පිරීමට අවසාන නයිට්‍රජන්.
activities.why_ta: பூந்தலை நிரம்ப இறுதி நைட்ரஜன்.

activities.title: Check for curd browning
activities.description: Inspect tied curd for browning, rot, or pest entry.
activities.why: Browning reduces market value. Act quickly if seen.
activities.title_si: මල් ශීර්ෂය දුඹුරු වීම සඳහා පරීක්ෂා කරන්න
activities.description_si: බැඳ ඇති මල් ශීර්ෂය දුඹුරු වීම, කුණුවීම හෝ පළිබෝධ ඇතුළු වීම සඳහා පරීක්ෂා කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: கட்டிய பூந்தலையில் பழுப்பாதல், அழுகல் அல்லது பூச்சி நுழைவு உள்ளதா எனச் சோதியுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: දුඹුරු වීම වෙළඳපොළ වටිනාකම අඩු කරයි. දුටුවහොත් ඉක්මනින් ක්‍රියා කරන්න.
activities.why_ta: பழுப்பாதல் சந்தை மதிப்பைக் குறைக்கும். கண்டால் விரைவாக நடவடிக்கை எடுங்கள்.

stages.description_si: තීරණාත්මක අවධිය — මල් ශීර්ෂයේ සුදු පැහැය ආරක්ෂා කරන්න.

stages.name: Harvest

activities.title: Harvest when curd is compact
activities.description: Cut when curd is firm, white, 15–20 cm diameter. Do not delay.
activities.why: Over-mature curds become loose (ricey) and unsaleable.
activities.title_si: මල් ශීර්ෂය ඝන වූ විට අස්වනු නෙළන්න
activities.description_si: මල් ශීර්ෂය තද, සුදු, විෂ්කම්භය සෙ.මී. 15–20 වූ විට කපන්න. ප්‍රමාද නොකරන්න.
activities.description_ta: பூந்தலை உறுதியாக, வெண்மையாக, 15–20 செ.மீ விட்டத்துடன் இருக்கும்போது வெட்டுங்கள். தாமதிக்காதீர்கள்.
activities.why_si: අධික ලෙස මේරූ මල් ශීර්ෂ ලිහිල් (බත් ඇට වැනි) වී විකිණිය නොහැකි වේ.
activities.why_ta: அதிகம் முற்றிய பூந்தலைகள் தளர்ந்து (அரிசி போல்) விற்பனைக்கு உதவாது.

activities.title: Continue daily checks
activities.description: Adjacent plants may mature within days of each other. Check daily.
activities.why: Missing harvest peak = total loss of that head.
activities.description_si: යාබද පැළ දින කිහිපයක් ඇතුළත මේරිය හැක. දිනපතා පරීක්ෂා කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: அருகருகே உள்ள செடிகள் சில நாட்களுக்குள் முற்றலாம். தினமும் சோதியுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: අස්වනු නෙළීමේ උපරිම අවස්ථාව මඟ හැරීම = එම ගෙඩිය සම්පූර්ණයෙන්ම අහිමි වීම.
activities.why_ta: அறுவடை உச்சத்தைத் தவறவிட்டால் = அந்தப் பூந்தலை முழுமையாக இழப்பு.

stages.description_si: මල් ශීර්ෂය උපරිම ගුණාත්මකභාවයෙන් ඇති විට අස්වනු නෙළන්න.
stages.description_ta: பூந்தலை உச்சத் தரத்தில் இருக்கும்போது அறுவடை செய்யுங்கள்.

fertilization.why_si: ගුණාත්මක මල් ශීර්ෂයක් සඳහා පෝෂක බහුල පදනම.

irrigation.notes: Never let soil dry during curd development — causes hollow stems and poor curd quality.
irrigation.notes_si: මල් ශීර්ෂය වර්ධනය වන කාලයේ පස කිසි විටෙක වියළීමට ඉඩ නොදෙන්න — එයින් කඳ හිස් වීම සහ මල් ශීර්ෂයේ ගුණය දුර්වල වීම සිදු වේ.
irrigation.notes_ta: பூந்தலை வளரும் காலத்தில் மண் காய ஒருபோதும் விடாதீர்கள் — தண்டு உள்ளீடற்றதாதலும் பூந்தலைத் தரக் குறைவும் ஏற்படும்.
water_stress_signs_si: ලිහිල් හෝ 'බත් ඇට වැනි' මල් ශීර්ෂය

diseases.name: Club Root
diseases.symptoms: Swollen, distorted, club-shaped roots; wilting and stunted growth above ground.
diseases.favorable_conditions: Acidic soil (pH < 6.0), high moisture, warm temperatures.
diseases.prevention: Maintain soil pH above 6.5 with lime. Crop rotation (no Brassicas for 4 years). Good drainage.
diseases.treatment: No effective chemical cure. Apply lime to raise pH. Remove infected plants.
diseases.symptoms_si: ඉදිමුණු, විකෘති, මුගුරක හැඩැති මුල්; පොළොවට ඉහළ කොටස මැලවීම සහ වර්ධනය බාල වීම.
diseases.symptoms_ta: வீங்கிய, உருக்குலைந்த, தண்டாயுத வடிவ வேர்கள்; தரைக்கு மேலே வாடலும் வளர்ச்சிக் குன்றலும்.
diseases.favorable_conditions_si: ආම්ලික පස (pH < 6.0), ඉහළ තෙතමනය, උණුසුම් උෂ්ණත්වය.
diseases.favorable_conditions_ta: அமில மண் (pH < 6.0), அதிக ஈரப்பதம், வெப்பமான வெப்பநிலை.
diseases.prevention_si: හුණු යොදා පසේ pH 6.5ට වඩා වැඩිව තබා ගන්න. බෝග මාරුව (අවුරුදු 4ක් ගෝවා කුලයේ බෝග නොවගා කරන්න). හොඳ ජලාපවහනය.
diseases.prevention_ta: சுண்ணாம்பு இட்டு மண் pH-ஐ 6.5க்கு மேல் வையுங்கள். பயிர்ச் சுழற்சி (4 ஆண்டுகள் முட்டைக்கோஸ் குடும்பப் பயிர்கள் வேண்டாம்). நல்ல வடிகால்.
diseases.treatment_si: ඵලදායී රසායනික ප්‍රතිකාරයක් නැත. pH වැඩි කිරීමට හුණු යොදන්න. ආසාදිත පැළ ඉවත් කරන්න.
diseases.treatment_ta: பயனுள்ள இரசாயன சிகிச்சை இல்லை. pH-ஐ உயர்த்தச் சுண்ணாம்பு இடுங்கள். பாதிக்கப்பட்ட செடிகளை அகற்றுங்கள்.

diseases.name: Damping Off
diseases.symptoms: Seedling stem rots at soil surface; seedlings collapse and die.
diseases.favorable_conditions: Overwatered nursery, poor drainage, dense sowing.
diseases.prevention: Well-drained nursery soil. Avoid overwatering. Good air circulation.
diseases.treatment: Drench with Captan or Thiram (2 g/L) at first sign of infection.
diseases.symptoms_si: පස මතුපිටදී පැළයේ කඳ කුණු වේ; පැළ ඇද වැටී මිය යයි.
diseases.symptoms_ta: மண் மேற்பரப்பில் நாற்றுத் தண்டு அழுகும்; நாற்றுகள் சரிந்து இறக்கும்.
diseases.favorable_conditions_si: තවානට අධිකව ජලය දීම, දුර්වල ජලාපවහනය, ඝනව බීජ වැපිරීම.
diseases.favorable_conditions_ta: நாற்றங்காலில் அதிக நீர், மோசமான வடிகால், அடர்த்தியான விதைப்பு.
diseases.prevention_si: හොඳින් ජලය බැස යන තවාන් පස. අධිකව ජලය දීමෙන් වළකින්න. හොඳ වාතාශ්‍රය.
diseases.prevention_ta: நன்கு நீர் வடியும் நாற்றங்கால் மண். அதிக நீர் பாய்ச்சுவதைத் தவிருங்கள். நல்ல காற்றோட்டம்.
diseases.treatment_si: ආසාදනයේ පළමු ලක්ෂණය දුටු විට Captan හෝ Thiram (ලීටරයකට ග්‍රෑ. 2) මගින් පස තෙමන්න.
diseases.treatment_ta: தொற்றின் முதல் அறிகுறியிலேயே Captan அல்லது Thiram (லிட்டருக்கு 2 கி) கொண்டு மண்ணை நனையுங்கள்.

diseases.name: Yellowing Curds
diseases.symptoms: Curd develops yellow or brown discolouration instead of white.
diseases.favorable_conditions: Direct sunlight exposure during curd development, high temperatures.
diseases.prevention: Tie outer leaves over developing curd ('blanching') to block sunlight.
diseases.treatment: Not a disease — preventable by leaf blanching. No chemical treatment needed.
diseases.symptoms_si: මල් ශීර්ෂය සුදු වෙනුවට කහ හෝ දුඹුරු පැහැයක් ගනී.
diseases.symptoms_ta: பூந்தலை வெண்மைக்குப் பதிலாக மஞ்சள் அல்லது பழுப்பு நிறம் பெறும்.
diseases.favorable_conditions_si: මල් ශීර්ෂය වර්ධනය වන කාලයේ සෘජු හිරු එළියට නිරාවරණය වීම, ඉහළ උෂ්ණත්වය.
diseases.favorable_conditions_ta: பூந்தலை வளரும்போது நேரடிச் சூரிய ஒளி படுதல், அதிக வெப்பநிலை.
diseases.prevention_si: හිරු එළිය වැළැක්වීමට වැඩෙන මල් ශීර්ෂයට උඩින් පිටත කොළ බඳින්න ('සුදු කිරීම').
diseases.prevention_ta: சூரிய ஒளியைத் தடுக்க வளரும் பூந்தலைக்கு மேல் வெளி இலைகளைக் கட்டுங்கள் ('வெண்மையாக்கல்').
diseases.treatment_si: රෝගයක් නොවේ — කොළ බැඳීමෙන් වැළැක්විය හැක. රසායනික ප්‍රතිකාර අවශ්‍ය නැත.
diseases.treatment_ta: இது நோய் அல்ல — இலைகளைக் கட்டுவதால் தடுக்கலாம். இரசாயன சிகிச்சை தேவையில்லை.

pests.name: Cabbage Worm (Imported)
pests.damage: Feeds on leaves causing irregular holes; can destroy young plants completely.
pests.identification: Green caterpillars on leaf undersides; white butterfly seen in field.
pests.prevention: Inspect regularly. Remove egg masses from leaf undersides. Use netting.
pests.treatment: Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) spray (2 g/L) or Chlorpyrifos (2 ml/L).
pests.prevention_si: නිතිපතා පරීක්ෂා කරන්න. කොළවල යටි පැත්තෙන් බිත්තර පොකුරු ඉවත් කරන්න. දැල් භාවිත කරන්න.
pests.prevention_ta: தொடர்ந்து சோதியுங்கள். இலைகளின் அடிப்பக்கத்திலிருந்து முட்டைக் கூட்டங்களை அகற்றுங்கள். வலையைப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள்.
pests.treatment_si: Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) ඉසීම (ලීටරයකට ග්‍රෑ. 2) හෝ Chlorpyrifos (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 2).
pests.treatment_ta: Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) தெளிப்பு (லிட்டருக்கு 2 கி) அல்லது Chlorpyrifos (லிட்டருக்கு 2 மி.லி).
pests.damage_si: කොළ කමින් අක්‍රමවත් සිදුරු ඇති කරයි; ළපටි පැළ සම්පූර්ණයෙන්ම විනාශ කළ හැක.
pests.damage_ta: இலைகளை உண்டு ஒழுங்கற்ற துளைகளை ஏற்படுத்தும்; இளம் செடிகளை முழுமையாக அழிக்கலாம்.
pests.identification_si: කොළවල යටි පැත්තේ කොළ පැහැ දළඹුවන්; කෙතේ සුදු සමනලුන් දකින්නට ලැබේ.
pests.identification_ta: இலைகளின் அடிப்பக்கத்தில் பச்சைப் புழுக்கள்; வயலில் வெள்ளை வண்ணத்துப்பூச்சிகள் தென்படும்.

pests.name: Aphid
pests.damage: Sucks sap from young shoots; excretes honeydew causing sooty mould.
pests.identification: Dense clusters of small grey-green insects on shoot tips.
pests.prevention: Encourage predatory insects. Neem oil spray (5 ml/L).
pests.treatment: Dimethoate 40EC (1.5 ml/L) if infestation severe.
pests.prevention_si: විලෝපික කෘමීන් දිරිමත් කරන්න. කොහොඹ තෙල් ඉසීම (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 5).
pests.prevention_ta: இரைகொல்லிப் பூச்சிகளை ஊக்குவியுங்கள். வேப்ப எண்ணெய் தெளிப்பு (லிட்டருக்கு 5 மி.லி).
pests.treatment_si: ආසාදනය දැඩි නම් Dimethoate 40EC (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 1.5).
pests.treatment_ta: தாக்குதல் கடுமையாக இருந்தால் Dimethoate 40EC (லிட்டருக்கு 1.5 மி.லி).
pests.damage_si: ළපටි දළුවලින් යුෂ උරා බොයි; කළු දිලීර (සූටි මෝල්ඩ්) ඇති කරන මී පැණි වැනි ස්‍රාවයක් පිට කරයි.
pests.damage_ta: இளம் தளிர்களில் சாற்றை உறிஞ்சும்; கரும்பூஞ்சணத்தை ஏற்படுத்தும் தேன் போன்ற திரவத்தை வெளியிடும்.
pests.identification_si: දළු අග කුඩා අළු-කොළ පැහැ කෘමීන්ගේ ඝන පොකුරු.
pests.identification_ta: தளிர் நுனிகளில் சிறிய சாம்பல்-பச்சைப் பூச்சிகளின் அடர்த்தியான கூட்டங்கள்.

risks.name: High Temperature (>25°C)
risks.description: Causes poor curd set, loose ricey curds, or no curd formation.
risks.signs: Premature bolting, small or loose curds.
risks.mitigation: Plant in cooler season. Use temperature-tolerant varieties.
risks.description_si: මල් ශීර්ෂ හටගැනීම දුර්වල වීම, ලිහිල් බත් ඇට වැනි මල් ශීර්ෂ, හෝ මල් ශීර්ෂ නොහටගැනීම.
risks.description_ta: பூந்தலை உருவாக்கக் குறைவு, தளர்வான அரிசி போன்ற பூந்தலைகள், அல்லது பூந்தலை உருவாகாமை.
risks.signs_si: කලින් මල් දණ්ඩ මතු වීම, කුඩා හෝ ලිහිල් මල් ශීර්ෂ.
risks.signs_ta: முன்கூட்டியே பூந்தண்டு எழுதல், சிறிய அல்லது தளர்வான பூந்தலைகள்.
risks.mitigation_si: සිසිල් කාලයේ සිටුවන්න. උෂ්ණත්වයට ඔරොත්තු දෙන ප්‍රභේද භාවිත කරන්න.
risks.mitigation_ta: குளிர்ந்த பருவத்தில் நடுங்கள். வெப்பத்தைத் தாங்கும் இனங்களைப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள்.

risks.name: Frost
risks.description: Kills young transplants and damages curds.
risks.mitigation: Cover with sacks during cold nights in Nuwara Eliya.
risks.description_si: අලුතින් සිටුවූ පැළ මරා දමන අතර මල් ශීර්ෂවලට හානි කරයි.
risks.description_ta: புதிதாக நட்ட நாற்றுகளைக் கொன்று பூந்தலைகளைச் சேதப்படுத்தும்.
risks.signs_si: එක රැයකින් පත්‍ර කළු වී මැලවීම.
risks.mitigation_si: නුවරඑළියේ සීතල රාත්‍රීවලදී ගෝනිවලින් ආවරණය කරන්න.
risks.mitigation_ta: நுவரெலியாவில் குளிரான இரவுகளில் கோணிப் பைகளால் மூடுங்கள்.

indicators: Firm compact white curd 15–20 cm diameter
Curd surface is smooth and even
harvest.method: Cut at base with sharp knife leaving 3–4 leaves.
harvest.frequency: Single harvest; check daily near maturity
harvest.post_harvest: Keep cool and shaded. Avoid sunlight — yellows quickly. Market within 3–5 days.
harvest.method_si: කොළ 3–4ක් ඉතිරි කරමින් තියුණු පිහියකින් පාමුලින් කපන්න.
harvest.method_ta: இலைகள் 3–4 ஐ விட்டு, கூர்மையான கத்தியால் அடியில் வெட்டுங்கள்.
harvest.frequency_si: එක් වරක් අස්වනු නෙළීම; මේරීමට ආසන්නයේ දිනපතා පරීක්ෂා කරන්න
harvest.frequency_ta: ஒரே முறை அறுவடை; முதிர்ச்சி நெருங்கும்போது தினமும் சோதியுங்கள்
harvest.post_harvest_si: සිසිල්ව සහ සෙවණේ තබන්න. හිරු එළියෙන් වළකින්න — ඉක්මනින් කහ වේ. දින 3–5ක් ඇතුළත වෙළඳපොළට යවන්න.
harvest.post_harvest_ta: குளிர்ச்சியாகவும் நிழலிலும் வையுங்கள். சூரிய ஒளியைத் தவிருங்கள் — விரைவில் மஞ்சளாகும். 3–5 நாட்களுக்குள் சந்தைக்கு அனுப்புங்கள்.
indicators_si: විෂ්කම්භය සෙ.මී. 15–20 වූ තද, ඝන, සුදු මල් ශීර්ෂය
මල් ශීර්ෂයේ මතුපිට සිනිඳු සහ ඒකාකාරය
indicators_ta: 15–20 செ.மீ விட்டமுள்ள உறுதியான, இறுக்கமான வெண்மையான பூந்தலை

Cauliflower (Gowa).growth_stages_text: Cauliflower cultivation follows several important growth stages including germination, vegetative growth, curd formation, and harvesting. Germination usually occurs within 5–10 days after sowing, while the vegetative stage continues for about 20–30 days. Curd development begins around 45–55 days after transplanting, and harvesting is generally carried out between 60–75 days when the curds become compact, white, and fully developed. Farmers commonly use transplanting methods rather than direct seeding, maintaining plant spacing of approximately 45–60 cm between plants and rows to ensure healthy growth and air circulation.
Cauliflower (Gowa).management_text: Proper crop management requires a week-by-week schedule for activities such as land preparation, nursery management, transplanting, fertilizer application, irrigation, pest management, and harvesting. Fertilizer application is important during early vegetative growth and curd development stages, using nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium-based fertilizers in recommended quantities to improve yield and curd quality. Irrigation frequency varies according to the crop stage, with frequent watering required during germination and curd formation stages, while moderate irrigation is sufficient during vegetative growth. Farmers identify harvest readiness when the cauliflower curds become firm, compact, and reach marketable size before flowering starts.
Cauliflower (Gowa).disease_management_text: Disease management is essential in cauliflower cultivation. Club root disease causes swollen and distorted roots, leading to wilting and stunted growth, and can be controlled through proper soil pH management and crop rotation. Damping off disease appears as seedling stem rot near the soil surface and can be reduced through proper drainage and fungicide treatment. Yellowing curds occur due to excessive sunlight or high temperatures and can be minimized by covering the curds with leaves during development. Risk mitigation practices such as proper drainage systems, balanced fertilizer use, timely irrigation, disease monitoring, resistant varieties, and climate-aware cultivation methods help farmers reduce crop damage and improve productivity under changing environmental conditions.
Cauliflower (Gowa).overview_si: ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ “මල් ගෝවා” ලෙස හැඳින්වෙන මල් ගෝවා (Brassica oleracea var. botrytis) Brassicaceae කුලයට අයත්, සිසිල් දේශගුණයක වැඩෙන එළවළු බෝගයකි. වර්ධනයට හිතකර පාරිසරික තත්ත්ව ලබා දෙන බැවින් එය නුවරඑළිය, බදුල්ල, මහනුවර වැනි සිසිල් ප්‍රදේශවල ප්‍රධාන වශයෙන් වගා කෙරේ. මල් ගෝවා 15°C–25°C අතර උෂ්ණත්වයේ හොඳින් වැඩෙන අතර, pH 6.0–6.8 අතර, හොඳින් ජලය බැස යන ලෝම පසක් අවශ්‍ය වේ. නිසි මල් ශීර්ෂ (කර්ඩ්) වර්ධනයට සහ නිරෝගී වර්ධනයට මධ්‍යස්ථ වර්ෂාව, ප්‍රමාණවත් හිරු එළිය සහ නිතිපතා ජලසම්පාදනය අවශ්‍යය. සාමාන්‍යයෙන් පැළ සිටුවීමෙන් දින 60–75 අතර අස්වනු නෙළන අතර, සුදුසු වගා තත්ත්ව යටතේ හෙක්ටයාරයකට ටොන් 6–9ක සාමාන්‍ය අස්වැන්නක් ලබා දිය හැක. උෂ්ණත්වය, පාංශු තෙතමනය, වර්ෂාව, ආර්ද්‍රතාව සහ හිරු එළිය මල් ගෝවා වගාවට බලපාන පොදු සාධක වේ. ආම්ලික පස, දිලීර ආසාදන, දුර්වල ජලාපවහනය, අධික හිරු එළිය හෝ ඉහළ උෂ්ණත්වය නිසා බහුලව ඇතිවන මුල් ඉදිමීමේ රෝගය, කුඩා පැළ කුණුවීම සහ මල් ශීර්ෂ කහ වීම වැනි ගැටලු ද ගොවීන් පාලනය කළ යුතුය.
Cauliflower (Gowa).overview_ta: இலங்கையில் “மல் கோவா” என அழைக்கப்படும் காலிஃபிளவர் (Brassica oleracea var. botrytis), Brassicaceae குடும்பத்தைச் சேர்ந்த குளிர் காலநிலைக் காய்கறிப் பயிர். வளர்ச்சிக்குச் சாதகமான சூழல் இருப்பதால் நுவரெலியா, பதுளை, கண்டி போன்ற குளிர்ந்த பகுதிகளில் இது முக்கியமாகப் பயிரிடப்படுகிறது. காலிஃபிளவர் 15°C–25°C வெப்பநிலையில் நன்றாக வளரும்; pH 6.0–6.8 உள்ள, நன்கு நீர் வடியும் இருமண் தேவை. சரியான பூந்தலை வளர்ச்சி மற்றும் ஆரோக்கியமான வளர்ச்சிக்கு மிதமான மழை, போதுமான சூரிய ஒளி, தொடர்ச்சியான நீர்ப்பாசனம் தேவை. பொதுவாக நாற்று நட்டு 60–75 நாட்களில் அறுவடை செய்யப்படும்; ஏற்ற சாகுபடி நிலைமைகளில் எக்டேருக்குச் சராசரியாக 6–9 டன் மகசூல் தரலாம். வெப்பநிலை, மண் ஈரப்பதம், மழை, காற்று ஈரப்பதம், சூரிய ஒளி ஆகியவை காலிஃபிளவர் சாகுபடியைப் பாதிக்கும் பொதுவான காரணிகள். அமில மண், பூஞ்சைத் தொற்றுகள், மோசமான வடிகால், அதிக சூரிய ஒளி அல்லது அதிக வெப்பநிலை காரணமாகப் பொதுவாக ஏற்படும் வேர் முடிச்சு நோய், நாற்று அழுகல், பூந்தலை மஞ்சளாதல் போன்ற பிரச்சினைகளையும் விவசாயிகள் கட்டுப்படுத்த வேண்டும்.

Kohlrabi (Nokol).overview: Kohlrabi, commonly known as “Nokol” in Sri Lanka, is a cool-climate vegetable crop belonging to the Brassicaceae family and scientifically known as Brassica oleracea var. gongylodes. It is mainly cultivated in cooler regions of Sri Lanka such as Nuwara Eliya, Badulla, and Kandy where the environmental conditions are suitable for its growth. Kohlrabi grows best in temperatures between 15°C and 25°C and requires fertile, well-drained loamy soil with a soil pH ranging from 6.0 to 7.0. The crop requires moderate rainfall, good sunlight exposure, and regular watering for healthy bulb development. It is generally harvested within 55 to 70 days after planting and can produce good yields under proper cultivation practices. The edible swollen stem is rich in vitamins, minerals, and dietary fiber, making it a nutritious vegetable. Important factors affecting kohlrabi cultivation include temperature, soil moisture, soil fertility, rainfall, humidity, and sunlight. Farmers must also manage common diseases and pests such as leaf spot, damping off, aphids, and cabbage worms, which can reduce crop quality and yield if not properly controlled.

stages.name: Land Preparation

activities.title: Plough and lime if needed
activities.description: Prepare beds, pH 6.0–7.0.
activities.why: Club root prevention requires correct pH.
activities.description_si: pH 6.0–7.0 වන සේ පාත්ති සකස් කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: pH 6.0–7.0 ஆக இருக்கும்படி பாத்திகளைத் தயார்செய்யுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: මුල් ඉදිමීමේ රෝගය වැළැක්වීමට නිවැරදි pH අවශ්‍යය.
activities.why_ta: வேர் முடிச்சு நோயைத் தடுக்கச் சரியான pH தேவை.

activities.title: Apply compost
activities.description: Incorporate 10 t/ha compost.
activities.why: Good organic matter improves bulb development.
activities.description_si: හෙක්ටයාරයකට ටොන් 10ක් කොම්පෝස්ට් පසට මිශ්‍ර කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: எக்டேருக்கு 10 டன் மக்கிய உரத்தை மண்ணுடன் கலந்துவிடுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: හොඳ කාබනික ද්‍රව්‍ය ප්‍රමාණයක් බල්බ වර්ධනය වැඩි දියුණු කරයි.
activities.why_ta: நல்ல அளவு கரிமப் பொருள் குமிழ் வளர்ச்சியை மேம்படுத்தும்.

stages.description_si: සාරවත් උස් කළ පාත්ති සකස් කරන්න.

stages.name: Planting

activities.title: Transplant or direct sow
activities.description: 25-day transplants or direct sow at 30×40 cm. Water immediately.
activities.why: Close spacing produces uniform sized bulbs.
activities.title_si: පැළ සිටුවීම හෝ සෘජුව බීජ වැපිරීම
activities.description_si: දින 25ක පැළ සිටුවීම හෝ සෙ.මී. 30×40 පරතරයෙන් සෘජුව වැපිරීම. වහාම ජලය දෙන්න.
activities.description_ta: 25 நாள் நாற்றுகளை நடுதல் அல்லது 30×40 செ.மீ இடைவெளியில் நேரடியாக விதைத்தல். உடனே நீர் பாய்ச்சுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: කිට්ටු පරතරයෙන් ඒකාකාර ප්‍රමාණයේ බල්බ ලැබේ.
activities.why_ta: நெருக்கமான இடைவெளி சீரான அளவுக் குமிழ்களைத் தரும்.

activities.title: Water daily first week
activities.description: Maintain consistent moisture.
activities.why: Fast-growing crop needs consistent water from day 1.
activities.description_si: නොකඩවා තෙතමනය පවත්වා ගන්න.
activities.description_ta: தொடர்ச்சியான ஈரப்பதத்தைப் பேணுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: වේගයෙන් වැඩෙන මෙම බෝගයට පළමු දින සිටම නොකඩවා ජලය අවශ්‍යය.
activities.why_ta: வேகமாக வளரும் இப்பயிருக்கு முதல் நாளிலிருந்தே தொடர்ச்சியான நீர் தேவை.

stages.description_si: පැළ ස්ථාපිත කරන්න.

stages.name: Vegetative Growth

activities.title: Top dressing 1
activities.description: Urea 75 kg/ha ring.
activities.why: Nitrogen drives rapid stem swelling.
activities.description_si: යූරියා හෙක්ටයාරයකට කි.ග්‍රෑ. 75 වළල්ලක් ලෙස.
activities.description_ta: எக்டேருக்கு 75 கி.கி யூரியா வளையமாக.
activities.why_si: නයිට්‍රජන් කඳ වේගයෙන් ඉදිමීමට දායක වේ.
activities.why_ta: நைட்ரஜன் தண்டு வேகமாகப் பருப்பதைத் தூண்டும்.

activities.title: Weed thoroughly
activities.description: Remove all weeds. Shallow hoeing.
activities.why: Weeds compete heavily with this fast-growing crop.
activities.description_si: සියලු වල් පැළෑටි ඉවත් කරන්න. නොගැඹුරු උදැලි කෙටීම.
activities.description_ta: எல்லாக் களைகளையும் அகற்றுங்கள். ஆழமற்ற மண்வெட்டி உழவு.
activities.why_si: වේගයෙන් වැඩෙන මෙම බෝගය සමඟ වල් පැළෑටි දැඩි ලෙස තරඟ කරයි.
activities.why_ta: வேகமாக வளரும் இப்பயிருடன் களைகள் கடுமையாகப் போட்டியிடும்.

stages.description_si: කොළ සහ කඳ වේගයෙන් වර්ධනය වීම.

stages.name: Bulb/Stem Swelling
stages.description: Swollen stem development — harvest window approaches.

activities.title: Monitor bulb size
activities.description: Check swollen stem weekly.
activities.why: Kohlrabi can over-mature and become woody quickly.
activities.description_si: ඉදිමුණු කඳ සතිපතා පරීක්ෂා කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: பருத்த தண்டை வாரந்தோறும் சோதியுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: නෝකෝල් ඉක්මනින් අධික ලෙස මේරී ලී වැනි තද විය හැක.
activities.why_ta: நூல்கோல் விரைவில் அதிகம் முற்றி மரம் போல் கடினமாகலாம்.

activities.title: Maintain consistent moisture
activities.description: Water every 3 days.
activities.why: Irregular watering causes cracking of the swollen stem.
activities.description_si: දින 3කට වරක් ජලය දෙන්න.
activities.description_ta: 3 நாட்களுக்கு ஒருமுறை நீர் பாய்ச்சுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: අක්‍රමවත් ජලය දීම ඉදිමුණු කඳ ඉරිතැලීමට හේතු වේ.
activities.why_ta: ஒழுங்கற்ற நீர்ப்பாசனம் பருத்த தண்டில் வெடிப்பை ஏற்படுத்தும்.

stages.description_si: කඳ ඉදිමීම — අස්වනු කාලය ළං වේ.

stages.name: Harvest

activities.title: Begin harvest
activities.description: Harvest when swollen stem is 6–8 cm diameter. Do not wait longer.
activities.why: Over-mature kohlrabi becomes tough and fibrous, losing market value.
activities.description_si: ඉදිමුණු කඳේ විෂ්කම්භය සෙ.මී. 6–8 වූ විට අස්වනු නෙළන්න. ඊට වඩා ප්‍රමාද නොකරන්න.
activities.description_ta: பருத்த தண்டின் விட்டம் 6–8 செ.மீ ஆனதும் அறுவடை செய்யுங்கள். அதற்கு மேல் காத்திருக்காதீர்கள்.
activities.why_si: අධික ලෙස මේරූ නෝකෝල් තද වී කෙඳි සහිත වන අතර වෙළඳපොළ වටිනාකම අහිමි වේ.
activities.why_ta: அதிகம் முற்றிய நூல்கோல் கடினமாகி நார்த்தன்மை அடைந்து சந்தை மதிப்பை இழக்கும்.

activities.title: Harvest remaining plants over 7 days
activities.description: Stagger harvest as plants mature.
activities.why: Field does not mature uniformly — check every 2–3 days.
activities.title_si: ඉතිරි පැළ දින 7ක් පුරා අස්වනු නෙළන්න
activities.description_si: පැළ මේරෙන ආකාරයට අදියරෙන් අදියර අස්වනු නෙළන්න.
activities.description_ta: செடிகள் முற்றும் வரிசைப்படி படிப்படியாக அறுவடை செய்யுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: කෙත ඒකාකාරව නොමේරේ — දින 2–3කට වරක් පරීක්ෂා කරන්න.
activities.why_ta: வயல் சீராக முற்றாது — 2–3 நாட்களுக்கு ஒருமுறை சோதியுங்கள்.

stages.description_si: කඳන් ලී වැනි තද වීමට පෙර අස්වනු නෙළන්න.
stages.description_ta: தண்டுகள் மரம் போல் கடினமாவதற்கு முன் அறுவடை செய்யுங்கள்.

irrigation.notes: Consistent moisture prevents cracking. Reduce before harvest.
irrigation.notes_si: නොකඩවා තෙතමනය ඉරිතැලීම වළක්වයි. අස්වනු නෙළීමට පෙර අඩු කරන්න.
irrigation.notes_ta: தொடர்ச்சியான ஈரப்பதம் வெடிப்பைத் தடுக்கும். அறுவடைக்கு முன் குறையுங்கள்.

diseases.name: Leaf Spot
diseases.symptoms: Small dark or yellowish circular spots on leaves; spreads rapidly under humid conditions.
diseases.favorable_conditions: High humidity, poor air circulation, overhead irrigation.
diseases.prevention: Good plant spacing. Avoid overhead watering. Remove infected leaves.
diseases.treatment: Mancozeb 80WP (2.5 g/L) or Copper Oxychloride (3 g/L) every 7–10 days.
diseases.symptoms_si: කොළ මත කුඩා තද හෝ කහ පැහැති රවුම් පැල්ලම්; ආර්ද්‍ර තත්ත්වවලදී වේගයෙන් පැතිරේ.
diseases.symptoms_ta: இலைகளில் சிறிய கருமையான அல்லது மஞ்சள் வட்டப் புள்ளிகள்; ஈரப்பதமான நிலையில் வேகமாகப் பரவும்.
diseases.favorable_conditions_si: ඉහළ ආර්ද්‍රතාව, දුර්වල වාතාශ්‍රය, ඉහළින් ජලය ඉසීම.
diseases.favorable_conditions_ta: அதிக ஈரப்பதம், மோசமான காற்றோட்டம், மேலிருந்து நீர் தெளிப்பு.
diseases.prevention_si: පැළ අතර හොඳ පරතරය. ඉහළින් ජලය දීමෙන් වළකින්න. ආසාදිත කොළ ඉවත් කරන්න.
diseases.prevention_ta: செடிகளுக்கிடையே நல்ல இடைவெளி. மேலிருந்து நீர் பாய்ச்சுவதைத் தவிருங்கள். பாதிக்கப்பட்ட இலைகளை அகற்றுங்கள்.
diseases.treatment_si: Mancozeb 80WP (ලීටරයකට ග්‍රෑ. 2.5) හෝ Copper Oxychloride (ලීටරයකට ග්‍රෑ. 3) දින 7–10කට වරක්.
diseases.treatment_ta: Mancozeb 80WP (லிட்டருக்கு 2.5 கி) அல்லது Copper Oxychloride (லிட்டருக்கு 3 கி) 7–10 நாட்களுக்கு ஒருமுறை.

diseases.name: Damping Off
diseases.symptoms: Young seedlings rot at soil surface and collapse.
diseases.favorable_conditions: Waterlogged nursery, poor drainage, dense sowing.
diseases.prevention: Well-drained nursery. Moderate watering. Thin seedlings.
diseases.treatment: Captan or Thiram drench (2 g/L) at seedling stage.
diseases.symptoms_si: ළපටි පැළ පස මතුපිටදී කුණු වී ඇද වැටේ.
diseases.symptoms_ta: இளம் நாற்றுகள் மண் மேற்பரப்பில் அழுகிச் சரியும்.
diseases.favorable_conditions_si: ජලය රැඳුණු තවාන, දුර්වල ජලාපවහනය, ඝනව බීජ වැපිරීම.
diseases.favorable_conditions_ta: நீர் தேங்கிய நாற்றங்கால், மோசமான வடிகால், அடர்த்தியான விதைப்பு.
diseases.prevention_si: හොඳින් ජලය බැස යන තවාන. මධ්‍යස්ථව ජලය දීම. පැළ විරල කරන්න.
diseases.prevention_ta: நன்கு நீர் வடியும் நாற்றங்கால். மிதமான நீர்ப்பாசனம். நாற்றுகளைக் களைந்து இடைவெளி விடுங்கள்.
diseases.treatment_si: පැළ අවධියේදී Captan හෝ Thiram (ලීටරයකට ග්‍රෑ. 2) මගින් පස තෙමීම.
diseases.treatment_ta: நாற்று நிலையில் Captan அல்லது Thiram (லிட்டருக்கு 2 கி) கொண்டு மண்ணை நனைத்தல்.

pests.name: Aphid
pests.damage: Sucks plant sap; weakens growth and excretes honeydew attracting ants.
pests.identification: Clusters of small soft-bodied insects on new growth and leaf undersides.
pests.prevention: Neem oil spray. Remove heavily infested shoots.
pests.treatment: Dimethoate 40EC (1.5 ml/L). Spray in cool morning hours.
pests.prevention_si: කොහොඹ තෙල් ඉසීම. දැඩි ලෙස ආසාදිත දළු ඉවත් කරන්න.
pests.prevention_ta: வேப்ப எண்ணெய் தெளிப்பு. கடுமையாகப் பாதிக்கப்பட்ட தளிர்களை அகற்றுங்கள்.
pests.treatment_si: Dimethoate 40EC (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 1.5). සිසිල් උදෑසන ඉසින්න.
pests.treatment_ta: Dimethoate 40EC (லிட்டருக்கு 1.5 மி.லி). குளிர்ந்த காலை நேரத்தில் தெளியுங்கள்.
pests.damage_si: ශාක යුෂ උරා බොයි; වර්ධනය දුර්වල කරන අතර කූඹින් ආකර්ෂණය කරන මී පැණි වැනි ස්‍රාවයක් පිට කරයි.
pests.damage_ta: தாவரச் சாற்றை உறிஞ்சும்; வளர்ச்சியை வலுவிழக்கச் செய்து எறும்புகளைக் கவரும் தேன் போன்ற திரவத்தை வெளியிடும்.
pests.identification_si: නව වර්ධනය සහ කොළවල යටි පැත්තේ කුඩා මෘදු සිරුරු සහිත කෘමි පොකුරු.
pests.identification_ta: புதிய வளர்ச்சியிலும் இலைகளின் அடிப்பக்கத்திலும் சிறிய மென்னுடல் பூச்சிக் கூட்டங்கள்.

pests.name: Cabbage Worm
pests.damage: Feeds on leaves causing large irregular holes; reduces marketability.
pests.identification: Green caterpillars visible on leaf surfaces; white butterfly in field.
pests.prevention: Hand-pick caterpillars and egg masses. Use row covers.
pests.treatment: Bt (Bacillus thuringiensis) 2 g/L or Chlorpyrifos 2 ml/L if severe.
pests.prevention_si: දළඹුවන් සහ බිත්තර පොකුරු අතින් අල්ලා ඉවත් කරන්න. පේළි ආවරණ භාවිත කරන්න.
pests.prevention_ta: புழுக்களையும் முட்டைக் கூட்டங்களையும் கையால் பொறுக்கி அகற்றுங்கள். வரிசை மூடிகளைப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள்.
pests.treatment_si: දැඩි නම් Bt (Bacillus thuringiensis) ලීටරයකට ග්‍රෑ. 2 හෝ Chlorpyrifos ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 2.
pests.treatment_ta: கடுமையாக இருந்தால் Bt (Bacillus thuringiensis) லிட்டருக்கு 2 கி அல்லது Chlorpyrifos லிட்டருக்கு 2 மி.லி.
pests.damage_si: කොළ කමින් විශාල අක්‍රමවත් සිදුරු ඇති කරයි; වෙළඳපොළ වටිනාකම අඩු කරයි.
pests.damage_ta: இலைகளை உண்டு பெரிய ஒழுங்கற்ற துளைகளை ஏற்படுத்தும்; சந்தை மதிப்பைக் குறைக்கும்.
pests.identification_si: කොළ මතුපිට කොළ පැහැ දළඹුවන් පෙනේ; කෙතේ සුදු සමනලුන්.
pests.identification_ta: இலை மேற்பரப்பில் பச்சைப் புழுக்கள் தெரியும்; வயலில் வெள்ளை வண்ணத்துப்பூச்சிகள்.

risks.name: High Temperature
risks.description: Causes bolting (flowering) instead of stem swelling.
risks.signs: Plants bolt to flower without forming bulb.
risks.mitigation: Plant in cooler season. Use heat-tolerant variety.
risks.description_si: කඳ ඉදිමීම වෙනුවට කලින් මල් දණ්ඩ මතු වීම (මල් පිපීම) සිදු වේ.
risks.description_ta: தண்டு பருப்பதற்குப் பதிலாக முன்கூட்டியே பூந்தண்டு எழும் (பூக்கும்).
risks.signs_si: බල්බයක් නොසාදා පැළ මල් දණ්ඩ මතු කර මල් පිපේ.
risks.signs_ta: குமிழ் உருவாகாமல் செடிகள் பூந்தண்டு எழுந்து பூக்கும்.
risks.mitigation_si: සිසිල් කාලයේ සිටුවන්න. තාපයට ඔරොත්තු දෙන ප්‍රභේදයක් භාවිත කරන්න.
risks.mitigation_ta: குளிர்ந்த பருவத்தில் நடுங்கள். வெப்பத்தைத் தாங்கும் இனத்தைப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள்.

risks.name: Late Harvest
risks.description: Over-mature stems become woody and unmarketable.
risks.mitigation: Harvest promptly at 6–8 cm diameter.
risks.description_si: අධික ලෙස මේරූ කඳන් ලී වැනි තද වී විකිණිය නොහැකි වේ.
risks.description_ta: அதிகம் முற்றிய தண்டுகள் மரம் போல் கடினமாகி விற்பனைக்கு உதவாது.
risks.signs_si: තද ලී වැනි කඳ, ඉරිතැලුණු පොත්ත.
risks.signs_ta: கடினமான மரம் போன்ற தண்டு, வெடித்த தோல்.
risks.mitigation_si: විෂ්කම්භය සෙ.මී. 6–8 වූ විට වහාම අස්වනු නෙළන්න.
risks.mitigation_ta: 6–8 செ.மீ விட்டம் ஆனதும் உடனே அறுவடை செய்யுங்கள்.

indicators: Stem still feels soft when pressed
harvest.method: Pull or cut at base. Remove large outer leaves.
harvest.frequency: Harvest over 7–10 days as plants mature
harvest.post_harvest: Remove leaves. Store in cool area. Market within 5–7 days.
harvest.method_si: පාමුලින් ගලවන්න හෝ කපන්න. විශාල පිටත කොළ ඉවත් කරන්න.
harvest.method_ta: அடியில் பிடுங்குங்கள் அல்லது வெட்டுங்கள். பெரிய வெளி இலைகளை அகற்றுங்கள்.
harvest.frequency_si: පැළ මේරෙන ආකාරයට දින 7–10ක් පුරා අස්වනු නෙළන්න
harvest.frequency_ta: செடிகள் முற்றும் வரிசைப்படி 7–10 நாட்களில் அறுவடை செய்தல்
harvest.post_harvest_si: කොළ ඉවත් කරන්න. සිසිල් තැනක ගබඩා කරන්න. දින 5–7ක් ඇතුළත වෙළඳපොළට යවන්න.
harvest.post_harvest_ta: இலைகளை அகற்றுங்கள். குளிர்ந்த இடத்தில் சேமியுங்கள். 5–7 நாட்களுக்குள் சந்தைக்கு அனுப்புங்கள்.
indicators_si: තද කළ විට කඳ තවමත් මෘදු ලෙස දැනේ

Kohlrabi (Nokol).growth_stages_text: Kohlrabi cultivation includes several important growth stages such as germination, vegetative growth, bulb enlargement, and harvesting. Germination usually occurs within 5–10 days after sowing, while the vegetative stage continues for about 20–30 days. Bulb enlargement begins around 35–45 days after planting, and harvesting is generally carried out between 55–70 days when the swollen stem becomes tender, round, and reaches marketable size. Farmers commonly use transplanting methods or direct seeding methods with proper spacing of approximately 30–45 cm between plants and rows to ensure healthy bulb development and sufficient air circulation.
Kohlrabi (Nokol).management_text: Effective crop management requires a week-by-week schedule covering nursery preparation, land preparation, transplanting, fertilizer application, irrigation, weed control, pest management, and harvesting activities. Fertilizer application is important during the vegetative and bulb development stages, commonly using nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium fertilizers in recommended quantities to improve plant growth and bulb quality. Irrigation frequency depends on the crop stage, with regular watering needed during germination and bulb formation stages, while moderate irrigation is sufficient during vegetative growth. Harvesting is done when the swollen stem becomes firm, tender, and reaches the desired size before it becomes fibrous.
Kohlrabi (Nokol).disease_management_text: Disease and pest management play a major role in successful kohlrabi cultivation. Leaf spot disease appears as small dark or yellowish spots on leaves and can spread rapidly under humid conditions, while damping off causes young seedlings to rot near the soil surface, resulting in seedling death. Aphids suck plant sap and weaken plant growth, while cabbage worms feed on leaves and reduce crop quality. These problems can be managed through proper field sanitation, balanced fertilizer application, crop rotation, biological control methods, and recommended pesticide or fungicide applications when necessary. Risk mitigation practices such as maintaining proper drainage, regular field monitoring, timely irrigation, use of healthy seedlings, and climate-aware cultivation practices help reduce crop losses and improve overall productivity.
Kohlrabi (Nokol).overview_si: ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ “නෝකෝල්” ලෙස හැඳින්වෙන නෝකෝල් (Brassica oleracea var. gongylodes) Brassicaceae කුලයට අයත්, සිසිල් දේශගුණයක වැඩෙන එළවළු බෝගයකි. පාරිසරික තත්ත්ව වර්ධනයට සුදුසු නුවරඑළිය, බදුල්ල, මහනුවර වැනි සිසිල් ප්‍රදේශවල එය ප්‍රධාන වශයෙන් වගා කෙරේ. නෝකෝල් 15°C–25°C අතර උෂ්ණත්වයේ හොඳින් වැඩෙන අතර, pH 6.0–7.0 අතර, හොඳින් ජලය බැස යන සාරවත් ලෝම පසක් අවශ්‍ය වේ. නිරෝගී බල්බ වර්ධනයට මධ්‍යස්ථ වර්ෂාව, හොඳ හිරු එළිය සහ නිතිපතා ජලය දීම අවශ්‍යය. සාමාන්‍යයෙන් සිටුවීමෙන් දින 55–70 අතර අස්වනු නෙළන අතර, නිසි වගා ක්‍රම යටතේ හොඳ අස්වැන්නක් ලබා දිය හැක. ආහාරයට ගන්නා ඉදිමුණු කඳ විටමින්, ඛනිජ සහ ආහාර තන්තුවලින් පොහොසත් බැවින් එය පෝෂ්‍යදායී එළවළුවකි. උෂ්ණත්වය, පාංශු තෙතමනය, පසේ සාරවත්බව, වර්ෂාව, ආර්ද්‍රතාව සහ හිරු එළිය නෝකෝල් වගාවට බලපාන ප්‍රධාන සාධක වේ. පත්‍ර පුල්ලි රෝගය, කුඩා පැළ කුණුවීම, කුඩිත්තා සහ ගෝවා දළඹුවා වැනි පොදු රෝග හා පළිබෝධ ද ගොවීන් පාලනය කළ යුතු අතර, නිසි ලෙස පාලනය නොකළහොත් ඒවා බෝගයේ ගුණාත්මකභාවය සහ අස්වැන්න අඩු කරයි.
Kohlrabi (Nokol).overview_ta: இலங்கையில் “நோகோல்” என அழைக்கப்படும் நூல்கோல் (Brassica oleracea var. gongylodes), Brassicaceae குடும்பத்தைச் சேர்ந்த குளிர் காலநிலைக் காய்கறிப் பயிர். வளர்ச்சிக்கு ஏற்ற சூழல் உள்ள நுவரெலியா, பதுளை, கண்டி போன்ற குளிர்ந்த பகுதிகளில் இது முக்கியமாகப் பயிரிடப்படுகிறது. நூல்கோல் 15°C–25°C வெப்பநிலையில் நன்றாக வளரும்; pH 6.0–7.0 உள்ள, நன்கு நீர் வடியும் வளமான இருமண் தேவை. ஆரோக்கியமான குமிழ் வளர்ச்சிக்கு மிதமான மழை, நல்ல சூரிய ஒளி, தொடர்ந்து நீர் பாய்ச்சுதல் தேவை. பொதுவாக நடவு செய்து 55–70 நாட்களில் அறுவடை செய்யப்படும்; சரியான சாகுபடி முறைகளில் நல்ல மகசூல் தரும். உண்ணக்கூடிய பருத்த தண்டு விட்டமின்கள், கனிமங்கள், நார்ச்சத்து நிறைந்திருப்பதால் இது சத்தான காய்கறி. வெப்பநிலை, மண் ஈரப்பதம், மண் வளம், மழை, காற்று ஈரப்பதம், சூரிய ஒளி ஆகியவை நூல்கோல் சாகுபடியைப் பாதிக்கும் முக்கியக் காரணிகள். இலைப்புள்ளி நோய், நாற்று அழுகல், அசுவினி, முட்டைக்கோஸ் புழு போன்ற பொதுவான நோய்களையும் பூச்சிகளையும் விவசாயிகள் கட்டுப்படுத்த வேண்டும்; இல்லையெனில் இவை பயிரின் தரத்தையும் மகசூலையும் குறைக்கும்.

Radish.overview: Radish, commonly known as “Raabu” or “Mooli” in Sri Lanka, is a fast-growing root vegetable crop belonging to the Brassicaceae family and scientifically known as Raphanus sativus. It is mainly cultivated in cooler and intermediate regions such as Nuwara Eliya, Badulla, and Kandy where climatic conditions are suitable for proper root enlargement and quality development. Radish grows best in temperatures between 15°C and 25°C and requires loose, well-drained sandy loam soil with a soil pH ranging from 6.0 to 7.0. The crop needs moderate rainfall, regular irrigation, and good sunlight exposure for healthy growth and crisp root formation. Radish is widely used in Sri Lankan cuisine in curries, salads, and pickles and is valued for its nutritional benefits including vitamins, fiber, and minerals. The crop is very fast-growing and can be harvested within 30 to 50 days after sowing depending on the variety. Important factors affecting radish cultivation include temperature, soil moisture, rainfall, sunlight, humidity, and soil fertility. Common pests and diseases include aphids, root maggots, flea beetles, damping off, and fungal leaf diseases, which can reduce yield and root quality if not properly managed.
Radish.propagation: Direct sowing only (taproots do not tolerate transplanting)

stages.name: Land Preparation

activities.title: Deep plough and fine tilth
activities.description: Plough to 30 cm. Break all clods finely. Remove stones.
activities.why: Stones and clods cause forked or misshapen roots — no market value.
activities.description_si: සෙ.මී. 30ක් ගැඹුරට සීසාන්න. සියලු පස් කැට සියුම්ව කඩන්න. ගල් ඉවත් කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: 30 செ.மீ ஆழத்துக்கு உழுங்கள். எல்லா மண் கட்டிகளையும் நுண்மையாக உடையுங்கள். கற்களை அகற்றுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: ගල් සහ පස් කැට නිසා දෙබෙදුණු හෝ හැඩය වෙනස් මුල් හටගනී — වෙළඳපොළ වටිනාකමක් නැත.
activities.why_ta: கற்களும் மண் கட்டிகளும் கிளைத்த அல்லது உருக்குலைந்த கிழங்குகளை ஏற்படுத்தும் — சந்தை மதிப்பு இல்லை.

activities.title: Apply compost
activities.description: Incorporate 10 t/ha compost. Do not apply fresh manure.
activities.why: Fresh manure causes forking and hairy roots.
activities.description_si: හෙක්ටයාරයකට ටොන් 10ක් කොම්පෝස්ට් පසට මිශ්‍ර කරන්න. නැවුම් පොහොර (නොදිරූ ගොම) නොයොදන්න.
activities.description_ta: எக்டேருக்கு 10 டன் மக்கிய உரத்தை மண்ணுடன் கலந்துவிடுங்கள். மக்காத புதிய எருவை இடாதீர்கள்.
activities.why_si: නැවුම් පොහොර නිසා මුල් දෙබෙදී රෝම සහිත වේ.
activities.why_ta: புதிய எரு கிழங்குகளைக் கிளைக்கவும் வேர்ப்பூங்கள் உருவாகவும் செய்யும்.

stages.description_si: සියුම්, ගැඹුරු ලෙස පස සකස් කරන්න.

stages.name: Sowing

activities.title: Sow seeds in shallow furrows
activities.description: Draw furrows 1 cm deep, 25 cm apart. Sow seeds 5 cm apart. Cover lightly.
activities.why: Shallow sowing and fine soil ensures uniform germination.
activities.description_si: සෙ.මී. 25 පරතරයෙන් සෙ.මී. 1ක් ගැඹුරු ඇළ කපන්න. සෙ.මී. 5 පරතරයෙන් බීජ වපුරන්න. සැහැල්ලුවෙන් වසන්න.
activities.description_ta: 25 செ.மீ இடைவெளியில் 1 செ.மீ ஆழச் சால்களை அமையுங்கள். 5 செ.மீ இடைவெளியில் விதையுங்கள். லேசாக மூடுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: නොගැඹුරුව වැපිරීම සහ සියුම් පස ඒකාකාර පැළවීම සහතික කරයි.
activities.why_ta: ஆழமற்ற விதைப்பும் நுண்ணிய மண்ணும் சீரான முளைப்பை உறுதிசெய்யும்.

activities.title: Thin seedlings
activities.description: Thin to 10 cm apart once 5–8 cm tall.
activities.why: Crowded radish develops no roots — only leaves.
activities.description_si: පැළ සෙ.මී. 5–8ක් උස වූ පසු සෙ.මී. 10 පරතරයක් වන සේ විරල කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: நாற்றுகள் 5–8 செ.மீ உயரமானதும் 10 செ.மீ இடைவெளி இருக்கும்படி களையுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: ඝනව වැඩෙන රාබුවල මුල් නොහටගනී — කොළ පමණක් වැඩේ.
activities.why_ta: நெருக்கமாக வளரும் முள்ளங்கியில் கிழங்கு உருவாகாது — இலைகள் மட்டுமே வளரும்.

stages.description_si: සෘජුව බීජ වපුරා විරල කරන්න.

stages.name: Leaf & Root Growth

activities.title: Top dressing
activities.description: Urea 75 kg/ha between rows.
activities.why: Single nitrogen application at mid-growth.
activities.description_si: පේළි අතරට යූරියා හෙක්ටයාරයකට කි.ග්‍රෑ. 75.
activities.description_ta: வரிசைகளுக்கு இடையே எக்டேருக்கு 75 கி.கி யூரியா.
activities.why_si: වර්ධන කාලයේ මැද එක් වරක් නයිට්‍රජන් යෙදීම.
activities.why_ta: வளர்ச்சியின் நடுவில் ஒருமுறை நைட்ரஜன் இடுதல்.

activities.title: Weed between rows
activities.description: Hand weed carefully to avoid root disturbance.
activities.why: Weed competition causes poor root development.
activities.description_si: මුල්වලට හානි නොවන සේ ප්‍රවේශමෙන් අතින් වල් නෙළන්න.
activities.description_ta: கிழங்குகளைச் சேதப்படுத்தாமல் கவனமாகக் கையால் களையெடுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: වල් පැළෑටි සමඟ තරඟය මුල් වර්ධනය දුර්වල කරයි.
activities.why_ta: களைகளுடனான போட்டி கிழங்கு வளர்ச்சியைக் குறைக்கும்.

activities.title: Water every 3–4 days
activities.description: Maintain consistent moisture.
activities.why: Irregular moisture causes cracking and hollow centres.
activities.description_si: නොකඩවා තෙතමනය පවත්වා ගන්න.
activities.description_ta: தொடர்ச்சியான ஈரப்பதத்தைப் பேணுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: අක්‍රමවත් තෙතමනය ඉරිතැලීම සහ මැද හිස් වීම ඇති කරයි.
activities.why_ta: ஒழுங்கற்ற ஈரப்பதம் வெடிப்பையும் நடுவில் குழியையும் ஏற்படுத்தும்.

stages.description_si: මුල් වේගයෙන් ඉදිමීම.

stages.name: Harvest

activities.title: Check for harvest readiness
activities.description: Pull one plant to check root size (3–5 cm diameter).
activities.why: Radish matures faster than expected in warm weather.
activities.description_si: මුලේ ප්‍රමාණය (විෂ්කම්භය සෙ.මී. 3–5) පරීක්ෂා කිරීමට එක් පැළයක් ගලවන්න.
activities.description_ta: கிழங்கின் அளவை (3–5 செ.மீ விட்டம்) சோதிக்க ஒரு செடியைப் பிடுங்குங்கள்.
activities.why_si: උණුසුම් කාලගුණයේදී රාබු බලාපොරොත්තු වූවාට වඩා ඉක්මනින් මේරේ.
activities.why_ta: வெப்பமான வானிலையில் முள்ளங்கி எதிர்பார்த்ததை விட விரைவில் முற்றும்.

activities.title: Harvest in one go
activities.description: Pull all plants when mature. Do not leave over-ripe plants in soil.
activities.why: Over-mature radish becomes pithy, hollow, and hot — unmarketable.
activities.description_si: මේරූ විට සියලු පැළ ගලවන්න. අධික ලෙස මේරූ පැළ පසේ නොතබන්න.
activities.description_ta: முற்றியதும் எல்லாச் செடிகளையும் பிடுங்குங்கள். அதிகம் முற்றியவற்றை மண்ணில் விடாதீர்கள்.
activities.why_si: අධික ලෙස මේරූ රාබු පිදුරු වැනි, හිස්, සැර වන අතර විකිණිය නොහැක.
activities.why_ta: அதிகம் முற்றிய முள்ளங்கி பஞ்சு போலாகி, உள்ளீடற்றதாகி, காரமாகிவிடும் — விற்பனைக்கு உதவாது.

stages.description_si: වහාම අස්වනු නෙළන්න — රාබු ඉක්මනින් අධික ලෙස මේරේ.
stages.description_ta: உடனே அறுவடை செய்யுங்கள் — முள்ளங்கி விரைவில் அதிகம் முற்றிவிடும்.

fertilization.why: All nutrition needed at sowing — too short a crop for multiple applications.
fertilization.why_si: සියලු පෝෂණය වැපිරීමේදීම අවශ්‍යය — කිහිප වරක් යෙදීමට බෝගයේ කාලය කෙටිය.
fertilization.why_ta: எல்லா ஊட்டமும் விதைக்கும் போதே தேவை — பலமுறை இடுவதற்குப் பயிர்க் காலம் குறுகியது.

irrigation.notes: Consistent moisture prevents cracking and hollow centres. Reduce before harvest.
irrigation.notes_si: නොකඩවා තෙතමනය ඉරිතැලීම සහ මැද හිස් වීම වළක්වයි. අස්වනු නෙළීමට පෙර අඩු කරන්න.
irrigation.notes_ta: தொடர்ச்சியான ஈரப்பதம் வெடிப்பையும் நடுக் குழியையும் தடுக்கும். அறுவடைக்கு முன் குறையுங்கள்.

diseases.name: Damping Off
diseases.symptoms: Seedling stems rot at soil surface; seedlings collapse and die.
diseases.favorable_conditions: Overwatering, poor drainage, dense sowing.
diseases.prevention: Well-drained seedbed. Thin to proper spacing. Moderate watering.
diseases.treatment: Captan or Thiram drench (2 g/L) at seedling stage.
diseases.symptoms_si: පස මතුපිටදී පැළයේ කඳ කුණු වේ; පැළ ඇද වැටී මිය යයි.
diseases.symptoms_ta: மண் மேற்பரப்பில் நாற்றுத் தண்டு அழுகும்; நாற்றுகள் சரிந்து இறக்கும்.
diseases.favorable_conditions_si: අධිකව ජලය දීම, දුර්වල ජලාපවහනය, ඝනව බීජ වැපිරීම.
diseases.favorable_conditions_ta: அதிக நீர்ப்பாசனம், மோசமான வடிகால், அடர்த்தியான விதைப்பு.
diseases.prevention_si: හොඳින් ජලය බැස යන බීජ පාත්තිය. නිසි පරතරයට විරල කරන්න. මධ්‍යස්ථව ජලය දීම.
diseases.prevention_ta: நன்கு நீர் வடியும் விதைப்பாத்தி. சரியான இடைவெளிக்குக் களையுங்கள். மிதமான நீர்ப்பாசனம்.
diseases.treatment_si: පැළ අවධියේදී Captan හෝ Thiram (ලීටරයකට ග්‍රෑ. 2) මගින් පස තෙමීම.
diseases.treatment_ta: நாற்று நிலையில் Captan அல்லது Thiram (லிட்டருக்கு 2 கி) கொண்டு மண்ணை நனைத்தல்.

diseases.name: Fungal Leaf Disease
diseases.symptoms: Dark spots or patches on leaves; reduces growth and yield.
diseases.favorable_conditions: Humid conditions, dense canopy, wet foliage.
diseases.prevention: Good spacing. Avoid overhead irrigation.
diseases.treatment: Mancozeb 80WP (2 g/L) if symptoms develop.
diseases.symptoms_si: කොළ මත තද පැහැ පැල්ලම් හෝ ලප; වර්ධනය සහ අස්වැන්න අඩු කරයි.
diseases.symptoms_ta: இலைகளில் கரும் புள்ளிகள் அல்லது திட்டுகள்; வளர்ச்சியையும் மகசூலையும் குறைக்கும்.
diseases.favorable_conditions_si: ආර්ද්‍ර තත්ත්ව, ඝන වියන, තෙත් කොළ.
diseases.favorable_conditions_ta: ஈரப்பதமான நிலை, அடர்த்தியான இலைப்பரப்பு, ஈரமான இலைகள்.
diseases.prevention_si: හොඳ පරතරය. ඉහළින් ජලය ඉසීමෙන් වළකින්න.
diseases.prevention_ta: நல்ல இடைவெளி. மேலிருந்து நீர் தெளிப்பதைத் தவிருங்கள்.
diseases.treatment_si: ලක්ෂණ මතු වුවහොත් Mancozeb 80WP (ලීටරයකට ග්‍රෑ. 2).
diseases.treatment_ta: அறிகுறிகள் தோன்றினால் Mancozeb 80WP (லிட்டருக்கு 2 கி).

pests.name: Root Maggot
pests.damage: Tunnels inside developing roots causing internal damage and market rejection.
pests.identification: Entry holes at root crown; maggots visible inside when cut.
pests.prevention: Crop rotation. Avoid planting in previously infested soil.
pests.treatment: Chlorpyrifos granules at sowing. Soil drench if early damage noticed.
pests.prevention_si: බෝග මාරුව. කලින් ආසාදනය වූ පසේ සිටුවීමෙන් වළකින්න.
pests.prevention_ta: பயிர்ச் சுழற்சி. முன்பு பாதிக்கப்பட்ட மண்ணில் நடுவதைத் தவிருங்கள்.
pests.treatment_si: වැපිරීමේදී Chlorpyrifos කැට. මුල් අවධියේ හානිය දුටුවහොත් පස තෙමීම.
pests.treatment_ta: விதைக்கும் போது Chlorpyrifos குருணைகள். ஆரம்பச் சேதம் தெரிந்தால் மண்ணை நனைத்தல்.
pests.damage_si: වැඩෙන මුල් තුළ උමං හාරා ඇතුළත හානි කරන අතර මුල් වෙළඳපොළේ ප්‍රතික්ෂේප වේ.
pests.damage_ta: வளரும் கிழங்குகளுக்குள் சுரங்கம் அமைத்து உட்புறச் சேதம் ஏற்படுத்தும்; கிழங்குகள் சந்தையில் நிராகரிக்கப்படும்.
pests.identification_si: මුලේ ඉහළ කොටසේ ඇතුළු වූ සිදුරු; කැපූ විට ඇතුළත පණුවන් පෙනේ.
pests.identification_ta: கிழங்கின் மேற்பகுதியில் நுழைவுத் துளைகள்; வெட்டினால் உள்ளே புழுக்கள் தெரியும்.

pests.name: Flea Beetle
pests.damage: Creates small circular holes in leaves; severe in seedling stage.
pests.identification: Tiny black jumping beetles on plants; pin-point holes in leaves.
pests.prevention: Row covers on seedlings. Keep field clean.
pests.treatment: Chlorpyrifos 20EC (2 ml/L) or Carbaryl dust if damage is significant.
pests.prevention_si: පැළ මත පේළි ආවරණ. කෙත පිරිසිදුව තබා ගන්න.
pests.prevention_ta: நாற்றுகளுக்கு வரிசை மூடிகள். வயலைச் சுத்தமாக வையுங்கள்.
pests.treatment_si: හානිය සැලකිය යුතු නම් Chlorpyrifos 20EC (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 2) හෝ Carbaryl කුඩු.
pests.treatment_ta: சேதம் கணிசமாக இருந்தால் Chlorpyrifos 20EC (லிட்டருக்கு 2 மி.லி) அல்லது Carbaryl தூள்.
pests.damage_si: කොළවල කුඩා රවුම් සිදුරු ඇති කරයි; පැළ අවධියේදී දැඩි හානියක්.
pests.damage_ta: இலைகளில் சிறிய வட்டத் துளைகளை ஏற்படுத்தும்; நாற்று நிலையில் கடும் சேதம்.
pests.identification_si: පැළ මත පනින කුඩා කළු කුරුමිණියන්; කොළවල ඉඳිකටු තුඩක් තරම් සිදුරු.
pests.identification_ta: செடிகளில் தாவும் சிறிய கருப்பு வண்டுகள்; இலைகளில் ஊசிமுனை அளவுத் துளைகள்.

pests.name: Aphid
pests.damage: Sucks sap from young leaves; causes curling.
pests.identification: Clusters on young growth.
pests.prevention: Neem oil spray.
pests.treatment: Dimethoate 40EC (1.5 ml/L) only if infestation is heavy.
pests.prevention_si: කොහොඹ තෙල් ඉසීම.
pests.prevention_ta: வேப்ப எண்ணெய் தெளிப்பு.
pests.treatment_si: ආසාදනය අධික නම් පමණක් Dimethoate 40EC (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 1.5).
pests.treatment_ta: தாக்குதல் அதிகமாக இருந்தால் மட்டும் Dimethoate 40EC (லிட்டருக்கு 1.5 மி.லி).
pests.damage_si: ළපටි කොළවලින් යුෂ උරා බොයි; කොඩවීම ඇති කරයි.
pests.damage_ta: இளம் இலைகளில் சாற்றை உறிஞ்சும்; சுருளை ஏற்படுத்தும்.
pests.identification_si: ළපටි වර්ධනය මත පොකුරු.
pests.identification_ta: இளம் வளர்ச்சியில் கூட்டங்கள்.

risks.name: High Temperature (>25°C)
risks.description: Radish bolts to flower without forming root.
risks.mitigation: Plant in cooler season (up-country Maha). Avoid low country.
risks.description_si: රාබු මුල් නොසාදා මල් දණ්ඩ මතු කර මල් පිපේ.
risks.description_ta: முள்ளங்கி கிழங்கு உருவாகாமல் பூந்தண்டு எழுந்து பூக்கும்.
risks.signs_si: මුල් ඉදිමීමකින් තොරව පැළ මල් පිපේ.
risks.mitigation_si: සිසිල් කාලයේ (උඩරට මහ කන්නයේ) සිටුවන්න. පහතරට වගාවෙන් වළකින්න.
risks.mitigation_ta: குளிர்ந்த பருவத்தில் (மலைநாட்டுப் பெரும்போகம்) நடுங்கள். தாழ்நாட்டில் தவிருங்கள்.

risks.name: Late Harvest
risks.description: Over-mature radish becomes pithy, hollow, and spicy-hot — unmarketable.
risks.mitigation: Set harvest reminders at day 30 and 35. Pull test 3–4 plants.
risks.description_si: අධික ලෙස මේරූ රාබු පිදුරු වැනි, හිස්, ඉතා සැර වන අතර විකිණිය නොහැක.
risks.description_ta: அதிகம் முற்றிய முள்ளங்கி பஞ்சு போலாகி, உள்ளீடற்றதாகி, மிகக் காரமாகிவிடும் — விற்பனைக்கு உதவாது.
risks.signs_si: ගැලවූ විට මෘදු, ස්පොන්ජ් වැනි මුල්.
risks.mitigation_si: 30 සහ 35 දිනවල අස්වනු මතක් කිරීම් සකසන්න. පැළ 3–4ක් ගලවා පරීක්ෂා කරන්න.
risks.mitigation_ta: 30, 35ஆம் நாட்களில் அறுவடை நினைவூட்டல்களை அமையுங்கள். 3–4 செடிகளைப் பிடுங்கிச் சோதியுங்கள்.

indicators: Root feels solid and heavy when pulled
harvest.method: Pull plant by hand. Remove leaves, leaving 3 cm of stalk.
harvest.post_harvest: Trim leaves. Wash roots. Bunch and market within 2–3 days. Wilts quickly without refrigeration.
harvest.method_si: අතින් පැළය ගලවන්න. සෙ.මී. 3ක නටුවක් ඉතිරි කරමින් කොළ ඉවත් කරන්න.
harvest.method_ta: கையால் செடியைப் பிடுங்குங்கள். 3 செ.மீ காம்பை விட்டு இலைகளை அகற்றுங்கள்.
harvest.post_harvest_si: කොළ කපා හරින්න. මුල් සෝදන්න. මිටි බැඳ දින 2–3ක් ඇතුළත වෙළඳපොළට යවන්න. ශීතකරණයක් නැතිව ඉක්මනින් මැලවේ.
harvest.post_harvest_ta: இலைகளை வெட்டுங்கள். கிழங்குகளைக் கழுவுங்கள். கட்டுகளாகக் கட்டி 2–3 நாட்களுக்குள் சந்தைக்கு அனுப்புங்கள். குளிரூட்டல் இல்லாவிட்டால் விரைவில் வாடும்.
indicators_si: ගැලවූ විට මුල ඝන හා බර ලෙස දැනේ

Radish.growth_stages_text: Radish cultivation follows several important growth stages including germination, seedling establishment, vegetative growth, root enlargement, and harvesting. Germination usually occurs within 3–7 days after sowing, making radish one of the quickest germinating root crops. Early seedling growth is rapid, followed by vegetative growth for about 10–20 days depending on environmental conditions and soil fertility. Root enlargement begins around 15–25 days after sowing, and harvesting is typically carried out between 30–50 days when roots become tender, firm, and reach the desired size and shape. Farmers commonly use direct seeding methods and maintain spacing of approximately 5–8 cm between plants and 20–30 cm between rows to ensure proper root expansion and uniform development.
Radish.management_text: Successful radish cultivation requires a structured week-by-week crop management plan including land preparation, seed sowing, fertilizer application, irrigation, thinning, weed control, pest monitoring, and harvesting activities. Fertilizer application is important during early vegetative growth and root development stages, commonly using balanced nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium fertilizers and organic compost to support healthy root formation. Excess nitrogen is avoided as it can cause excessive leaf growth and poor root quality. Irrigation frequency is highest during germination and early root development stages to maintain uniform soil moisture, while moderate irrigation is maintained during later stages to prevent root cracking and pithiness.
Radish.disease_management_text: Disease and pest management are essential in radish cultivation. Aphids suck plant sap and cause leaf curling and weakening of plants, while root maggots damage developing roots by tunneling inside, reducing market value. Flea beetles create small holes in leaves, reducing photosynthesis and plant vigor. Damping off affects young seedlings, causing stem rot near the soil surface and plant death, while fungal leaf diseases appear as dark spots or patches on leaves that reduce growth and yield. These problems can be controlled through crop rotation, field sanitation, balanced fertilizer use, proper irrigation management, removal of infected plants, and biological or chemical control methods when necessary. Risk mitigation practices such as regular field monitoring, timely weeding, maintaining soil fertility, and integrated pest management techniques help reduce crop losses and improve overall productivity.
Radish.overview_si: ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ “රාබු” ලෙස හැඳින්වෙන රාබු (Raphanus sativus) Brassicaceae කුලයට අයත්, වේගයෙන් වැඩෙන මුල් එළවළු බෝගයකි. නිසි මුල් වර්ධනයට සහ ගුණාත්මකභාවයට දේශගුණය සුදුසු නුවරඑළිය, බදුල්ල, මහනුවර වැනි සිසිල් සහ අතරමැදි ප්‍රදේශවල එය ප්‍රධාන වශයෙන් වගා කෙරේ. රාබු 15°C–25°C අතර උෂ්ණත්වයේ හොඳින් වැඩෙන අතර, pH 6.0–7.0 අතර, ලිහිල්, හොඳින් ජලය බැස යන වැලි ලෝම පසක් අවශ්‍ය වේ. නිරෝගී වර්ධනයට සහ හපන විට කුරුකුරු ගතියක් ඇති මුල් සෑදීමට මධ්‍යස්ථ වර්ෂාව, නිතිපතා ජලසම්පාදනය සහ හොඳ හිරු එළිය අවශ්‍යය. ශ්‍රී ලාංකික ආහාරවල ව්‍යංජන, සලාද සහ අච්චාරු සඳහා රාබු බහුලව භාවිත වන අතර, විටමින්, තන්තු සහ ඛනිජ අඩංගු බැවින් පෝෂණීය වටිනාකමක් ඇත. මෙම බෝගය ඉතා වේගයෙන් වැඩෙන අතර ප්‍රභේදය අනුව බීජ වැපිරීමෙන් දින 30–50 අතර අස්වනු නෙළිය හැක. උෂ්ණත්වය, පාංශු තෙතමනය, වර්ෂාව, හිරු එළිය, ආර්ද්‍රතාව සහ පසේ සාරවත්බව රාබු වගාවට බලපාන ප්‍රධාන සාධක වේ. කුඩිත්තා, මුල් පණුවා, පිම්මන කුරුමිණියා, කුඩා පැළ කුණුවීම සහ දිලීර පත්‍ර රෝග පොදු පළිබෝධ හා රෝග වන අතර, නිසි ලෙස පාලනය නොකළහොත් ඒවා අස්වැන්න සහ මුල්වල ගුණාත්මකභාවය අඩු කරයි.
Radish.overview_ta: இலங்கையில் “ராபு” என அழைக்கப்படும் முள்ளங்கி (Raphanus sativus), Brassicaceae குடும்பத்தைச் சேர்ந்த, வேகமாக வளரும் கிழங்குக் காய்கறிப் பயிர். சரியான கிழங்கு வளர்ச்சிக்கும் தரத்துக்கும் ஏற்ற காலநிலை உள்ள நுவரெலியா, பதுளை, கண்டி போன்ற குளிர்ந்த மற்றும் இடைப் பகுதிகளில் இது முக்கியமாகப் பயிரிடப்படுகிறது. முள்ளங்கி 15°C–25°C வெப்பநிலையில் நன்றாக வளரும்; pH 6.0–7.0 உள்ள, இளகிய, நன்கு நீர் வடியும் மணல் கலந்த இருமண் தேவை. ஆரோக்கியமான வளர்ச்சி மற்றும் மொறுமொறுப்பான கிழங்கு உருவாக்கத்துக்கு மிதமான மழை, தொடர்ச்சியான நீர்ப்பாசனம், நல்ல சூரிய ஒளி அவசியம். இலங்கை உணவில் கறி, சாலட், ஊறுகாய் ஆகியவற்றுக்கு முள்ளங்கி பரவலாகப் பயன்படுகிறது; விட்டமின்கள், நார்ச்சத்து, கனிமங்கள் அடங்கியிருப்பதால் ஊட்டச்சத்து மதிப்புடையது. இப்பயிர் மிக வேகமாக வளரும்; இனத்தைப் பொறுத்து விதைத்து 30–50 நாட்களில் அறுவடை செய்யலாம். வெப்பநிலை, மண் ஈரப்பதம், மழை, சூரிய ஒளி, காற்று ஈரப்பதம், மண் வளம் ஆகியவை முள்ளங்கி சாகுபடியைப் பாதிக்கும் முக்கியக் காரணிகள். அசுவினி, வேர்ப் புழு, தத்துப்பூச்சி வண்டு, நாற்று அழுகல், பூஞ்சை இலை நோய்கள் ஆகியவை பொதுவான பூச்சிகளும் நோய்களும்; சரியாகக் கட்டுப்படுத்தாவிட்டால் இவை மகசூலையும் கிழங்கின் தரத்தையும் குறைக்கும்.

Big Onion.overview: Big onion, commonly known as “Bombay onion” in Sri Lanka, is an important bulb vegetable crop belonging to the Amaryllidaceae family and scientifically known as Allium cepa. It is widely cultivated in Sri Lanka, especially in dry and intermediate zones such as Anuradhapura, Polonnaruwa, and Hambantota due to their warm climate and suitable soil conditions. Big onion grows best in temperatures between 20°C and 30°C and requires well-drained sandy loam or loamy soil with a soil pH ranging from 5.5 to 6.8. The crop needs moderate rainfall, controlled irrigation, and full sunlight exposure for proper bulb formation and development. Big onion is widely used in Sri Lankan cuisine as a key ingredient in curries, sambols, and various food preparations, and is also an important commercial crop for local markets and imports. The crop generally takes about 90 to 120 days after transplanting to reach maturity depending on the variety and growing conditions. Important factors affecting cultivation include temperature, soil moisture, rainfall, sunlight, humidity, and soil fertility. Common pests and diseases include thrips, onion maggots, aphids, purple blotch, downy mildew, and bacterial soft rot, which can significantly reduce yield and bulb quality if not properly managed.

stages.name: Land Preparation
stages.description: Fine seedbed for uniform bulb development.

activities.title: Plough and fine till
activities.description: Plough twice. Final fine tilth with cross harrowing. Level carefully.
activities.why: Uneven fields cause irregular irrigation and uneven bulb development.
activities.description_si: දෙවරක් සීසාන්න. හරස් පෝරු ගාමින් අවසාන වශයෙන් පස සියුම් කරන්න. ප්‍රවේශමෙන් සමතලා කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: இருமுறை உழுங்கள். குறுக்குப் பரம்படித்து இறுதியாக மண்ணை நுண்மையாக்குங்கள். கவனமாகச் சமன்செய்யுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: අසමතලා කෙත් නිසා අක්‍රමවත් ජලසම්පාදනය සහ අසමාන බල්බ වර්ධනය සිදු වේ.
activities.why_ta: சமமற்ற வயல்கள் ஒழுங்கற்ற நீர்ப்பாசனத்தையும் சீரற்ற குமிழ் வளர்ச்சியையும் ஏற்படுத்தும்.

activities.title: Apply basal fertiliser
activities.description: Incorporate compost 10 t/ha and basal NPK.
activities.why: Onion has a shallow root system — all nutrients must be near the surface.
activities.description_si: හෙක්ටයාරයකට ටොන් 10ක් කොම්පෝස්ට් සහ මූලික NPK පසට මිශ්‍ර කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: எக்டேருக்கு 10 டன் மக்கிய உரத்தையும் அடியுர NPK-ஐயும் மண்ணுடன் கலந்துவிடுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: ළූණුවලට නොගැඹුරු මුල් පද්ධතියක් ඇත — සියලු පෝෂක මතුපිටට ආසන්නව තිබිය යුතුය.
activities.why_ta: வெங்காயத்துக்கு ஆழமற்ற வேர்த் தொகுதி உண்டு — எல்லா ஊட்டச்சத்தும் மேற்பரப்புக்கு அருகில் இருக்க வேண்டும்.
