stages.description_si: ඒකාකාර බල්බ වර්ධනයට සියුම් බීජ පාත්තියක්.

stages.name: Transplanting

activities.title: Transplant 35–40 day seedlings
activities.description: Plant seedlings (pencil thickness) at 10×20 cm. Water immediately.
activities.why: Correct seedling size is critical — too small or large = poor establishment.
activities.description_si: (පැන්සලක් තරම් ඝනකම) පැළ සෙ.මී. 10×20 පරතරයෙන් සිටුවන්න. වහාම ජලය දෙන්න.
activities.description_ta: (பென்சில் அளவு தடிமனான) நாற்றுகளை 10×20 செ.மீ இடைவெளியில் நடுங்கள். உடனே நீர் பாய்ச்சுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: පැළයේ නිවැරදි ප්‍රමාණය අත්‍යවශ්‍යයි — ඉතා කුඩා හෝ විශාල වුවහොත් ස්ථාපිත වීම දුර්වල වේ.
activities.why_ta: நாற்றின் சரியான அளவு மிக அவசியம் — மிகச் சிறியதோ பெரியதோ ஆனால் நிலைபெறுதல் குறையும்.

activities.title: Water daily for 2 weeks
activities.description: Twice daily if hot and dry.
activities.why: High water demand at establishment in dry zone conditions.
activities.description_si: උණුසුම් හා වියළි නම් දිනකට දෙවරක්.
activities.description_ta: வெப்பமாகவும் வறண்டும் இருந்தால் தினமும் இருமுறை.
activities.why_si: වියළි කලාප තත්ත්වවලදී ස්ථාපිත වීමේදී ජල ඉල්ලුම ඉහළය.
activities.why_ta: உலர் வலய நிலைமைகளில் நிலைபெறும் போது நீர்த் தேவை அதிகம்.

stages.description_si: තවානේ හැදූ පැළ ස්ථාපිත කරන්න.

stages.name: Leaf Development

activities.title: Top dressing 1
activities.description: Urea 75 kg/ha + MOP 50 kg/ha.
activities.why: Nitrogen for leaf development — leaves manufacture the food that fills the bulb.
activities.description_si: යූරියා හෙක්ටයාරයකට කි.ග්‍රෑ. 75 + MOP කි.ග්‍රෑ. 50.
activities.description_ta: எக்டேருக்கு 75 கி.கி யூரியா + 50 கி.கி MOP.
activities.why_si: කොළ වර්ධනයට නයිට්‍රජන් — බල්බය පුරවන ආහාරය නිපදවන්නේ කොළයි.
activities.why_ta: இலை வளர்ச்சிக்கு நைட்ரஜன் — குமிழை நிரப்பும் உணவை இலைகளே உற்பத்தி செய்யும்.

activities.title: Daily thrips scouting
activities.description: Check inner young leaves for silver streaking — sign of thrips.
activities.why: Thrips cause purple blotch and direct leaf damage — most destructive onion pest.
activities.description_si: ඇතුළත ළපටි කොළවල රිදී පැහැති ඉරි — ත්‍රිප්ස්වල ලක්ෂණය — පරීක්ෂා කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: உள் இளம் இலைகளில் வெள்ளிக் கோடுகள் — இலைப்பேனின் அறிகுறி — உள்ளனவா எனச் சோதியுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: ත්‍රිප්ස් දම් පැල්ලම් රෝගයට සහ කොළවලට සෘජු හානියට හේතු වේ — ළූණුවල වඩාත්ම විනාශකාරී පළිබෝධයයි.
activities.why_ta: இலைப்பேன் ஊதா கறை நோயையும் நேரடி இலைச் சேதத்தையும் ஏற்படுத்தும் — வெங்காயத்தின் மிக அழிவுகரமான பூச்சி.

activities.title: Top dressing 2
activities.description: Urea 50 kg/ha + MOP 75 kg/ha.
activities.why: Second feed before bulbing begins.
activities.description_si: යූරියා හෙක්ටයාරයකට කි.ග්‍රෑ. 50 + MOP කි.ග්‍රෑ. 75.
activities.description_ta: எக்டேருக்கு 50 கி.கி யூரியா + 75 கி.கி MOP.
activities.why_si: බල්බ සෑදීම ආරම්භ වීමට පෙර දෙවන පොහොර යෙදීම.
activities.why_ta: குமிழ் உருவாகத் தொடங்கும் முன் இரண்டாவது உரமிடல்.

stages.description_si: ප්‍රභාසංශ්ලේෂණයට කොළ ප්‍රමාණය ගොඩනඟන්න.

stages.name: Bulb Development
stages.description: Leaves fold over as bulb swells.

activities.title: Reduce irrigation frequency
activities.description: Water every 5–7 days. Reduce nitrogen.
activities.why: Excessive nitrogen and water at this stage causes soft bulbs with poor storage.
activities.title_si: ජලය දෙන වාර ගණන අඩු කරන්න
activities.description_si: දින 5–7කට වරක් ජලය දෙන්න. නයිට්‍රජන් අඩු කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: 5–7 நாட்களுக்கு ஒருமுறை நீர் பாய்ச்சுங்கள். நைட்ரஜனைக் குறையுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: මෙම අවධියේ අධික නයිට්‍රජන් සහ ජලය නිසා ගබඩා කිරීමේ හැකියාව අඩු මෘදු බල්බ හටගනී.
activities.why_ta: இந்த நிலையில் அதிக நைட்ரஜனும் நீரும் சேமிப்புத் திறன் குறைந்த மென்மையான குமிழ்களை உருவாக்கும்.

activities.title: Check for purple blotch
activities.description: Look for water-soaked lesions with purple centres on leaves.
activities.why: Purple blotch from thrips damage spreads rapidly during bulbing.
activities.title_si: දම් පැල්ලම් රෝගය සඳහා පරීක්ෂා කරන්න
activities.description_si: කොළ මත දම් පැහැ මැදක් සහිත, ජලයෙන් තෙත් වූ වැනි තුවාල සොයන්න.
activities.description_ta: இலைகளில் ஊதா நிற மையத்துடன் நீரில் ஊறியது போன்ற புண்களைத் தேடுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: ත්‍රිප්ස් හානිය නිසා ඇතිවන දම් පැල්ලම් රෝගය බල්බ සෑදෙන කාලයේ වේගයෙන් පැතිරේ.
activities.why_ta: இலைப்பேன் சேதத்தால் ஏற்படும் ஊதா கறை நோய் குமிழ் உருவாகும் காலத்தில் வேகமாகப் பரவும்.

activities.title: Stop irrigation 2 weeks before harvest
activities.description: Allow leaves to yellow and fall over naturally.
activities.why: Curing in the soil hardens the bulb skin for storage.
activities.title_si: අස්වනු නෙළීමට සති 2කට පෙර ජලය දීම නවත්වන්න
activities.description_si: කොළ ස්වාභාවිකව කහ වී නැමී වැටීමට ඉඩ හරින්න.
activities.description_ta: இலைகள் இயற்கையாக மஞ்சளாகிச் சாய விடுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: පසේදීම සුව වීමෙන් ගබඩා කිරීමට බල්බයේ පොත්ත තද වේ.
activities.why_ta: மண்ணிலேயே பதப்படுவதால் சேமிப்புக்கு ஏற்றவாறு குமிழின் தோல் உறுதியாகும்.

stages.description_si: බල්බය ඉදිමෙන විට කොළ නැමී වැටේ.

stages.name: Harvest

activities.title: Harvest when 75% of tops fall
activities.description: Pull bulbs when majority of tops have fallen over and yellowed.
activities.why: Premature harvest gives soft bulbs with short shelf life.
activities.title_si: කොළවලින් 75%ක් නැමී වැටුණු විට අස්වනු නෙළන්න
activities.description_si: බොහෝ කොළ නැමී කහ වූ විට බල්බ ගලවන්න.
activities.description_ta: பெரும்பாலான இலைகள் சாய்ந்து மஞ்சளானதும் குமிழ்களைப் பிடுங்குங்கள்.
activities.why_si: කලින් නෙළීමෙන් කල් තබා ගැනීමේ හැකියාව අඩු මෘදු බල්බ ලැබේ.
activities.why_ta: முன்கூட்டிய அறுவடை குறைந்த நாள் கெடாமல் இருக்கும் மென்மையான குமிழ்களைத் தரும்.

activities.title: Field cure for 7–10 days
activities.description: Leave harvested bulbs on the ground in the sun for 7–10 days.
activities.why: Sun curing hardens outer skin and improves storage life dramatically.
activities.description_si: නෙළූ බල්බ දින 7–10ක් අව්වේ බිම තබන්න.
activities.description_ta: அறுவடை செய்த குமிழ்களை 7–10 நாட்கள் வெயிலில் தரையில் விடுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: අව්වේ සුව කිරීමෙන් පිටත පොත්ත තද වී ගබඩා කාලය විශාල ලෙස වැඩි වේ.
activities.why_ta: வெயிலில் பதப்படுத்துவது வெளித்தோலை உறுதியாக்கிச் சேமிப்புக் காலத்தைப் பெருமளவு நீட்டிக்கும்.

stages.description_si: අස්වනු නෙළා ගබඩා කිරීමට සුව කරන්න.

fertilization.why: Shallow-rooted crop needs all basal nutrients near surface.
fertilization.why_si: නොගැඹුරු මුල් ඇති බෝගයකට සියලු මූලික පෝෂක මතුපිටට ආසන්නව අවශ්‍යය.
fertilization.why_ta: ஆழமற்ற வேருள்ள பயிருக்கு எல்லா அடியுர ஊட்டச்சத்தும் மேற்பரப்புக்கு அருகில் தேவை.

irrigation.frequency: Every 3–4 days (leaf stage); every 5–7 days (bulbing stage)
irrigation.notes: Stop irrigation completely 2 weeks before harvest. This is critical for bulb quality and storage.
irrigation.frequency_si: දින 3–4කට වරක් (කොළ අවධිය); දින 5–7කට වරක් (බල්බ අවධිය)
irrigation.frequency_ta: 3–4 நாட்களுக்கு ஒருமுறை (இலை நிலை); 5–7 நாட்களுக்கு ஒருமுறை (குமிழ் நிலை)
irrigation.notes_si: අස්වනු නෙළීමට සති 2කට පෙර ජලය දීම සම්පූර්ණයෙන්ම නවත්වන්න. බල්බවල ගුණාත්මකභාවයට සහ ගබඩා කිරීමට මෙය අත්‍යවශ්‍යයි.
irrigation.notes_ta: அறுவடைக்கு 2 வாரங்களுக்கு முன் நீர்ப்பாசனத்தை முழுமையாக நிறுத்துங்கள். குமிழின் தரத்துக்கும் சேமிப்புக்கும் இது மிக அவசியம்.
irrigation.critical_stages_text_si: ස්ථාපිත වීම · කොළ වර්ධනය · බල්බ සෑදීමේ ආරම්භය
irrigation.critical_stages_text_ta: நிலைபெறுதல் · இலை வளர்ச்சி · குமிழ் உருவாக்கத் தொடக்கம்

diseases.name: Purple Blotch
diseases.symptoms: Purple or brown lesions on leaves that gradually spread; premature drying and yield reduction.
diseases.favorable_conditions: Humid weather, prolonged leaf wetness, poor air circulation.
diseases.prevention: Good plant spacing. Avoid overhead irrigation. Remove infected leaves early.
diseases.treatment: Mancozeb 80WP (2.5 g/L) or Iprodione (1.5 ml/L) every 7–10 days.
diseases.symptoms_si: කොළ මත ක්‍රමයෙන් පැතිරෙන දම් හෝ දුඹුරු තුවාල; කලින් වියළීම සහ අස්වැන්න අඩු වීම.
diseases.symptoms_ta: இலைகளில் படிப்படியாகப் பரவும் ஊதா அல்லது பழுப்புப் புண்கள்; முன்கூட்டியே காய்தலும் மகசூல் குறைவும்.
diseases.favorable_conditions_si: ආර්ද්‍ර කාලගුණය, කොළ දිගු කලක් තෙත්ව පැවතීම, දුර්වල වාතාශ්‍රය.
diseases.favorable_conditions_ta: ஈரப்பதமான வானிலை, இலைகள் நீண்ட நேரம் ஈரமாக இருத்தல், மோசமான காற்றோட்டம்.
diseases.prevention_si: පැළ අතර හොඳ පරතරය. ඉහළින් ජලය ඉසීමෙන් වළකින්න. ආසාදිත කොළ කලින්ම ඉවත් කරන්න.
diseases.prevention_ta: செடிகளுக்கிடையே நல்ல இடைவெளி. மேலிருந்து நீர் தெளிப்பதைத் தவிருங்கள். பாதிக்கப்பட்ட இலைகளை முன்கூட்டியே அகற்றுங்கள்.
diseases.treatment_si: Mancozeb 80WP (ලීටරයකට ග්‍රෑ. 2.5) හෝ Iprodione (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 1.5) දින 7–10කට වරක්.
diseases.treatment_ta: Mancozeb 80WP (லிட்டருக்கு 2.5 கி) அல்லது Iprodione (லிட்டருக்கு 1.5 மி.லி) 7–10 நாட்களுக்கு ஒருமுறை.

diseases.name: Downy Mildew
diseases.symptoms: Pale green to yellow patches on leaves; grey-purple fungal growth under humid conditions.
diseases.favorable_conditions: Cool humid weather, heavy dew, poor air circulation, overhead irrigation.
diseases.prevention: Avoid overhead irrigation. Crop rotation. Resistant varieties.
diseases.treatment: Metalaxyl + Mancozeb (2.5 g/L) spray preventively in wet conditions.
diseases.symptoms_si: කොළ මත ලා කොළ සිට කහ දක්වා ලප; ආර්ද්‍ර තත්ත්වවලදී අළු-දම් පැහැ දිලීර වර්ධනය.
diseases.symptoms_ta: இலைகளில் வெளிர் பச்சை முதல் மஞ்சள் வரையான திட்டுகள்; ஈரப்பதமான நிலையில் சாம்பல்-ஊதா பூஞ்சை வளர்ச்சி.
diseases.favorable_conditions_si: සිසිල් ආර්ද්‍ර කාලගුණය, අධික පිනි, දුර්වල වාතාශ්‍රය, ඉහළින් ජලය ඉසීම.
diseases.favorable_conditions_ta: குளிர்ந்த ஈரமான வானிலை, அதிக பனித்துளி, மோசமான காற்றோட்டம், மேலிருந்து நீர் தெளிப்பு.
diseases.prevention_si: ඉහළින් ජලය ඉසීමෙන් වළකින්න. බෝග මාරුව. ඔරොත්තු දෙන ප්‍රභේද.
diseases.prevention_ta: மேலிருந்து நீர் தெளிப்பதைத் தவிருங்கள். பயிர்ச் சுழற்சி. எதிர்ப்புள்ள இனங்கள்.
diseases.treatment_si: තෙත් තත්ත්වවලදී වැළැක්වීම සඳහා Metalaxyl + Mancozeb (ලීටරයකට ග්‍රෑ. 2.5) ඉසීම.
diseases.treatment_ta: ஈரமான நிலையில் தடுப்பாக Metalaxyl + Mancozeb (லிட்டருக்கு 2.5 கி) தெளிப்பு.

diseases.name: Bacterial Soft Rot
diseases.symptoms: Watery soft decay of bulbs with foul smell; bulbs become unusable.
diseases.favorable_conditions: High moisture, wounds on bulbs, warm conditions.
diseases.prevention: Reduce irrigation before harvest. Handle bulbs carefully. Proper storage.
diseases.treatment: No chemical cure. Improve drainage and harvest handling. Proper curing of bulbs.
diseases.symptoms_si: දුගඳ සහිතව බල්බ ජලමය ලෙස මෘදුව දිරාපත් වේ; බල්බ භාවිතයට නුසුදුසු වේ.
diseases.symptoms_ta: துர்நாற்றத்துடன் குமிழ்கள் நீர்த்தன்மையுடன் மென்மையாக அழுகும்; பயன்படுத்த முடியாததாகிவிடும்.
diseases.favorable_conditions_si: ඉහළ තෙතමනය, බල්බවල තුවාල, උණුසුම් තත්ත්ව.
diseases.favorable_conditions_ta: அதிக ஈரப்பதம், குமிழ்களில் காயங்கள், வெப்பமான நிலை.
diseases.prevention_si: අස්වනු නෙළීමට පෙර ජලය දීම අඩු කරන්න. බල්බ ප්‍රවේශමෙන් හසුරුවන්න. නිසි ගබඩා කිරීම.
diseases.prevention_ta: அறுவடைக்கு முன் நீர்ப்பாசனத்தைக் குறையுங்கள். குமிழ்களைக் கவனமாகக் கையாளுங்கள். சரியான சேமிப்பு.
diseases.treatment_si: රසායනික ප්‍රතිකාරයක් නැත. ජලාපවහනය සහ අස්වනු හැසිරවීම වැඩි දියුණු කරන්න. බල්බ නිසි ලෙස සුව කරන්න.
diseases.treatment_ta: இரசாயன சிகிச்சை இல்லை. வடிகாலையும் அறுவடைக் கையாளுதலையும் மேம்படுத்துங்கள். குமிழ்களைச் சரியாகப் பதப்படுத்துங்கள்.

pests.name: Thrips
pests.damage: Most damaging onion pest; silvery streaks on leaves; severe leaf curling; reduced bulb size.
pests.identification: Tiny yellowish insects in leaf folds; silvery scarring on leaves.
pests.prevention: Blue sticky traps. Avoid dense planting. Proper field sanitation.
pests.treatment: Spinosad 45SC (0.3 ml/L) or Fipronil. Apply in early morning. Rotate chemicals.
pests.prevention_si: නිල් ඇලෙන උගුල්. ඝනව සිටුවීමෙන් වළකින්න. කෙත නිසි ලෙස පිරිසිදුව තබා ගන්න.
pests.prevention_ta: நீல ஒட்டும் பொறிகள். அடர்த்தியாக நடுவதைத் தவிருங்கள். வயலைச் சரியாகச் சுத்தமாக வையுங்கள்.
pests.treatment_si: Spinosad 45SC (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 0.3) හෝ Fipronil. අලුයම යොදන්න. රසායනික මාරුවෙන් මාරුවට භාවිත කරන්න.
pests.treatment_ta: Spinosad 45SC (லிட்டருக்கு 0.3 மி.லி) அல்லது Fipronil. அதிகாலையில் தெளியுங்கள். இரசாயனங்களை மாற்றி மாற்றிப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள்.
pests.damage_si: ළූණුවලට වඩාත්ම හානිකර පළිබෝධය; කොළ මත රිදී පැහැති ඉරි; කොළ දැඩි ලෙස කොඩවීම; බල්බවල ප්‍රමාණය අඩු වීම.
pests.damage_ta: வெங்காயத்தின் மிகச் சேதம் விளைவிக்கும் பூச்சி; இலைகளில் வெள்ளிக் கோடுகள்; கடுமையான இலைச் சுருள்; குமிழ் அளவு குறைவு.
pests.identification_si: කොළ නැමුම් තුළ කුඩා කහ පැහැති කෘමීන්; කොළ මත රිදී පැහැති කැළැල්.
pests.identification_ta: இலை மடிப்புகளில் சிறிய மஞ்சள் பூச்சிகள்; இலைகளில் வெள்ளி நிறத் தழும்புகள்.

pests.name: Onion Maggot
pests.damage: Larvae damage roots and bulb base causing rotting and plant death.
pests.identification: Plants wilting; soft rotting at bulb base; white maggots in soil.
pests.prevention: Crop rotation. Avoid planting where maggots were present previously.
pests.treatment: Chlorpyrifos granules at planting. Soil drench if attack is identified early.
pests.prevention_si: බෝග මාරුව. කලින් පණුවන් සිටි ස්ථානවල සිටුවීමෙන් වළකින්න.
pests.prevention_ta: பயிர்ச் சுழற்சி. முன்பு புழுக்கள் இருந்த இடங்களில் நடுவதைத் தவிருங்கள்.
pests.treatment_si: සිටුවන විට Chlorpyrifos කැට. ප්‍රහාරය කලින්ම හඳුනාගත්තොත් පස තෙමීම.
pests.treatment_ta: நடவின் போது Chlorpyrifos குருணைகள். தாக்குதலை முன்கூட்டியே கண்டறிந்தால் மண்ணை நனைத்தல்.
pests.damage_si: කීටයෝ මුල් සහ බල්බයේ පාමුලට හානි කරමින් කුණුවීම සහ පැළ මිය යාම ඇති කරති.
pests.damage_ta: புழுக்கள் வேர்களையும் குமிழின் அடிப்பகுதியையும் சேதப்படுத்தி அழுகலையும் செடி இறப்பையும் ஏற்படுத்தும்.
pests.identification_si: පැළ මැලවීම; බල්බයේ පාමුල මෘදුව කුණු වීම; පසේ සුදු පණුවන්.
pests.identification_ta: செடிகள் வாடுதல்; குமிழின் அடிப்பகுதி மென்மையாக அழுகுதல்; மண்ணில் வெள்ளைப் புழுக்கள்.

pests.name: Aphid
pests.damage: Sucks sap; causes leaf curling and may transmit viruses.
pests.identification: Colonies on young leaves and inside developing bulb.
pests.prevention: Neem oil spray. Yellow sticky traps.
pests.treatment: Dimethoate 40EC (1.5 ml/L).
pests.prevention_si: කොහොඹ තෙල් ඉසීම. කහ ඇලෙන උගුල්.
pests.prevention_ta: வேப்ப எண்ணெய் தெளிப்பு. மஞ்சள் ஒட்டும் பொறிகள்.
pests.treatment_si: Dimethoate 40EC (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 1.5).
pests.treatment_ta: Dimethoate 40EC (லிட்டருக்கு 1.5 மி.லி).
pests.damage_si: යුෂ උරා බොයි; කොළ කොඩවීම ඇති කරන අතර වෛරස පැතිරවිය හැක.
pests.damage_ta: சாற்றை உறிஞ்சும்; இலைச் சுருளை ஏற்படுத்தும், வைரஸ்களையும் பரப்பலாம்.
pests.identification_si: ළපටි කොළ මත සහ වැඩෙන බල්බය ඇතුළත ජනපද.
pests.identification_ta: இளம் இலைகளிலும் வளரும் குமிழுக்குள்ளும் கூட்டங்கள்.

risks.name: Excessive Rain During Bulbing
risks.description: Soft bulbs, neck rot, very poor storage life.
risks.signs: Soft watery bulbs, plants not falling over.
risks.mitigation: Plant in dry season. Ensure drainage. Reduce irrigation.
risks.description_si: මෘදු බල්බ, බෙල්ල කුණුවීම, ගබඩා කාලය ඉතා අඩු වීම.
risks.description_ta: மென்மையான குமிழ்கள், கழுத்து அழுகல், மிகக் குறைந்த சேமிப்புக் காலம்.
risks.signs_si: මෘදු ජලමය බල්බ, කොළ නැමී නොවැටීම.
risks.mitigation_si: වියළි කාලයේ සිටුවන්න. ජලාපවහනය සහතික කරන්න. ජලය දීම අඩු කරන්න.
risks.mitigation_ta: வறண்ட பருவத்தில் நடுங்கள். வடிகாலை உறுதிசெய்யுங்கள். நீர்ப்பாசனத்தைக் குறையுங்கள்.

risks.name: Drought During Leaf Development
risks.description: Reduced leaf area = small bulbs.
risks.mitigation: Maintain regular irrigation schedule. Mulch between rows.
risks.description_si: කොළ ප්‍රමාණය අඩු වීම = කුඩා බල්බ.
risks.description_ta: இலைப் பரப்பு குறைவு = சிறிய குமிழ்கள்.
risks.signs_si: වර්ධනය මන්දගාමී වීම, සිහින් කොළ.
risks.mitigation_si: නිතිපතා ජලය දීමේ කාලසටහන පවත්වා ගන්න. පේළි අතර වසුන් යොදන්න.
risks.mitigation_ta: தொடர் நீர்ப்பாசன அட்டவணையைப் பேணுங்கள். வரிசைகளுக்கு இடையே மூடாக்கு இடுங்கள்.

harvest.method: Pull by hand or use fork. Do not throw — bulbs bruise easily.
harvest.post_harvest: Field cure 7–10 days in sun. Top and root trim. Grade by size. Store in well-ventilated slatted trays. Shelf life 3–6 months.
harvest.method_si: අතින් හෝ ගෑරුප්පුවකින් ගලවන්න. විසි නොකරන්න — බල්බ පහසුවෙන් තැලේ.
harvest.method_ta: கையால் அல்லது முட்கரண்டியால் பிடுங்குங்கள். வீசாதீர்கள் — குமிழ்கள் எளிதில் நசுங்கும்.
harvest.post_harvest_si: දින 7–10ක් කෙතේ අව්වේ සුව කරන්න. කොළ සහ මුල් කපා හරින්න. ප්‍රමාණය අනුව ශ්‍රේණිගත කරන්න. හොඳින් වාතාශ්‍රය ඇති ලීසි තැටිවල ගබඩා කරන්න. කල් තබා ගත හැකි කාලය මාස 3–6.
harvest.post_harvest_ta: 7–10 நாட்கள் வயலில் வெயிலில் பதப்படுத்துங்கள். தழையையும் வேரையும் வெட்டுங்கள். அளவின்படி தரம் பிரியுங்கள். நன்கு காற்றோட்டமுள்ள பலகைத் தட்டுகளில் சேமியுங்கள். 3–6 மாதங்கள் கெடாமல் இருக்கும்.

Big Onion.growth_stages_text: Big onion cultivation follows several important growth stages including seed germination, seedling establishment, vegetative growth, bulb initiation, bulb enlargement, maturation, and harvesting. Seeds usually germinate within 7–12 days after sowing in nursery beds. Seedlings are maintained in the nursery for approximately 35–45 days before transplanting into the main field. After transplanting, the crop enters a vegetative growth stage where leaves develop rapidly. Bulb initiation generally begins 45–60 days after transplanting and is followed by bulb enlargement, during which nutrients and carbohydrates accumulate within the bulb. Harvesting is carried out when approximately 50–70% of the tops fall over naturally and leaves begin to dry, indicating bulb maturity. The entire crop cycle generally lasts 90–120 days depending on variety and environmental conditions.
Big Onion.management_text: Successful big onion cultivation requires a well-planned crop management schedule involving land preparation, nursery establishment, transplanting, fertilizer application, irrigation management, weed control, pest monitoring, and harvesting. Farmers typically prepare raised beds and incorporate organic matter before planting. Seedlings are transplanted at a spacing of approximately 10–15 cm between plants and 20–30 cm between rows to ensure adequate bulb development. Fertilizer management is critical, with nitrogen supporting leaf growth during early stages and phosphorus and potassium promoting bulb formation and overall plant health. Organic compost and well-decomposed manure are often added during land preparation to improve soil fertility and structure.
Big Onion.disease_management_text: Irrigation management plays a major role in onion production. Frequent light watering is required during germination and immediately after transplanting to establish healthy seedlings. During vegetative growth and bulb development, irrigation should be provided regularly to maintain consistent soil moisture. However, excessive water can increase disease incidence and reduce bulb quality. Irrigation is usually reduced or stopped completely two to three weeks before harvest to promote bulb maturity, improve storage quality, and reduce the risk of bulb rotting.
Big Onion.risk_mitigation_text: Disease and pest management are essential for achieving high-quality onion yields. Thrips are among the most damaging pests, feeding on leaf tissues and causing silvery streaks, leaf curling, and reduced bulb size. Onion maggots attack roots and bulbs, resulting in plant wilting and bulb decay. Aphids weaken plants by sucking sap and can transmit viral diseases. Purple blotch disease appears as purple-brown lesions on leaves, eventually causing leaf drying and reduced bulb development. Downy mildew causes pale green to yellow patches on leaves accompanied by gray fungal growth under humid conditions. Bacterial soft rot affects harvested and stored bulbs, causing water-soaked tissues, foul odor, and bulb decomposition. These problems can be managed through proper field sanitation, crop rotation, balanced fertilizer application, adequate plant spacing, good drainage, timely irrigation management, resistant varieties, and integrated pest management practices. Risk mitigation strategies are important for maintaining stable production and reducing losses. During periods of excessive rainfall, farmers should improve drainage systems to prevent waterlogging and disease outbreaks. During drought conditions, mulching and efficient irrigation practices help conserve soil moisture. Regular field inspections allow early detection of pests and diseases before severe damage occurs. Using certified seeds, maintaining proper nutrient management, and practicing crop rotation can significantly improve crop health and productivity. These measures help ensure stable yields, high-quality bulbs, and greater resilience to changing environmental conditions and climate-related stresses.
Big Onion.overview_si: ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ “බොම්බායි ළූණු” ලෙසද හැඳින්වෙන ලොකු ළූණු (Allium cepa) Amaryllidaceae කුලයට අයත් වැදගත් බල්බ එළවළු බෝගයකි. උණුසුම් දේශගුණය සහ සුදුසු පාංශු තත්ත්ව නිසා එය ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ, විශේෂයෙන් අනුරාධපුරය, පොළොන්නරුව, හම්බන්තොට වැනි වියළි සහ අතරමැදි කලාපවල බහුලව වගා කෙරේ. ලොකු ළූණු 20°C–30°C අතර උෂ්ණත්වයේ හොඳින් වැඩෙන අතර, pH 5.5–6.8 අතර, හොඳින් ජලය බැස යන වැලි ලෝම හෝ ලෝම පසක් අවශ්‍ය වේ. නිසි බල්බ සෑදීමට සහ වර්ධනයට මධ්‍යස්ථ වර්ෂාව, පාලිත ජලසම්පාදනය සහ පූර්ණ හිරු එළිය අවශ්‍යය. ශ්‍රී ලාංකික ආහාරවල ව්‍යංජන, සම්බෝල සහ විවිධ ආහාර සඳහා ප්‍රධාන අමුද්‍රව්‍යයක් ලෙස ලොකු ළූණු බහුලව භාවිත වන අතර, එය දේශීය වෙළඳපොළ සහ ආනයන සම්බන්ධයෙන් වැදගත් වාණිජ බෝගයකි. ප්‍රභේදය සහ වගා තත්ත්ව අනුව පැළ සිටුවීමෙන් දින 90–120ක් පමණ ගත වූ පසු මේරේ. උෂ්ණත්වය, පාංශු තෙතමනය, වර්ෂාව, හිරු එළිය, ආර්ද්‍රතාව සහ පසේ සාරවත්බව වගාවට බලපාන ප්‍රධාන සාධක වේ. ත්‍රිප්ස්, ළූණු පණුවා, කුඩිත්තා, දම් පැල්ලම් රෝගය, ඩවුනි මිල්ඩිව් රෝගය සහ බැක්ටීරියා මෘදු කුණුවීම පොදු පළිබෝධ හා රෝග වන අතර, නිසි ලෙස පාලනය නොකළහොත් ඒවා අස්වැන්න සහ බල්බවල ගුණාත්මකභාවය බෙහෙවින් අඩු කරයි.
Big Onion.overview_ta: இலங்கையில் “பம்பாய் வெங்காயம்” என்றும் அழைக்கப்படும் பெரிய வெங்காயம் (Allium cepa), Amaryllidaceae குடும்பத்தைச் சேர்ந்த முக்கியமான குமிழ்க் காய்கறிப் பயிர். வெப்பமான காலநிலையும் ஏற்ற மண் நிலைமைகளும் காரணமாக இலங்கையில், குறிப்பாக அனுராதபுரம், பொலன்னறுவை, அம்பாந்தோட்டை போன்ற உலர் மற்றும் இடை வலயங்களில் பரவலாகப் பயிரிடப்படுகிறது. பெரிய வெங்காயம் 20°C–30°C வெப்பநிலையில் நன்றாக வளரும்; pH 5.5–6.8 உள்ள, நன்கு நீர் வடியும் மணல் கலந்த இருமண் அல்லது இருமண் தேவை. சரியான குமிழ் உருவாக்கம் மற்றும் வளர்ச்சிக்கு மிதமான மழை, கட்டுப்படுத்தப்பட்ட நீர்ப்பாசனம், முழுச் சூரிய ஒளி அவசியம். இலங்கை உணவில் கறி, சம்பல் மற்றும் பல்வேறு உணவுகளின் முக்கியப் பொருளாகப் பெரிய வெங்காயம் பரவலாகப் பயன்படுகிறது; உள்ளூர்ச் சந்தைக்கும் இறக்குமதிக்கும் தொடர்புடைய முக்கிய வணிகப் பயிர். இனம் மற்றும் வளர்ப்பு நிலைமைகளைப் பொறுத்து நாற்று நட்டு சுமார் 90–120 நாட்களில் முற்றும். வெப்பநிலை, மண் ஈரப்பதம், மழை, சூரிய ஒளி, காற்று ஈரப்பதம், மண் வளம் ஆகியவை சாகுபடியைப் பாதிக்கும் முக்கியக் காரணிகள். இலைப்பேன், வெங்காயப் புழு, அசுவினி, ஊதா கறை நோய், அடிச்சாம்பல் நோய், பாக்டீரியா மென் அழுகல் ஆகியவை பொதுவான பூச்சிகளும் நோய்களும்; சரியாகக் கட்டுப்படுத்தாவிட்டால் இவை மகசூலையும் குமிழின் தரத்தையும் பெருமளவு குறைக்கும்.

Red Onion.overview: Red onion, commonly known as “Rathu Lunu” in Sri Lanka, is an important bulb vegetable crop belonging to the Amaryllidaceae family and scientifically known as Allium cepa var. aggregatum (shallot-type red onion commonly grown in Sri Lanka). It is widely cultivated in dry and intermediate zones of Sri Lanka such as Anuradhapura, Polonnaruwa, and Hambantota due to their hot climate and well-drained soil conditions. Red onion grows best in temperatures between 20°C and 30°C and requires well-drained sandy loam or loamy soil with a soil pH ranging from 5.5 to 6.8. The crop needs moderate rainfall, controlled irrigation, and full sunlight exposure for proper bulb development and maturation. Red onion is a key ingredient in Sri Lankan cooking and is widely used in curries, sambols, and various traditional dishes, valued for its strong flavor and nutritional benefits. The crop generally takes about 80 to 110 days after planting to reach maturity depending on the variety and growing conditions. Important factors affecting cultivation include temperature, soil moisture, rainfall, sunlight, humidity, and soil fertility. Common pests and diseases include thrips, onion maggots, aphids, purple blotch, downy mildew, and bacterial soft rot, which can significantly reduce yield and bulb quality if not properly managed.

stages.name: Land Preparation

activities.title: Plough and fine till
activities.description: Fine tilth to 20 cm. Level well. Form raised beds if needed.
activities.why: Shallow root system requires fine, even seedbed.
activities.description_si: සෙ.මී. 20ක් ගැඹුරට පස සියුම් කරන්න. හොඳින් සමතලා කරන්න. අවශ්‍ය නම් උස් කළ පාත්ති සාදන්න.
activities.description_ta: 20 செ.மீ ஆழம் வரை மண்ணை நுண்மையாக்குங்கள். நன்றாகச் சமன்செய்யுங்கள். தேவைப்பட்டால் உயர்த்திய பாத்திகள் அமையுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: නොගැඹුරු මුල් පද්ධතියට සියුම්, සමතලා බීජ පාත්තියක් අවශ්‍යය.
activities.why_ta: ஆழமற்ற வேர்த் தொகுதிக்கு நுண்ணிய, சமமான விதைப்பாத்தி தேவை.

activities.title: Apply basal fertiliser
activities.description: Compost 10 t/ha + TSP + MOP incorporated.
activities.why: Base nutrients at surface for shallow feeder.
activities.description_si: හෙක්ටයාරයකට ටොන් 10ක් කොම්පෝස්ට් + TSP + MOP පසට මිශ්‍ර කරන ලදී.
activities.description_ta: எக்டேருக்கு 10 டன் மக்கிய உரம் + TSP + MOP மண்ணுடன் கலக்கப்படும்.
activities.why_si: නොගැඹුරු මුල් ඇති බෝගයකට මූලික පෝෂක මතුපිටම යොදන්න.
activities.why_ta: ஆழமற்ற வேருள்ள பயிருக்கு அடிப்படை ஊட்டச்சத்துகள் மேற்பரப்பில்.

stages.description_si: නොගැඹුරු, සියුම් බීජ පාත්තියක් සකස් කරන්න.

stages.name: Planting

activities.title: Plant sets at 15×20 cm spacing
activities.description: Push sets 2–3 cm into soil. Pointed tip up. Water immediately.
activities.why: Correct depth — if too shallow, sets dry out; too deep, slow emergence.
activities.description_si: බීජ ළූණු සෙ.මී. 2–3ක් පසට තද කරන්න. උල් කෙළවර ඉහළට. වහාම ජලය දෙන්න.
activities.description_ta: விதை வெங்காயத்தை 2–3 செ.மீ மண்ணுக்குள் அழுத்துங்கள். கூர் முனை மேலே. உடனே நீர் பாய்ச்சுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: නිවැරදි ගැඹුර — ඉතා නොගැඹුරු නම් බීජ ළූණු වියළේ; ඉතා ගැඹුරු නම් පැළ මතුවීම ප්‍රමාද වේ.
activities.why_ta: சரியான ஆழம் — மிக ஆழமற்றதானால் விதை வெங்காயம் காய்ந்துவிடும்; மிக ஆழமானால் முளைப்பு தாமதமாகும்.

activities.title: Water every 2 days first 2 weeks
activities.description: Keep soil moist for sprouting.
activities.why: Sets need moisture to sprout and establish.
activities.title_si: පළමු සති 2 දින 2කට වරක් ජලය දෙන්න
activities.title_ta: முதல் 2 வாரங்கள் 2 நாட்களுக்கு ஒருமுறை நீர் பாய்ச்சுதல்
activities.description_si: පැළ ලෑමට පස තෙත්ව තබා ගන්න.
activities.description_ta: முளைப்பதற்கு மண்ணை ஈரமாக வையுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: බීජ ළූණු පැළ ලා ස්ථාපිත වීමට තෙතමනය අවශ්‍යය.
activities.why_ta: விதை வெங்காயம் முளைத்து நிலைபெற ஈரப்பதம் தேவை.

stages.description_si: බීජ ළූණු සිටුවා ස්ථාපිත කරන්න.

stages.name: Leaf Development

activities.title: Top dressing 1
activities.description: Urea 75 kg/ha + MOP 50 kg/ha between rows.
activities.why: Nitrogen for leaf and shoot development.
activities.description_si: පේළි අතරට යූරියා හෙක්ටයාරයකට කි.ග්‍රෑ. 75 + MOP කි.ග්‍රෑ. 50.
activities.description_ta: வரிசைகளுக்கு இடையே எக்டேருக்கு 75 கி.கி யூரியா + 50 கி.கி MOP.
activities.why_si: කොළ සහ දළු වර්ධනයට නයිට්‍රජන්.
activities.why_ta: இலை, தளிர் வளர்ச்சிக்கு நைட்ரஜன்.

activities.title: Scout for thrips daily
activities.description: Check young inner leaves for silver streaks.
activities.why: Thrips are the main pest. Control before populations explode.
activities.description_si: ඇතුළත ළපටි කොළවල රිදී පැහැති ඉරි පරීක්ෂා කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: உள் இளம் இலைகளில் வெள்ளிக் கோடுகள் உள்ளனவா எனச் சோதியுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: ත්‍රිප්ස් ප්‍රධාන පළිබෝධයයි. ගහනය වේගයෙන් වැඩි වීමට පෙර පාලනය කරන්න.
activities.why_ta: இலைப்பேன் முக்கியப் பூச்சி. எண்ணிக்கை பெருகுவதற்கு முன் கட்டுப்படுத்துங்கள்.

stages.description_si: කොළ ප්‍රමාණය ගොඩනඟන්න.

stages.name: Bulbing
stages.description: Bulbs swell as leaves transfer nutrients.

activities.title: Top dressing 2
activities.description: MOP 75 kg/ha. Reduce Urea.
activities.why: Higher potassium for bulb fill.
activities.description_si: MOP හෙක්ටයාරයකට කි.ග්‍රෑ. 75. යූරියා අඩු කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: எக்டேருக்கு 75 கி.கி MOP. யூரியாவைக் குறையுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: බල්බ පිරීමට වැඩි පොටෑසියම්.
activities.why_ta: குமிழ் நிரம்புவதற்கு அதிக பொட்டாசியம்.

activities.title: Stop irrigation
activities.description: Cease all irrigation 2 weeks before harvest.
activities.why: Dry conditions cure the bulb skin properly.
activities.description_si: අස්වනු නෙළීමට සති 2කට පෙර සියලු ජලය දීම නවත්වන්න.
activities.description_ta: அறுவடைக்கு 2 வாரங்களுக்கு முன் எல்லா நீர்ப்பாசனத்தையும் நிறுத்துங்கள்.
activities.why_si: වියළි තත්ත්ව බල්බයේ පොත්ත නිසි ලෙස සුව කරයි.
activities.why_ta: வறண்ட நிலை குமிழ்த் தோலைச் சரியாகப் பதப்படுத்தும்.

stages.description_si: කොළ පෝෂක මාරු කරන විට බල්බ ඉදිමේ.

stages.name: Harvest

activities.title: Harvest when tops fall
activities.description: Pull when 70–80% of leaves have fallen and yellowed.
activities.why: Premature harvest = poor storage life.
activities.title_si: කොළ නැමී වැටුණු විට අස්වනු නෙළන්න
activities.description_si: කොළවලින් 70–80%ක් නැමී කහ වූ විට ගලවන්න.
activities.description_ta: 70–80% இலைகள் சாய்ந்து மஞ்சளானதும் பிடுங்குங்கள்.
activities.why_si: කලින් නෙළීම = දුර්වල ගබඩා කාලය.
activities.why_ta: முன்கூட்டிய அறுவடை = குறைந்த சேமிப்புக் காலம்.

activities.title: Sun-cure 5–7 days
activities.description: Spread in sun for 5–7 days.
activities.why: Sun curing hardens skin and extends shelf life to 6+ months.
activities.description_si: දින 5–7ක් අව්වේ විහිදා තබන්න.
activities.description_ta: 5–7 நாட்கள் வெயிலில் பரப்பி வையுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: අව්වේ සුව කිරීමෙන් පොත්ත තද වී කල් තබා ගත හැකි කාලය මාස 6කට වඩා දීර්ඝ වේ.
activities.why_ta: வெயிலில் பதப்படுத்துவது தோலை உறுதியாக்கி 6 மாதங்களுக்கு மேல் கெடாமல் வைத்திருக்கும்.

stages.description_si: අස්වනු නෙළා අව්වේ සුව කරන්න.

fertilization.why: Shallow feeder — all basal near surface.
fertilization.why_si: නොගැඹුරු මුල් සහිතයි — සියලු මූලික පොහොර මතුපිටට ආසන්නව.
fertilization.why_ta: ஆழமற்ற வேர் — எல்லா அடியுரமும் மேற்பரப்புக்கு அருகில்.

fertilization.why_si: බල්බ සෑදීම — නයිට්‍රජන් අඩු කර, පොටෑසියම් වැඩි කරන්න.
fertilization.why_ta: குமிழ் உருவாக்கம் — நைட்ரஜனைக் குறைத்து, பொட்டாசியத்தை அதிகரியுங்கள்.

irrigation.notes: Stop irrigation 2 weeks before harvest — critical for storage quality.
irrigation.notes_si: අස්වනු නෙළීමට සති 2කට පෙර ජලය දීම නවත්වන්න — ගබඩා ගුණාත්මකභාවයට අත්‍යවශ්‍යයි.
irrigation.notes_ta: அறுவடைக்கு 2 வாரங்களுக்கு முன் நீர்ப்பாசனத்தை நிறுத்துங்கள் — சேமிப்புத் தரத்துக்கு மிக அவசியம்.

diseases.name: Purple Blotch
diseases.symptoms: Purple-coloured lesions on leaves; premature leaf drying; reduced bulb size.
diseases.favorable_conditions: Humid conditions, prolonged leaf wetness, poor air circulation.
diseases.prevention: Good plant spacing. Avoid overhead irrigation. Remove infected leaves.
diseases.treatment: Mancozeb 80WP (2.5 g/L) or Iprodione (1.5 ml/L) every 7–10 days.
diseases.symptoms_si: කොළ මත දම් පැහැ තුවාල; කොළ කලින් වියළීම; බල්බවල ප්‍රමාණය අඩු වීම.
diseases.symptoms_ta: இலைகளில் ஊதா நிறப் புண்கள்; இலைகள் முன்கூட்டியே காய்தல்; குமிழ் அளவு குறைவு.
diseases.favorable_conditions_si: ආර්ද්‍ර තත්ත්ව, කොළ දිගු කලක් තෙත්ව පැවතීම, දුර්වල වාතාශ්‍රය.
diseases.favorable_conditions_ta: ஈரப்பதமான நிலை, இலைகள் நீண்ட நேரம் ஈரமாக இருத்தல், மோசமான காற்றோட்டம்.
diseases.prevention_si: පැළ අතර හොඳ පරතරය. ඉහළින් ජලය ඉසීමෙන් වළකින්න. ආසාදිත කොළ ඉවත් කරන්න.
diseases.prevention_ta: செடிகளுக்கிடையே நல்ல இடைவெளி. மேலிருந்து நீர் தெளிப்பதைத் தவிருங்கள். பாதிக்கப்பட்ட இலைகளை அகற்றுங்கள்.
diseases.treatment_si: Mancozeb 80WP (ලීටරයකට ග්‍රෑ. 2.5) හෝ Iprodione (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 1.5) දින 7–10කට වරක්.
diseases.treatment_ta: Mancozeb 80WP (லிட்டருக்கு 2.5 கி) அல்லது Iprodione (லிட்டருக்கு 1.5 மி.லி) 7–10 நாட்களுக்கு ஒருமுறை.

diseases.name: Downy Mildew
diseases.symptoms: Pale green to yellow patches on leaves; grey fungal growth on leaf surface in humid conditions.
diseases.favorable_conditions: Cool humid weather, heavy dew, overhead irrigation.
diseases.prevention: Crop rotation. Avoid overhead irrigation. Good air circulation.
diseases.treatment: Metalaxyl + Mancozeb (2.5 g/L) preventively in wet season.
diseases.symptoms_si: කොළ මත ලා කොළ සිට කහ දක්වා ලප; ආර්ද්‍ර තත්ත්වවලදී කොළ මතුපිට අළු පැහැ දිලීර වර්ධනය.
diseases.symptoms_ta: இலைகளில் வெளிர் பச்சை முதல் மஞ்சள் வரையான திட்டுகள்; ஈரப்பதமான நிலையில் இலை மேற்பரப்பில் சாம்பல் நிறப் பூஞ்சை வளர்ச்சி.
diseases.favorable_conditions_si: සිසිල් ආර්ද්‍ර කාලගුණය, අධික පිනි, ඉහළින් ජලය ඉසීම.
diseases.favorable_conditions_ta: குளிர்ந்த ஈரமான வானிலை, அதிக பனித்துளி, மேலிருந்து நீர் தெளிப்பு.
diseases.prevention_si: බෝග මාරුව. ඉහළින් ජලය ඉසීමෙන් වළකින්න. හොඳ වාතාශ්‍රය.
diseases.prevention_ta: பயிர்ச் சுழற்சி. மேலிருந்து நீர் தெளிப்பதைத் தவிருங்கள். நல்ல காற்றோட்டம்.
diseases.treatment_si: වැසි කාලයේ වැළැක්වීම සඳහා Metalaxyl + Mancozeb (ලීටරයකට ග්‍රෑ. 2.5).
diseases.treatment_ta: மழைக் காலத்தில் தடுப்பாக Metalaxyl + Mancozeb (லிட்டருக்கு 2.5 கி).

diseases.name: Bacterial Soft Rot
diseases.symptoms: Watery soft decay of bulbs; foul smell; affects stored bulbs.
diseases.favorable_conditions: High moisture, wounds during harvest, warm conditions.
diseases.prevention: Reduce irrigation 2 weeks before harvest. Handle bulbs carefully. Proper curing.
diseases.treatment: No chemical cure. Improve drainage and post-harvest handling.
diseases.symptoms_si: බල්බ ජලමය ලෙස මෘදුව දිරාපත් වීම; දුගඳ; ගබඩා කළ බල්බවලට බලපායි.
diseases.symptoms_ta: குமிழ்கள் நீர்த்தன்மையுடன் மென்மையாக அழுகுதல்; துர்நாற்றம்; சேமித்த குமிழ்களையும் பாதிக்கும்.
diseases.favorable_conditions_si: ඉහළ තෙතමනය, අස්වනු නෙළීමේදී වන තුවාල, උණුසුම් තත්ත්ව.
diseases.favorable_conditions_ta: அதிக ஈரப்பதம், அறுவடையின் போது ஏற்படும் காயங்கள், வெப்பமான நிலை.
diseases.prevention_si: අස්වනු නෙළීමට සති 2කට පෙර ජලය දීම අඩු කරන්න. බල්බ ප්‍රවේශමෙන් හසුරුවන්න. නිසි ලෙස සුව කරන්න.
diseases.prevention_ta: அறுவடைக்கு 2 வாரங்களுக்கு முன் நீர்ப்பாசனத்தைக் குறையுங்கள். குமிழ்களைக் கவனமாகக் கையாளுங்கள். சரியாகப் பதப்படுத்துங்கள்.
diseases.treatment_si: රසායනික ප්‍රතිකාරයක් නැත. ජලාපවහනය සහ අස්වනු නෙළීමෙන් පසු හැසිරවීම වැඩි දියුණු කරන්න.
diseases.treatment_ta: இரசாயன சிகிச்சை இல்லை. வடிகாலையும் அறுவடைக்குப் பிந்தைய கையாளுதலையும் மேம்படுத்துங்கள்.

pests.name: Thrips
pests.damage: Most damaging pest; causes silvery leaf streaks, curling, and reduced bulb size.
pests.identification: Tiny yellowish insects in leaf folds; silver scarring on leaves.
pests.prevention: Blue sticky traps. Avoid dense planting.
pests.treatment: Spinosad 45SC (0.3 ml/L) or Fipronil. Rotate chemical classes to avoid resistance.
pests.prevention_si: නිල් ඇලෙන උගුල්. ඝනව සිටුවීමෙන් වළකින්න.
pests.prevention_ta: நீல ஒட்டும் பொறிகள். அடர்த்தியாக நடுவதைத் தவிருங்கள்.
pests.treatment_si: Spinosad 45SC (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 0.3) හෝ Fipronil. ප්‍රතිරෝධය වැළැක්වීමට රසායනික වර්ග මාරුවෙන් මාරුවට භාවිත කරන්න.
pests.treatment_ta: Spinosad 45SC (லிட்டருக்கு 0.3 மி.லி) அல்லது Fipronil. எதிர்ப்புத்திறனைத் தவிர்க்க இரசாயன வகைகளை மாற்றி மாற்றிப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள்.
pests.damage_si: වඩාත්ම හානිකර පළිබෝධය; කොළ මත රිදී පැහැති ඉරි, කොඩවීම සහ බල්බවල ප්‍රමාණය අඩු වීම ඇති කරයි.
pests.damage_ta: மிகச் சேதம் விளைவிக்கும் பூச்சி; இலைகளில் வெள்ளிக் கோடுகள், சுருள், குமிழ் அளவுக் குறைவு ஏற்படுத்தும்.
pests.identification_si: කොළ නැමුම් තුළ කුඩා කහ පැහැති කෘමීන්; කොළ මත රිදී පැහැති කැළැල්.
pests.identification_ta: இலை மடிப்புகளில் சிறிய மஞ்சள் பூச்சிகள்; இலைகளில் வெள்ளி நிறத் தழும்புகள்.

pests.name: Onion Maggot
pests.damage: Larvae attack roots and bulb base causing rotting and plant collapse.
pests.identification: Wilting plants; maggots in soil around root zone; soft decaying base.
pests.prevention: Crop rotation. Avoid planting in infested fields.
pests.treatment: Chlorpyrifos granules at planting.
pests.prevention_si: බෝග මාරුව. ආසාදිත කෙත්වල සිටුවීමෙන් වළකින්න.
pests.prevention_ta: பயிர்ச் சுழற்சி. பாதிக்கப்பட்ட வயல்களில் நடுவதைத் தவிருங்கள்.
pests.treatment_si: සිටුවන විට Chlorpyrifos කැට.
pests.treatment_ta: நடவின் போது Chlorpyrifos குருணைகள்.
pests.damage_si: කීටයෝ මුල් සහ බල්බයේ පාමුලට පහර දී කුණුවීම සහ පැළ ඇද වැටීම ඇති කරති.
pests.damage_ta: புழுக்கள் வேர்களையும் குமிழின் அடிப்பகுதியையும் தாக்கி அழுகலையும் செடி சரிவையும் ஏற்படுத்தும்.
pests.identification_si: මැලවෙන පැළ; මුල් කලාපය වටා පසේ පණුවන්; මෘදුව දිරාපත් වන පාමුල.
pests.identification_ta: வாடும் செடிகள்; வேர்ப் பகுதியைச் சுற்றி மண்ணில் புழுக்கள்; மென்மையாக அழுகும் அடிப்பகுதி.

pests.name: Aphid
pests.damage: Sucks sap; causes leaf curling; may transmit viral diseases.
pests.identification: Colonies on young leaves.
pests.prevention: Yellow sticky traps. Neem oil spray.
pests.treatment: Dimethoate 40EC (1.5 ml/L).
pests.prevention_si: කහ ඇලෙන උගුල්. කොහොඹ තෙල් ඉසීම.
pests.prevention_ta: மஞ்சள் ஒட்டும் பொறிகள். வேப்ப எண்ணெய் தெளிப்பு.
pests.treatment_si: Dimethoate 40EC (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 1.5).
pests.treatment_ta: Dimethoate 40EC (லிட்டருக்கு 1.5 மி.லி).
pests.damage_si: යුෂ උරා බොයි; කොළ කොඩවීම ඇති කරයි; වෛරස රෝග පැතිරවිය හැක.
pests.damage_ta: சாற்றை உறிஞ்சும்; இலைச் சுருளை ஏற்படுத்தும்; வைரஸ் நோய்களைப் பரப்பலாம்.
pests.identification_si: ළපටි කොළ මත ජනපද.
pests.identification_ta: இளம் இலைகளில் கூட்டங்கள்.

risks.name: Rain at Harvest
risks.description: Wet conditions re-sprout harvested bulbs and promote neck rot.
risks.mitigation: Time harvest for dry weather. Cure immediately after pulling.
risks.description_si: තෙත් තත්ත්ව නිසා නෙළූ බල්බ නැවත පැළ ලන අතර බෙල්ල කුණුවීම වැඩි වේ.
risks.description_ta: ஈரமான நிலை அறுவடை செய்த குமிழ்களை மீண்டும் முளைக்கச் செய்து கழுத்து அழுகலை அதிகரிக்கும்.
risks.signs_si: කොළ පැළ ලන බල්බ, මෘදු බෙල්ල.
risks.signs_ta: பச்சை முளை விடும் குமிழ்கள், மென்மையான கழுத்து.
risks.mitigation_si: වියළි කාලගුණයක් සඳහා අස්වනු නෙළීම සැලසුම් කරන්න. ගැලවූ වහාම සුව කරන්න.
risks.mitigation_ta: வறண்ட வானிலைக்கு ஏற்ப அறுவடையைத் திட்டமிடுங்கள். பிடுங்கியவுடன் பதப்படுத்துங்கள்.

risks.name: Planting Diseased Sets
risks.description: Infected sets spread disease to entire crop.
risks.signs: Early plant death, ring rot in bulbs.
risks.mitigation: Use certified or own disease-free sets only. Dip in Mancozeb solution before planting.
risks.description_si: ආසාදිත බීජ ළූණු මුළු බෝගයටම රෝගය පතුරුවයි.
risks.description_ta: பாதிக்கப்பட்ட விதை வெங்காயம் முழுப் பயிருக்கும் நோயைப் பரப்பும்.
risks.signs_si: පැළ කලින් මිය යාම, බල්බවල වළලු කුණුවීම.
risks.signs_ta: செடிகள் முன்கூட்டியே இறத்தல், குமிழ்களில் வளைய அழுகல்.
risks.mitigation_si: සහතික කළ හෝ තමන්ගේම රෝගවලින් තොර බීජ ළූණු පමණක් භාවිත කරන්න. සිටුවීමට පෙර Mancozeb ද්‍රාවණයක ගිල්වන්න.
risks.mitigation_ta: சான்றளிக்கப்பட்ட அல்லது சொந்த நோயற்ற விதை வெங்காயத்தை மட்டும் பயன்படுத்துங்கள். நடுவதற்கு முன் Mancozeb கரைசலில் நனையுங்கள்.

harvest.method: Pull by hand. Do not bruise. Remove soil.
harvest.post_harvest: Sun cure 5–7 days. Grade. Store in slatted open trays in cool ventilated shade. Shelf life 6–8 months.
harvest.method_si: අතින් ගලවන්න. තැලීමට ඉඩ නොදෙන්න. පස ඉවත් කරන්න.
harvest.method_ta: கையால் பிடுங்குங்கள். நசுங்க விடாதீர்கள். மண்ணை அகற்றுங்கள்.
harvest.post_harvest_si: දින 5–7ක් අව්වේ සුව කරන්න. ශ්‍රේණිගත කරන්න. සිසිල්, වාතාශ්‍රය ඇති සෙවණක විවෘත ලීසි තැටිවල ගබඩා කරන්න. කල් තබා ගත හැකි කාලය මාස 6–8.
harvest.post_harvest_ta: 5–7 நாட்கள் வெயிலில் பதப்படுத்துங்கள். தரம் பிரியுங்கள். குளிர்ந்த, காற்றோட்டமுள்ள நிழலில் திறந்த பலகைத் தட்டுகளில் சேமியுங்கள். 6–8 மாதங்கள் கெடாமல் இருக்கும்.
indicators_si: බල්බයේ පොත්ත වියළී කඩදාසි මෙන් වේ
indicators_ta: குமிழ்த் தோல் காய்ந்து காகிதம் போல் இருக்கும்

Red Onion.growth_stages_text: Red onion cultivation follows several important growth stages including germination, seedling establishment, vegetative growth, bulb initiation, bulb enlargement, maturation, and harvesting. Seeds or bulbs usually sprout within 5–10 days under suitable environmental conditions. During the seedling stage, roots and leaves develop rapidly to establish healthy plants. Vegetative growth continues for approximately 30–45 days, during which plants produce leaves that support future bulb formation. Bulb initiation begins when plants receive favorable temperature and day-length conditions. This is followed by bulb enlargement, where nutrients and carbohydrates accumulate in the bulbs. As the crop matures, the leaves gradually turn yellow and begin to fall over, indicating readiness for harvest. Harvesting is usually carried out between 80–110 days after planting when bulbs have reached their full size and maturity.
Red Onion.management_text: A typical crop management schedule begins with land preparation and planting. Well-decomposed organic manure or compost is incorporated into the soil before planting to improve fertility and soil structure. Red onions are commonly planted using bulbs or seedlings at a spacing of approximately 10–15 cm between plants and 20–30 cm between rows. Proper spacing improves air circulation, reduces disease incidence, and allows bulbs to develop uniformly. Weed control is particularly important during the early growth stages because weeds compete with onion plants for nutrients, water, and sunlight.
Red Onion.disease_management_text: Fertilizer management is essential for achieving high yields and good bulb quality. Basal fertilizer applications containing phosphorus and potassium are usually applied during land preparation to promote root development and early growth. Nitrogen is applied in split doses during vegetative growth to encourage healthy leaf development, which directly influences bulb size. Potassium is particularly important during bulb formation and enlargement because it improves bulb quality, storage life, and resistance to diseases. Excessive nitrogen application during late growth stages should be avoided because it can delay bulb maturation and reduce storage quality.
Red Onion.risk_mitigation_text: Irrigation management plays a critical role throughout the crop cycle. Adequate moisture is required during germination and early growth to ensure uniform plant establishment. During bulb initiation and enlargement, regular irrigation supports proper bulb development and prevents yield reduction. However, excessive watering should be avoided because waterlogged conditions encourage fungal diseases and bulb rot. Irrigation is usually reduced or stopped one to two weeks before harvest to allow bulbs to mature properly and improve storage quality. Disease and pest management are among the most important aspects of red onion production. Thrips are one of the most damaging pests and feed on leaves, causing silvery streaks, curling, and reduced photosynthesis. Onion maggots attack roots and bulbs, causing rotting and plant death. Aphids feed on plant sap and can transmit viral diseases. Purple blotch disease appears as purple-colored lesions on leaves, reducing photosynthetic activity and yield. Downy mildew causes pale green or yellow patches on leaves followed by fungal growth under humid conditions. Bacterial soft rot affects bulbs during growth and storage, causing soft, watery decay with a foul odor. These problems can be minimized through proper field sanitation, crop rotation, use of disease-free planting material, balanced fertilization, good drainage, and integrated pest management practices. Risk mitigation strategies are important for maintaining stable red onion production and reducing losses from environmental stresses. During periods of heavy rainfall, proper drainage systems should be maintained to prevent waterlogging and disease outbreaks. During drought conditions, efficient irrigation methods and mulching can help conserve soil moisture and reduce plant stress. Farmers should regularly monitor fields for early signs of pest and disease infestations and take timely corrective actions. Crop rotation, use of certified planting materials, balanced nutrient management, and proper storage practices help improve crop health and productivity. These measures ensure consistent bulb yields, improved bulb quality, longer storage life, and greater resilience to changing climatic conditions and environmental challenges.
Red Onion.overview_si: ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ “රතු ළූණු” ලෙස හැඳින්වෙන රතු ළූණු (Allium cepa var. aggregatum — ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ බහුලව වගා කෙරෙන කුඩා ළූණු වර්ගය) Amaryllidaceae කුලයට අයත් වැදගත් බල්බ එළවළු බෝගයකි. උණුසුම් දේශගුණය සහ හොඳින් ජලය බැස යන පස නිසා එය අනුරාධපුරය, පොළොන්නරුව, හම්බන්තොට වැනි වියළි සහ අතරමැදි කලාපවල බහුලව වගා කෙරේ. රතු ළූණු 20°C–30°C අතර උෂ්ණත්වයේ හොඳින් වැඩෙන අතර, pH 5.5–6.8 අතර, හොඳින් ජලය බැස යන වැලි ලෝම හෝ ලෝම පසක් අවශ්‍ය වේ. නිසි බල්බ වර්ධනයට සහ මේරීමට මධ්‍යස්ථ වර්ෂාව, පාලිත ජලසම්පාදනය සහ පූර්ණ හිරු එළිය අවශ්‍යය. ශ්‍රී ලාංකික ආහාර පිසීමේ ප්‍රධාන අමුද්‍රව්‍යයක් වන රතු ළූණු ව්‍යංජන, සම්බෝල සහ විවිධ සාම්ප්‍රදායික ආහාර සඳහා බහුලව භාවිත වන අතර, එහි තද රසය සහ පෝෂණීය ප්‍රතිලාභ නිසා අගය කෙරේ. ප්‍රභේදය සහ වගා තත්ත්ව අනුව සිටුවීමෙන් දින 80–110ක් පමණ ගත වූ පසු මේරේ. උෂ්ණත්වය, පාංශු තෙතමනය, වර්ෂාව, හිරු එළිය, ආර්ද්‍රතාව සහ පසේ සාරවත්බව වගාවට බලපාන ප්‍රධාන සාධක වේ. ත්‍රිප්ස්, ළූණු පණුවා, කුඩිත්තා, දම් පැල්ලම් රෝගය, ඩවුනි මිල්ඩිව් රෝගය සහ බැක්ටීරියා මෘදු කුණුවීම පොදු පළිබෝධ හා රෝග වන අතර, නිසි ලෙස පාලනය නොකළහොත් ඒවා අස්වැන්න සහ බල්බවල ගුණාත්මකභාවය බෙහෙවින් අඩු කරයි.
Red Onion.overview_ta: இலங்கையில் “ரத்து லூனு” என அழைக்கப்படும் சின்ன வெங்காயம் (Allium cepa var. aggregatum — இலங்கையில் பொதுவாகப் பயிரிடப்படும் சிறிய வெங்காய வகை), Amaryllidaceae குடும்பத்தைச் சேர்ந்த முக்கியமான குமிழ்க் காய்கறிப் பயிர். வெப்பமான காலநிலையும் நன்கு நீர் வடியும் மண்ணும் காரணமாக அனுராதபுரம், பொலன்னறுவை, அம்பாந்தோட்டை போன்ற உலர் மற்றும் இடை வலயங்களில் பரவலாகப் பயிரிடப்படுகிறது. சின்ன வெங்காயம் 20°C–30°C வெப்பநிலையில் நன்றாக வளரும்; pH 5.5–6.8 உள்ள, நன்கு நீர் வடியும் மணல் கலந்த இருமண் அல்லது இருமண் தேவை. சரியான குமிழ் வளர்ச்சி மற்றும் முதிர்ச்சிக்கு மிதமான மழை, கட்டுப்படுத்தப்பட்ட நீர்ப்பாசனம், முழுச் சூரிய ஒளி அவசியம். இலங்கைச் சமையலின் முக்கியப் பொருளான சின்ன வெங்காயம் கறி, சம்பல் மற்றும் பல்வேறு பாரம்பரிய உணவுகளுக்குப் பரவலாகப் பயன்படுகிறது; அதன் காரமான சுவைக்கும் ஊட்டச்சத்து நன்மைகளுக்கும் மதிப்புண்டு. இனம் மற்றும் வளர்ப்பு நிலைமைகளைப் பொறுத்து நடவு செய்து சுமார் 80–110 நாட்களில் முற்றும். வெப்பநிலை, மண் ஈரப்பதம், மழை, சூரிய ஒளி, காற்று ஈரப்பதம், மண் வளம் ஆகியவை சாகுபடியைப் பாதிக்கும் முக்கியக் காரணிகள். இலைப்பேன், வெங்காயப் புழு, அசுவினி, ஊதா கறை நோய், அடிச்சாம்பல் நோய், பாக்டீரியா மென் அழுகல் ஆகியவை பொதுவான பூச்சிகளும் நோய்களும்; சரியாகக் கட்டுப்படுத்தாவிட்டால் இவை மகசூலையும் குமிழின் தரத்தையும் பெருமளவு குறைக்கும்.

Leeks.overview: Leeks are a cool-climate vegetable crop belonging to the Amaryllidaceae family and scientifically known as Allium ampeloprasum var. porrum. In Sri Lanka, leeks are mainly cultivated in cooler up-country regions such as Nuwara Eliya, Badulla, and Kandy where temperatures are favorable for growth. Leeks grow best in temperatures between 13°C and 24°C and require fertile, well-drained loamy soil rich in organic matter with a soil pH ranging from 6.0 to 7.0. The crop requires moderate rainfall, regular irrigation, and good sunlight exposure for proper stem development and healthy growth. Leeks are valued for their long edible white stems and are widely used in soups, salads, and vegetable dishes due to their mild onion-like flavor and nutritional benefits. The crop is generally harvested within 90 to 120 days after planting depending on the variety and growing conditions. Important factors affecting leek cultivation include temperature, soil moisture, sunlight, rainfall, humidity, and soil fertility. Common pests and diseases affecting leeks include leaf miners, thrips, onion maggots, purple blotch disease, and fungal infections, which can reduce crop quality and yield if not properly managed.

stages.name: Land Preparation
stages.description: Prepare deep fertile soil for long white stem development.

activities.title: Deep plough to 35 cm
activities.description: Fine tilth. Level well. Form beds.
activities.why: Leeks need deep soil for the long white stem to develop below ground.
activities.description_si: පස සියුම් කරන්න. හොඳින් සමතලා කරන්න. පාත්ති සාදන්න.
activities.description_ta: மண்ணை நுண்மையாக்குங்கள். நன்றாகச் சமன்செய்யுங்கள். பாத்திகள் அமையுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: පොළොව යට දිගු සුදු කඳ වර්ධනය වීමට ලීක්ස්වලට ගැඹුරු පසක් අවශ්‍යය.
activities.why_ta: தரைக்குக் கீழ் நீண்ட வெண்ணிறத் தண்டு வளர லீக்ஸுக்கு ஆழமான மண் தேவை.

activities.title: Apply compost
activities.description: Incorporate 15 t/ha compost.
activities.why: Leeks are heavy feeders. Rich organic base is essential.
activities.description_si: හෙක්ටයාරයකට ටොන් 15ක් කොම්පෝස්ට් පසට මිශ්‍ර කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: எக்டேருக்கு 15 டன் மக்கிய உரத்தை மண்ணுடன் கலந்துவிடுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: ලීක්ස් පෝෂක බහුලව අවශ්‍ය බෝගයකි. කාබනික ද්‍රව්‍ය බහුල පදනමක් අත්‍යවශ්‍යයි.
activities.why_ta: லீக்ஸ் அதிக ஊட்டம் தேவைப்படும் பயிர். கரிமப் பொருள் நிறைந்த அடித்தளம் அவசியம்.

stages.description_si: දිගු සුදු කඳ වර්ධනයට ගැඹුරු සාරවත් පසක් සකස් කරන්න.
stages.description_ta: நீண்ட வெண்ணிறத் தண்டு வளர்ச்சிக்கு ஆழமான வளமான மண்ணைத் தயார்செய்யுங்கள்.

stages.name: Transplanting

activities.title: Transplant 40–50 day seedlings into furrows
activities.description: Plant in 15 cm deep furrows at 15×30 cm spacing. Drop plant in, do not backfill yet.
activities.why: Deep planting in furrow promotes white stem (blanching) development.
activities.description_si: සෙ.මී. 15×30 පරතරයෙන් සෙ.මී. 15ක් ගැඹුරු ඇළවල සිටුවන්න. පැළය ඇතුළට දමන්න, තවම පස නොවසන්න.
activities.description_ta: 15×30 செ.மீ இடைவெளியில் 15 செ.மீ ஆழச் சால்களில் நடுங்கள். நாற்றை உள்ளே இடுங்கள், இப்போதே மண்ணால் மூட வேண்டாம்.
activities.why_si: ඇළවල ගැඹුරට සිටුවීම සුදු කඳ වර්ධනයට (සුදු කිරීමට) උපකාරී වේ.
activities.why_ta: சால்களில் ஆழமாக நடுவது வெண்ணிறத் தண்டு வளர்ச்சிக்கு (வெண்மையாக்கலுக்கு) உதவும்.

activities.title: Water daily for 2 weeks
activities.description: Gentle watering at base.
activities.why: Deep-planted seedlings need moisture to establish.
activities.description_si: පැළයේ මුලට මෘදුව ජලය දීම.
activities.description_ta: செடியின் அடியில் மெதுவாக நீர் ஊற்றுதல்.
activities.why_si: ගැඹුරට සිටුවූ පැළ ස්ථාපිත වීමට තෙතමනය අවශ්‍යය.
activities.why_ta: ஆழமாக நட்ட நாற்றுகள் நிலைபெற ஈரப்பதம் தேவை.

stages.description_si: පැළ ස්ථාපිත කරන්න.

stages.name: Leaf Development

activities.title: Top dressing 1
activities.description: Urea 100 kg/ha + MOP 50 kg/ha.
activities.why: High nitrogen for the multi-leaf development phase.
activities.description_si: යූරියා හෙක්ටයාරයකට කි.ග්‍රෑ. 100 + MOP කි.ග්‍රෑ. 50.
activities.description_ta: எக்டேருக்கு 100 கி.கி யூரியா + 50 கி.கி MOP.
activities.why_si: කොළ රැසක් වර්ධනය වන අවධියට වැඩි නයිට්‍රජන්.
activities.why_ta: பல இலைகள் வளரும் நிலைக்கு அதிக நைட்ரஜன்.

activities.title: First earthing up
activities.description: Mound soil 10 cm up around plant stems.
activities.why: Earthing up excludes light and blanches the stem white.
activities.description_si: පැළවල කඳන් වටා සෙ.මී. 10ක් ඉහළට පස් ගොඩ කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: செடித் தண்டுகளைச் சுற்றி 10 செ.மீ உயரத்துக்கு மண்ணைக் குவியுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: පස් කෙටීමෙන් ආලෝකය වැසී කඳ සුදු පැහැ වේ.
activities.why_ta: மண் அணைப்பது ஒளியைத் தடுத்துத் தண்டை வெண்மையாக்கும்.

activities.title: Scout for thrips and leaf miner
activities.description: Check leaves for silvering (thrips) and mines (leaf miner).
activities.why: Both pests cause leaf damage that reduces photosynthesis.
activities.title_si: ත්‍රිප්ස් සහ පත්‍ර සුරංගකාරයා සඳහා පරීක්ෂා කරන්න
activities.title_ta: இலைப்பேன், இலைச் சுரங்கப் புழுவுக்காக ஆய்வு செய்தல்
activities.description_si: කොළවල රිදී පැහැය (ත්‍රිප්ස්) සහ සුරං (පත්‍ර සුරංගකාරයා) පරීක්ෂා කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: இலைகளில் வெள்ளி நிறம் (இலைப்பேன்), சுரங்கங்கள் (இலைச் சுரங்கப் புழு) உள்ளனவா எனச் சோதியுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: මෙම පළිබෝධ දෙකම ප්‍රභාසංශ්ලේෂණය අඩු කරන කොළ හානියක් ඇති කරයි.
activities.why_ta: இவ்விரு பூச்சிகளும் ஒளிச்சேர்க்கையைக் குறைக்கும் இலைச் சேதத்தை ஏற்படுத்தும்.

stages.description_si: ශක්තිමත් පත්‍ර රාමුවක් ගොඩනඟන්න.

stages.name: Stem Development
stages.description: Continue earthing up for long white stem.

activities.title: Top dressing 2
activities.description: Urea 75 kg/ha + MOP 75 kg/ha.
activities.why: Sustains leaf growth and stem thickening.
activities.description_si: යූරියා හෙක්ටයාරයකට කි.ග්‍රෑ. 75 + MOP කි.ග්‍රෑ. 75.
activities.description_ta: எக்டேருக்கு 75 கி.கி யூரியா + 75 கி.கி MOP.
activities.why_si: කොළ වර්ධනය සහ කඳ මහත් වීම පවත්වා ගනී.
activities.why_ta: இலை வளர்ச்சியையும் தண்டு தடிப்பையும் பேணும்.

activities.title: Second earthing up
activities.description: Mound soil further up stems.
activities.why: Second earthing extends the white stem length — improves market grade.
activities.description_si: කඳන් දිගේ තවත් ඉහළට පස් ගොඩ කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: தண்டுகளில் மேலும் உயரத்துக்கு மண்ணைக் குவியுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: දෙවන පස් කෙටීමෙන් සුදු කඳේ දිග වැඩි වී වෙළඳපොළ ශ්‍රේණිය ඉහළ යයි.
activities.why_ta: இரண்டாவது மண் அணைப்பு வெண்ணிறத் தண்டின் நீளத்தை அதிகரித்துச் சந்தைத் தரத்தை உயர்த்தும்.

activities.title: Maintain regular irrigation
activities.description: Water every 4 days.
activities.why: Consistent moisture prevents pithy stems.
activities.description_si: දින 4කට වරක් ජලය දෙන්න.
activities.description_ta: 4 நாட்களுக்கு ஒருமுறை நீர் பாய்ச்சுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: නොකඩවා තෙතමනය කඳන් පිදුරු වැනි වීම වළක්වයි.
activities.why_ta: தொடர்ச்சியான ஈரப்பதம் தண்டுகள் பஞ்சு போலாவதைத் தடுக்கும்.

stages.description_si: දිගු සුදු කඳක් සඳහා පස් කෙටීම දිගටම කරන්න.
stages.description_ta: நீண்ட வெண்ணிறத் தண்டுக்கு மண் அணைப்பைத் தொடருங்கள்.

stages.name: Harvest
stages.description: Harvest when stems reach desired thickness.

activities.title: Check stem diameter
activities.description: Harvest when white stem is 2–3 cm diameter.
activities.why: Leeks can remain in ground longer than most vegetables if needed.
activities.description_si: සුදු කඳේ විෂ්කම්භය සෙ.මී. 2–3 වූ විට අස්වනු නෙළන්න.
activities.description_ta: வெண்ணிறத் தண்டின் விட்டம் 2–3 செ.மீ ஆனதும் அறுவடை செய்யுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: අවශ්‍ය නම් ලීක්ස් බොහෝ එළවළුවලට වඩා වැඩි කාලයක් පසේ තබා ගත හැක.
activities.why_ta: தேவைப்பட்டால் லீக்ஸைப் பெரும்பாலான காய்கறிகளை விட நீண்ட காலம் மண்ணில் வைத்திருக்கலாம்.

activities.title: Dig and harvest
activities.description: Use fork to loosen soil. Pull carefully.
activities.why: Leek stems are fragile — avoid bending or breaking.
activities.description_si: ගෑරුප්පුවකින් පස ලිහිල් කරන්න. ප්‍රවේශමෙන් ගලවන්න.
activities.description_ta: முட்கரண்டியால் மண்ணைத் தளர்த்துங்கள். கவனமாகப் பிடுங்குங்கள்.
activities.why_si: ලීක්ස් කඳන් බිඳෙනසුලුයි — නැමීමෙන් හෝ කැඩීමෙන් වළකින්න.
activities.why_ta: லீக்ஸ் தண்டுகள் உடையக்கூடியவை — வளைப்பதையும் உடைப்பதையும் தவிருங்கள்.

stages.description_si: කඳන් අපේක්ෂිත මහතට පැමිණි විට අස්වනු නෙළන්න.
stages.description_ta: தண்டுகள் விரும்பிய தடிமனை அடைந்ததும் அறுவடை செய்யுங்கள்.

fertilization.why_si: පෝෂක බහුලව අවශ්‍ය බෝගයට පෝෂක බහුල පදනමක් අවශ්‍යය.
fertilization.why_ta: அதிக ஊட்டம் தேவைப்படும் பயிருக்கு வளமான அடித்தளம் தேவை.

irrigation.notes: Consistent moisture throughout. Leeks tolerate cooler conditions but not drought.
irrigation.notes_si: මුළු කාලය පුරාම නොකඩවා තෙතමනය. ලීක්ස් සිසිල් තත්ත්වවලට ඔරොත්තු දුන්නද නියඟයට ඔරොත්තු නොදෙයි.
irrigation.notes_ta: முழுக் காலமும் தொடர்ச்சியான ஈரப்பதம். லீக்ஸ் குளிர்ந்த நிலைமைகளைத் தாங்கும்; ஆனால் வறட்சியைத் தாங்காது.

diseases.name: Purple Blotch
diseases.symptoms: Purple or brown lesions on leaves; gradually spreads causing premature leaf death.
diseases.favorable_conditions: High humidity, wet weather, poor air circulation.
diseases.prevention: Good plant spacing. Avoid overhead irrigation. Remove infected leaves.
diseases.treatment: Mancozeb 80WP (2.5 g/L) or Iprodione (1.5 ml/L) every 7–10 days.
diseases.symptoms_si: කොළ මත දම් හෝ දුඹුරු තුවාල; ක්‍රමයෙන් පැතිරී කොළ කලින් මිය යාමට හේතු වේ.
diseases.symptoms_ta: இலைகளில் ஊதா அல்லது பழுப்புப் புண்கள்; படிப்படியாகப் பரவி இலைகள் முன்கூட்டியே இறக்கக் காரணமாகும்.
diseases.favorable_conditions_si: ඉහළ ආර්ද්‍රතාව, තෙත් කාලගුණය, දුර්වල වාතාශ්‍රය.
diseases.favorable_conditions_ta: அதிக ஈரப்பதம், ஈரமான வானிலை, மோசமான காற்றோட்டம்.
diseases.prevention_si: පැළ අතර හොඳ පරතරය. ඉහළින් ජලය ඉසීමෙන් වළකින්න. ආසාදිත කොළ ඉවත් කරන්න.
diseases.prevention_ta: செடிகளுக்கிடையே நல்ல இடைவெளி. மேலிருந்து நீர் தெளிப்பதைத் தவிருங்கள். பாதிக்கப்பட்ட இலைகளை அகற்றுங்கள்.
diseases.treatment_si: Mancozeb 80WP (ලීටරයකට ග්‍රෑ. 2.5) හෝ Iprodione (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 1.5) දින 7–10කට වරක්.
diseases.treatment_ta: Mancozeb 80WP (லிட்டருக்கு 2.5 கி) அல்லது Iprodione (லிட்டருக்கு 1.5 மி.லி) 7–10 நாட்களுக்கு ஒருமுறை.

diseases.name: Fungal Stem Rot
diseases.symptoms: Yellowing, rotting, and collapse of leaves; white fluffy fungal growth at stem base.
diseases.favorable_conditions: High humidity, waterlogged soil, poor drainage.
diseases.prevention: Well-drained raised beds. Crop rotation. Remove infected plants.
diseases.treatment: Copper fungicide drench or Thiram spray at base of plant.
diseases.symptoms_si: කොළ කහ වී, කුණු වී ඇද වැටීම; කඳේ පාමුල සුදු පුළුන් වැනි දිලීර වර්ධනය.
diseases.symptoms_ta: இலைகள் மஞ்சளாகி, அழுகிச் சரிதல்; தண்டின் அடியில் வெண்மையான பஞ்சு போன்ற பூஞ்சை வளர்ச்சி.
diseases.favorable_conditions_si: ඉහළ ආර්ද්‍රතාව, ජලය රැඳුණු පස, දුර්වල ජලාපවහනය.
diseases.favorable_conditions_ta: அதிக ஈரப்பதம், நீர் தேங்கிய மண், மோசமான வடிகால்.
diseases.prevention_si: හොඳින් ජලය බැස යන උස් කළ පාත්ති. බෝග මාරුව. ආසාදිත පැළ ඉවත් කරන්න.
diseases.prevention_ta: நன்கு நீர் வடியும் உயர்த்திய பாத்திகள். பயிர்ச் சுழற்சி. பாதிக்கப்பட்ட செடிகளை அகற்றுங்கள்.
diseases.treatment_si: පැළයේ පාමුලට තඹ දිලීර නාශකයකින් පස තෙමීම හෝ Thiram ඉසීම.
diseases.treatment_ta: செடியின் அடியில் செம்புப் பூஞ்சைக்கொல்லியால் மண்ணை நனைத்தல் அல்லது Thiram தெளிப்பு.

pests.name: Leaf Miner
pests.damage: Creates pale winding tunnels inside leaves; reduces photosynthesis.
pests.identification: Visible pale serpentine trails in leaf tissue.
pests.prevention: Remove heavily mined leaves. Avoid excessive nitrogen.
pests.treatment: Abamectin 1.8EC (0.5 ml/L) or Cyromazine if infestation is high.
pests.prevention_si: දැඩි ලෙස සුරං හාරා ඇති කොළ ඉවත් කරන්න. අධික නයිට්‍රජන් යෙදීමෙන් වළකින්න.
pests.prevention_ta: அதிகம் சுரங்கம் அமைக்கப்பட்ட இலைகளை அகற்றுங்கள். அதிக நைட்ரஜன் இடுவதைத் தவிருங்கள்.
pests.treatment_si: ආසාදනය වැඩි නම් Abamectin 1.8EC (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 0.5) හෝ Cyromazine.
pests.treatment_ta: தாக்குதல் அதிகமாக இருந்தால் Abamectin 1.8EC (லிட்டருக்கு 0.5 மி.லி) அல்லது Cyromazine.
pests.damage_si: කොළ ඇතුළත ලා පැහැ, සර්පිලාකාර උමං සාදයි; ප්‍රභාසංශ්ලේෂණය අඩු කරයි.
pests.damage_ta: இலைகளுக்குள் வெளிறிய வளைந்த சுரங்கங்களை அமைக்கும்; ஒளிச்சேர்க்கையைக் குறைக்கும்.
pests.identification_si: කොළ පටකයේ ලා පැහැ, සර්පිලාකාර ඉරි පෙනේ.
pests.identification_ta: இலைத் திசுவில் வெளிறிய வளைந்த கோடுகள் தெரியும்.

pests.name: Thrips
pests.damage: Sucks sap causing silvery patches, leaf curling, and drying.
pests.identification: Tiny yellowish insects in leaf folds; silvery scarring on leaves.
pests.prevention: Blue sticky traps. Reflective mulch. Avoid over-fertilisation.
pests.treatment: Spinosad 45SC (0.3 ml/L) or Fipronil spray. Apply early morning.
pests.prevention_si: නිල් ඇලෙන උගුල්. ආලෝකය පරාවර්තනය කරන වසුන්. අධික පොහොර යෙදීමෙන් වළකින්න.
pests.prevention_ta: நீல ஒட்டும் பொறிகள். ஒளியைப் பிரதிபலிக்கும் மூடாக்கு. அளவுக்கு மீறி உரமிடுவதைத் தவிருங்கள்.
pests.treatment_si: Spinosad 45SC (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 0.3) හෝ Fipronil ඉසීම. අලුයම යොදන්න.
pests.treatment_ta: Spinosad 45SC (லிட்டருக்கு 0.3 மி.லி) அல்லது Fipronil தெளிப்பு. அதிகாலையில் தெளியுங்கள்.
pests.damage_si: යුෂ උරා බීමෙන් රිදී පැහැති ලප, කොළ කොඩවීම සහ වියළීම ඇති කරයි.
pests.damage_ta: சாற்றை உறிஞ்சி வெள்ளித் திட்டுகள், இலைச் சுருள், காய்தல் ஆகியவற்றை ஏற்படுத்தும்.
pests.identification_si: කොළ නැමුම් තුළ කුඩා කහ පැහැති කෘමීන්; කොළ මත රිදී පැහැති කැළැල්.
pests.identification_ta: இலை மடிப்புகளில் சிறிய மஞ்சள் பூச்சிகள்; இலைகளில் வெள்ளி நிறத் தழும்புகள்.

pests.name: Onion Maggot
pests.damage: Damages roots and lower stems causing weak growth and rotting.
pests.identification: Wilting plants; white maggots visible in soil around root zone.
pests.prevention: Crop rotation. Avoid planting in previously affected soil.
pests.treatment: Chlorpyrifos granules at planting. Soil drench if attack is early.
pests.prevention_si: බෝග මාරුව. කලින් බලපෑමට ලක් වූ පසේ සිටුවීමෙන් වළකින්න.
pests.prevention_ta: பயிர்ச் சுழற்சி. முன்பு பாதிக்கப்பட்ட மண்ணில் நடுவதைத் தவிருங்கள்.
pests.treatment_si: සිටුවන විට Chlorpyrifos කැට. ප්‍රහාරය කලින්ම දුටුවහොත් පස තෙමීම.
pests.treatment_ta: நடவின் போது Chlorpyrifos குருணைகள். தாக்குதல் ஆரம்பத்திலேயே தெரிந்தால் மண்ணை நனைத்தல்.
pests.damage_si: මුල් සහ පහළ කඳට හානි කරමින් දුර්වල වර්ධනය සහ කුණුවීම ඇති කරයි.
pests.damage_ta: வேர்களையும் கீழ்த் தண்டையும் சேதப்படுத்தி வலுவற்ற வளர்ச்சியையும் அழுகலையும் ஏற்படுத்தும்.
pests.identification_si: මැලවෙන පැළ; මුල් කලාපය වටා පසේ සුදු පණුවන් පෙනේ.
pests.identification_ta: வாடும் செடிகள்; வேர்ப் பகுதியைச் சுற்றி மண்ணில் வெள்ளைப் புழுக்கள் தெரியும்.

risks.name: High Temperature (>24°C)
risks.description: Bolting and poor stem development.
risks.signs: Plants flower without thick stem formation.
risks.mitigation: Plant in cool season only. Nuwara Eliya and Badulla.
risks.description_si: කලින් මල් දණ්ඩ මතු වීම සහ කඳ වර්ධනය දුර්වල වීම.
risks.description_ta: முன்கூட்டியே பூந்தண்டு எழுதலும் தண்டு வளர்ச்சிக் குறைவும்.
risks.signs_si: මහත කඳක් නොසාදා පැළ මල් පිපේ.
risks.mitigation_si: සිසිල් කාලයේ පමණක් සිටුවන්න. නුවරඑළිය සහ බදුල්ල.
risks.mitigation_ta: குளிர்ந்த பருவத்தில் மட்டும் நடுங்கள். நுவரெலியா, பதுளை.

risks.name: Insufficient Earthing Up
risks.description: Short green stem — low market value.
risks.mitigation: Earth up twice: at 5 WAP and 10 WAP.
risks.description_si: කෙටි කොළ පැහැ කඳ — වෙළඳපොළ වටිනාකම අඩුය.
risks.description_ta: குட்டையான பச்சைத் தண்டு — சந்தை மதிப்பு குறைவு.
risks.signs_si: අස්වනු නෙළන විට කෙටි සුදු කඳ.
risks.mitigation_si: දෙවරක් පස් කොටන්න: සිටුවීමෙන් සති 5 සහ සති 10 දී.
risks.mitigation_ta: இருமுறை மண் அணையுங்கள்: நடவுக்குப் பின் 5ஆம், 10ஆம் வாரங்களில்.

harvest.method: Loosen soil with fork, pull plant carefully. Trim roots and top leaves.
harvest.frequency: Harvest over 2–3 weeks as plants reach size
harvest.post_harvest: Trim roots and outer leaves. Bunch in groups of 10. Store cool. Market within 5–7 days.
harvest.method_si: ගෑරුප්පුවකින් පස ලිහිල් කර, පැළය ප්‍රවේශමෙන් ගලවන්න. මුල් සහ ඉහළ කොළ කපා හරින්න.
harvest.method_ta: முட்கரண்டியால் மண்ணைத் தளர்த்தி, செடியைக் கவனமாகப் பிடுங்குங்கள். வேர்களையும் மேல் இலைகளையும் வெட்டுங்கள்.
harvest.frequency_si: පැළ ප්‍රමාණයට පැමිණෙන ආකාරයට සති 2–3ක් පුරා අස්වනු නෙළන්න
harvest.frequency_ta: செடிகள் அளவை அடையும் வரிசைப்படி 2–3 வாரங்களில் அறுவடை செய்தல்
harvest.post_harvest_si: මුල් සහ පිටත කොළ කපා හරින්න. 10 බැගින් මිටි බඳින්න. සිසිල්ව ගබඩා කරන්න. දින 5–7ක් ඇතුළත වෙළඳපොළට යවන්න.
harvest.post_harvest_ta: வேர்களையும் வெளி இலைகளையும் வெட்டுங்கள். 10 ஆகக் கட்டுகளாகக் கட்டுங்கள். குளிர்ச்சியாகச் சேமியுங்கள். 5–7 நாட்களுக்குள் சந்தைக்கு அனுப்புங்கள்.
indicators_si: කඳ තද හා ඝන ලෙස දැනේ

Leeks.growth_stages_text: Leek cultivation follows several important growth stages including germination, vegetative growth, stem thickening, and harvesting. Germination usually occurs within 7–14 days after sowing, while vegetative growth continues for several weeks depending on environmental conditions and nutrient availability. Stem thickening and elongation begin around 45–60 days after transplanting, and harvesting is generally carried out between 90–120 days when the stems become thick, long, tender, and reach marketable size. Farmers commonly use nursery-raised seedlings for transplanting and maintain proper spacing of approximately 15–20 cm between plants and 30–45 cm between rows to ensure healthy stem development and sufficient air circulation.
Leeks.management_text: Successful leek cultivation requires a week-by-week crop management schedule including nursery preparation, land preparation, transplanting, fertilizer application, irrigation, weed management, pest monitoring, and harvesting activities. Fertilizer application is important during vegetative growth and stem development stages, commonly using nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium fertilizers, and organic compost to improve plant vigor and stem quality. Irrigation frequency varies according to crop growth stages, with regular watering required during germination and stem development stages, while moderate irrigation is maintained during mature vegetative growth. Harvesting indicators include thick white stems, healthy green leaves, and proper stem length suitable for consumption and market use.
Leeks.disease_management_text: Disease and pest management are essential in successful leek cultivation. Leaf miners create tunnels inside leaves that reduce photosynthesis and plant health, while thrips suck plant sap causing silvery patches, curling, and drying of leaves. Onion maggots damage roots and lower stems, leading to weak growth and rotting symptoms. Purple blotch disease appears as purple or brown lesions on leaves, which gradually spread and reduce plant vigor, while fungal infections can cause leaf yellowing, rotting, and poor stem quality under humid conditions. These problems can be managed through proper field sanitation, balanced fertilizer use, crop rotation, proper spacing, removal of infected plants, and recommended pesticide or fungicide applications when necessary. Risk mitigation practices such as regular field monitoring, proper drainage management, timely irrigation, use of healthy seedlings, and climate-aware cultivation methods help reduce crop damage and improve overall productivity.
Leeks.overview_si: ලීක්ස් (Allium ampeloprasum var. porrum) Amaryllidaceae කුලයට අයත්, සිසිල් දේශගුණයක වැඩෙන එළවළු බෝගයකි. ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ ලීක්ස් ප්‍රධාන වශයෙන් වර්ධනයට හිතකර උෂ්ණත්වයක් ඇති නුවරඑළිය, බදුල්ල, මහනුවර වැනි සිසිල් උඩරට ප්‍රදේශවල වගා කෙරේ. ලීක්ස් 13°C–24°C අතර උෂ්ණත්වයේ හොඳින් වැඩෙන අතර, pH 6.0–7.0 අතර, කාබනික ද්‍රව්‍ය බහුල, හොඳින් ජලය බැස යන සාරවත් ලෝම පසක් අවශ්‍ය වේ. නිසි කඳ වර්ධනයට සහ නිරෝගී වර්ධනයට මධ්‍යස්ථ වර්ෂාව, නිතිපතා ජලසම්පාදනය සහ හොඳ හිරු එළිය අවශ්‍යය. ආහාරයට ගන්නා දිගු සුදු කඳ නිසා අගය කෙරෙන ලීක්ස්, එහි මෘදු ළූණු වැනි රසය සහ පෝෂණීය ප්‍රතිලාභ නිසා සුප්, සලාද සහ එළවළු ආහාර සඳහා බහුලව භාවිත වේ. ප්‍රභේදය සහ වගා තත්ත්ව අනුව සිටුවීමෙන් දින 90–120 අතර අස්වනු නෙළනු ලැබේ. උෂ්ණත්වය, පාංශු තෙතමනය, හිරු එළිය, වර්ෂාව, ආර්ද්‍රතාව සහ පසේ සාරවත්බව ලීක්ස් වගාවට බලපාන ප්‍රධාන සාධක වේ. පත්‍ර සුරංගකාරයා, ත්‍රිප්ස්, ළූණු පණුවා, දම් පැල්ලම් රෝගය සහ දිලීර ආසාදන ලීක්ස්වලට බලපාන පොදු පළිබෝධ හා රෝග වන අතර, නිසි ලෙස පාලනය නොකළහොත් ඒවා බෝගයේ ගුණාත්මකභාවය සහ අස්වැන්න අඩු කරයි.
Leeks.overview_ta: லீக்ஸ் (Allium ampeloprasum var. porrum), Amaryllidaceae குடும்பத்தைச் சேர்ந்த குளிர் காலநிலைக் காய்கறிப் பயிர். இலங்கையில் லீக்ஸ் முக்கியமாக வளர்ச்சிக்குச் சாதகமான வெப்பநிலை உள்ள நுவரெலியா, பதுளை, கண்டி போன்ற குளிர்ந்த மலைநாட்டுப் பகுதிகளில் பயிரிடப்படுகிறது. லீக்ஸ் 13°C–24°C வெப்பநிலையில் நன்றாக வளரும்; pH 6.0–7.0 உள்ள, கரிமப் பொருள் நிறைந்த, நன்கு நீர் வடியும் வளமான இருமண் தேவை. சரியான தண்டு வளர்ச்சி மற்றும் ஆரோக்கியமான வளர்ச்சிக்கு மிதமான மழை, தொடர்ச்சியான நீர்ப்பாசனம், நல்ல சூரிய ஒளி அவசியம். உண்ணக்கூடிய நீண்ட வெண்ணிறத் தண்டுகளுக்காக மதிக்கப்படும் லீக்ஸ், அதன் மென்மையான வெங்காயச் சுவையாலும் ஊட்டச்சத்தாலும் சூப், சாலட், காய்கறி உணவுகளுக்குப் பரவலாகப் பயன்படுகிறது. இனம் மற்றும் வளர்ப்பு நிலைமைகளைப் பொறுத்து நடவு செய்து 90–120 நாட்களில் அறுவடை செய்யப்படும். வெப்பநிலை, மண் ஈரப்பதம், சூரிய ஒளி, மழை, காற்று ஈரப்பதம், மண் வளம் ஆகியவை லீக்ஸ் சாகுபடியைப் பாதிக்கும் முக்கியக் காரணிகள். இலைச் சுரங்கப் புழு, இலைப்பேன், வெங்காயப் புழு, ஊதா கறை நோய், பூஞ்சைத் தொற்றுகள் ஆகியவை லீக்ஸைத் தாக்கும் பொதுவான பூச்சிகளும் நோய்களும்; சரியாகக் கட்டுப்படுத்தாவிட்டால் இவை பயிரின் தரத்தையும் மகசூலையும் குறைக்கும்.

Cowpea.overview: Cowpea, commonly known as “Vigna” or “Wandakka” in Sri Lanka, is a warm-season legume crop belonging to the Fabaceae family and scientifically known as Vigna unguiculata. It is widely cultivated across Sri Lanka, especially in dry and intermediate zones, due to its ability to tolerate drought conditions and grow in relatively poor soils. Cowpea grows best in temperatures between 20°C and 30°C and prefers well-drained sandy or loamy soils with a soil pH ranging from 5.5 to 7.5. The crop requires low to moderate rainfall, good sunlight exposure, and minimal irrigation once established, making it suitable for rainfed agriculture. Cowpea is an important source of plant protein and is commonly consumed in Sri Lankan curries and dry vegetable dishes. It also improves soil fertility through nitrogen fixation, making it beneficial in crop rotation systems. The crop generally matures within 60 to 90 days after planting depending on the variety. Important factors affecting cowpea cultivation include temperature, soil moisture, rainfall, sunlight, and soil fertility. Common pests and diseases include aphids, bean flies, pod borers, thrips, powdery mildew, and viral infections, which can reduce yield and seed quality if not properly managed.

stages.name: Land Preparation
stages.description: Minimal tillage needed — cowpea tolerates poor soils.

activities.title: Plough lightly to 20 cm
activities.description: Remove weeds. Break large clods.
activities.why: Cowpea tolerates poor soils but weeds in early stages cause significant yield loss.
activities.description_si: වල් පැළෑටි ඉවත් කරන්න. විශාල පස් කැට කඩන්න.
activities.description_ta: களைகளை அகற்றுங்கள். பெரிய மண் கட்டிகளை உடையுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: කව්පි සාරවත් නොවන පසට ඔරොත්තු දුන්නද, මුල් අවධිවල වල් පැළෑටි සැලකිය යුතු අස්වනු හානියක් ඇති කරයි.
activities.why_ta: காராமணி வளம் குறைந்த மண்ணைத் தாங்கும்; ஆனால் ஆரம்ப நிலைகளில் களைகள் கணிசமான மகசூல் இழப்பை ஏற்படுத்தும்.

stages.description_si: අවම සීසෑමක් ප්‍රමාණවත් — කව්පි සාරවත් නොවන පසට ඔරොත්තු දෙයි.
stages.description_ta: குறைந்த உழவே போதும் — காராமணி வளம் குறைந்த மண்ணைத் தாங்கும்.

stages.name: Sowing & Germination

activities.title: Sow 2 seeds per hole at 3 cm depth
activities.description: Space 20×45 cm. Cover and firm soil.
activities.why: Correct depth ensures rapid uniform germination.
activities.description_si: සෙ.මී. 20×45 පරතරය. පසින් වසා තද කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: 20×45 செ.மீ இடைவெளி. மண்ணால் மூடி அழுத்துங்கள்.
activities.why_si: නිවැරදි ගැඹුර වේගවත්, ඒකාකාර පැළවීම සහතික කරයි.
activities.why_ta: சரியான ஆழம் விரைவான, சீரான முளைப்பை உறுதிசெய்யும்.

activities.title: Thin to 1 plant per hole
activities.description: Remove weaker seedling once established.
activities.why: Avoids overcrowding and competition.
activities.title_si: වළකට එක් පැළයක් දක්වා විරල කරන්න
activities.description_si: ස්ථාපිත වූ පසු දුර්වල පැළය ඉවත් කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: நிலைபெற்ற பின் வலுவற்ற நாற்றை அகற்றுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: පැළ ඝන වීම සහ තරඟය වළක්වයි.
activities.why_ta: நெருக்கத்தையும் போட்டியையும் தவிர்க்கும்.

stages.description_si: නිවැරදි ගැඹුරට සෘජුව බීජ සිටුවන්න.

stages.name: Vegetative Growth

activities.title: Apply top dressing
activities.description: Urea 25 kg/ha + MOP 50 kg/ha. Keep nitrogen low — cowpea fixes its own.
activities.why: Low nitrogen — excess inhibits the nitrogen-fixing nodules.
activities.description_si: යූරියා හෙක්ටයාරයකට කි.ග්‍රෑ. 25 + MOP කි.ග්‍රෑ. 50. නයිට්‍රජන් අඩුවෙන් තබන්න — කව්පි තමන්ටම නයිට්‍රජන් තිර කර ගනී.
activities.description_ta: எக்டேருக்கு 25 கி.கி யூரியா + 50 கி.கி MOP. நைட்ரஜனைக் குறைவாக வையுங்கள் — காராமணி தானே நைட்ரஜனை நிலைநிறுத்தும்.
activities.why_si: අඩු නයිට්‍රජන් — අධික නයිට්‍රජන් නයිට්‍රජන් තිර කරන ගැටිති වර්ධනය වළක්වයි.
activities.why_ta: குறைந்த நைட்ரஜன் — அதிக நைட்ரஜன் நைட்ரஜனை நிலைநிறுத்தும் வேர் முடிச்சுகளைத் தடுக்கும்.

activities.title: First weeding
activities.description: Hand weed or hoe between rows carefully.
activities.why: Critical weed-free period for establishment.
activities.description_si: පේළි අතර ප්‍රවේශමෙන් අතින් වල් නෙළන්න හෝ උදැල්ලෙන් කොටන්න.
activities.description_ta: வரிசைகளுக்கு இடையே கவனமாகக் கையால் களையெடுங்கள் அல்லது மண்வெட்டியால் கொத்துங்கள்.
activities.why_si: ස්ථාපිත වීමට වල් පැළෑටිවලින් තොරව තිබිය යුතු තීරණාත්මක කාලය.
activities.why_ta: நிலைபெறுவதற்குக் களையின்றி இருக்க வேண்டிய முக்கியமான காலம்.

activities.title: Check for bean fly
activities.description: Look for wilted seedling stems with larval tunnels.
activities.why: Bean fly is the most damaging early pest of cowpea.
activities.description_si: කීට උමං සහිත මැලවුණු පැළ කඳන් සොයන්න.
activities.description_ta: புழுச் சுரங்கங்களுடன் வாடிய நாற்றுத் தண்டுகளைத் தேடுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: බෝංචි මැස්සා කව්පිවල මුල් අවධියේ වඩාත්ම හානිකර පළිබෝධයයි.
activities.why_ta: பீன்ஸ் ஈ காராமணியின் ஆரம்ப நிலையில் மிகச் சேதம் விளைவிக்கும் பூச்சி.

stages.description_si: වැල්/පඳුර වේගයෙන් වර්ධනය වීම.

stages.name: Flowering & Pod Fill

activities.title: Scout for pod borers
activities.description: Check developing pods for entry holes and frass.
activities.why: Pod borers are the main yield-reducing pest at this stage.
activities.title_si: කරල් විදින දළඹුවා සඳහා පරීක්ෂා කරන්න
activities.description_si: වැඩෙන කරල්වල ඇතුළු වූ සිදුරු සහ අසූචි පරීක්ෂා කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: வளரும் காய்களில் நுழைவுத் துளைகளும் கழிவும் உள்ளனவா எனச் சோதியுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: මෙම අවධියේදී අස්වැන්න අඩු කරන ප්‍රධාන පළිබෝධය කරල් විදින දළඹුවාය.
activities.why_ta: இந்த நிலையில் மகசூலைக் குறைக்கும் முக்கியப் பூச்சி காய்த் துளைப்பான்.

activities.title: Irrigate if dry during pod fill
activities.description: Water once if no rain for 10+ days during pod fill.
activities.why: Water stress during pod fill causes seed shrinkage and yield loss.
activities.title_si: කරල් පිරෙන කාලයේ වියළි නම් ජලය දෙන්න
activities.title_ta: காய் நிரம்பும் காலத்தில் வறண்டிருந்தால் நீர் பாய்ச்சுதல்
activities.description_si: කරල් පිරෙන කාලයේ දින 10කට වැඩි කාලයක් වැසි නොමැති නම් එක් වරක් ජලය දෙන්න.
activities.description_ta: காய் நிரம்பும் காலத்தில் 10 நாட்களுக்கு மேல் மழை இல்லையெனில் ஒருமுறை நீர் பாய்ச்சுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: කරල් පිරෙන කාලයේ ජල ආතතිය නිසා බීජ හැකිළී අස්වැන්න අඩු වේ.
activities.why_ta: காய் நிரம்பும் காலத்தில் நீர் அழுத்தம் விதைகளைச் சுருங்கச் செய்து மகசூலைக் குறைக்கும்.

stages.description_si: කරල් වර්ධනය අස්වැන්න තීරණය කරයි.

stages.name: Harvest
stages.description: Harvest at correct stage for intended use.

activities.title: Green pod harvest (vegetable use)
activities.description: Harvest young tender pods when full but seeds not yet showing through skin.
activities.why: Green pods have best eating quality at this stage.
activities.description_si: කරල් පිරී ඇති නමුත් බීජ තවම පොත්තෙන් නොපෙනෙන ළපටි, මෘදු අවධියේ නෙළන්න.
activities.description_ta: காய்கள் நிறைந்தும் விதைகள் இன்னும் தோலின் வழியே தெரியாத இளம், மென்மையான நிலையில் பறியுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: මෙම අවධියේදී අමු කරල්වල ආහාර ගුණය හොඳම වේ.
activities.why_ta: இந்த நிலையில் பச்சைக் காய்கள் சாப்பிடச் சிறந்தவை.

activities.title: Dry grain harvest
activities.description: Allow pods to dry and turn brown on plant. Harvest before pods shatter.
activities.why: Delay causes pod shattering and grain loss.
activities.description_si: කරල් පැළයේදීම වියළී දුඹුරු වීමට ඉඩ හරින්න. කරල් පුපුරා යාමට පෙර නෙළන්න.
activities.description_ta: காய்கள் செடியிலேயே காய்ந்து பழுப்பாக விடுங்கள். காய்கள் வெடிப்பதற்கு முன் அறுவடை செய்யுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: ප්‍රමාද වුවහොත් කරල් පුපුරා ඇට අහිමි වේ.
activities.why_ta: தாமதித்தால் காய்கள் வெடித்துத் தானியம் இழக்கப்படும்.

stages.description_si: අපේක්ෂිත භාවිතයට ගැළපෙන නිවැරදි අවධියේ අස්වනු නෙළන්න.
stages.description_ta: தேவைக்கு ஏற்ற சரியான நிலையில் அறுவடை செய்யுங்கள்.

fertilization.why: Phosphorus for root nodule development. No nitrogen — cowpea fixes its own.
fertilization.why_si: මුල් ගැටිති වර්ධනයට පොස්පරස්. නයිට්‍රජන් එපා — කව්පි තමන්ටම නයිට්‍රජන් තිර කර ගනී.
fertilization.why_ta: வேர் முடிச்சு வளர்ச்சிக்குப் பாஸ்பரஸ். நைட்ரஜன் வேண்டாம் — காராமணி தானே நைட்ரஜனை நிலைநிறுத்தும்.

fertilization.why: Minimal nitrogen only to kick-start early growth before nodules form.
fertilization.why_si: ගැටිති සෑදීමට පෙර මුල් වර්ධනය ආරම්භ කිරීමට පමණක් අවම නයිට්‍රජන්.
fertilization.why_ta: வேர் முடிச்சுகள் உருவாகும் முன் ஆரம்ப வளர்ச்சியைத் தொடங்க மட்டும் குறைந்த நைட்ரஜன்.

irrigation.notes: Cowpea is drought tolerant. Avoid overwatering. One irrigation at pod fill if no rain is usually sufficient.
irrigation.notes_si: කව්පි නියඟයට ඔරොත්තු දෙයි. අධිකව ජලය දීමෙන් වළකින්න. වැසි නොමැති නම් කරල් පිරෙන කාලයේ එක් වරක් ජලය දීම සාමාන්‍යයෙන් ප්‍රමාණවත්ය.
irrigation.notes_ta: காராமணி வறட்சியைத் தாங்கும். அதிக நீர் பாய்ச்சுவதைத் தவிருங்கள். மழை இல்லையெனில் காய் நிரம்பும் போது ஒருமுறை நீர் பாய்ச்சுவது பொதுவாகப் போதும்.

diseases.name: Powdery Mildew
diseases.symptoms: White powdery coating on leaves; reduces photosynthesis and plant vigour.
diseases.favorable_conditions: Hot dry weather alternating with humidity.
diseases.prevention: Good plant spacing. Avoid excessive nitrogen.
diseases.treatment: Wettable Sulphur (3 g/L) or Triadimefon (1 g/L).
diseases.symptoms_si: කොළ මත සුදු පිටි වැනි තට්ටුවක්; ප්‍රභාසංශ්ලේෂණය සහ පැළයේ ශක්තිය අඩු කරයි.
diseases.symptoms_ta: இலைகளில் வெண்மையான தூள் போன்ற படலம்; ஒளிச்சேர்க்கையையும் செடியின் வீரியத்தையும் குறைக்கும்.
diseases.favorable_conditions_si: උණුසුම් වියළි කාලගුණය ආර්ද්‍රතාව සමඟ මාරුවෙන් මාරුවට පැවතීම.
diseases.favorable_conditions_ta: வெப்பமான வறண்ட வானிலையும் ஈரப்பதமும் மாறி மாறி வருதல்.
diseases.prevention_si: පැළ අතර හොඳ පරතරය. අධික නයිට්‍රජන් යෙදීමෙන් වළකින්න.
diseases.prevention_ta: செடிகளுக்கிடையே நல்ல இடைவெளி. அதிக நைட்ரஜன் இடுவதைத் தவிருங்கள்.
diseases.treatment_si: Wettable Sulphur (ලීටරයකට ග්‍රෑ. 3) හෝ Triadimefon (ලීටරයකට ග්‍රෑ. 1).
diseases.treatment_ta: Wettable Sulphur (லிட்டருக்கு 3 கி) அல்லது Triadimefon (லிட்டருக்கு 1 கி).

diseases.name: Viral Mosaic
diseases.symptoms: Yellow-green mosaic patterns; leaf puckering; stunted growth; reduced pod fill.
diseases.favorable_conditions: High aphid populations; hot dry weather.
diseases.prevention: Use virus-free seeds. Control aphid vectors. Remove infected plants.
diseases.treatment: No cure. Control aphids with Imidacloprid (0.3 ml/L).
diseases.symptoms_si: කහ-කොළ මොසෙයික් රටා; කොළ රැළි වැටීම; වර්ධනය බාල වීම; කරල් පිරීම අඩු වීම.
diseases.symptoms_ta: மஞ்சள்-பச்சைத் தேமல் வடிவங்கள்; இலைச் சுருக்கம்; வளர்ச்சிக் குன்றல்; காய் நிரம்புதல் குறைவு.
diseases.favorable_conditions_si: කුඩිත්තන් ගහනය වැඩි වීම; උණුසුම් වියළි කාලගුණය.
diseases.favorable_conditions_ta: அதிக அசுவினி; வெப்பமான வறண்ட வானிலை.
diseases.prevention_si: වෛරසවලින් තොර බීජ භාවිත කරන්න. වාහක කුඩිත්තන් පාලනය කරන්න. ආසාදිත පැළ ඉවත් කරන්න.
diseases.prevention_ta: வைரஸற்ற விதைகளைப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள். நோய் பரப்பும் அசுவினியைக் கட்டுப்படுத்துங்கள். பாதிக்கப்பட்ட செடிகளை அகற்றுங்கள்.
diseases.treatment_si: ප්‍රතිකාරයක් නැත. Imidacloprid (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 0.3) මගින් කුඩිත්තන් පාලනය කරන්න.
diseases.treatment_ta: சிகிச்சை இல்லை. Imidacloprid (லிட்டருக்கு 0.3 மி.லி) மூலம் அசுவினியைக் கட்டுப்படுத்துங்கள்.

pests.name: Bean Fly
pests.damage: Larvae mine stems causing 'dead heart'; young plants die; yield dramatically reduced.
pests.identification: Wilting seedlings at 7–14 days; maggots in stem when cut open.
pests.prevention: Seed dressing with insecticide. Early sowing. Use of resistant varieties.
pests.treatment: Chlorpyrifos soil drench (2 ml/L) or Carbosulfan seed dressing.
pests.prevention_si: කෘමි නාශකයකින් බීජ ආලේප කිරීම. කලින් බීජ සිටුවීම. ඔරොත්තු දෙන ප්‍රභේද භාවිතය.
pests.prevention_ta: பூச்சிக்கொல்லியால் விதை நேர்த்தி. முன்கூட்டிய விதைப்பு. எதிர்ப்புள்ள இனங்களைப் பயன்படுத்துதல்.
pests.treatment_si: Chlorpyrifos මගින් පස තෙමීම (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 2) හෝ Carbosulfan මගින් බීජ ආලේප කිරීම.
pests.treatment_ta: Chlorpyrifos கொண்டு மண்ணை நனைத்தல் (லிட்டருக்கு 2 மி.லி) அல்லது Carbosulfan விதை நேர்த்தி.
pests.damage_si: කීටයෝ කඳ තුළ සුරං හාරා 'මැරුණු දළු' ඇති කරති; ළපටි පැළ මිය යන අතර අස්වැන්න විශාල ලෙස අඩු වේ.
pests.damage_ta: புழுக்கள் தண்டுக்குள் சுரங்கம் அமைத்து 'காய்ந்த குருத்து' ஏற்படுத்தும்; இளம் செடிகள் இறந்து மகசூல் பெருமளவு குறையும்.
pests.identification_si: දින 7–14දී පැළ මැලවීම; කඳ කපා බැලූ විට ඇතුළත පණුවන්.
pests.identification_ta: 7–14 நாட்களில் நாற்றுகள் வாடுதல்; தண்டை வெட்டினால் உள்ளே புழுக்கள்.

pests.name: Pod Borer
pests.damage: Larvae feed inside developing pods reducing seed quality and yield.
pests.identification: Entry holes in pods; frass visible; damaged seeds inside.
pests.prevention: Pheromone traps. Monitor pod formation stage closely.
pests.treatment: Spinosad 45SC (0.3 ml/L) or Chlorpyrifos (2 ml/L) at flowering.
pests.prevention_si: ෆෙරමෝන උගුල්. කරල් හටගන්නා අවධිය සමීපව නිරීක්ෂණය කරන්න.
