diseases.prevention: Good plant spacing. Trellis. Avoid overhead irrigation.
diseases.treatment: Mancozeb 80WP (2.5 g/L) or Copper Oxychloride (3 g/L).
diseases.symptoms_si: කොළ මත දුඹුරු හෝ තද පැහැ තුවාල; ප්‍රභාසංශ්ලේෂණය සහ පැළයේ සෞඛ්‍යය අඩු කරයි.
diseases.symptoms_ta: இலைகளில் பழுப்பு அல்லது கரும் புண்கள்; ஒளிச்சேர்க்கையையும் செடியின் ஆரோக்கியத்தையும் குறைக்கும்.
diseases.favorable_conditions_si: ඉහළ ආර්ද්‍රතාව, දුර්වල වාතාශ්‍රය, ඉහළින් ජලය ඉසීම.
diseases.favorable_conditions_ta: அதிக ஈரப்பதம், மோசமான காற்றோட்டம், மேலிருந்து நீர் தெளிப்பு.
diseases.prevention_si: පැළ අතර හොඳ පරතරය. මැස්ස. ඉහළින් ජලය ඉසීමෙන් වළකින්න.
diseases.prevention_ta: செடிகளுக்கிடையே நல்ல இடைவெளி. பந்தல். மேலிருந்து நீர் தெளிப்பதைத் தவிருங்கள்.
diseases.treatment_si: Mancozeb 80WP (ලීටරයකට ග්‍රෑ. 2.5) හෝ Copper Oxychloride (ලීටරයකට ග්‍රෑ. 3).
diseases.treatment_ta: Mancozeb 80WP (லிட்டருக்கு 2.5 கி) அல்லது Copper Oxychloride (லிட்டருக்கு 3 கி).

diseases.name: Bacterial Wilt
diseases.cause: Ralstonia solanacearum — soil-borne bacterial pathogen that survives in soil for many years.
diseases.symptoms: Sudden wilting of the whole plant even when soil moisture is adequate. Cutting the stem base and suspending in water shows bacterial ooze streaming out.
diseases.favorable_conditions: Poorly drained soils, fields previously used for solanaceous crops (tomato, brinjal, potato), warm and humid conditions.
diseases.prevention: Improve field drainage, rotate crops — avoid planting after tomato, brinjal, or potato for at least 2-3 seasons. Remove and destroy infected plants with the surrounding soil.
diseases.treatment: No reliable chemical cure. Remove infected plants immediately with surrounding soil and sanitize the area. Do not compost infected material.
diseases.cause_si: Ralstonia solanacearum — වසර ගණනාවක් පසේ ජීවත් වන, පසින් බෝවන බැක්ටීරියා රෝගකාරකයකි.
diseases.cause_ta: Ralstonia solanacearum — பல ஆண்டுகள் மண்ணில் வாழும், மண் வழியாகப் பரவும் பாக்டீரியா நோய்க்கிருமி.
diseases.symptoms_si: පසේ තෙතමනය ප්‍රමාණවත් වුවද මුළු පැළයම හදිසියේ මැලවීම. කඳේ පාමුල කපා ජලයේ එල්ලූ විට බැක්ටීරියා ස්‍රාවය ගලා යන අයුරු පෙනේ.
diseases.symptoms_ta: மண் ஈரப்பதம் போதுமானதாக இருந்தும் முழுச் செடியும் திடீரென வாடுதல். தண்டின் அடிப்பகுதியை வெட்டி நீரில் தொங்கவிட்டால் பாக்டீரியாக் கசிவு வழிந்தோடுவது தெரியும்.
diseases.favorable_conditions_si: ජලය හොඳින් බැස නොයන පස, කලින් Solanaceae බෝග (තක්කාලි, වම්බටු, අර්තාපල්) වගා කළ කෙත්, උණුසුම් සහ ආර්ද්‍ර තත්ත්ව.
diseases.favorable_conditions_ta: நீர் சரியாக வடியாத மண், முன்பு Solanaceae பயிர்கள் (தக்காளி, கத்தரி, உருளைக்கிழங்கு) பயிரிட்ட வயல்கள், வெப்பமான ஈரப்பதமான நிலை.
diseases.prevention_si: කෙතේ ජලාපවහනය වැඩි දියුණු කරන්න, බෝග මාරු කරන්න — තක්කාලි, වම්බටු හෝ අර්තාපල්වලින් පසු අවම වශයෙන් කන්න 2–3ක් සිටුවීමෙන් වළකින්න. ආසාදිත පැළ අවට පස සමඟ ඉවත් කර විනාශ කරන්න.
diseases.prevention_ta: வயலின் வடிகாலை மேம்படுத்துங்கள், பயிர்ச் சுழற்சி செய்யுங்கள் — தக்காளி, கத்தரி அல்லது உருளைக்கிழங்குக்குப் பின் குறைந்தது 2–3 பருவங்கள் நடுவதைத் தவிருங்கள். பாதிக்கப்பட்ட செடிகளைச் சுற்றியுள்ள மண்ணுடன் அகற்றி அழியுங்கள்.
diseases.treatment_si: විශ්වාසදායක රසායනික ප්‍රතිකාරයක් නැත. ආසාදිත පැළ අවට පස සමඟ වහාම ඉවත් කර එම ප්‍රදේශය විෂබීජහරණය කරන්න. ආසාදිත ද්‍රව්‍ය කොම්පෝස්ට් නොකරන්න.
diseases.treatment_ta: நம்பகமான இரசாயன சிகிச்சை இல்லை. பாதிக்கப்பட்ட செடிகளைச் சுற்றியுள்ள மண்ணுடன் உடனே அகற்றி அப்பகுதியைக் கிருமிநீக்கம் செய்யுங்கள். பாதிக்கப்பட்ட பொருட்களை உரமாக்காதீர்கள்.

diseases.name: Powdery Mildew
diseases.cause: Fungal infection favoured by humid conditions with poor airflow between plants.
diseases.symptoms: White powdery patches on leaves and young stems; affected leaves yellow and dry. Reduced flowering and pod set in severe cases.
diseases.favorable_conditions: High humidity, poor plant spacing, overcrowding, overhead irrigation in the evening.
diseases.prevention: Provide proper plant spacing for good airflow, prune dense growth, avoid overhead irrigation late in the day.
diseases.treatment: Remove and destroy infected leaves. Apply a sulfur-based or DOA-recommended fungicide according to label instructions at first sign of infection.
diseases.cause_si: පැළ අතර වාතය ගලායාම දුර්වල, ආර්ද්‍ර තත්ත්වවලදී වැඩෙන දිලීර ආසාදනයකි.
diseases.cause_ta: செடிகளுக்கிடையே காற்றோட்டம் குறைந்த, ஈரப்பதமான நிலையில் பெருகும் பூஞ்சைத் தொற்று.
diseases.symptoms_si: කොළ සහ ළපටි කඳන් මත සුදු පිටි වැනි ලප; බලපෑමට ලක් වූ කොළ කහ වී වියළේ. දැඩි අවස්ථාවලදී මල් පිපීම සහ කරල් හටගැනීම අඩු වේ.
diseases.symptoms_ta: இலைகளிலும் இளம் தண்டுகளிலும் வெண்மையான தூள் போன்ற திட்டுகள்; பாதிக்கப்பட்ட இலைகள் மஞ்சளாகிக் காயும். கடுமையான நிலையில் பூப்பும் காய்ப்பும் குறையும்.
diseases.favorable_conditions_si: ඉහළ ආර්ද්‍රතාව, පැළ අතර දුර්වල පරතරය, පැළ ඝන වීම, සවස් කාලයේ ඉහළින් ජලය ඉසීම.
diseases.favorable_conditions_ta: அதிக ஈரப்பதம், செடிகளுக்கிடையே போதிய இடைவெளியின்மை, நெருக்கம், மாலையில் மேலிருந்து நீர் தெளிப்பு.
diseases.prevention_si: හොඳ වාතාශ්‍රයක් සඳහා නිසි පරතරයක් තබන්න, ඝන වර්ධනය කප්පාදු කරන්න, දවසේ පසු කාලයේ ඉහළින් ජලය ඉසීමෙන් වළකින්න.
diseases.prevention_ta: நல்ல காற்றோட்டத்துக்குச் சரியான இடைவெளி விடுங்கள், அடர்த்தியான வளர்ச்சியைக் கத்தரியுங்கள், பிற்பகலில் மேலிருந்து நீர் தெளிப்பதைத் தவிருங்கள்.
diseases.treatment_si: ආසාදිත කොළ ඉවත් කර විනාශ කරන්න. ආසාදනයේ පළමු ලක්ෂණය දුටු විට, ලේබලයේ උපදෙස් පරිදි සල්ෆර් පදනම් කරගත් හෝ කෘෂිකර්ම දෙපාර්තමේන්තුව නිර්දේශිත දිලීර නාශකයක් යොදන්න.
diseases.treatment_ta: பாதிக்கப்பட்ட இலைகளை அகற்றி அழியுங்கள். தொற்றின் முதல் அறிகுறியிலேயே, லேபிள் அறிவுறுத்தலின்படி கந்தக அடிப்படையிலான அல்லது விவசாயத் திணைக்களம் பரிந்துரைத்த பூஞ்சைக்கொல்லியைத் தெளியுங்கள்.

pests.name: Bean Fly
pests.damage: Larvae mine stems causing death of young plants.
pests.identification: Wilting seedlings with maggots visible in stem cross-section.
pests.prevention: Early planting. Seed dressing. Good field sanitation.
pests.treatment: Chlorpyrifos soil drench (2 ml/L) at planting.
pests.prevention_si: කලින් සිටුවීම. බීජ ආලේපනය. කෙත හොඳින් පිරිසිදුව තබා ගැනීම.
pests.prevention_ta: முன்கூட்டிய நடவு. விதை நேர்த்தி. வயலைச் சுத்தமாக வைத்திருத்தல்.
pests.treatment_si: සිටුවන විට Chlorpyrifos මගින් පස තෙමීම (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 2).
pests.treatment_ta: நடவின் போது Chlorpyrifos கொண்டு மண்ணை நனைத்தல் (லிட்டருக்கு 2 மி.லி).
pests.damage_si: කීටයෝ කඳ තුළ සුරං හාරා ළපටි පැළ මරා දමති.
pests.damage_ta: புழுக்கள் தண்டுக்குள் சுரங்கம் அமைத்து இளம் செடிகளைக் கொல்லும்.
pests.identification_si: කඳේ හරස්කඩේ පණුවන් පෙනෙන, මැලවෙන පැළ.
pests.identification_ta: தண்டின் குறுக்குவெட்டில் புழுக்கள் தெரியும் வாடும் நாற்றுகள்.

pests.name: Aphid
pests.damage: Sucks sap from new growth; reduces plant vigour.
pests.identification: Soft-bodied insects on shoot tips and young leaves.
pests.prevention: Neem oil spray. Yellow sticky traps.
pests.treatment: Dimethoate 40EC (1.5 ml/L) if heavy infestation.
pests.prevention_si: කොහොඹ තෙල් ඉසීම. කහ ඇලෙන උගුල්.
pests.prevention_ta: வேப்ப எண்ணெய் தெளிப்பு. மஞ்சள் ஒட்டும் பொறிகள்.
pests.treatment_si: ආසාදනය අධික නම් Dimethoate 40EC (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 1.5).
pests.treatment_ta: தாக்குதல் அதிகமாக இருந்தால் Dimethoate 40EC (லிட்டருக்கு 1.5 மி.லி).
pests.damage_si: නව වර්ධනයෙන් යුෂ උරා බොයි; පැළයේ ශක්තිය අඩු කරයි.
pests.damage_ta: புதிய வளர்ச்சியில் சாற்றை உறிஞ்சும்; செடியின் வீரியத்தைக் குறைக்கும்.
pests.identification_si: දළු අග සහ ළපටි කොළ මත මෘදු සිරුරු සහිත කෘමීන්.
pests.identification_ta: தளிர் நுனிகளிலும் இளம் இலைகளிலும் மென்னுடல் பூச்சிகள்.

pests.name: Pod Borer
pests.damage: Internal damage to pods; reduces seed quality.
pests.identification: Entry holes on pods; frass visible.
pests.prevention: Pheromone traps. Monitor at pod initiation.
pests.treatment: Spinosad 45SC (0.3 ml/L) at first pod stage.
pests.prevention_si: ෆෙරමෝන උගුල්. කරල් හටගැනීම ආරම්භයේදී නිරීක්ෂණය කරන්න.
pests.prevention_ta: இனக்கவர்ச்சிப் பொறிகள். காய் தொடங்கும்போது கண்காணியுங்கள்.
pests.treatment_si: පළමු කරල් අවධියේදී Spinosad 45SC (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 0.3).
pests.treatment_ta: முதல் காய் நிலையில் Spinosad 45SC (லிட்டருக்கு 0.3 மி.லி).
pests.damage_si: කරල්වලට ඇතුළත හානිය; බීජවල ගුණාත්මකභාවය අඩු කරයි.
pests.damage_ta: காய்களுக்கு உட்புறச் சேதம்; விதைத் தரத்தைக் குறைக்கும்.
pests.identification_si: කරල්වල ඇතුළු වූ සිදුරු; අසූචි පෙනේ.
pests.identification_ta: காய்களில் நுழைவுத் துளைகள்; கழிவு தெரியும்.

risks.name: Drought
risks.description: Winged bean needs more water than other legumes. Flower drop without moisture.
risks.mitigation: Regular drip or furrow irrigation. Heavy mulching.
risks.description_si: දඹලවලට අනෙකුත් රනිල බෝගවලට වඩා වැඩි ජලයක් අවශ්‍යය. තෙතමනය නොමැතිව මල් හැලේ.
risks.description_ta: சிறகுப்பயறுக்கு மற்ற பயறு வகைகளை விட அதிக நீர் தேவை. ஈரப்பதம் இல்லாவிட்டால் பூக்கள் உதிரும்.
risks.signs_si: මල් පිපීම අඩු වීම, කරල් හැලීම.
risks.mitigation_si: නිතිපතා බිංදු හෝ ඇළ මාර්ග ජලසම්පාදනය. ඝනව වසුන් යොදන්න.
risks.mitigation_ta: தொடர் சொட்டு அல்லது சால் நீர்ப்பாசனம். தடிமனாக மூடாக்கு இடுங்கள்.

risks.name: Weak Trellis
risks.description: Heavy mature vines collapse, breaking stems and losing entire crop.
risks.mitigation: Use hardwood or concrete poles. Inspect trellis before rainy season.
risks.description_si: බර, මේරූ වැල් ඇද වැටී කඳන් කැඩී මුළු බෝගයම අහිමි වේ.
risks.description_ta: கனமான முதிர்ந்த கொடிகள் சரிந்து தண்டுகள் உடைந்து முழுப் பயிரும் இழக்கப்படும்.
risks.signs_si: මැස්සේ කණු ඇල වීම, කම්බි එල්ලා වැටීම.
risks.mitigation_si: දැව හෝ කොන්ක්‍රීට් කණු භාවිත කරන්න. වැසි කාලයට පෙර මැස්ස පරීක්ෂා කරන්න.
risks.mitigation_ta: உறுதியான மரம் அல்லது கொங்கிரீட் கம்புகளைப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள். மழைக் காலத்துக்கு முன் பந்தலைச் சோதியுங்கள்.

indicators: Pods 10–15 cm long with prominent wings
Pods still flat — seeds not bulging
harvest.method: Hand pick individual pods. Cut with scissors to avoid stem damage.
harvest.post_harvest: Store cool. Market within 2–3 days. Young leaves can also be picked for cooking.
harvest.method_si: එක් එක් කරල අතින් නෙළන්න. කඳට හානි නොවීමට කතුරකින් කපන්න.
harvest.method_ta: ஒவ்வொரு காயாகக் கையால் பறியுங்கள். தண்டு சேதமடையாமல் கத்தரிக்கோலால் வெட்டுங்கள்.
harvest.post_harvest_si: සිසිල්ව ගබඩා කරන්න. දින 2–3ක් ඇතුළත වෙළඳපොළට යවන්න. ළපටි කොළ ද ආහාරයට නෙළිය හැක.
harvest.post_harvest_ta: குளிர்ச்சியாகச் சேமியுங்கள். 2–3 நாட்களுக்குள் சந்தைக்கு அனுப்புங்கள். இளம் இலைகளையும் சமையலுக்குப் பறிக்கலாம்.
indicators_si: පැහැදිලි පියාපත් සහිත සෙ.මී. 10–15ක් දිග කරල්
කරල් තවමත් පැතලියි — බීජ ඉලිප්පී නැත
indicators_ta: காய்கள் இன்னும் தட்டையாக இருக்கும் — விதைகள் புடைத்திருக்காது

Winged Bean (Dambala).growth_stages_text: Winged bean cultivation follows several important growth stages including germination, vegetative vine growth, flowering, pod formation, and harvesting. Germination usually occurs within 6–10 days after sowing, while vegetative growth continues for about 30–50 days depending on soil fertility and environmental conditions. Flowering typically begins around 60–80 days after planting, followed by pod development and tuber formation in some varieties. Harvesting of young pods generally starts within 90–120 days when pods are tender, green, and not fibrous. Farmers commonly use direct seeding methods and maintain spacing of approximately 1–1.5 meters between plants to support vigorous vine growth, sunlight exposure, and air circulation. Trellis systems or staking are often used to improve pod quality, reduce disease incidence, and make harvesting easier.
Winged Bean (Dambala).management_text: Successful winged bean cultivation requires a structured week-by-week crop management plan including land preparation, seed sowing, fertilizer application, irrigation, weed control, vine training, pest monitoring, and harvesting activities. Fertilizer application is important during vegetative growth and flowering stages, commonly using phosphorus-rich fertilizers along with nitrogen, potassium, and organic compost to enhance vine development and pod production. Irrigation is especially important during germination, flowering, and pod development stages, while mature plants can tolerate short dry periods once well established. Harvesting indicators include tender green pods, good pod length, and soft texture suitable for consumption.
Winged Bean (Dambala).disease_management_text: Disease and pest management are essential in successful winged bean cultivation. Aphids suck plant sap, causing curling, yellowing, and reduced plant vigor, while bean flies damage seedlings and weaken early plant establishment. Pod borers feed inside developing pods, reducing seed and pod quality, and leaf spot diseases appear as brown or dark lesions that reduce photosynthesis and plant health. Fungal infections may also occur under high humidity conditions, affecting vines and leaves. These problems can be controlled through proper field sanitation, crop rotation, balanced fertilizer use, removal of infected plant parts, trellis support systems, biological pest control methods, and recommended pesticide or fungicide applications when necessary. Risk mitigation practices such as regular field monitoring, proper irrigation management, maintaining soil fertility, use of healthy seeds, and integrated pest management techniques help reduce crop losses and improve overall productivity.
Winged Bean (Dambala).overview_si: ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ “දඹල” ලෙස හැඳින්වෙන දඹල (Psophocarpus tetragonolobus) Fabaceae කුලයට අයත් නිවර්තන රනිල එළවළු බෝගයකි. ඉහළ පෝෂණීය වටිනාකම සහ උණුසුම්, ආර්ද්‍ර තත්ත්වවලට හැඩගැසීමේ හැකියාව නිසා එය ශ්‍රී ලංකාව පුරා ගෙවතුවල සහ කුඩා ගොවිපළවල, විශේෂයෙන් තෙත් සහ අතරමැදි කලාපවල බහුලව වගා කෙරේ. දඹල 22°C–30°C අතර උෂ්ණත්වයේ හොඳින් වැඩෙන අතර, pH 5.5–7.0 අතර, කාබනික ද්‍රව්‍ය බහුල, හොඳින් ජලය බැස යන සාරවත් ලෝම පසකට කැමතිය. නිසි වැල් වර්ධනයට සහ කරල් වර්ධනයට මධ්‍යස්ථ වර්ෂාව, වියළි කාලවලදී නිතිපතා ජලය දීම සහ පූර්ණ හිරු එළිය අවශ්‍යය. දඹලවල විශේෂත්වය නම් පැළයේ සියලුම කොටස් පාහේ — අල, කොළ, මල් සහ කරල් — ආහාරයට ගත හැකි අතර ප්‍රෝටීන්, විටමින් සහ ඛනිජවලින් ඉතා පොහොසත් වීමයි; එබැවින් එය වැදගත් සාම්ප්‍රදායික ආහාර ප්‍රභවයකි. තත්ත්ව අනුව සාමාන්‍යයෙන් සිටුවීමෙන් දින 90–120 අතර ආහාරයට ගත හැකි කරල් ලැබීම ආරම්භ වේ. උෂ්ණත්වය, පාංශු තෙතමනය, වර්ෂාව, හිරු එළිය, ආර්ද්‍රතාව සහ පසේ සාරවත්බව වගාවට බලපාන ප්‍රධාන සාධක වේ. කුඩිත්තා, බෝංචි මැස්සා, කරල් විදින දළඹුවා, පත්‍ර පුල්ලි රෝග සහ දිලීර ආසාදන පොදු පළිබෝධ හා රෝග වන අතර, නිසි ලෙස පාලනය නොකළහොත් ඒවා අස්වැන්න සහ පැළයේ සෞඛ්‍යය අඩු කරයි.
Winged Bean (Dambala).overview_ta: இலங்கையில் “தம்பல” என அழைக்கப்படும் சிறகுப்பயறு (Psophocarpus tetragonolobus), Fabaceae குடும்பத்தைச் சேர்ந்த அயனமண்டலப் பயறு வகைக் காய்கறிப் பயிர். அதிக ஊட்டச்சத்து மதிப்பும் வெப்பமான, ஈரப்பதமான நிலைமைகளுக்கு ஏற்ப வளரும் தன்மையும் காரணமாக இலங்கை முழுவதும் வீட்டுத் தோட்டங்களிலும் சிறு பண்ணைகளிலும், குறிப்பாக ஈர மற்றும் இடை வலயங்களில் பரவலாக வளர்க்கப்படுகிறது. சிறகுப்பயறு 22°C–30°C வெப்பநிலையில் நன்றாக வளரும்; pH 5.5–7.0 உள்ள, கரிமப் பொருள் நிறைந்த, நன்கு நீர் வடியும் வளமான இருமண் சிறந்தது. சரியான கொடி வளர்ச்சி மற்றும் காய் வளர்ச்சிக்கு மிதமான மழை, வறண்ட காலங்களில் தொடர்ந்து நீர் பாய்ச்சுதல், முழுச் சூரிய ஒளி தேவை. சிறகுப்பயறின் தனிச்சிறப்பு, செடியின் கிட்டத்தட்ட எல்லாப் பகுதிகளும் — கிழங்கு, இலைகள், பூக்கள், காய்கள் — உண்ணக்கூடியவை என்பதும் புரதம், விட்டமின்கள், கனிமங்கள் நிறைந்தவை என்பதும்; எனவே இது முக்கியமான பாரம்பரிய உணவு மூலம். நிலைமைகளைப் பொறுத்து பொதுவாக நடவு செய்து 90–120 நாட்களில் உண்ணக்கூடிய காய்களைத் தரத் தொடங்கும். வெப்பநிலை, மண் ஈரப்பதம், மழை, சூரிய ஒளி, காற்று ஈரப்பதம், மண் வளம் ஆகியவை சாகுபடியைப் பாதிக்கும் முக்கியக் காரணிகள். அசுவினி, பீன்ஸ் ஈ, காய்த் துளைப்பான், இலைப்புள்ளி நோய்கள், பூஞ்சைத் தொற்றுகள் ஆகியவை பொதுவான பூச்சிகளும் நோய்களும்; சரியாகக் கட்டுப்படுத்தாவிட்டால் இவை மகசூலையும் செடியின் ஆரோக்கியத்தையும் குறைக்கும்.

Maize.overview: Maize, commonly known as “Corn” in Sri Lanka, is an important cereal crop belonging to the Poaceae family and scientifically known as Zea mays. It is widely cultivated across Sri Lanka, especially in dry and intermediate zones such as Anuradhapura, Polonnaruwa, and Monaragala due to favorable warm climates and irrigation support. Maize grows best in temperatures between 21°C and 32°C and requires well-drained fertile loamy or sandy loam soil with a soil pH ranging from 5.5 to 7.0. The crop needs moderate rainfall, good sunlight exposure, and proper soil moisture during flowering and grain filling stages for high yield. Maize is an important food and industrial crop in Sri Lanka, used for human consumption, animal feed, and food processing industries, and is valued for its high carbohydrate and energy content. The crop generally takes about 90 to 120 days to mature depending on the variety and environmental conditions. Important factors affecting cultivation include temperature, soil moisture, rainfall, sunlight, humidity, and soil fertility. Common pests and diseases include fall armyworm, stem borers, aphids, leaf blight, rust, and bacterial wilt, which can significantly reduce yield and grain quality if not properly managed.
Maize.propagation: Direct sowing (2 seeds per hole, thin to 1)

stages.name: Land Preparation

activities.title: Deep plough to 25 cm
activities.description: Break clods, level field, form rows.
activities.why: Maize has a deep root system that benefits from deep tillage.
activities.description_si: පස් කැට කඩා, කෙත සමතලා කර, පේළි සකස් කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: மண் கட்டிகளை உடைத்து, வயலைச் சமன்செய்து, வரிசைகள் அமையுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: බඩ ඉරිඟුවලට ගැඹුරු සීසෑමෙන් ප්‍රයෝජන ලබන ගැඹුරු මුල් පද්ධතියක් ඇත.
activities.why_ta: மக்காச்சோளத்துக்கு ஆழமான உழவால் பயன்பெறும் ஆழமான வேர்த் தொகுதி உண்டு.

activities.title: Apply compost
activities.description: Incorporate 5–8 t/ha compost.
activities.why: Organic matter improves moisture retention in dry-zone soils.
activities.description_si: හෙක්ටයාරයකට ටොන් 5–8ක් කොම්පෝස්ට් පසට මිශ්‍ර කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: எக்டேருக்கு 5–8 டன் மக்கிய உரத்தை மண்ணுடன் கலந்துவிடுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: කාබනික ද්‍රව්‍ය වියළි කලාපයේ පසේ තෙතමනය රඳවා ගැනීම වැඩි කරයි.
activities.why_ta: கரிமப் பொருட்கள் உலர் வலய மண்ணில் ஈரப்பதத்தைத் தக்கவைக்கும் திறனை மேம்படுத்தும்.

stages.description_si: සාරවත්, හොඳින් ජලය බැස යන කෙතක් සකස් කරන්න.
stages.description_ta: வளமான, நன்கு நீர் வடியும் வயலைத் தயார்செய்யுங்கள்.

stages.name: Sowing & Germination

activities.title: Sow 2 seeds per hole at 3–4 cm
activities.description: Row spacing 75 cm, spacing 25 cm. Aim for 50,000–60,000 plants/ha.
activities.why: Correct plant population is critical — too sparse or dense both reduce yield.
activities.description_si: පේළි පරතරය සෙ.මී. 75, පැළ පරතරය සෙ.මී. 25. හෙක්ටයාරයකට පැළ 50,000–60,000ක් ඉලක්ක කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: வரிசை இடைவெளி 75 செ.மீ, செடி இடைவெளி 25 செ.மீ. எக்டேருக்கு 50,000–60,000 செடிகளை இலக்காகக் கொள்ளுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: නිවැරදි පැළ ගහනය අත්‍යවශ්‍යයි — ඉතා විරල හෝ ඉතා ඝන වීම දෙකම අස්වැන්න අඩු කරයි.
activities.why_ta: சரியான செடி எண்ணிக்கை மிக அவசியம் — மிகக் குறைவோ மிக அடர்த்தியோ இரண்டுமே மகசூலைக் குறைக்கும்.

activities.title: Thin to 1 plant per hole
activities.description: Remove weaker seedling at 7–10 days.
activities.why: One strong plant per position is more productive than two competing.
activities.title_si: වළකට එක් පැළයක් දක්වා විරල කරන්න
activities.description_si: දින 7–10දී දුර්වල පැළය ඉවත් කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: 7–10 நாட்களில் வலுவற்ற நாற்றை அகற்றுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: එක් ස්ථානයකට ශක්තිමත් එක් පැළයක් තරඟ කරන පැළ දෙකකට වඩා ඵලදායීය.
activities.why_ta: ஓர் இடத்துக்கு ஒரு வலுவான செடி, போட்டியிடும் இரண்டை விட அதிக விளைச்சல் தரும்.

activities.title: Irrigate if no rain
activities.description: Water every 5–7 days in first 3 weeks if dry.
activities.why: Uniform germination needs consistent moisture.
activities.description_si: පළමු සති 3 තුළ වියළි නම් දින 5–7කට වරක් ජලය දෙන්න.
activities.description_ta: முதல் 3 வாரங்களில் வறண்டிருந்தால் 5–7 நாட்களுக்கு ஒருமுறை நீர் பாய்ச்சுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: ඒකාකාර පැළවීමට නොකඩවා තෙතමනය අවශ්‍යය.
activities.why_ta: சீரான முளைப்புக்குத் தொடர்ச்சியான ஈரப்பதம் தேவை.

stages.description_si: නිවැරදි පැළ ගහනයකින් වපුරන්න.

stages.name: Vegetative Growth
stages.description: Rapid tall stem growth — build leaf area.

activities.title: First weeding
activities.description: Hoe between rows. Critical weed-free period.
activities.why: Weeds at this stage compete heavily — one weedy month can reduce yield 40%.
activities.description_si: පේළි අතර උදැල්ලෙන් කොටන්න. වල් පැළෑටිවලින් තොරව තිබිය යුතු තීරණාත්මක කාලයයි.
activities.description_ta: வரிசைகளுக்கு இடையே மண்வெட்டியால் கொத்துங்கள். களையின்றி இருக்க வேண்டிய முக்கியமான காலம்.
activities.why_si: මෙම අවධියේ වල් පැළෑටි දැඩි ලෙස තරඟ කරයි — වල් පැළෑටි සහිත එක් මාසයකින් අස්වැන්න 40%කින් අඩු විය හැක.
activities.why_ta: இந்த நிலையில் களைகள் கடுமையாகப் போட்டியிடும் — களையுடன் ஒரு மாதம் இருந்தாலே மகசூல் 40% குறையலாம்.

activities.title: Top dressing 1
activities.description: Urea 100 kg/ha between rows. Side dress and hill up.
activities.why: High nitrogen demand during vegetative phase.
activities.description_si: පේළි අතරට යූරියා හෙක්ටයාරයකට කි.ග්‍රෑ. 100. පැත්තකින් යොදා පස් කොටන්න.
activities.description_ta: வரிசைகளுக்கு இடையே எக்டேருக்கு 100 கி.கி யூரியா. பக்கவாட்டில் இட்டு மண் அணையுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: ශාක වර්ධන අවධියේදී නයිට්‍රජන් ඉල්ලුම ඉහළය.
activities.why_ta: தாவர வளர்ச்சி நிலையில் நைட்ரஜன் தேவை அதிகம்.

activities.title: Begin FAW scouting
activities.description: Check whorls of young plants for frass and feeding damage.
activities.why: Fall Armyworm hides in the whorl — must check inside plant.
activities.description_si: අසූචි සහ කෑම හානි සඳහා ළපටි පැළවල කොළ කැරැල්ල (මැද දළුව) පරීක්ෂා කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: கழிவுக்கும் உண்ணும் சேதத்துக்கும் இளம் செடிகளின் நடுக்குருத்தைச் சோதியுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: සේනා දළඹුවා මැද දළුව තුළ සැඟවේ — පැළය ඇතුළත පරීක්ෂා කළ යුතුය.
activities.why_ta: படைப்புழு நடுக்குருத்துக்குள் ஒளிந்திருக்கும் — செடியின் உள்ளே சோதிக்க வேண்டும்.

activities.title: Second weeding and hill up
activities.description: Hill up soil 15 cm around plant base.
activities.why: Earthing up prevents lodging (plants falling over) and supports root development.
activities.title_si: දෙවන වල් නෙළීම සහ පස් කෙටීම
activities.description_si: පැළයේ පාමුල වටා සෙ.මී. 15ක් උසට පස් කොටන්න.
activities.description_ta: செடியின் அடிப்பகுதியைச் சுற்றி 15 செ.மீ உயரத்துக்கு மண் அணையுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: පස් කෙටීමෙන් පැළ ඇලවීම (වැටීම) වළකින අතර මුල් වර්ධනයට උපකාරී වේ.
activities.why_ta: மண் அணைப்பது செடிகள் சாய்வதைத் தடுத்து வேர் வளர்ச்சிக்கு உதவும்.

stages.description_si: උස කඳ වේගයෙන් වැඩේ — කොළ ප්‍රමාණය ගොඩනඟන්න.
stages.description_ta: உயரமான தண்டு வேகமாக வளரும் — இலைப் பரப்பை உருவாக்குங்கள்.

stages.name: Tasseling & Silking

activities.title: Top dressing 2
activities.description: Urea 75 kg/ha between rows.
activities.why: Final nitrogen push before cob fill.
activities.description_si: පේළි අතරට යූරියා හෙක්ටයාරයකට කි.ග්‍රෑ. 75.
activities.description_ta: வரிசைகளுக்கு இடையே எக்டேருக்கு 75 கி.கி யூரியா.
activities.why_si: කරල පිරීමට පෙර අවසාන නයිට්‍රජන් යෙදීම.
activities.why_ta: கதிர் நிரம்புவதற்கு முன் இறுதி நைட்ரஜன் இடுதல்.

activities.title: Ensure adequate moisture
activities.description: Irrigate every 5–7 days. Critical at silking.
activities.why: Water stress at tasseling/silking causes poor pollination and blank cobs.
activities.description_si: දින 5–7කට වරක් ජලය දෙන්න. රේණු මතු වන කාලයේ අත්‍යවශ්‍යයි.
activities.description_ta: 5–7 நாட்களுக்கு ஒருமுறை நீர் பாய்ச்சுங்கள். பட்டிழை வெளிவரும் போது மிக அவசியம்.
activities.why_si: මල් කරල් (ටැසල්)/රේණු මතු වන කාලයේ ජල ආතතිය නිසා පරාගණය දුර්වල වී ඇට නැති කරල් හටගනී.
activities.why_ta: ஆண்பூங்கொத்து/பட்டிழை வெளிவரும் காலத்தில் நீர் அழுத்தம் மகரந்தச் சேர்க்கையைக் குறைத்து, மணியில்லாக் கதிர்களை உருவாக்கும்.

activities.title: Check for stem borer
activities.description: Look for dead hearts (central dead leaf) or entry holes in stems.
activities.why: Stem borer at this stage bores into developing cob stalk.
activities.description_si: මැරුණු දළු (මැද කොළය මැරී) හෝ කඳේ ඇතුළු වූ සිදුරු සොයන්න.
activities.description_ta: காய்ந்த குருத்து (நடு இலை காய்தல்) அல்லது தண்டில் நுழைவுத் துளைகளைத் தேடுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: මෙම අවධියේ කඳ විදින්නා වැඩෙන කරලේ නටුව තුළට විද යයි.
activities.why_ta: இந்த நிலையில் தண்டுத் துளைப்பான் வளரும் கதிரின் காம்புக்குள் துளைக்கும்.

stages.description_si: තීරණාත්මක පරාගණ අවධිය — රේණු (සිල්ක්) ආරක්ෂා කරන්න.
stages.description_ta: முக்கியமான மகரந்தச் சேர்க்கை நிலை — பட்டிழைகளைப் பாதுகாக்கவும்.
stages.name_si: මල් කරල් (ටැසල්) සහ රේණු (සිල්ක්) පිට වීම

stages.name: Grain Fill & Maturity

activities.title: Maintain moisture
activities.description: Irrigate every 7 days during grain fill.
activities.why: Water stress during grain fill causes kernel abortion and reduces yield.
activities.description_si: ඇට පිරෙන කාලයේ දින 7කට වරක් ජලය දෙන්න.
activities.description_ta: மணி நிரம்பும் காலத்தில் 7 நாட்களுக்கு ஒருமுறை நீர் பாய்ச்சுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: ඇට පිරෙන කාලයේ ජල ආතතිය නිසා ඇට නොපිරී අස්වැන්න අඩු වේ.
activities.why_ta: மணி நிரம்பும் காலத்தில் நீர் அழுத்தம் மணிகள் நிரம்பாமல் செய்து மகசூலைக் குறைக்கும்.

activities.title: Bird scaring
activities.description: Post reflective tape or place scarecrows. Patrol morning and evening.
activities.why: Birds and squirrels cause 10–20% grain loss at this stage.
activities.description_si: පරාවර්තක පටි එල්ලන්න හෝ පඹයන් තබන්න. උදේ සහ සවස මුර කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: ஒளிபிரதிபலிக்கும் நாடாக்களைக் கட்டுங்கள் அல்லது வெருளிகளை வையுங்கள். காலையும் மாலையும் கண்காணியுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: මෙම අවධියේ කුරුල්ලන් සහ ලේනුන් නිසා ඇට 10–20%ක් අහිමි වේ.
activities.why_ta: இந்த நிலையில் பறவைகளும் அணில்களும் 10–20% தானிய இழப்பை ஏற்படுத்தும்.

stages.description_si: කරල් ඇටවලින් පිරේ.

stages.name: Harvest

activities.title: Check for harvest readiness
activities.description: Husk a cob — kernels should be hard and dented at crown.
activities.why: Soft kernels = too early. Dented hard kernels = ready for dry grain harvest.
activities.description_si: කරලක ලෙල්ල ඉවත් කරන්න — ඇට තද වී මුදුනේ ගිලී තිබිය යුතුය.
activities.description_ta: ஒரு கதிரின் தோலை உரியுங்கள் — மணிகள் கடினமாகி உச்சியில் குழிந்திருக்க வேண்டும்.
activities.why_si: මෘදු ඇට = ඉතා කලින්. ගිලුණු තද ඇට = වියළි ඇට අස්වැන්නට සූදානම්.
activities.why_ta: மென்மையான மணிகள் = மிக முன்கூட்டியே. குழிந்த கடினமான மணிகள் = உலர் தானிய அறுவடைக்குத் தயார்.

activities.title: Harvest and dry
activities.description: Pull cobs, remove husks, sun dry.
activities.why: Sun drying reduces moisture to safe storage levels.
activities.description_si: කරල් කඩා, ලෙලි ඉවත් කර, අව්වේ වියළන්න.
activities.description_ta: கதிர்களை ஒடித்து, தோலை உரித்து, வெயிலில் உலர்த்துங்கள்.
activities.why_si: අව්වේ වියළීමෙන් තෙතමනය ආරක්ෂිත ගබඩා මට්ටමට අඩු වේ.
activities.why_ta: வெயிலில் உலர்த்துவது ஈரப்பதத்தைப் பாதுகாப்பான சேமிப்பு அளவுக்குக் குறைக்கும்.

stages.description_si: කායික මේරීම සිදු වූ විට අස්වනු නෙළන්න.

irrigation.notes: Most critical: NEVER stress maize at tasseling/silking — this is the single most yield-determining water timing.
irrigation.notes_si: වඩාත්ම තීරණාත්මකයි: මල් කරල්/රේණු මතු වන කාලයේ බඩ ඉරිඟුවලට කිසි විටෙක ජල ආතතියක් ඇති නොකරන්න — අස්වැන්න තීරණය කරන වඩාත්ම වැදගත් ජල අවධිය මෙයයි.
irrigation.notes_ta: மிக முக்கியம்: ஆண்பூங்கொத்து/பட்டிழை வெளிவரும் காலத்தில் மக்காச்சோளத்துக்கு ஒருபோதும் நீர் அழுத்தம் ஏற்படக் கூடாது — மகசூலைத் தீர்மானிக்கும் மிக முக்கியமான நீர்ப்பாசன நேரம் இதுவே.
irrigation.critical_stages_text_si: පැළවීම · මල් කරල්/රේණු මතුවීම (දින 50–65) · ඇට පිරීම (දින 75–95)

diseases.name: Leaf Blight
diseases.symptoms: Large tan-grey elongated lesions on leaves; severe defoliation reduces yield.
diseases.favorable_conditions: Humid conditions, moderate temperatures, dense canopy.
diseases.prevention: Resistant varieties. Crop rotation. Good spacing.
diseases.treatment: Mancozeb 80WP (2.5 g/L) or Propiconazole (1 ml/L).
diseases.symptoms_si: කොළ මත විශාල, දිගටි, ලා දුඹුරු-අළු පැහැ තුවාල; දැඩි ලෙස කොළ හැලීම අස්වැන්න අඩු කරයි.
diseases.symptoms_ta: இலைகளில் பெரிய, நீண்ட, மங்கிய பழுப்பு-சாம்பல் புண்கள்; கடுமையான இலை உதிர்வு மகசூலைக் குறைக்கும்.
diseases.favorable_conditions_si: ආර්ද්‍ර තත්ත්ව, මධ්‍යස්ථ උෂ්ණත්වය, ඝන වියන.
diseases.favorable_conditions_ta: ஈரப்பதமான நிலை, மிதமான வெப்பநிலை, அடர்த்தியான இலைப்பரப்பு.
diseases.prevention_si: ඔරොත්තු දෙන ප්‍රභේද. බෝග මාරුව. හොඳ පරතරය.
diseases.prevention_ta: எதிர்ப்புள்ள இனங்கள். பயிர்ச் சுழற்சி. நல்ல இடைவெளி.
diseases.treatment_si: Mancozeb 80WP (ලීටරයකට ග්‍රෑ. 2.5) හෝ Propiconazole (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 1).
diseases.treatment_ta: Mancozeb 80WP (லிட்டருக்கு 2.5 கி) அல்லது Propiconazole (லிட்டருக்கு 1 மி.லி).

diseases.name: Rust
diseases.symptoms: Reddish-brown pustules on leaf surfaces; reduces photosynthesis and grain fill.
diseases.favorable_conditions: Humid cooler conditions, dense planting.
diseases.prevention: Resistant varieties. Good spacing.
diseases.treatment: Tebuconazole (1 ml/L) or Mancozeb (2.5 g/L).
diseases.symptoms_si: කොළ මතුපිට රතු-දුඹුරු බිබිලි; ප්‍රභාසංශ්ලේෂණය සහ ඇට පිරීම අඩු කරයි.
diseases.symptoms_ta: இலை மேற்பரப்பில் செம்பழுப்புக் கொப்புளங்கள்; ஒளிச்சேர்க்கையையும் மணி நிரம்புதலையும் குறைக்கும்.
diseases.favorable_conditions_si: ආර්ද්‍ර, සිසිල් තත්ත්ව, ඝනව සිටුවීම.
diseases.favorable_conditions_ta: ஈரப்பதமான, குளிர்ந்த நிலை, அடர்த்தியான நடவு.
diseases.prevention_si: ඔරොත්තු දෙන ප්‍රභේද. හොඳ පරතරය.
diseases.prevention_ta: எதிர்ப்புள்ள இனங்கள். நல்ல இடைவெளி.
diseases.treatment_si: Tebuconazole (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 1) හෝ Mancozeb (ලීටරයකට ග්‍රෑ. 2.5).
diseases.treatment_ta: Tebuconazole (லிட்டருக்கு 1 மி.லி) அல்லது Mancozeb (லிட்டருக்கு 2.5 கி).

diseases.name: Bacterial Wilt / Stewart's Wilt
diseases.symptoms: Pale green-yellow leaf streaks; wilting and death of young plants in severe cases.
diseases.favorable_conditions: High flea beetle populations; warm humid conditions.
diseases.prevention: Resistant varieties. Control flea beetle at seedling stage.
diseases.treatment: Flea beetle control with Chlorpyrifos.
diseases.symptoms_si: කොළ මත ලා කොළ-කහ ඉරි; දැඩි අවස්ථාවලදී ළපටි පැළ මැලවී මිය යයි.
diseases.symptoms_ta: இலைகளில் வெளிர் பச்சை-மஞ்சள் கோடுகள்; கடுமையான நிலையில் இளம் செடிகள் வாடி இறக்கும்.
diseases.favorable_conditions_si: පිම්මන කුරුමිණි ගහනය වැඩි වීම; උණුසුම් ආර්ද්‍ර තත්ත්ව.
diseases.favorable_conditions_ta: அதிக தத்துப்பூச்சி வண்டுகள்; வெப்பமான ஈரப்பதமான நிலை.
diseases.prevention_si: ඔරොත්තු දෙන ප්‍රභේද. පැළ අවධියේදී පිම්මන කුරුමිණියා පාලනය කරන්න.
diseases.prevention_ta: எதிர்ப்புள்ள இனங்கள். நாற்று நிலையில் தத்துப்பூச்சி வண்டைக் கட்டுப்படுத்துங்கள்.
diseases.treatment_si: Chlorpyrifos මගින් පිම්මන කුරුමිණියා පාලනය.
diseases.treatment_ta: Chlorpyrifos மூலம் தத்துப்பூச்சி வண்டுக் கட்டுப்பாடு.

pests.name: Fall Armyworm
pests.damage: Most destructive maize pest in Sri Lanka; feeds on whorl leaves and ears; severe yield loss.
pests.identification: Ragged windowpane damage on whorl leaves; frass and bored entry on ears.
pests.prevention: Pheromone traps for early detection. Regular field scouting. Act immediately.
pests.treatment: Spinosad 45SC (0.3 ml/L) or Emamectin benzoate (0.4 g/L) applied into whorl urgently.
pests.prevention_si: කලින්ම හඳුනාගැනීමට ෆෙරමෝන උගුල්. නිතිපතා කෙත් පරීක්ෂාව. වහාම ක්‍රියා කරන්න.
pests.prevention_ta: முன்கூட்டியே கண்டறிய இனக்கவர்ச்சிப் பொறிகள். தொடர் வயல் ஆய்வு. உடனே நடவடிக்கை எடுங்கள்.
pests.treatment_si: Spinosad 45SC (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 0.3) හෝ Emamectin benzoate (ලීටරයකට ග්‍රෑ. 0.4) හදිසියේම මැද දළුව තුළට යොදන්න.
pests.treatment_ta: Spinosad 45SC (லிட்டருக்கு 0.3 மி.லி) அல்லது Emamectin benzoate (லிட்டருக்கு 0.4 கி) உடனடியாக நடுக்குருத்துக்குள் தெளியுங்கள்.
pests.damage_si: ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ බඩ ඉරිඟුවලට වඩාත්ම විනාශකාරී පළිබෝධය; මැද දළුවේ කොළ සහ කරල් කයි; දැඩි අස්වනු හානියක්.
pests.damage_ta: இலங்கையில் மக்காச்சோளத்தின் மிக அழிவுகரமான பூச்சி; நடுக்குருத்து இலைகளையும் கதிர்களையும் உண்ணும்; கடும் மகசூல் இழப்பு.
pests.identification_si: මැද දළුවේ කොළවල ඉරුණු, ජනෙල් වැනි හානිය; කරල්වල අසූචි සහ විදින ලද සිදුරු.
pests.identification_ta: நடுக்குருத்து இலைகளில் கிழிந்த, சன்னல் போன்ற சேதம்; கதிர்களில் கழிவும் துளைகளும்.

pests.name: Stem Borer
pests.damage: Bores into stems causing dead heart; disrupts nutrient transport to ear.
pests.identification: Entry holes in stems; frass; wilted central shoot in young plants.
pests.prevention: Field sanitation. Trichogramma release at egg stage.
pests.treatment: Chlorpyrifos (2 ml/L) spray. Apply into whorl at 2nd-3rd instar.
pests.prevention_si: කෙත පිරිසිදුව තබා ගැනීම. බිත්තර අවධියේදී Trichogramma මුදා හැරීම.
pests.prevention_ta: வயல் சுகாதாரம். முட்டை நிலையில் Trichogramma ஒட்டுண்ணிகளை விடுவித்தல்.
pests.treatment_si: Chlorpyrifos (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 2) ඉසීම. කීටයාගේ 2–3 වන අවධියේදී මැද දළුව තුළට යොදන්න.
pests.treatment_ta: Chlorpyrifos (லிட்டருக்கு 2 மி.லி) தெளிப்பு. புழுவின் 2–3ஆம் நிலையில் நடுக்குருத்துக்குள் தெளியுங்கள்.
pests.damage_si: කඳ තුළට විද මැරුණු දළු ඇති කරයි; කරලට පෝෂක ගෙන යාම අඩාල කරයි.
pests.damage_ta: தண்டுக்குள் துளைத்துக் காய்ந்த குருத்தை ஏற்படுத்தும்; கதிருக்கு ஊட்டச்சத்து செல்வதைத் தடுக்கும்.
pests.identification_si: කඳේ ඇතුළු වූ සිදුරු; අසූචි; ළපටි පැළවල මැද දළුව මැලවීම.
pests.identification_ta: தண்டில் நுழைவுத் துளைகள்; கழிவு; இளம் செடிகளில் நடுக்குருத்து வாடுதல்.

pests.name: Aphid
pests.damage: Forms dense colonies on tassels and upper leaves; reduces pollination and grain fill.
pests.identification: Dense yellow-green colonies on upper plant; sticky honeydew.
pests.prevention: Encourage natural enemies. Avoid excess nitrogen.
pests.treatment: Imidacloprid (0.3 ml/L) or Dimethoate (1.5 ml/L) at threshold.
pests.prevention_si: ස්වාභාවික සතුරන් දිරිමත් කරන්න. අධික නයිට්‍රජන් යෙදීමෙන් වළකින්න.
pests.prevention_ta: இயற்கை எதிரிகளை ஊக்குவியுங்கள். அதிக நைட்ரஜனைத் தவிருங்கள்.
pests.treatment_si: සීමාව ඉක්මවූ විට Imidacloprid (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 0.3) හෝ Dimethoate (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 1.5).
pests.treatment_ta: வரம்பை மீறினால் Imidacloprid (லிட்டருக்கு 0.3 மி.லி) அல்லது Dimethoate (லிட்டருக்கு 1.5 மி.லி).
pests.damage_si: මල් කරල් සහ ඉහළ කොළ මත ඝන ජනපද සාදයි; පරාගණය සහ ඇට පිරීම අඩු කරයි.
pests.damage_ta: ஆண்பூங்கொத்திலும் மேல் இலைகளிலும் அடர்த்தியான கூட்டங்களை உருவாக்கும்; மகரந்தச் சேர்க்கையையும் மணி நிரம்புதலையும் குறைக்கும்.
pests.identification_si: පැළයේ ඉහළ කොටසේ කහ-කොළ පැහැ ඝන ජනපද; ඇලෙන සුළු මී පැණි වැනි ස්‍රාවයක්.
pests.identification_ta: செடியின் மேற்பகுதியில் மஞ்சள்-பச்சை அடர்த்தியான கூட்டங்கள்; ஒட்டும் தேன் போன்ற திரவம்.

risks.name: Fall Armyworm Outbreak
risks.description: Can destroy entire crop if not controlled within 72 hours of detection.
risks.signs: Frass in whorls, ragged leaves, rapid defoliation.
risks.mitigation: Scout daily from day 14. Apply insecticide into whorl IMMEDIATELY at first sign.
risks.description_si: හඳුනාගත් පැය 72ක් ඇතුළත පාලනය නොකළහොත් මුළු බෝගයම විනාශ කළ හැක.
risks.description_ta: கண்டறிந்த 72 மணி நேரத்துக்குள் கட்டுப்படுத்தாவிட்டால் முழுப் பயிரையும் அழிக்கலாம்.
risks.signs_si: මැද දළුවල අසූචි, ඉරුණු කොළ, වේගයෙන් කොළ අහිමි වීම.
risks.signs_ta: நடுக்குருத்தில் கழிவு, கிழிந்த இலைகள், வேகமான இலை இழப்பு.
risks.mitigation_si: 14 වන දින සිට දිනපතා පරීක්ෂා කරන්න. පළමු ලක්ෂණය දුටු විගසම මැද දළුව තුළට කෘමි නාශක යොදන්න.
risks.mitigation_ta: 14ஆம் நாளிலிருந்து தினமும் ஆய்வு செய்யுங்கள். முதல் அறிகுறியிலேயே உடனடியாக நடுக்குருத்துக்குள் பூச்சிக்கொல்லி தெளியுங்கள்.

risks.name: Drought at Tasseling
risks.description: Poor pollination causes blank cobs with no grain.
risks.signs: Brown silks before pollen shed. Empty cob at harvest.
risks.mitigation: Irrigate every 5–7 days. Never miss during this 2-week window.
risks.name_si: මල් කරල් මතු වන කාලයේ නියඟය
risks.description_si: දුර්වල පරාගණය නිසා ඇට නැති හිස් කරල් හටගනී.
risks.description_ta: குறைந்த மகரந்தச் சேர்க்கையால் மணியில்லா வெற்றுக் கதிர்கள் உருவாகும்.
risks.signs_si: පරාග මුදා හැරීමට පෙර රේණු දුඹුරු වීම. අස්වනු නෙළන විට හිස් කරල්.
risks.signs_ta: மகரந்தம் உதிர்வதற்கு முன் பட்டிழைகள் பழுப்பாதல். அறுவடையின் போது வெற்றுக் கதிர்கள்.
risks.mitigation_si: දින 5–7කට වරක් ජලය දෙන්න. මෙම සති 2ක කාලය තුළ කිසි විටෙක මඟ නොහරින්න.
risks.mitigation_ta: 5–7 நாட்களுக்கு ஒருமுறை நீர் பாய்ச்சுங்கள். இந்த 2 வாரக் காலத்தில் ஒருபோதும் தவறவிடாதீர்கள்.

indicators.grain: Kernels dented and hard, black layer visible at base of kernel
indicators.fresh: Silks brown, kernels milky when punctured

harvest.method: Pull cob downward and twist off. Remove husk. Spread to sun-dry.
harvest.frequency: Single harvest for dry grain; multiple for fresh corn
harvest.post_harvest: Sun dry 5–7 days to 13% moisture. Shell. Store in sealed bags or metal drums. Use phosphine tablets if storing more than 3 months.
harvest.method_si: කරල පහළට ඇද කරකවා කඩන්න. ලෙල්ල ඉවත් කරන්න. අව්වේ වියළීමට විහිදන්න.
harvest.method_ta: கதிரைக் கீழ்நோக்கி இழுத்துத் திருகி ஒடியுங்கள். தோலை உரியுங்கள். வெயிலில் உலர்த்தப் பரப்புங்கள்.
harvest.frequency_si: වියළි ඇට සඳහා එක් වරක්; නැවුම් බඩ ඉරිඟු සඳහා කිහිප වරක් අස්වනු නෙළීම
harvest.frequency_ta: உலர் தானியத்துக்கு ஒரே முறை; புதிய சோளத்துக்குப் பலமுறை அறுவடை
harvest.post_harvest_si: තෙතමනය 13% දක්වා දින 5–7ක් අව්වේ වියළන්න. ඇට ගලවන්න. මුද්‍රා තැබූ මලුවල හෝ ලෝහ බැරල්වල ගබඩා කරන්න. මාස 3කට වඩා ගබඩා කරන්නේ නම් ෆොස්ෆීන් පෙති භාවිත කරන්න.
harvest.post_harvest_ta: ஈரப்பதம் 13% ஆகும் வரை 5–7 நாட்கள் வெயிலில் உலர்த்துங்கள். மணிகளை உதிருங்கள். மூடிய பைகளிலோ உலோகப் பீப்பாய்களிலோ சேமியுங்கள். 3 மாதங்களுக்கு மேல் சேமித்தால் பொஸ்பீன் மாத்திரைகளைப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள்.

Maize.growth_stages_text: Maize cultivation follows several important growth stages including germination, seedling establishment, vegetative growth, tasseling, silking, pollination, grain filling, physiological maturity, and harvesting. Germination usually occurs within 4–8 days after sowing under suitable soil moisture and temperature conditions. During the seedling stage, roots and leaves develop rapidly, establishing a strong foundation for future growth. The vegetative stage lasts approximately 30–50 days, during which plants increase in height and leaf area. Tasseling marks the emergence of the male flowers at the top of the plant, while silking occurs when the female flower structures emerge from the ears. Successful pollination between tassels and silks is essential for complete kernel formation. Grain filling follows pollination as starch accumulates within developing kernels. The crop reaches physiological maturity when kernels become hard and a black layer forms at the base of the grain. Harvesting is generally carried out within 90–120 days after planting when grain moisture has decreased to suitable levels.
Maize.management_text: Successful maize cultivation requires a structured crop management schedule including land preparation, seed sowing, fertilizer application, irrigation management, weed control, pest monitoring, and harvesting activities. Farmers commonly use direct seeding methods and maintain spacing of approximately 20–30 cm between plants and 60–75 cm between rows to ensure adequate sunlight exposure, nutrient availability, and air circulation. Fertilizer management is critical because maize is a heavy nutrient feeder. Nitrogen is required for vigorous vegetative growth and leaf development, phosphorus promotes strong root growth and early establishment, while potassium improves grain filling, plant strength, and resistance to environmental stress. Organic manure or compost is often incorporated during land preparation to improve soil fertility and water retention.
Maize.disease_management_text: Irrigation management plays a significant role in achieving high maize yields. Adequate moisture is essential during germination to ensure uniform plant establishment. During vegetative growth, regular irrigation supports healthy leaf and stem development. Water demand becomes highest during tasseling, silking, pollination, and grain filling stages. Moisture stress during these critical periods can lead to poor pollination, incomplete kernel formation, and substantial yield reduction. While maize requires consistent soil moisture, excessive irrigation and waterlogging should be avoided because they can damage roots and increase the risk of disease outbreaks.
Maize.risk_mitigation_text: Disease and pest management are essential components of maize production. Fall armyworm is one of the most destructive pests affecting maize in Sri Lanka, feeding on leaves, whorls, tassels, and ears, causing severe yield losses. Stem borers tunnel into stems and weaken plant structure, reducing nutrient transport. Aphids suck plant sap and may transmit viral diseases. Leaf blight appears as elongated lesions on leaves that reduce photosynthesis and overall plant vigor. Rust disease causes reddish-brown pustules on leaves, leading to reduced growth and grain production. Bacterial wilt results in yellowing, wilting, and eventual death of infected plants. These pests and diseases can be controlled through crop rotation, use of resistant varieties, field sanitation, timely planting, balanced fertilizer application, biological control measures, and integrated pest management practices. Risk mitigation strategies are important for maintaining stable maize production and minimizing losses caused by environmental stresses. During drought periods, mulching, conservation tillage, and efficient irrigation systems help conserve soil moisture and reduce water stress. During periods of heavy rainfall, proper drainage systems prevent waterlogging and root damage. Regular field scouting enables early detection of pests and diseases, allowing timely intervention before major damage occurs. The use of certified seeds, proper plant spacing, balanced nutrient management, and crop rotation improves crop health and resilience. These practices help ensure consistent grain yields, better grain quality, and greater adaptability to changing climatic conditions and environmental challenges.
Maize.overview_si: ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ “බඩ ඉරිඟු” ලෙස හැඳින්වෙන බඩ ඉරිඟු (Zea mays) Poaceae කුලයට අයත් වැදගත් ධාන්‍ය බෝගයකි. හිතකර උණුසුම් දේශගුණය සහ ජලසම්පාදන පහසුකම් නිසා එය ශ්‍රී ලංකාව පුරා, විශේෂයෙන් අනුරාධපුරය, පොළොන්නරුව, මොණරාගල වැනි වියළි සහ අතරමැදි කලාපවල බහුලව වගා කෙරේ. බඩ ඉරිඟු 21°C–32°C අතර උෂ්ණත්වයේ හොඳින් වැඩෙන අතර, pH 5.5–7.0 අතර, හොඳින් ජලය බැස යන සාරවත් ලෝම හෝ වැලි ලෝම පසක් අවශ්‍ය වේ. ඉහළ අස්වැන්නකට මධ්‍යස්ථ වර්ෂාව, හොඳ හිරු එළිය සහ මල් පිපෙන හා ඇට පිරෙන අවධිවලදී නිසි පාංශු තෙතමනය අවශ්‍යය. බඩ ඉරිඟු ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ වැදගත් ආහාර සහ කාර්මික බෝගයක් වන අතර, මිනිස් පරිභෝජනය, සත්ත්ව ආහාර සහ ආහාර සැකසුම් කර්මාන්ත සඳහා භාවිත වේ; ඉහළ කාබෝහයිඩ්‍රේට් සහ ශක්ති ප්‍රමාණය නිසා අගය කෙරේ. ප්‍රභේදය සහ පාරිසරික තත්ත්ව අනුව සාමාන්‍යයෙන් මේරීමට දින 90–120ක් පමණ ගත වේ. උෂ්ණත්වය, පාංශු තෙතමනය, වර්ෂාව, හිරු එළිය, ආර්ද්‍රතාව සහ පසේ සාරවත්බව වගාවට බලපාන ප්‍රධාන සාධක වේ. සේනා දළඹුවා, කඳ විදින්නා, කුඩිත්තා, පත්‍ර අංගමාරය, මලකඩ රෝගය සහ බැක්ටීරියා මැලවීම පොදු පළිබෝධ හා රෝග වන අතර, නිසි ලෙස පාලනය නොකළහොත් ඒවා අස්වැන්න සහ ඇටවල ගුණාත්මකභාවය බෙහෙවින් අඩු කරයි.
Maize.overview_ta: இலங்கையில் “சோளம்” என அழைக்கப்படும் மக்காச்சோளம் (Zea mays), Poaceae குடும்பத்தைச் சேர்ந்த முக்கியமான தானியப் பயிர். சாதகமான வெப்பமான காலநிலையும் நீர்ப்பாசன வசதியும் காரணமாக இலங்கை முழுவதும், குறிப்பாக அனுராதபுரம், பொலன்னறுவை, மொணராகலை போன்ற உலர் மற்றும் இடை வலயங்களில் பரவலாகப் பயிரிடப்படுகிறது. மக்காச்சோளம் 21°C–32°C வெப்பநிலையில் நன்றாக வளரும்; pH 5.5–7.0 உள்ள, நன்கு நீர் வடியும் வளமான இருமண் அல்லது மணல் கலந்த இருமண் தேவை. அதிக மகசூலுக்கு மிதமான மழை, நல்ல சூரிய ஒளி, பூக்கும் மற்றும் தானியம் நிரம்பும் நிலைகளில் சரியான மண் ஈரப்பதம் தேவை. மக்காச்சோளம் இலங்கையில் முக்கியமான உணவு மற்றும் தொழில்துறைப் பயிர்; மனித உணவு, கால்நடைத் தீவனம், உணவுப் பதப்படுத்தும் தொழில்கள் ஆகியவற்றுக்குப் பயன்படுகிறது; அதிக மாவுச்சத்துக்கும் ஆற்றலுக்கும் மதிக்கப்படுகிறது. இனம் மற்றும் சூழல் நிலைமைகளைப் பொறுத்து பொதுவாக முற்றுவதற்குச் சுமார் 90–120 நாட்கள் ஆகும். வெப்பநிலை, மண் ஈரப்பதம், மழை, சூரிய ஒளி, காற்று ஈரப்பதம், மண் வளம் ஆகியவை சாகுபடியைப் பாதிக்கும் முக்கியக் காரணிகள். படைப்புழு, தண்டுத் துளைப்பான், அசுவினி, இலைக் கருகல், துரு நோய், பாக்டீரியா வாடல் ஆகியவை பொதுவான பூச்சிகளும் நோய்களும்; சரியாகக் கட்டுப்படுத்தாவிட்டால் இவை மகசூலையும் தானியத் தரத்தையும் பெருமளவு குறைக்கும்.

Sweet Corn.overview: Sweet corn, commonly known as “Sweet corn” in Sri Lanka, is a high-value cereal vegetable crop belonging to the Poaceae family and scientifically known as Zea mays saccharata. It is widely cultivated across Sri Lanka, especially in dry and intermediate zones as well as some irrigated farming areas, due to its fast growth and strong market demand. Sweet corn grows best in temperatures between 20°C and 30°C and requires well-drained fertile loamy or sandy loam soil with a soil pH ranging from 5.5 to 7.0. The crop needs moderate rainfall, regular irrigation, and full sunlight exposure for healthy plant growth, proper cob formation, and good kernel development. Sweet corn is widely consumed in Sri Lanka as a boiled snack, roasted food, and ingredient in salads and mixed dishes, and it is valued for its sweetness, fiber, and nutritional content. The crop generally takes about 65 to 100 days to mature depending on the variety and environmental conditions. Important factors affecting cultivation include temperature, soil moisture, rainfall, sunlight, humidity, and soil fertility. Common pests and diseases include fall armyworm, stem borers, aphids, cutworms, leaf blight, rust, and bacterial wilt, which can significantly reduce yield and cob quality if not properly managed.

stages.name: Land Preparation

activities.title: Plough 25 cm deep and fine till
activities.description: Level well. Sweet corn requires uniform growth for simultaneous harvest.
activities.why: Uniform field preparation = uniform plant population = single-time harvest.
activities.title_si: සෙ.මී. 25ක් ගැඹුරට සීසා පස සියුම් කරන්න
activities.description_si: හොඳින් සමතලා කරන්න. එකවර අස්වනු නෙළීමට මිහිරි බඩ ඉරිඟුවලට ඒකාකාර වර්ධනයක් අවශ්‍යය.
activities.description_ta: நன்றாகச் சமன்செய்யுங்கள். ஒரே நேரத்தில் அறுவடை செய்ய இனிப்பு மக்காச்சோளத்துக்குச் சீரான வளர்ச்சி தேவை.
activities.why_si: ඒකාකාර කෙත් සැකසීම = ඒකාකාර පැළ ගහනය = එක් වරක් අස්වනු නෙළීම.
activities.why_ta: சீரான வயல் தயாரிப்பு = சீரான செடி எண்ணிக்கை = ஒரே முறை அறுவடை.

stages.description_si: සාරවත් කෙතක් සකස් කරන්න.

stages.name: Sowing

activities.title: Sow 2 seeds per hole, 25×60 cm
activities.description: Cover 3–4 cm deep. Water.
activities.why: Higher population than grain maize for sweet corn.
activities.description_si: සෙ.මී. 3–4ක් ගැඹුරට වසන්න. ජලය දෙන්න.
activities.description_ta: 3–4 செ.மீ ஆழத்தில் மூடுங்கள். நீர் பாய்ச்சுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: මිහිරි බඩ ඉරිඟු සඳහා ඇට බඩ ඉරිඟුවලට වඩා වැඩි ගහනයක්.
activities.why_ta: தானிய மக்காச்சோளத்தை விட இனிப்பு மக்காச்சோளத்துக்கு அதிக செடி எண்ணிக்கை.

activities.title: Thin to 1 plant
activities.description: Remove weaker seedling.
activities.why: Single strong plant per position.
activities.description_si: දුර්වල පැළය ඉවත් කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: வலுவற்ற நாற்றை அகற்றுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: එක් ස්ථානයකට ශක්තිමත් එක් පැළයක්.
activities.why_ta: ஓர் இடத்துக்கு ஒரு வலுவான செடி.

stages.description_si: නිවැරදි පැළ ගහනයකින් වපුරන්න.

stages.name: Vegetative Growth

activities.title: Weed and hill up
activities.description: Hoe between rows and heap soil around base.
activities.why: Hilling prevents lodging.
activities.description_si: පේළි අතර උදැල්ලෙන් කොටා පාමුල වටා පස් ගොඩ කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: வரிசைகளுக்கு இடையே கொத்தி, அடிப்பகுதியைச் சுற்றி மண்ணைக் குவியுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: පස් කෙටීමෙන් පැළ ඇලවීම වළකී.
activities.why_ta: மண் அணைப்பது செடிகள் சாய்வதைத் தடுக்கும்.

activities.title: Top dressing 1
activities.description: Urea 100 kg/ha side dress.
activities.why: High nitrogen for sweet corn quality.
activities.description_si: යූරියා හෙක්ටයාරයකට කි.ග්‍රෑ. 100 පැත්තකින් යෙදීම.
activities.description_ta: எக்டேருக்கு 100 கி.கி யூரியா பக்கவாட்டில் இடுதல்.
activities.why_si: මිහිරි බඩ ඉරිඟුවල ගුණාත්මකභාවයට වැඩි නයිට්‍රජන්.
activities.why_ta: இனிப்பு மக்காச்சோளத்தின் தரத்துக்கு அதிக நைட்ரஜன்.

activities.title: Scout for Fall Armyworm
activities.description: Check whorls for frass.
activities.why: FAW management same as maize — critical early.
activities.description_si: අසූචි සඳහා මැද දළු පරීක්ෂා කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: கழிவுக்காக நடுக்குருத்துகளைச் சோதியுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: සේනා දළඹුවා පාලනය බඩ ඉරිඟුවලට සමානයි — මුල් අවධියේදී අත්‍යවශ්‍යයි.
activities.why_ta: படைப்புழுக் கட்டுப்பாடு மக்காச்சோளத்தைப் போன்றதே — ஆரம்பத்தில் மிக அவசியம்.

stages.description_si: වේගවත් වර්ධන අවධිය.

stages.name: Tasseling & Silking

activities.title: Irrigate every 4–5 days
activities.description: Critical moisture at silking.
activities.why: Silk drying out = poor pollination = missing kernels.
activities.description_si: රේණු මතු වන කාලයේ තෙතමනය අත්‍යවශ්‍යයි.
activities.description_ta: பட்டிழை வெளிவரும் போது ஈரப்பதம் மிக அவசியம்.
activities.why_si: රේණු වියළීම = දුර්වල පරාගණය = ඇට නැති කොටස්.
activities.why_ta: பட்டிழை காய்தல் = குறைந்த மகரந்தச் சேர்க்கை = மணிகள் இல்லாத பகுதிகள்.

activities.title: Top dressing 2
activities.description: Urea 50 kg/ha.
activities.why: Final nitrogen for sweet kernel development.
activities.description_si: යූරියා හෙක්ටයාරයකට කි.ග්‍රෑ. 50.
activities.description_ta: எக்டேருக்கு 50 கி.கி யூரியா.
activities.why_si: මිහිරි ඇට වර්ධනයට අවසාන නයිට්‍රජන්.
activities.why_ta: இனிப்பு மணி வளர்ச்சிக்கு இறுதி நைட்ரஜன்.

stages.description_si: පරාගණය ඇට පිරීම තීරණය කරයි.
stages.name_si: මල් කරල් (ටැසල්) සහ රේණු (සිල්ක්) පිට වීම

stages.name: Harvest
stages.description: Harvest at milky stage — timing is critical.

activities.title: Check for milky stage
activities.description: Pierce a kernel with thumbnail — milky liquid = harvest now.
activities.why: Sweet corn quality window is only 3–5 days. Miss it = starchy cobs.
activities.description_si: නියපොත්තෙන් ඇටයක් සිදුරු කරන්න — කිරි වැනි දියරයක් = දැන්ම අස්වනු නෙළන්න.
activities.description_ta: நகத்தால் ஒரு மணியைக் குத்துங்கள் — பால் போன்ற திரவம் = இப்போதே அறுவடை செய்யுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: මිහිරි බඩ ඉරිඟුවල ගුණාත්මක කාලය දින 3–5ක් පමණි. එය මඟ හැරුණොත් = පිෂ්ඨමය කරල්.
activities.why_ta: இனிப்பு மக்காச்சோளத்தின் தரமான காலம் 3–5 நாட்கள் மட்டுமே. தவறவிட்டால் = மாவுத்தன்மையுள்ள கதிர்கள்.

activities.title: Harvest entire field within 3–5 days
activities.description: Stagger planting by 2 weeks for continuous supply.
activities.why: Once at milky stage, all cobs mature quickly.
activities.title_si: මුළු කෙතම දින 3–5ක් ඇතුළත අස්වනු නෙළන්න
activities.description_si: නොකඩවා සැපයුමක් සඳහා සති 2 බැගින් පරතරයක් තබා සිටුවන්න.
activities.description_ta: தொடர்ச்சியான விநியோகத்துக்கு 2 வார இடைவெளியில் படிப்படியாக நடுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: කිරි අවධියට පැමිණි පසු සියලු කරල් ඉක්මනින් මේරේ.
activities.why_ta: பால் நிலையை அடைந்ததும் எல்லாக் கதிர்களும் விரைவில் முற்றிவிடும்.

stages.description_si: කිරි අවධියේ අස්වනු නෙළන්න — කාලය ඉතා තීරණාත්මකයි.
stages.description_ta: பால் நிலையில் அறுவடை செய்யுங்கள் — நேரம் மிக முக்கியம்.

irrigation.notes: Sweet corn has LESS drought tolerance than grain maize. Never miss irrigation at silking.
irrigation.notes_si: මිහිරි බඩ ඉරිඟුවලට ඇට බඩ ඉරිඟුවලට වඩා නියඟයට ඔරොත්තු දීමේ හැකියාව අඩුයි. රේණු මතු වන කාලයේ කිසි විටෙක ජලය දීම මඟ නොහරින්න.
irrigation.notes_ta: தானிய மக்காச்சோளத்தை விட இனிப்பு மக்காச்சோளத்துக்கு வறட்சி தாங்கும் திறன் குறைவு. பட்டிழை வெளிவரும் போது நீர்ப்பாசனத்தை ஒருபோதும் தவறவிடாதீர்கள்.

diseases.name: Leaf Blight
diseases.symptoms: Elongated tan/brown lesions on leaves; reduces photosynthesis.
diseases.favorable_conditions: Humid conditions, warm weather, dense planting.
diseases.prevention: Good plant spacing. Resistant varieties. Crop rotation.
diseases.treatment: Mancozeb 80WP (2.5 g/L) or Propiconazole (1 ml/L) spray.
diseases.symptoms_si: කොළ මත දිගටි ලා දුඹුරු/දුඹුරු තුවාල; ප්‍රභාසංශ්ලේෂණය අඩු කරයි.
diseases.symptoms_ta: இலைகளில் நீண்ட மங்கிய பழுப்பு/பழுப்புப் புண்கள்; ஒளிச்சேர்க்கையைக் குறைக்கும்.
diseases.favorable_conditions_si: ආර්ද්‍ර තත්ත්ව, උණුසුම් කාලගුණය, ඝනව සිටුවීම.
diseases.favorable_conditions_ta: ஈரப்பதமான நிலை, வெப்பமான வானிலை, அடர்த்தியான நடவு.
diseases.prevention_si: හොඳ පැළ පරතරය. ඔරොත්තු දෙන ප්‍රභේද. බෝග මාරුව.
diseases.prevention_ta: நல்ல செடி இடைவெளி. எதிர்ப்புள்ள இனங்கள். பயிர்ச் சுழற்சி.
diseases.treatment_si: Mancozeb 80WP (ලීටරයකට ග්‍රෑ. 2.5) හෝ Propiconazole (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 1) ඉසීම.
diseases.treatment_ta: Mancozeb 80WP (லிட்டருக்கு 2.5 கி) அல்லது Propiconazole (லிட்டருக்கு 1 மி.லி) தெளிப்பு.

diseases.name: Rust
diseases.symptoms: Reddish-brown pustules on leaf surfaces; defoliation under severe attack.
diseases.favorable_conditions: Humid weather, cool nights, moderate temperatures.
diseases.prevention: Resistant varieties. Good plant spacing.
diseases.treatment: Tebuconazole (1 ml/L) or Mancozeb (2.5 g/L).
diseases.symptoms_si: කොළ මතුපිට රතු-දුඹුරු බිබිලි; දැඩි ආසාදනයකදී කොළ හැලේ.
diseases.symptoms_ta: இலை மேற்பரப்பில் செம்பழுப்புக் கொப்புளங்கள்; கடும் தாக்குதலில் இலைகள் உதிரும்.
diseases.favorable_conditions_si: ආර්ද්‍ර කාලගුණය, සිසිල් රාත්‍රි, මධ්‍යස්ථ උෂ්ණත්වය.
diseases.favorable_conditions_ta: ஈரப்பதமான வானிலை, குளிர்ந்த இரவுகள், மிதமான வெப்பநிலை.
diseases.prevention_si: ඔරොත්තු දෙන ප්‍රභේද. හොඳ පැළ පරතරය.
diseases.prevention_ta: எதிர்ப்புள்ள இனங்கள். நல்ல செடி இடைவெளி.
diseases.treatment_si: Tebuconazole (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 1) හෝ Mancozeb (ලීටරයකට ග්‍රෑ. 2.5).
diseases.treatment_ta: Tebuconazole (லிட்டருக்கு 1 மி.லி) அல்லது Mancozeb (லிட்டருக்கு 2.5 கி).

diseases.name: Bacterial Wilt / Stewart's Wilt
diseases.symptoms: Pale green to yellow streaks on leaves; plants wilt and die in severe cases.
diseases.favorable_conditions: High flea beetle population; warm wet conditions.
diseases.prevention: Resistant varieties. Flea beetle control at seedling stage.
diseases.treatment: Control flea beetle vector with Chlorpyrifos. No direct chemical cure.
diseases.cause_si: බැක්ටීරියා (Pantoea stewartii — පිම්මන කුරුමිණියා මගින් පැතිරේ)
diseases.symptoms_si: කොළ මත ලා කොළ සිට කහ දක්වා ඉරි; දැඩි අවස්ථාවලදී පැළ මැලවී මිය යයි.
diseases.symptoms_ta: இலைகளில் வெளிர் பச்சை முதல் மஞ்சள் வரை கோடுகள்; கடுமையான நிலையில் செடிகள் வாடி இறக்கும்.
diseases.favorable_conditions_si: පිම්මන කුරුමිණි ගහනය වැඩි වීම; උණුසුම් තෙත් තත්ත්ව.
diseases.favorable_conditions_ta: அதிக தத்துப்பூச்சி வண்டுகள்; வெப்பமான ஈரமான நிலை.
diseases.prevention_si: ඔරොත්තු දෙන ප්‍රභේද. පැළ අවධියේදී පිම්මන කුරුමිණියා පාලනය.
diseases.prevention_ta: எதிர்ப்புள்ள இனங்கள். நாற்று நிலையில் தத்துப்பூச்சி வண்டுக் கட்டுப்பாடு.
diseases.treatment_si: Chlorpyrifos මගින් රෝගය පතුරුවන පිම්මන කුරුමිණියා පාලනය කරන්න. සෘජු රසායනික ප්‍රතිකාරයක් නැත.
diseases.treatment_ta: நோயைப் பரப்பும் தத்துப்பூச்சி வண்டை Chlorpyrifos மூலம் கட்டுப்படுத்துங்கள். நேரடி இரசாயனச் சிகிச்சை இல்லை.

pests.name: Fall Armyworm
pests.damage: Most destructive pest of maize and sweet corn; feeds on whorl leaves and developing cobs causing severe yield loss.
pests.identification: Ragged windowpane damage on whorl leaves; frass and entry holes on cobs.
pests.prevention: Regular monitoring from seedling stage. Pheromone traps. Early intervention.
pests.treatment: Spinosad 45SC (0.3 ml/L) or Emamectin benzoate (0.4 g/L) into whorl. Act within 1–2 days of detection.
pests.prevention_si: පැළ අවධියේ සිට නිතිපතා නිරීක්ෂණය. ෆෙරමෝන උගුල්. කලින්ම මැදිහත් වීම.
pests.prevention_ta: நாற்று நிலையிலிருந்தே தொடர் கண்காணிப்பு. இனக்கவர்ச்சிப் பொறிகள். முன்கூட்டிய தலையீடு.
pests.treatment_si: Spinosad 45SC (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 0.3) හෝ Emamectin benzoate (ලීටරයකට ග්‍රෑ. 0.4) මැද දළුව තුළට. හඳුනාගත් දින 1–2ක් ඇතුළත ක්‍රියා කරන්න.
pests.treatment_ta: Spinosad 45SC (லிட்டருக்கு 0.3 மி.லி) அல்லது Emamectin benzoate (லிட்டருக்கு 0.4 கி) நடுக்குருத்துக்குள். கண்டறிந்த 1–2 நாட்களுக்குள் நடவடிக்கை எடுங்கள்.
pests.damage_si: බඩ ඉරිඟු සහ මිහිරි බඩ ඉරිඟුවල වඩාත්ම විනාශකාරී පළිබෝධය; මැද දළුවේ කොළ සහ වැඩෙන කරල් කමින් දැඩි අස්වනු හානියක් ඇති කරයි.
pests.damage_ta: மக்காச்சோளம் மற்றும் இனிப்பு மக்காச்சோளத்தின் மிக அழிவுகரமான பூச்சி; நடுக்குருத்து இலைகளையும் வளரும் கதிர்களையும் உண்டு கடும் மகசூல் இழப்பை ஏற்படுத்தும்.
pests.identification_si: මැද දළුවේ කොළවල ඉරුණු, ජනෙල් වැනි හානිය; කරල්වල අසූචි සහ ඇතුළු වූ සිදුරු.
pests.identification_ta: நடுக்குருத்து இலைகளில் கிழிந்த, சன்னல் போன்ற சேதம்; கதிர்களில் கழிவும் நுழைவுத் துளைகளும்.

pests.name: Stem Borer
pests.damage: Larvae tunnel into stems causing dead heart and weakening plants; reduces nutrient flow to cob.
pests.identification: Entry holes in stems with frass; wilted growing point in young plants.
pests.prevention: Field sanitation. Release of Trichogramma egg parasitoids.
pests.treatment: Chlorpyrifos (2 ml/L) at early infestation. Apply into whorl.
pests.prevention_si: කෙත පිරිසිදුව තබා ගැනීම. Trichogramma බිත්තර පරපෝෂිතයන් මුදා හැරීම.
pests.prevention_ta: வயல் சுகாதாரம். Trichogramma முட்டை ஒட்டுண்ணிகளை விடுவித்தல்.
pests.treatment_si: ආසාදනයේ මුල් අවධියේදී Chlorpyrifos (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 2). මැද දළුව තුළට යොදන්න.
pests.treatment_ta: தாக்குதலின் ஆரம்பத்தில் Chlorpyrifos (லிட்டருக்கு 2 மி.லி). நடுக்குருத்துக்குள் தெளியுங்கள்.
pests.damage_si: කීටයන් කඳ තුළට උමං හාරා මැරුණු දළු ඇති කර පැළ දුර්වල කරයි; කරලට පෝෂක ගලා යාම අඩු කරයි.
pests.damage_ta: புழுக்கள் தண்டுக்குள் சுரங்கம் தோண்டி காய்ந்த குருத்தை ஏற்படுத்தி செடிகளை வலுவிழக்கச் செய்யும்; கதிருக்கு ஊட்டச்சத்து செல்வதைக் குறைக்கும்.
pests.identification_si: අසූචි සහිත, කඳේ ඇතුළු වූ සිදුරු; ළපටි පැළවල වැඩෙන අග්‍රය මැලවීම.
pests.identification_ta: கழிவுடன் கூடிய தண்டு நுழைவுத் துளைகள்; இளம் செடிகளில் வளர் நுனி வாடுதல்.

pests.name: Cutworm
pests.damage: Cuts young seedling stems at soil level overnight.
pests.identification: Collapsed seedlings; fat caterpillar in soil near base.
pests.prevention: Deep ploughing before planting to expose larvae.
pests.treatment: Chlorpyrifos granules in soil at planting.
pests.prevention_si: කීටයන් මතුපිටට ගැනීමට සිටුවීමට පෙර ගැඹුරට සීසෑම.
pests.prevention_ta: புழுக்களை வெளிப்படுத்த நடவுக்கு முன் ஆழமாக உழுதல்.
pests.treatment_si: සිටුවන විට පසට Chlorpyrifos කැට.
pests.treatment_ta: நடவின் போது மண்ணில் Chlorpyrifos குருணைகள்.
pests.damage_si: රාත්‍රියේදී ළපටි පැළවල කඳ පොළොව මට්ටමින් කපයි.
pests.damage_ta: இரவில் இளம் நாற்றுகளின் தண்டுகளை மண் மட்டத்தில் வெட்டும்.
pests.identification_si: ඇද වැටුණු පැළ; පාමුල අසල පසේ මහත දළඹුවෙක්.
pests.identification_ta: சாய்ந்து விழுந்த நாற்றுகள்; அடிப்பகுதி அருகே மண்ணில் பருத்த புழு.

pests.name: Aphid
pests.damage: Sucks sap from leaves and tassels; reduces pollination and grain fill.
pests.identification: Dense colonies on leaves and tassels.
pests.prevention: Natural enemies. Neem oil spray.
pests.treatment: Imidacloprid (0.3 ml/L) if severe.
pests.prevention_si: ස්වාභාවික සතුරන්. කොහොඹ තෙල් ඉසීම.
pests.prevention_ta: இயற்கை எதிரிகள். வேப்ப எண்ணெய் தெளிப்பு.
pests.treatment_si: දැඩි නම් Imidacloprid (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 0.3).
pests.treatment_ta: கடுமையானால் Imidacloprid (லிட்டருக்கு 0.3 மி.லி).
pests.damage_si: කොළ සහ මල් කරල්වලින් යුෂ උරා බොයි; පරාගණය සහ ඇට පිරීම අඩු කරයි.
pests.damage_ta: இலைகளிலும் ஆண்பூங்கொத்துகளிலும் சாற்றை உறிஞ்சும்; மகரந்தச் சேர்க்கையையும் மணி நிரம்புதலையும் குறைக்கும்.
pests.identification_si: කොළ සහ මල් කරල් මත ඝන ජනපද.
pests.identification_ta: இலைகளிலும் ஆண்பூங்கொத்துகளிலும் அடர்த்தியான கூட்டங்கள்.

risks.name: Fall Armyworm
risks.description: Destroys crop rapidly if not controlled within 48–72 hours.
risks.mitigation: Scout daily. Act immediately.
risks.description_si: පැය 48–72ක් ඇතුළත පාලනය නොකළහොත් බෝගය වේගයෙන් විනාශ කරයි.
risks.description_ta: 48–72 மணி நேரத்துக்குள் கட்டுப்படுத்தாவிட்டால் பயிரை வேகமாக அழிக்கும்.
risks.signs_si: මැද දළුවල අසූචි, වේගයෙන් කොළ හැලීම.
risks.mitigation_si: දිනපතා පරීක්ෂා කරන්න. වහාම ක්‍රියා කරන්න.
risks.mitigation_ta: தினமும் ஆய்வு செய்யுங்கள். உடனே நடவடிக்கை எடுங்கள்.

risks.name: Missing Harvest Window
risks.description: Over-mature sweet corn becomes starchy and worthless.
risks.signs: Hard starchy kernels. No milky liquid.
risks.mitigation: Check daily from day 63. Harvest entire block within 3–5 days of milky stage.
risks.description_si: අධික ලෙස මේරූ මිහිරි බඩ ඉරිඟු පිෂ්ඨමය වී වටිනාකමක් නැති වේ.
risks.description_ta: அதிகம் முற்றிய இனிப்பு மக்காச்சோளம் மாவுத்தன்மையாகி மதிப்பிழக்கும்.
risks.signs_si: තද පිෂ්ඨමය ඇට. කිරි වැනි දියරයක් නැත.
risks.signs_ta: கடினமான மாவுத்தன்மையுள்ள மணிகள். பால் போன்ற திரவம் இல்லை.
risks.mitigation_si: 63 වන දින සිට දිනපතා පරීක්ෂා කරන්න. කිරි අවධියට පැමිණ දින 3–5ක් ඇතුළත මුළු කොටසම අස්වනු නෙළන්න.
risks.mitigation_ta: 63ஆம் நாளிலிருந்து தினமும் சோதியுங்கள். பால் நிலையை அடைந்த 3–5 நாட்களுக்குள் முழுப் பகுதியையும் அறுவடை செய்யுங்கள்.

indicators: Cob feels plump and firm when squeezed through husk
Milky liquid spurts from kernel when pressed with thumbnail
harvest.method: Snap cob downward and twist off. Keep husks on for freshness.
harvest.frequency: Harvest all cobs within 3–5 days of reaching milky stage
harvest.post_harvest: Keep in husk. Store cool. Market within 24–48 hours. Sugars convert to starch rapidly at ambient temperature.
harvest.method_si: කරල පහළට නවා කරකවා කඩන්න. නැවුම්බව රැකීමට ලෙල්ල ඉවත් නොකරන්න.
harvest.method_ta: கதிரைக் கீழ்நோக்கி வளைத்துத் திருகி ஒடியுங்கள். புத்துணர்வுக்காகத் தோலை உரிக்காதீர்கள்.
harvest.frequency_si: කිරි අවධියට පැමිණ දින 3–5ක් ඇතුළත සියලු කරල් අස්වනු නෙළන්න
harvest.frequency_ta: பால் நிலையை அடைந்த 3–5 நாட்களுக்குள் எல்லாக் கதிர்களையும் அறுவடை செய்தல்
harvest.post_harvest_si: ලෙල්ල සහිතවම තබන්න. සිසිල්ව ගබඩා කරන්න. පැය 24–48ක් ඇතුළත වෙළඳපොළට යවන්න. සාමාන්‍ය උෂ්ණත්වයේදී සීනි ඉක්මනින් පිෂ්ඨය බවට පත් වේ.
harvest.post_harvest_ta: தோலுடனேயே வையுங்கள். குளிர்ச்சியாகச் சேமியுங்கள். 24–48 மணி நேரத்துக்குள் சந்தைப்படுத்துங்கள். அறை வெப்பநிலையில் சர்க்கரை விரைவாக மாவுச்சத்தாக மாறும்.
indicators_si: ලෙල්ල හරහා මිරිකූ විට කරල පිරුණු හා තද බවක් දැනේ
නියපොත්තෙන් තද කළ විට ඇටයෙන් කිරි වැනි දියරයක් විදී

Sweet Corn.growth_stages_text: Sweet corn cultivation follows several important growth stages including germination, seedling establishment, vegetative growth, tasseling, silking, pollination, cob development, grain filling, and harvesting. Germination usually occurs within 4–7 days after sowing under favorable moisture and temperature conditions. During the seedling stage, plants establish their root systems and begin rapid leaf development. Vegetative growth continues for approximately 25–40 days, followed by tasseling, where the male flowers emerge at the top of the plant. Silking occurs shortly afterward when female flower structures emerge from developing cobs. Successful pollination between tassels and silks is essential for complete kernel formation. Following pollination, kernels develop and fill with sugars, giving sweet corn its characteristic sweetness. Harvesting is generally carried out 65–100 days after planting when cobs reach the milk stage and kernels are fully developed but still tender.
Sweet Corn.management_text: Successful sweet corn cultivation requires a well-planned crop management schedule including land preparation, seed sowing, fertilizer application, irrigation management, weed control, pest monitoring, and harvesting. Farmers commonly use direct seeding methods with spacing of approximately 20–30 cm between plants and 60–75 cm between rows to allow adequate sunlight penetration and air circulation. Fertilizer management is important because sweet corn has relatively high nutrient requirements. Nitrogen promotes vigorous vegetative growth, phosphorus supports root development and early plant establishment, while potassium improves cob development, kernel quality, and plant resistance to environmental stress. Organic manure or compost is often incorporated during land preparation to improve soil fertility and water-holding capacity.
Sweet Corn.disease_management_text: Irrigation management is critical throughout the growing season. Adequate moisture is essential during germination to ensure uniform seed emergence. During vegetative growth, regular watering supports leaf and stem development. Water demand is highest during tasseling, silking, pollination, and cob development stages, where moisture stress can significantly reduce kernel formation and yield. Irrigation should be applied regularly while avoiding waterlogging, which can damage roots and encourage disease development. Mulching and efficient irrigation methods can help conserve soil moisture during dry periods.
Sweet Corn.risk_mitigation_text: Disease and pest management are essential for maintaining healthy crops and achieving high yields. Fall armyworm is one of the most destructive pests, feeding on leaves, whorls, and developing cobs, causing severe yield losses. Stem borers tunnel into stalks and weaken plants, while aphids suck plant sap and may transmit diseases. Cutworms attack young seedlings by cutting stems near the soil surface. Leaf blight appears as elongated brown lesions on leaves and can reduce photosynthesis. Rust disease causes reddish-brown pustules on leaves, weakening plant growth. Bacterial wilt causes yellowing, wilting, and eventual plant death. These problems can be managed through crop rotation, resistant varieties, balanced fertilizer application, proper field sanitation, biological control methods, and integrated pest management practices. Risk mitigation strategies play an important role in ensuring stable sweet corn production. During periods of drought, mulching and efficient irrigation systems help conserve soil moisture and reduce water stress. Proper field drainage is necessary during heavy rainfall to prevent root damage and disease outbreaks. Regular field scouting allows early detection of pest and disease problems so that corrective measures can be implemented promptly. The use of certified seeds, timely planting, proper plant spacing, crop rotation, and balanced nutrient management improves crop health and productivity. These practices help ensure consistent yields, high-quality cobs, and greater resilience to changing environmental and climatic conditions.
Sweet Corn.overview_si: ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ “ස්වීට් කෝන්” ලෙස හැඳින්වෙන මිහිරි බඩ ඉරිඟු (Zea mays saccharata) Poaceae කුලයට අයත්, ඉහළ වටිනාකමක් ඇති ධාන්‍ය එළවළු බෝගයකි. වේගවත් වර්ධනය සහ ප්‍රබල වෙළඳපොළ ඉල්ලුම නිසා එය ශ්‍රී ලංකාව පුරා, විශේෂයෙන් වියළි සහ අතරමැදි කලාපවල මෙන්ම ඇතැම් වාරිමාර්ග ගොවි ප්‍රදේශවලද වගා කෙරේ. මිහිරි බඩ ඉරිඟු 20°C–30°C අතර උෂ්ණත්වයේ හොඳින් වැඩෙන අතර, pH 5.5–7.0 අතර, හොඳින් ජලය බැස යන සාරවත් ලෝම හෝ වැලි ලෝම පසක් අවශ්‍ය වේ. නිරෝගී වර්ධනයට, නිසි කරල් සෑදීමට සහ හොඳ ඇට වර්ධනයට මධ්‍යස්ථ වර්ෂාව, නිතිපතා ජලසම්පාදනය සහ පූර්ණ හිරු එළිය අවශ්‍යය. මිහිරි බඩ ඉරිඟු ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ තම්බා කෙටි ආහාරයක් ලෙස, පුළුස්සා සහ සලාද හා මිශ්‍ර ආහාරවල අමුද්‍රව්‍යයක් ලෙස බහුලව ආහාරයට ගන්නා අතර, එහි මිහිරි රසය, තන්තු සහ පෝෂණීය වටිනාකම නිසා අගය කෙරේ. ප්‍රභේදය සහ පාරිසරික තත්ත්ව අනුව සාමාන්‍යයෙන් මේරීමට දින 65–100ක් පමණ ගත වේ. උෂ්ණත්වය, පාංශු තෙතමනය, වර්ෂාව, හිරු එළිය, ආර්ද්‍රතාව සහ පසේ සාරවත්බව වගාවට බලපාන ප්‍රධාන සාධක වේ. සේනා දළඹුවා, කඳ විදින්නා, කුඩිත්තා, කපන දළඹුවා, පත්‍ර අංගමාරය, මලකඩ රෝගය සහ බැක්ටීරියා මැලවීම පොදු පළිබෝධ හා රෝග වන අතර, නිසි ලෙස පාලනය නොකළහොත් ඒවා අස්වැන්න සහ කරල්වල ගුණාත්මකභාවය බෙහෙවින් අඩු කරයි.
Sweet Corn.overview_ta: இலங்கையில் “ஸ்வீட் கோர்ன்” என அழைக்கப்படும் இனிப்பு மக்காச்சோளம் (Zea mays saccharata), Poaceae குடும்பத்தைச் சேர்ந்த அதிக மதிப்புள்ள தானியக் காய்கறிப் பயிர். வேகமான வளர்ச்சியும் வலுவான சந்தைத் தேவையும் காரணமாக இலங்கை முழுவதும், குறிப்பாக உலர் மற்றும் இடை வலயங்களிலும் சில நீர்ப்பாசன விவசாயப் பகுதிகளிலும் பரவலாகப் பயிரிடப்படுகிறது. இனிப்பு மக்காச்சோளம் 20°C–30°C வெப்பநிலையில் நன்றாக வளரும்; pH 5.5–7.0 உள்ள, நன்கு நீர் வடியும் வளமான இருமண் அல்லது மணல் கலந்த இருமண் தேவை. ஆரோக்கியமான வளர்ச்சி, சரியான கதிர் உருவாக்கம், நல்ல மணி வளர்ச்சி ஆகியவற்றுக்கு மிதமான மழை, தொடர்ச்சியான நீர்ப்பாசனம், முழுச் சூரிய ஒளி அவசியம். இலங்கையில் இனிப்பு மக்காச்சோளம் அவித்த சிற்றுண்டியாகவும், சுட்டும், சாலட் மற்றும் கலப்பு உணவுகளின் பொருளாகவும் பரவலாக உண்ணப்படுகிறது; அதன் இனிப்பு, நார்ச்சத்து, ஊட்டச்சத்து ஆகியவற்றுக்கு மதிப்புண்டு. இனம் மற்றும் சூழல் நிலைமைகளைப் பொறுத்து பொதுவாக முற்றுவதற்குச் சுமார் 65–100 நாட்கள் ஆகும். வெப்பநிலை, மண் ஈரப்பதம், மழை, சூரிய ஒளி, காற்று ஈரப்பதம், மண் வளம் ஆகியவை சாகுபடியைப் பாதிக்கும் முக்கியக் காரணிகள். படைப்புழு, தண்டுத் துளைப்பான், அசுவினி, வெட்டுப்புழு, இலைக் கருகல், துரு நோய், பாக்டீரியா வாடல் ஆகியவை பொதுவான பூச்சிகளும் நோய்களும்; சரியாகக் கட்டுப்படுத்தாவிட்டால் இவை மகசூலையும் கதிர்த் தரத்தையும் பெருமளவு குறைக்கும்.

Sorghum.overview: Sorghum, commonly known in Sri Lanka as “Dura” or “Jowar”, is a drought-tolerant cereal crop belonging to the Poaceae family and scientifically known as Sorghum bicolor. It is mainly cultivated in the dry and intermediate zones of Sri Lanka due to its strong ability to withstand high temperatures and low rainfall conditions. Sorghum grows best in temperatures between 25°C and 35°C and prefers well-drained sandy or loamy soils with a soil pH ranging from 5.5 to 7.5. The crop requires low rainfall, full sunlight exposure, and minimal irrigation, making it suitable for rainfed and marginal agricultural lands. Sorghum is an important cereal used for human consumption, animal feed, and traditional food preparations, and it is valued for its high energy content and nutritional benefits. The crop generally matures within 90 to 120 days after planting depending on the variety and environmental conditions. Important factors affecting sorghum cultivation include temperature, soil moisture, rainfall, sunlight, and soil fertility. Common pests and diseases include shoot fly, stem borer, aphids, grain mold, leaf blight, and rust diseases, which can reduce yield and grain quality if not properly managed.

stages.description: Light preparation — sorghum tolerates difficult conditions.

activities.description: Remove weeds and level.

activities.description_si: වල් පැළ ඉවත් කර සමතලා කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: களைகளை அகற்றிச் சமன்செய்யுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: සෝගම් දුර්වල තත්ත්වවලට ඔරොත්තු දුන්නද හොඳ ආරම්භයක් අස්වැන්න සැලකිය යුතු ලෙස වැඩි කරයි.
activities.why_ta: சோளம் மோசமான நிலைமைகளைத் தாங்கினாலும் நல்ல தொடக்கம் மகசூலைக் கணிசமாக உயர்த்தும்.

stages.description_si: සැහැල්ලු කෙත් සැකසීමක් — සෝගම් දුෂ්කර තත්ත්වවලට ඔරොත්තු දෙයි.
stages.description_ta: எளிய வயல் தயாரிப்பு — சோளம் கடினமான நிலைமைகளைத் தாங்கும்.

stages.name: Sowing

activities.title: Sow 2–3 seeds per hole at 3–4 cm depth
activities.description: Spacing 20×60 cm.
activities.why: Sow at start of rain season for best establishment.
activities.description_si: පරතරය සෙ.මී. 20×60.
activities.why_si: හොඳින් පැළ ස්ථාපිත වීමට වැසි කාලය ආරම්භයේදී වපුරන්න.
activities.why_ta: நன்கு நிலைபெற மழைக்காலத் தொடக்கத்தில் விதையுங்கள்.

activities.title: Thin to 1–2 plants per hole
activities.description: Keep stronger seedlings.
activities.why: Reduces competition while maintaining good stand.
activities.description_si: ශක්තිමත් පැළ තබා ගන්න.
activities.description_ta: வலுவான நாற்றுகளை வைத்துக்கொள்ளுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: හොඳ පැළ ගහනයක් පවත්වා ගනිමින් තරගය අඩු කරයි.
activities.why_ta: நல்ல செடி எண்ணிக்கையைப் பேணிக்கொண்டே போட்டியைக் குறைக்கும்.

stages.description_si: වැසි ආරම්භයේදී වපුරන්න.

stages.name: Vegetative Growth
stages.description: Rapid growth with good nutrient uptake.

activities.title: Weed once at 2–3 WAP
activities.description: Critical weed-free period.
activities.why: Weed competition in first 4 weeks reduces yield by up to 50%.
activities.title_si: සිටුවා සති 2–3දී එක් වරක් වල් නෙළන්න
activities.description_si: වල් පැළ රහිතව තබා ගත යුතු තීරණාත්මක කාලය.
activities.description_ta: களையின்றி வைக்க வேண்டிய முக்கியமான காலம்.
activities.why_si: පළමු සති 4 තුළ වල් පැළ තරගය නිසා අස්වැන්න 50% දක්වා අඩු වේ.
activities.why_ta: முதல் 4 வாரங்களில் களைப் போட்டி மகசூலை 50% வரை குறைக்கும்.

activities.title: Top dressing
activities.description: Urea 75 kg/ha + MOP 50 kg/ha between rows.
activities.why: Sorghum responds well to nitrogen even in poor soils.
activities.description_si: පේළි අතරට යූරියා හෙක්ටයාරයකට කි.ග්‍රෑ. 75 + MOP කි.ග්‍රෑ. 50.
activities.description_ta: வரிசைகளுக்கு இடையே எக்டேருக்கு 75 கி.கி யூரியா + 50 கி.கி MOP.
activities.why_si: දුර්වල පසේ වුවද සෝගම් නයිට්‍රජන්වලට හොඳින් ප්‍රතිචාර දක්වයි.
activities.why_ta: வளமற்ற மண்ணிலும் சோளம் நைட்ரஜனுக்கு நன்றாகப் பதிலளிக்கும்.

stages.description_si: හොඳ පෝෂක අවශෝෂණයක් සමඟ වේගවත් වර්ධනය.

stages.name: Booting & Heading

activities.title: Scout for shoot fly and stem borer
activities.description: Check for dead hearts and stem entry holes.
activities.why: Stem borer at heading reduces grain fill significantly.
activities.title_si: දළු මැස්සා සහ කඳ විදින්නා සඳහා පරීක්ෂා කරන්න
activities.title_ta: குருத்து ஈ மற்றும் தண்டுத் துளைப்பானுக்காக ஆய்வு செய்தல்
activities.description_si: මැරුණු දළු සහ කඳේ ඇතුළු වූ සිදුරු පරීක්ෂා කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: காய்ந்த குருத்துகளையும் தண்டு நுழைவுத் துளைகளையும் சோதியுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: කරල මතු වන කාලයේ කඳ විදින්නා ඇට පිරීම සැලකිය යුතු ලෙස අඩු කරයි.
activities.why_ta: கதிர் வெளிவரும் காலத்தில் தண்டுத் துளைப்பான் மணி நிரம்புதலைக் கணிசமாகக் குறைக்கும்.

activities.title: Irrigate if possible at heading
activities.description: One irrigation at heading if no rain.
activities.why: Even drought-tolerant sorghum benefits from moisture at heading.
activities.title_si: හැකි නම් කරල මතු වන කාලයේ ජලය දෙන්න
activities.title_ta: முடிந்தால் கதிர் வெளிவரும் போது நீர் பாய்ச்சுதல்
activities.description_si: වැසි නැත්නම් කරල මතු වන කාලයේ එක් වරක් ජලය දෙන්න.
activities.description_ta: மழை இல்லையெனில் கதிர் வெளிவரும் போது ஒருமுறை நீர் பாய்ச்சுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: නියඟයට ඔරොත්තු දෙන සෝගම්වලට පවා කරල මතු වන කාලයේ තෙතමනය ප්‍රයෝජනවත් වේ.
activities.why_ta: வறட்சி தாங்கும் சோளத்துக்கும் கதிர் வெளிவரும் போது ஈரப்பதம் நன்மை தரும்.

stages.description_si: කරල (හිස) මතු වී ඇට පිරේ.
stages.name_si: ගැබ් ගැනීම සහ කරල් පිට වීම

stages.name: Harvest

activities.title: Watch for grain mold
activities.description: Check heads for black/pink mold during wet weather.
activities.why: Grain mold is the biggest risk in humid harvesting conditions.
activities.title_si: ඇට පුස් රෝගය ගැන විමසිලිමත් වන්න
activities.description_si: තෙත් කාලගුණයේදී කරල්වල කළු/රෝස පුස් තිබේදැයි පරීක්ෂා කරන්න.
activities.description_ta: ஈரமான வானிலையில் கதிர்களில் கருப்பு/இளஞ்சிவப்புப் பூஞ்சணம் உள்ளதா எனச் சோதியுங்கள்.
activities.why_si: ආර්ද්‍ර අස්වනු කාලයේ ඇති විශාලතම අවදානම ඇට පුස් රෝගයයි.
activities.why_ta: ஈரப்பதமான அறுவடைக் காலத்தில் மிகப்பெரிய ஆபத்து தானியப் பூஞ்சணமே.

activities.title: Harvest when grain is hard
activities.description: Heads turn brown, grain hard and dry.
activities.why: Early harvest when grain is soft increases mold and storage loss.
activities.title_si: ඇට තද වූ විට අස්වනු නෙළන්න
activities.description_si: කරල් දුඹුරු පැහැ වේ, ඇට තද වී වියළේ.
activities.description_ta: கதிர்கள் பழுப்பாகும், மணிகள் கடினமாகிக் காயும்.
activities.why_si: ඇට මෘදුව තිබියදී කලින් අස්වනු නෙළීමෙන් පුස් සහ ගබඩා හානිය වැඩි වේ.
activities.why_ta: மணிகள் மென்மையாக இருக்கும் போதே அறுவடை செய்வது பூஞ்சணத்தையும் சேமிப்பு இழப்பையும் அதிகரிக்கும்.

activities.title: Thresh and dry
activities.description: Cut heads. Thresh by beating. Sun dry 3–5 days.
activities.why: Rapid drying prevents grain mold in storage.
activities.description_si: කරල් කපන්න. තළා ඇට වෙන් කරන්න. දින 3–5ක් අව්වේ වියළන්න.
activities.description_ta: கதிர்களை வெட்டுங்கள். அடித்துப் போரடியுங்கள். 3–5 நாட்கள் வெயிலில் உலர்த்துங்கள்.
activities.why_si: ඉක්මනින් වියළීමෙන් ගබඩාවේදී ඇට පුස් වීම වළකී.
activities.why_ta: விரைவாக உலர்த்துவது சேமிப்பில் தானியப் பூஞ்சணத்தைத் தடுக்கும்.

stages.description_si: ඇට සම්පූර්ණයෙන් මේරූ විට අස්වනු නෙළන්න.

fertilization.why: Base P and K at planting.
fertilization.why_si: සිටුවන විට මූලික P සහ K.
fertilization.why_ta: நடவின் போது அடிப்படை P மற்றும் K.

fertilization.why: Nitrogen and potassium for growth and grain fill.
fertilization.why_si: වර්ධනයට සහ ඇට පිරීමට නයිට්‍රජන් සහ පොටෑසියම්.

irrigation.frequency: Rainfed mainly; 1–2 supplemental irrigations if available
irrigation.notes: Sorghum has a unique ability to pause growth during drought and resume when rain returns. Best drought tolerance of all cereal crops.
irrigation.frequency_si: ප්‍රධාන වශයෙන් වැසි ජලයෙන්; හැකි නම් අතිරේක ජලසම්පාදන 1–2ක්
irrigation.notes_si: නියඟයේදී වර්ධනය නතර කර වැසි ලැබුණු විට නැවත වර්ධනය ඇරඹීමේ සුවිශේෂී හැකියාවක් සෝගම්වලට ඇත. සියලු ධාන්‍ය බෝග අතර හොඳම නියඟ ඔරොත්තු දීමේ හැකියාව මෙයටයි.
irrigation.notes_ta: வறட்சியின் போது வளர்ச்சியை நிறுத்தி மழை வந்ததும் மீண்டும் வளரும் தனித்துவமான திறன் சோளத்துக்கு உண்டு. எல்லாத் தானியப் பயிர்களிலும் சிறந்த வறட்சி தாங்கும் திறன் இதற்கே.

diseases.name: Grain Mold
diseases.symptoms: Pink, grey, or black discolouration of grain at maturity; reduced grain quality and market value.
diseases.favorable_conditions: High humidity during grain maturation, delayed harvest, wet conditions.
diseases.prevention: Early harvest when moisture suitable. Use resistant varieties. Crop rotation.
diseases.treatment: Thiram or Captan seed dressing. Manage harvest timing carefully.
diseases.symptoms_si: මේරීමේදී ඇට රෝස, අළු හෝ කළු පැහැයට හැරීම; ඇටවල ගුණාත්මකභාවය සහ වෙළඳ වටිනාකම අඩු වේ.
diseases.symptoms_ta: முற்றும் போது தானியம் இளஞ்சிவப்பு, சாம்பல் அல்லது கருப்பு நிறமாதல்; தானியத் தரமும் சந்தை மதிப்பும் குறையும்.
diseases.favorable_conditions_si: ඇට මේරෙන කාලයේ අධික ආර්ද්‍රතාව, ප්‍රමාද වූ අස්වනු නෙළීම, තෙත් තත්ත්ව.
diseases.favorable_conditions_ta: மணி முற்றும் காலத்தில் அதிக ஈரப்பதம், தாமதமான அறுவடை, ஈரமான நிலை.
diseases.prevention_si: තෙතමනය සුදුසු වූ විට කලින් අස්වනු නෙළන්න. ඔරොත්තු දෙන ප්‍රභේද භාවිත කරන්න. බෝග මාරුව.
diseases.prevention_ta: ஈரப்பதம் ஏற்றதாக இருக்கும் போது முன்கூட்டியே அறுவடை செய்யுங்கள். எதிர்ப்புள்ள இனங்களைப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள். பயிர்ச் சுழற்சி.
diseases.treatment_si: Thiram හෝ Captan මගින් බීජ ප්‍රතිකාර. අස්වනු නෙළන කාලය ප්‍රවේශමෙන් කළමනාකරණය කරන්න.
diseases.treatment_ta: Thiram அல்லது Captan மூலம் விதை நேர்த்தி. அறுவடை நேரத்தைக் கவனமாக நிர்வகியுங்கள்.

diseases.name: Leaf Blight
diseases.symptoms: Large elongated tan lesions on leaves; reduces photosynthesis.
diseases.favorable_conditions: Humid conditions, dense canopy, moderate temperatures.
diseases.prevention: Good plant spacing. Resistant varieties.
diseases.treatment: Mancozeb 80WP (2.5 g/L) or Propiconazole (1 ml/L) spray.
diseases.symptoms_si: කොළ මත විශාල දිගටි ලා දුඹුරු තුවාල; ප්‍රභාසංශ්ලේෂණය අඩු කරයි.
diseases.symptoms_ta: இலைகளில் பெரிய நீண்ட மங்கிய பழுப்புப் புண்கள்; ஒளிச்சேர்க்கையைக் குறைக்கும்.
diseases.favorable_conditions_si: ආර්ද්‍ර තත්ත්ව, ඝන වියන, මධ්‍යස්ථ උෂ්ණත්වය.
diseases.favorable_conditions_ta: ஈரப்பதமான நிலை, அடர்த்தியான இலைப்பரப்பு, மிதமான வெப்பநிலை.
diseases.prevention_si: හොඳ පැළ පරතරය. ඔරොත්තු දෙන ප්‍රභේද.
diseases.prevention_ta: நல்ல செடி இடைவெளி. எதிர்ப்புள்ள இனங்கள்.
diseases.treatment_si: Mancozeb 80WP (ලීටරයකට ග්‍රෑ. 2.5) හෝ Propiconazole (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 1) ඉසීම.
diseases.treatment_ta: Mancozeb 80WP (லிட்டருக்கு 2.5 கி) அல்லது Propiconazole (லிட்டருக்கு 1 மி.லி) தெளிப்பு.

diseases.name: Rust
diseases.symptoms: Reddish-brown elongated pustules on both leaf surfaces; severe defoliation.
diseases.favorable_conditions: Humid weather, moderate temperatures (20–28°C).
diseases.prevention: Resistant varieties. Good plant spacing.
diseases.treatment: Tebuconazole (1 ml/L) or Mancozeb (2.5 g/L).
diseases.symptoms_si: කොළයේ දෙපැත්තේම රතු-දුඹුරු දිගටි බිබිලි; දැඩි ලෙස කොළ හැලීම.
diseases.symptoms_ta: இலையின் இரு பக்கங்களிலும் செம்பழுப்பு நீண்ட கொப்புளங்கள்; கடும் இலை உதிர்வு.
diseases.favorable_conditions_si: ආර්ද්‍ර කාලගුණය, මධ්‍යස්ථ උෂ්ණත්වය (20–28°C).
diseases.favorable_conditions_ta: ஈரப்பதமான வானிலை, மிதமான வெப்பநிலை (20–28°C).
diseases.prevention_si: ඔරොත්තු දෙන ප්‍රභේද. හොඳ පැළ පරතරය.
diseases.prevention_ta: எதிர்ப்புள்ள இனங்கள். நல்ல செடி இடைவெளி.
diseases.treatment_si: Tebuconazole (ලීටරයකට මි.ලී. 1) හෝ Mancozeb (ලීටරයකට ග්‍රෑ. 2.5).
diseases.treatment_ta: Tebuconazole (லிட்டருக்கு 1 மி.லி) அல்லது Mancozeb (லிட்டருக்கு 2.5 கி).

pests.name: Shoot Fly
pests.damage: Attacks seedlings causing 'dead heart' symptom; reduces plant population.
pests.identification: Withered central shoot of young plant; maggot inside stem base.
pests.prevention: Early sowing. Resistant varieties. Field sanitation.
pests.treatment: Chlorpyrifos granules at sowing or Carbosulfan seed dressing.
pests.prevention_si: කලින් වැපිරීම. ඔරොත්තු දෙන ප්‍රභේද. කෙත පිරිසිදුව තබා ගැනීම.
pests.prevention_ta: முன்கூட்டிய விதைப்பு. எதிர்ப்புள்ள இனங்கள். வயல் சுகாதாரம்.
pests.treatment_si: වපුරන විට Chlorpyrifos කැට හෝ Carbosulfan මගින් බීජ ප්‍රතිකාර.
pests.treatment_ta: விதைக்கும் போது Chlorpyrifos குருணைகள் அல்லது Carbosulfan விதை நேர்த்தி.
pests.damage_si: පැළවලට පහර දී 'මැරුණු දළු' ලක්ෂණය ඇති කරයි; පැළ ගහනය අඩු කරයි.
